entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq reported from Ma'mar, from Abu Harun al-'Abdi, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri, who said that the Messenger of God ﷺ said: “
entries.matn_en: Whoever tells lies about me should prepare for himself a dwelling in the Fire.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: حَدِّثُوا عَنِّي وَلَا حَرَجَ، وَلَكِنْ مَنْ كَذَبَ عَلَيَّ مُتَعَمِّدًا فَلْيَتَبَوَّأْ مَقْعَدَهُ مِنِ النَّارِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq reported from Ma'mar, from al-Hasan, that the Prophet ﷺ said: “
entries.matn_en: Narrate from me; there is no harm in doing so. But whoever deliberately tells a lie about me should take his seat in the Fire.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى قَرْيَةٍ مِنْ قُرَى الْأَنْصَارِ فَقَالَ: إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَرْسَلَنِي إِلَيْكُمْ، وَأَمَرَكُمْ أَنْ تُزَوِّجُونِي فُلَانَةَ، فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ أَهْلِهَا: جَاءَنَا هَذَا بِشَيْءٍ مَا نَعْرِفُهُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، أَنْزِلُوا الرَّجُلَ وَأَكْرِمُوهُ حَتَّى آتِيَكُمْ بِخَبَرِ ذَلِكَ، فَأَتَى النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَذَكَرَ ذَلِكَ لَهُ، فَأَرْسَلَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَلِيًّا، وَالزُّبَيْرَ فَقَالَ: «اذْهَبَا فَإِنْ أدْرَكْتُمَاهُ فَاقْتُلَاهُ، وَلَا أُرَاكُمَا تُدرِكَاهُ» ، قَالَ: فَذَهَبَا فَوَجَدَاهُ قد لَدَغَتْهُ حَيَّةٌ فَقَتَلَتْهُ، فَرَجَعَا إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَأَخْبَرَاهُ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «§مَنْ كَذَبَ عَلَيَّ مُتَعَمِّدًا فَلْيَتَبَوَّأْ مَقْعَدَهُ مِنَ النَّارِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq reported from Ma'mar, from an unnamed man, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr: “
entries.matn_en: A man came to an Ansar village and said, ‘The Messenger of God ﷺ has sent me and ordered you to marry me to a certain woman.’ A man from her family said, ‘This man has come to us with something we do not know to be from the Messenger of God ﷺ. Give him hospitality until I return with news of the matter.’ He went to the Prophet ﷺ and told him. The Prophet ﷺ sent 'Ali and al-Zubayr, saying, ‘Go. If you catch him, kill him, although I do not think you will catch him.’ They went and found that a snake had bitten and killed him. They returned to the Prophet ﷺ and told him; he said, ‘Whoever deliberately lies about me should take his seat in the Fire.’”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ: قَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ:
entries.matn_ar: لَمَّا وَلِيَ عُمَرُ، قَالَ: «§أَقِلُّوا الرِّوَايَةَ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِلَّا فِيمَا يُعْمَلُ بِهِ» قَالَ: ثُمَّ يَقُولُ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ: «أَفَإِنْ كُنْتُ مُحَدِّثَكُمْ بِهَذِهِ الْأَحَادِيثِ وَعُمَرُ حَيٌّ، أَمَا وَاللَّهِ إِذًا لَأَلْفَيتُ الْمِخْفَقَةَ سَتُبَاشِرُ ظَهْرِي»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq reported from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri: “Abu Hurayra said: ‘
entries.matn_en: When 'Umar took office, he said: “Narrate less from the Messenger of God ﷺ, except concerning matters to be acted upon.”’ Abu Hurayra then used to say: ‘If I had narrated these reports to you while 'Umar was alive, by God, I would have found his whip striking my back.’”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كُنْتُ عِنْدَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُغَفَّلٍ فَخَذَفَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ قَوْمِهِ، فَقَالَ: §لَا تَخْذِفْ فَإنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَدْ نَهَى عَنْهُ وَقَالَ: «إِنَّكَ لَا تَصْطَادُ بِهَا صَيْدًا، وَلَا تَقْتُلُ بِهَا عَدُوًّا، وَلَكِنَّهَا تَكْسِرُ السِّنَّ، وَتَفْقَأُ الْعَيْنَ» قَالَ: فَلَمْ يَنْتَهِ الرَّجُلُ فَقَالَ: أُحَدِّثُكَ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَنَّهُ نَهَى عَنْهَا وَلَا تَنْتَهِي لَا أُكَلِّمُكَ كَلِمَةً أَبَدًا
entries.isnad_en: Ma'mar reported from Ayyub, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr: “
entries.matn_en: I was with 'Abd Allah b. Mughaffal when a man of his people flicked a pebble with his fingers. He said, ‘Do not do that; the Messenger of God ﷺ forbade it and said: “You cannot hunt game or kill an enemy with it; it merely breaks a tooth or gouges out an eye.”’ The man did not stop. So he said, ‘I tell you that the Messenger of God ﷺ forbade it, yet you will not stop? I shall never speak another word to you.’”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنَ كَيْسَانَ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ الْجُهَنِيِّ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: لَعَنَ رَجُلٌ دِيكًا صَاحَ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَقَالَ: «§لَا تَلْعَنْهُ، فَإِنَّهُ يَدْعُو لِلصَّلَاةِ»
entries.isnad_en: Ma'mar reported from Salih b. Kaysan, from 'Ubayd God b. 'Abd Allah b. 'Utba, from Zayd b. Khalid al-Juhani: “
entries.matn_en: A man cursed a rooster that crowed in the presence of the Messenger of God ﷺ. He said, ‘Do not curse it, for it calls people to prayer.’”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ مَرْوَانَ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ أُبَيِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ: «إِنَّ §
entries.matn_ar: مِنَ الشِّعْرِ حِكْمَةً»
entries.isnad_en: Ma'mar reported from al-Zuhri, from 'Urwa, from Marwan b. al-Hakam, from 'Abd al-Rahman b. al-Aswad, from Ubayy b. Ka'b, who said: “I heard the Messenger of God ﷺ say, ‘
entries.matn_en: Some poetry contains wisdom.’”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ لِلنَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ أَنْزَلَ فِي الشِّعْرِ مَا أَنْزَلَ، قَالَ: «إِنَّ §
entries.matn_ar: الْمُؤْمِنَ يُجَاهِدُ بِنَفْسِهِ وَلِسَانِهِ، وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ لَكَأَنَّمَا يَرْمُونَ فِيهِمْ بِهِ نَضْحَ النَّبْلِ»
entries.isnad_en: Ma'mar reported from al-Zuhri, from 'Abd al-Rahman b. Ka'b b. Malik, from his father: “He said to the Prophet ﷺ, ‘God has revealed what He revealed concerning poetry.’ He replied: ‘
entries.matn_en: A believer strives with his person and with his tongue. By Him in whose hand my soul is, it is as though they are shooting arrows at them with it.’”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنِ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَهُوَ مُحَاصِرٌ أَهْلَ الطَّائِفِ لِكَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ وَهُوَ إِلَى جَنْبِهِ هِيهِ، يَسْتَنْشِدُهُ فَأَنْشَدَهُ قَصِيدَةً فِيهِمْ يَقُولُ: [البحر الوافر] قَضَيْنَا مِنْ تِهَامَةَ كُلَّ رَيْبٍ ... وَخَيْبَرَ ثُمَّ أَجْمَعْنَا السُّيوفَا نُخَيِّرُهَا وَلَوْ نَطَقَتْ لَقَالَتْ ... قَوَاطِعُهُنَّ دَوْسًا أَوْ ثَقِيفَا فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «§لَهُنَّ أَسْرَعُ فِيهِمْ مِنْ وَقْعِ النَّبْلِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq reported from Ma'mar, from Ayyub, from Ibn Sirin: “
entries.matn_en: While the Messenger of God ﷺ was besieging the people of Ta'if, he said to Ka'b b. Malik, who was beside him, ‘Well then,’ prompting him to recite some poetry. He recited a poem about them: ‘We have settled all our doubts about Tihama, and Khaybar too; then we gathered our swords. If those cutting blades could speak, they would say: Daws or Thaqif!’” The Prophet ﷺ said: “Such verses strike them more quickly than arrows.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنِ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ، أَنَّ
entries.matn_ar: عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ رَوَاحَةَ، وَكَعْبَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، وَحَسَّانَ بْنَ ثَابِتٍ، أَتَوُا النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَقَالُوا: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، لَوْ أَمَرْتَ عَلِيًّا يُجِيبُ هَؤُلَاءِ الَّذِينَ يَهْجُونَكَ وَهُمْ يَعْنُونَ أَبَا سُفْيَانَ بْنَ الْحَارِثِ، وَابْنَ الزِّبَعْرَى، وَالْعَاصَ بْنَ وَائِلٍ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «إِنَّ عَلِيًّا لَيْسَ هُنَالِكَ، وَلَكِنَّ §الْقَوْمَ إِذَا نَصَرُوا نَبِيَّهُمْ بِأَسْيَافِهِمْ فَبِأَلْسنَتِهِمْ أَحَقُّ أَنْ يَنصْرُوهُ» ، فَقَالَ حَسَّانُ: مَا كُنْتُ لِأَنْتصِرَ مِنْكَ إِلَّا هَذَا، وَاللَّهِ مَا أُحِبُّ أَنَّ لِي بِهَا مَقُولًا مَا بَيْنَ بُصْرَى إِلَى صَنْعَاءَ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: [البحر الوافر] لِسَانِي صَارِمٌ لَا عَيْبَ فِيهِ ... وَبَحْرِي مَا تُكَدِّرُهُ الدِّلَاءُ
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq reported from Ma'mar, from Ayyub, from Ibn Sirin: “
entries.matn_en: 'Abd Allah b. Rawaha, Ka'b b. Malik and Hassan b. Thabit came to the Prophet ﷺ and said, ‘Messenger of God, why not command 'Ali to answer those who lampoon you?’ They meant Abu Sufyan b. al-Harith, Ibn al-Ziba'ra and al-'As b. Wa'il. The Prophet ﷺ replied: ‘'Ali is not suited to that, but when people defend their Prophet with their swords, they are still more entitled to defend him with their tongues.’ Hassan said: ‘I needed nothing further than this in defending you. By God, I would not exchange it for power of speech across all the land from Busra to San'a'.’ Then he recited: ‘My tongue is a sharp sword without a flaw, and my sea cannot be muddied by buckets.’”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «§
entries.matn_ar: لَأَنْ يَمْتَلِئَ جَوْفُ أَحَدِكُمْ قَيْحًا خَيْرٌ لَهُ مِنْ أَنْ يَمْتَلِئَ شِعْرًا، فَإِذَا سَمِعْتُمُوهُ يُنْشِدُ فَاحْثُوا فِي وَجْهِهِ التُّرَابَ» قَالَ مَعْمَرٌ: وَسَمِعْتُ الزُّهْرِيَّ، وَقَتَادَةَ «يُنْشِدَانِ الشِّعْرَ» ، قَالَ: «وَكَانَ الْحَسَنُ لَا يَفْعَلُ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq reported from Ma'mar, from Ibn Tawus, from his father, who said that the Messenger of God ﷺ said: “It would be better for a man's
entries.matn_en: belly to be filled with pus than to be filled with poetry. If you hear someone reciting it, throw dust in his face.” Ma'mar added: “Yet I heard both al-Zuhri and Qatada reciting poetry, whereas al-Hasan did not do that.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، «
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ، كَانَ رُبَّمَا §يَتَمَثَّلُ بِالْبَيْتِ مِنَ الشِّعْرِ مِمَّا كَانَ فِي وَقَائِعِ الْعَرَبِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq reported from Ma'mar, from Qatada: “
entries.matn_en: Ibn Mas'ud would sometimes quote a verse of poetry from the historical battles of the Arabs.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي سَفَرٍ، فَنَزَلَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ فَرَجَزَ بِهِمْ، فَقَالَ: [البحر الرجز] لَمْ يَغْذُهَا مُدٌّ وَلَا نَصِيفُ ... وَلَا تُمَيْرَاتٌ وَلَا رَغِيفُ لَكِنْ غَذَاهَا اللَّبَنُ الْخَرِيفُ ... الْمَخْضُ والْقَارِصُ وَالصَّرِيفُ لَكِنْ غَذَاهَا الْحَنْظَلُ النَّقِيفُ ... وَمِذْقَةٌ كَطُرَّةِ الْخَنِيفِ تَبِيتُ بَيْنَ الزَّرْبِ وَالْكَنِيفِ قَالَ: «§فَخَافَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَنْ يَكُونَ بَيْنَهُمَا شَرٌّ، فَأَمَرَهُمَا فَرَكِبَا» ، وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو حَمْزَةَ الثُّمَالِيُّ بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِ هِشَامٍ وَزَادَ فِيهِ: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَطَفَ نَاقَتَهُ وَأَمَرَهُمَا فَرَكِبَا
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq reported from Ma'mar, from Hisham b. 'Urwa, from his father: “
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ was traveling when one of the Emigrants dismounted and chanted rajaz verse at the others: ‘Neither a mudd nor half a mudd has nourished her; neither a few dates nor a loaf. Rather, the milk of autumn has nourished her: buttermilk, sour milk and fresh milk. Rather, the cracked colocynth nourished her, and a thin drink like the edge of a rough garment; she spends the night between a pen and a latrine.’” The Prophet ﷺ feared that trouble might arise between the men, so he instructed both to mount their animals. Ma'mar added: “Abu Hamza al-Thumali related a similar account, adding that the Prophet ﷺ turned his she-camel around and ordered both men to mount.” [Some expressions in the transmitted poem are uncertain.]

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ، قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: إِنِّي لَأَبْغَضُ الْغِنَاءَ وَأُحِبُّ الرَّجَزَ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq reported from Ma'mar, from Yahya b. Sa'id, from Ibn al-Musayyib: “
entries.matn_en: I detest singing, but I like rajaz poetry.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ: بَلَغَنَا أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ
entries.matn_ar: كَانَتْ تَدْعُو كُلَّ مَنْ كَانَ يَقُولُ: إِنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ كَانَ يَقُولُ الشِّعْرَ، «§فَوَاللَّهِ مَا قَالَ بَيْتَ شِعْرٍ فِي جَاهِلِيَّةٍ وَلَا إِسْلَامٍ، وَلَقَدْ تَرَكَ هُوَ وَعُثْمَانُ الْخَمْرَ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ، أَفَهُوَ يَشْرَبُ الْخَمْرَ فِي الْإِسْلَامِ؟ أَوَهُوَ يَقُولُ؟»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq reported from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri: “We heard that
entries.matn_en: 'A'isha used to challenge anyone who claimed that Abu Bakr composed poetry: ‘By God, he never composed a line of poetry, whether before Islam or after it. He and 'Uthman abandoned wine even in the pre-Islamic period. Would he then drink wine under Islam? Or compose poetry?’”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْجَحْشِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ بَعْضِ أَشْيَاخِهِ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ، قِيلَ لَهُ: هَذَا §
entries.matn_ar: غُلَامُ بَنِي فُلَانٍ شَاعِرٌ، قَالَ: فَقَالَ لَهُ: «كَيْفَ تَقُولُ؟» قَالَ: [البحر الطويل] أُوَدِّعُ سَلْمَى إِنْ تَجَهَّزْتُ غَازِيًا ... كَفَى الشَّيْبُ وَالْإِسْلَامُ لِلْمَرْءِ نَاهِيَا، قَالَ عُمَرُ: «صَدَقْتَ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq reported from Ma'mar, from Sa'id ibn 'Abd al-Rahman al-Jahshi, from Abu Bakr b. Muhammad b. 'Amr, from one of his teachers: “'Umar b. al-Khattab was told, ‘
entries.matn_en: A young man of such-and-such a clan is a poet.’ 'Umar asked him, ‘What do you say?’ He recited: ‘I bid Salma farewell when I prepare to go on campaign; gray hair and Islam suffice to restrain a man.’ 'Umar replied, ‘You have spoken truthfully.’”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ حَسَّانَ بْنَ ثَابِتٍ كَانَ فِي حَلْقَةٍ فِيهِمْ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ فَقَالَ: أَنْشُدُكَ اللَّهَ يَا أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، أَسَمِعْتَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ: «§أَجِبْ عَنِّي، أَيَّدَكَ اللَّهُ بِرُوحِ الْقُدُسِ» فَقَالَ: اللَّهُمَّ نَعَمْ
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq reported from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, from Ibn al-Musayyib: “
entries.matn_en: Hassan b. Thabit was sitting in a gathering that included Abu Hurayra and said: ‘I ask you by God, Abu Hurayra, did you hear the Messenger of God ﷺ say, “Answer on my behalf; may God support you with the Holy Spirit”?’ He replied, ‘O God, yes.’”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: أَنْشَدَ حَسَّانُ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ قَالَ: فَمَرَّ بِهِ عُمَرُ فَلَحَظَهُ فَقَالَ: أَفِي الْمَسْجِدِ أَفِي الْمَسْجِدِ؟ قَالَ: «وَاللَّهِ لَقَدْ §أَنْشَدْتُ فِيهِ مَعَ مَنْ هُوَ خَيْرٌ مِنْكَ» قَالَ: فَخَشِيَ أَنْ يَرْمِيَهُ بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَأَجَازَ وَتَرَكَهُ
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq reported from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, from Ibn al-Musayyib: “
entries.matn_en: Hassan recited poetry in the mosque. 'Umar passed him and gave him a disapproving look, saying, ‘In the mosque? In the mosque?’ Hassan replied, ‘By God, I recited it here in the company of one better than you.’ Fearing that Hassan would invoke the Messenger of God ﷺ against him, 'Umar let him continue and left.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَر، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: لَمَّا أُهْبِطَ إِبْلِيسُ قَالَ: أَيْ رَبِّ، قَدْ لَعَنْتَهُ فَمَا عَمَلُهُ؟ قَالَ: السِّحْرُ، قَالَ: فَمَا قِرَاءَتُهُ؟ قَالَ: الشِّعْرُ، قَالَ: فَمَا كِتَابُهُ؟ قَالَ: الْوَشْمُ، قَالَ: فَمَا طَعَامُهُ؟ قَالَ: كُلُّ مَيْتَةٍ وَمَا لَمْ يُذْكَرِ اسْمُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ، قَالَ: فَمَا شَرَابُهُ؟ قَالَ: كُلُّ مُسْكِرٍ، قَالَ: فَأَيْنَ مَسْكَنُهُ؟ قَالَ: الْحَمَّامُ، قَالَ: فَأَيْنَ مَجْلِسُهُ؟ قَالَ: الْأَسْوَاقُ، قَالَ: فَمَا صَوْتُهُ؟ قَالَ: الْمِزْمَارُ، قَالَ: فَمَا مَصَايِدُهُ؟ قَالَ: النِّسَاءُ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq reported from Ma'mar, from Qatada: “
entries.matn_en: When Iblis was cast down, he asked, ‘My Lord, You have cursed him; what is his occupation?’ He said, ‘Sorcery.’ He asked, ‘What is his recitation?’ He said, ‘Poetry.’ ‘What is his scripture?’ ‘Tattooing.’ ‘What is his food?’ ‘Every carcass and whatever is slaughtered without God's name being mentioned.’ ‘What is his drink?’ ‘Every intoxicant.’ ‘Where is his residence?’ ‘The bathhouse.’ ‘Where is his place of assembly?’ ‘The markets.’ ‘What is his voice?’ ‘The flute.’ ‘What are his traps?’ ‘Women.’” [The dialogue's pronouns are presented as in the source.]

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَر، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَجُلًا قَالَ لِلنَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِنِّي لَأُحِبُّ الْجَمَالَ حَتَّى إِنِّي لَأُحِبُّهُ فِي شِرَاكِ نَعْلِي وَعَلَاقَةِ سَوْطِي، فَهَلْ تَخْشَى عَلَيَّ الْكِبْرَ؟ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «فَكَيْفَ تَجِدُ قَلْبَكَ؟» ، قَالَ: عَارِفًا لِلْحَقِّ مُطْمَئِنًّا إِلَيْهِ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «لَيْسَ الْكِبْرُ هُنَالِكَ، وَلَكِنَّ §الْكِبْرَ أَنْ تَغْمِطَ النَّاسَ، وَتَبْطَرَ الْحَقَّ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq reported from Ma'mar, from Qatada: “
entries.matn_en: A man said to the Prophet ﷺ: ‘I love beautiful things, even in the straps of my sandals and the loop of my whip. Do you fear I have arrogance?’ The Prophet ﷺ asked, ‘How do you find your heart?’ He replied, ‘Recognizing the truth and at peace with it.’ The Prophet ﷺ said, ‘That is not arrogance. Arrogance is looking down on people and rejecting the truth.’”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ أَبِي الْأَحْوَصِ الْجُشَمِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: رَآنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَلَيَّ أَطْمَارٌ، فَقَالَ: «هَلْ لَكَ مَالٌ؟» ، قُلْتُ: نَعَمْ، قَالَ: «مِنْ أَيِّ الْمَالِ؟» ، قَالَ: مِنْ كُلٍّ قَدْ آتَانِي اللَّهُ، مِنَ الشَّاءِ وَالْإِبِلِ، قَالَ: «§فَتَرَى نِعْمَةَ اللَّهِ وَكَرَامَتَهُ عَلَيْكَ» ، ثُمَّ قَالَ لَهُ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «هَلْ تُنْتِجُ إِبِلُكَ وَافِيَةً آذَانُهَا؟» ، قَالَ: وَهَلْ تُنْتِجُ إِلَّا كَذَلِكَ؟ - وَلَمْ يَكُنْ أَسْلَمَ يَوْمَئِذٍ - قَالَ: «فَلَعَلَّكَ تَأْخُذُ مُوسَاكَ فَتَقْطَعُ أُذُنَ بَعْضِهَا، تَقُولُ هَذِهِ بُحُرٌ، وَتَشُقُّ أُذُنَ أُخْرَى فَتَقُولُ هَذِهِ صُرُمٌ» قَالَ: نَعَمْ، قَالَ: «فَلَا تَفْعَلْ، فَإنَّ كُلَّ مَالٍ آتَاكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ حِلٌّ، وَإِنَّ مُوسَى اللَّهِ أَحَدُّ، وَسَاعِدُ اللَّهِ أَشَدُّ» ، قَالَ: فَقَالَ: يَا مُحَمَّدُ، أَرَأَيْتَ إِنْ مَرَرْتُ بِرَجُلٍ فَلَمْ يَقْرِنِي وَلَمْ يُضَيِّفْنِي، ثُمَّ مَرَّ بِي بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ أَقْرِيهِ أَمْ أَجْزِيهِ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «بَلِ، اقْرِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq reported from Ma'mar, from Abu Ishaq, from Abu al-Ahwas al-Jushami, from his father: “
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ saw me in shabby clothing and asked, ‘Do you have wealth?’ I said, ‘Yes.’ He asked, ‘Of what sort?’ I replied, ‘God has given me every kind, including sheep and camels.’ He said, ‘Then let God's favor and generosity toward you be seen.’ He asked, ‘Are your camels born with their ears intact?’ I replied, ‘Are they born any other way?’—I had not yet embraced Islam at the time. He said, ‘But perhaps you take your knife and cut the ear of one, saying: This one is set free [bahira]; and slit the ear of another, saying: This one is dedicated [surum].’ I said, ‘Yes.’ He replied, ‘Do not do that. Whatever property God has given you is lawful to you. God's knife is sharper and God's arm stronger.’ I said, ‘Muhammad, suppose I pass a man and he neither entertains me nor grants me hospitality, then he later passes by me: should I entertain him or treat him as he treated me?’ The Prophet ﷺ answered, ‘Rather, entertain him.’”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: رَأَى النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ رَجُلًا وَعَلَيْهِ أَطْمَارٌ قَالَ: فَدَعَاهُ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَقَالَ: «هَلْ لَكَ مَالٌ؟» ، قَالَ: نَعَمْ، قَالَ: «§فَكُلْ وَاشْرَبْ، وَتَصَدَّقْ وَالْبَسْ، فَإنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ أَنْ تُرَى نِعْمَتُهُ عَلَى عَبْدِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Ma'mar reported from Qatada: “
entries.matn_en: The Prophet ﷺ saw a man in worn clothing, summoned him and asked, ‘Do you have property?’ He said, ‘Yes.’ The Prophet ﷺ said, ‘Eat and drink, give charity, and wear good clothing; God loves to see His favor upon His servant.’”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: أَحَلَّ اللَّهُ الْأَكْلَ وَالشُّرْبَ مَا لَمْ يَكُنْ سَرَفًا أَوْ مَخِيلَةً»
entries.isnad_en: Ma'mar reported from Ibn Tawus, from his father, from Ibn 'Abbas: “
entries.matn_en: God has permitted eating and drinking so long as there is no extravagance or conceit.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْجَحْشِيِّ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ لِأَبِي قَتَادَةَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: إِنِ اتَّخَذْتَ شَعْرًا فَأَكْرِمْهُ» ، قَالَ: «وَكَانَ أَبُو قَتَادَةَ - حَسِبْتُ - يُرَجِّلُهُ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ مَرَّتَيْنِ»
entries.isnad_en: Ma'mar reported from Sa'id ibn 'Abd al-Rahman al-Jahshi that the Prophet ﷺ said to Abu Qatada: “
entries.matn_en: If you grow your hair long, then take good care of it.” The transmitter added, “I think Abu Qatada used to comb it twice every day.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنِ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: فَزِعَ النَّاسُ عَلَى عَهْدِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَأَبْطَأَ أَبُو قَتَادَةَ، فَقَالَ لَهُ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «مَا حَبَسَكَ؟» ، قَالَ: رَأْسِي كُنْتُ أُرَجِّلُهُ، قَالَ: §فَأَمَرَ بِرَأْسِهِ أَنْ يُحْلَقَ، فَقَالَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، دَعْهُ لِي - أَوْ هَبْهُ لِي - فَوَاللَّهِ لَأُعْتِبَنَّكَ، قَالَ: فَتَرَكَهُ، فَلَمَّا لَقُوا الْعَدُوَّ كَانَ أَوَّلَ النَّاسِ حَمَلَ، فَقَتَلَ مَسْعَدَةَ قَالَ: وَلَا أَعْلَمُ رَجُلًا مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ كَانَ أَشَدَّ عَلَى الْمُسْلِمِينَ مِنْهُ
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq reported from Ma'mar, from Ayyub, from Ibn Sirin: “
entries.matn_en: The people were alarmed during the lifetime of the Prophet ﷺ, but Abu Qatada was slow to respond. The Prophet ﷺ asked him, ‘What held you back?’ He replied, ‘My hair—I was combing it.’ The Prophet ﷺ ordered his head to be shaved. Abu Qatada said, ‘Messenger of God, leave it to me—or grant me this—for by God I will make amends to your satisfaction.’ He let him keep it. When they encountered the enemy, Abu Qatada was the first to charge and killed Mas'ada. I know of no polytheist who was harder upon the Muslims than he was.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: لَمَّا قَدِمَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ الْمَدِينَةَ وَجَدَ أَهْلَ الْكِتَابِ يَسْدِلُونَ الشَّعْرَ، وَوَجَدَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ يَفْرُقُونَ، «وَكَانَ إِذَا شَكَّ فِي أَمْرٍ لَمْ يُؤْمَرْ فِيهِ بِشَيْءٍ صَنَعَ مَا يَصْنَعُ أَهْلُ الْكِتَابِ، فَسَدَلَ، ثُمَّ §أَمَرَ بِالْفَرْقِ، فَفَرَقَ فَكَانَ الْفَرْقُ آخِرَ الْأَمْرَيْنِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq reported from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, from 'Ubayd God b. 'Abd Allah b. 'Utba: “
entries.matn_en: When the Prophet ﷺ reached Medina, he found the People of the Book letting their hair hang down without a part, whereas the polytheists parted theirs. When he was uncertain about a matter on which no command had been given, he followed the People of the Book. Accordingly he let his hair hang down, but afterward was commanded to part it. He parted it; parting was the later of the two practices.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ الْبُنَانِيِّ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ: «كَانَ §
entries.matn_ar: شَعْرُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِلَى أَنْصَافِ أُذُنَيْهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Ma'mar reported from Thabit al-Bunani, from Anas: “The Messenger of God's ﷺ
entries.matn_en: hair reached halfway down his ears.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ، قَالَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، أَمِنَ الْكِبْرِ أَنْ أسْتَتْبِعَ أَصْحَابِي إِلَى بَيْتِي فَأُطْعِمَهُمْ؟ قَالَ: «لَا» ، قَالَ: أَفَمِنَ الْكِبْرِ أَنْ يَكُونَ لِأَحَدِنَا رَاحِلَةٌ يَرْكَبُهَا؟ قَالَ: «لَا» ، قَالَ: أَفَمِنَ الْكِبْرِ أَنْ يَكُونَ لِأَحَدِنَا حُلَّةٌ يَلْبَسُهَا؟ قَالَ: «لَا، وَلَكِنَّ §الْكِبْرَ يَا عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَمْرٍو أَنْ تُسَفِّهَ الْحَقَّ، وَتَغْمِطَ النَّاسَ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq reported from Ma'mar, from Zayd b. Aslam, that
entries.matn_en: 'Abd Allah b. 'Amr b. al-'As asked the Messenger of God ﷺ: “Is it arrogant of me to bring my companions home and feed them?” He replied, “No.” “Is it arrogant for one of us to have a riding animal?” “No.” “Is it arrogant for one of us to have a suit of fine clothing?” “No. Rather, 'Abd Allah b. 'Amr, arrogance is treating the truth as foolish and despising people.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي أَيُّوبُ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَجُلًا أَثْنَى عَلَى رَجُلٍ عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ خَيْرًا، فَقَالَ لَهُ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «§قَطَعْتَ عُنُقَهُ، لَوْ سَمِعَكَ تَقُولُ هَذَا مَا أَفْلَحَ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq reported from Ma'mar, from Qatada, who said that Ayyub related to him from al-Hasan: “
entries.matn_en: A man praised another man excessively in the Prophet's ﷺ presence. The Prophet ﷺ said, ‘You have broken his neck! If he heard you say this, he would never prosper.’”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَجُلًا قَالَ لِلنَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَا خَيْرَ النَّاسِ وَابْنَ سَيِّدِنَا، فَقَالَ: «يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ §قُولُوا كَقْولِكُمْ، وَلَا تَسْتَهْوِيَنَّكُمُ الشَّيَاطِينُ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq reported from Ma'mar, from al-Hasan: “
entries.matn_en: A man said to the Prophet ﷺ, ‘O best of people and son of our master.’ He replied, ‘People, speak as you normally speak, and do not let the devils lead you astray.’”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، أَوْ غَيْرِهِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَجُلًا قَالَ لِابْنِ عُمَرَ: يَا خَيْرَ النَّاسِ وَابْنَ خَيْرِ النَّاسِ، قَالَ: «§لَسْتُ بِخَيْرِ النَّاسِ، وَلَكِنِّي مِنْ عِبَادِ اللَّهِ، أَرْجُو اللَّهَ وَأخَافُهُ، وَاللَّهِ لَنْ تَزَالُوا بِالرَّجُلِ حَتَّى تُهْلِكُوهُ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq reported from Ma'mar, from Ayyub, from Nafi' or another person: “
entries.matn_en: A man said to Ibn 'Umar, ‘O best of people, son of the best of people!’ He said, ‘I am not the best of people. I am merely one of God's servants who hopes in Him and fears Him. By God, you will continue praising a man until you destroy him.’”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: لَا تُطْرُونِي كَمَا أَطْرَتِ النَّصَارَى عِيسَى ابْنَ مَرْيَمَ، فَإِنَّمَا أَنَا عَبْدُهُ فَقُولُوا: عَبْدُ اللَّهِ وَرَسُولُهُ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq reported from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, from 'Ubayd God b. 'Abd Allah, from Ibn 'Abbas, from 'Umar b. al-Khattab, that the Messenger of God ﷺ said: “
entries.matn_en: Do not exaggerate in praising me as Christians exaggerated in praising Jesus son of Mary. I am only His servant, so say: ‘God's servant and His Messenger.’”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ لَيْثٍ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: مَا أَحَدٌ أُزَكِّيهِ إِلَّا النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq reported from Ma'mar, from Layth, from Tawus, from Ibn 'Abbas: “
entries.matn_en: I declare no one to be pure except the Prophet ﷺ.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي رَبِيعَةَ الصَّنْعَانِيُّ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ عَطَاءَ بْنَ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ يَقُولُ: {§
entries.matn_ar: وَكَانَ فِي الْمَدِينَةِ تِسْعَةُ رَهْطٍ يُفْسِدُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا يُصْلِحُونَ} [النمل: ٤٨] ، قَالَ: «كَانُوا يُقْرِضُونَ الدَّرَاهِمَ»
entries.isnad_en: Ma'mar said: Yahya b. Abi Rabi'a al-San'ani told us that he heard 'Ata' b. Abi Rabah recite: “
entries.matn_en: There were in the city nine men who spread corruption in the land and did not reform” (Quran 27:48). He explained: “They used to clip coins [fraudulently shave silver dirhams].”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: حَقُّ الضِّيَافَةِ ثَلَاثَةُ أَيَّامٍ، فَمَا زَادَ عَلَى ذَلِكَ فَهُوَ صَدَقَةٌ»
entries.isnad_en: Ma'mar reported from al-Zuhri that the Messenger of God ﷺ said: “The guest's
entries.matn_en: right to hospitality lasts three days. Whatever is given beyond that is charity.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ الْجُرَيْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «§
entries.matn_ar: حَقُّ الضِّيَافَةِ ثَلَاثَةٌ، وَمَا سِوَى ذَلِكَ صَدَقَةٌ»
entries.isnad_en: Ma'mar reported from Sa'id al-Jurayri, from Abu Nadra, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri, who said that the Messenger of God ﷺ said: “
entries.matn_en: The right of hospitality is three [days]; anything beyond that is charity.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الْعَيْزَارِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ أَتَاهُ الْأَعْرَابُ فَقَالُوا: إِنَّا نُقِيمُ الصَّلَاةَ، وَنُؤتِي الزَّكَاةَ، وَنَحُجُّ الْبَيْتَ، وَنَصُومُ رَمَضَانَ، وَإِنَّ نَاسًا مِنَ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ يَقُولُونَ: لَسْنَا عَلَى شَيْءٍ، فَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ: «§مَنْ أَقَامَ الصَّلَاةَ، وَآتَى الزَّكَاةَ، وَحَجَّ الْبَيْتَ، وَصَامَ رَمَضَانَ، وَقَرَى الضَّيْفَ، دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq reported from Ma'mar, from Abu Ishaq, from al-'Ayzar: “
entries.matn_en: Some Bedouins came to Ibn 'Abbas and said, ‘We perform prayer, give the alms, make pilgrimage to the House, and fast during Ramadan, but certain Emigrants say that we count for nothing.’ Ibn 'Abbas replied, ‘Whoever performs prayer, gives alms, makes pilgrimage to the House, fasts during Ramadan and entertains guests will enter Paradise.’”

sections.title_en: Moses and the Angel of Death

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: أُرْسِلَ مَلَكُ الْمَوْتِ إِلَى مُوسَى، فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُ صَكَّهُ فَفَقَأَ عَيْنَهُ، فَرَجَعَ إِلَى رَبِّهِ، فَقَالَ: أَرْسَلْتَنِي إِلَى عَبْدٍ لَا يُرِيدُ الْمَوْتَ، قَالَ: فَرَدَّ اللَّهُ عَيْنَهُ، فَقَالَ: §ارْجِعْ إِلَيْهِ فَقُلْ لَهُ: يَضَعُ يَدَهُ عَلَى مَتْنِ ثَوْرٍ فَلَهُ مَا غَطَّتْ يَدُهُ بِكُلِّ شَعْرَةٍ سَنَةٌ، فَقَالَ: أَيْ رَبِّ، ثُمَّ مَهْ؟ قَالَ: ثُمَّ الْمَوْتُ، قَالَ: فَالْآنَ، فَسَأَلَ اللَّهَ أَنْ يُدْنِيَهُ مِنَ الْأَرْضِ الْمُقَدَّسَةِ رَمْيَةً بِحَجَرٍ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ لَوْ كُنْتُ ثَمَّ لَأَرْيتُكُمْ قَبْرَهُ إِلَى جَنْبِ الطَّرِيقِ تَحْتَ الْكَثِيبِ الْأَحْمَرِ» .
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq reported from Ma'mar, from Ibn Tawus, from his father, from Abu Hurayra, from the Prophet ﷺ: “
entries.matn_en: The Angel of Death was sent to Moses. When he came to him, Moses struck him and knocked out his eye. The angel returned to his Lord and said, ‘You sent me to a servant who does not wish to die.’ God restored his eye and said, ‘Return and tell him to place his hand upon the back of an ox. For every hair his hand covers he shall have a year.’ Moses asked, ‘Lord, and after that?’ He replied, ‘Then death.’ Moses said, ‘Then now.’ He asked God to bring him within a stone's throw of the Holy Land. The Messenger of God ﷺ said: ‘If I were there, I could show you his grave beside the road, beneath the red sandhill.’”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: ٢٠٥٣١ قَالَ مَعْمَرٌ: وَأَخْبَرَنَا
entries.matn_ar: هَمَّامٌ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، مِثْلَهُ.،
entries.isnad_en: Ma'mar said: “
entries.matn_en: Hammam also related to us, from Abu Hurayra, the same account.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَمَّنْ سَمِعَ الْحَسَنَ، يُحَدِّثُ
entries.matn_ar: مِثْلَهُ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq reported from Ma'mar, from someone who heard al-Hasan transmit
entries.matn_en: the same report from the Prophet ﷺ.

sections.title_en: The Account of Adam and Iblīs

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ، قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَمَّا لَعَنَ إِبْلِيسَ سَأَلَهُ النَّظِرَةَ فَأَنْظَرَهُ، فَقَالَ: وَعِزَّتِكَ لَا أَخْرُجُ مِنْ صَدْرِ عَبْدِكَ حَتَّى تَخْرُجَ نَفْسُهُ، فَقَالَ: §وَعِزِّتِي لَا أَحْجُبُ تَوْبَتِي مِنْ عَبْدِي حَتَّى تَخْرُجَ نَفْسُهُ - أَوْ قَالَ: رُوحُهُ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq reported from Ma'mar, from Ayyub, from Abu Qilaba: “
entries.matn_en: When God cursed Iblis, Iblis asked to be granted respite and was granted it. He said, ‘By Your might, I shall not depart from Your servant's breast until his soul departs.’ God said, ‘By My might, I shall not withhold repentance from My servant until his soul—or,’ the transmitter said, ‘his spirit—departs.’”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي سَالِمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ: أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: صَلَّى بِنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ ذَاتَ لَيْلَةٍ صَلَاةَ الْعِشَاءَ - فِي آخِرِ حَيَاتِهِ -، فَلَمَّا سَلَّمَ قَامَ: فَقَالَ: «§أَرَأَيْتُكُمْ لَيْلَتَكُمْ، فَإنَّ عَلَى رَأْسِ مِائَةِ سَنَةٍ مِنْهَا لَا يَبْقَى مِمَّنْ هُوَ عَلَى ظَهْرِ الْأَرْضِ أَحَدٌ» قَالَ: ابْنُ عُمَرَ: فَوَهَلَ النَّاسُ فِي مَقَالَةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِيمَا يَتَحَدَّثُونَ مِنْ هَذِهِ الْأَحَادِيثِ عَنْ مِائَةِ سَنَةٍ، وَإِنَّمَا قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «لَا يَبْقَى مِمَّنْ هُوَ الْيَوْمَ عَلَى ظَهْرِ الْأَرْضِ أَحَدٌ» ، يُرِيدُ بِذَلِكَ أَنْ يَنْخَرِمَ ذَلِكَ الْقَرْنُ
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq reported from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, who said that Salim b. 'Abd Allah and Abu Bakr b. Sulayman informed him that 'Abd Allah b. 'Umar said: “
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ led us one night in the night prayer near the end of his life. After concluding he rose and said, ‘Consider this night of yours: after one hundred years from it, not a single person now living on the face of the earth will remain.’” Ibn 'Umar said: “The people misunderstood this saying in their discussion of reports about one hundred years. The Prophet ﷺ meant that none of those living on the earth today would remain—meaning that generation would come to an end.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، وَقَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: نَظَرَ بَعْضُ أَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَضُوءًا فَلَمْ يَجِدْهُ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «هَاهُنَا مَاءٌ؟» فَرَأَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَضَعَ يَدَهُ فِي الْإِنَاءِ الَّذِي فِيهِ الْمَاءُ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: «§تَوَضَّأْ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ» ، فَرَأَيْتُ الْمَاءَ يَفُورُ مِنْ بَيْنِ أَصَابِعِهِ، وَالْقَوْمُ يَتَوَضَّئُونَ، حَتَّى تَوَضَّئُوا مِنْ عِنْدِ آخِرِهِمْ، قَالَ ثَابِتٌ: فَقُلْتُ لِأَنَسٍ كَمْ تُرَاهُمْ كَانُوا؟ قَالَ: نَحْوًا مِنْ سَبْعِينَ رَجُلًا .
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq reported from Ma'mar, from Thabit and Qatada, from Anas: “
entries.matn_en: Some Companions of the Prophet ﷺ looked for water for ablution and could find none. The Prophet ﷺ asked, ‘Is there any water here?’ I saw him place his hand in a vessel that held water and say, ‘Perform ablution in God's name.’ Water gushed from between his fingers while the people performed ablution, until the last of them had finished.” Thabit asked Anas, “How many were there, in your estimation?” He replied, “About seventy men.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ، عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ مُسْلِمِ بْنِ صُبَيْحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، وَأَبِي سَعِيدٍ
entries.matn_ar: مِثْلَهُ
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq reported through al-A'mash, from Muslim b. Subayh, from Abu Hurayra and Abu Sa'id,
entries.matn_en: a report with the same meaning as the preceding account. [The source has an incomplete transmission link before al-A'mash.]

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ عَوْفٍ، عَنْ أَبِي رَجَاءٍ الْعُطَارِدِيِّ، عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ الْحُصَيْنِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي سَفَرٍ هُوَ وَأَصْحَابُهُ فَأَصَابَهُمْ عَطَشٌ شَدِيدٌ، فَأَرْسَلَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ رَجُلَيْنِ مِنْ أَصْحَابِهِ - عَلِيٌّ وَالزُّبَيْرُ أَوْ غَيْرُهُمَا - فَقَالَ: «§إِنَّكُمَا سَتَجِدَانِ امْرَأَةً فِي مَكَانِ كَذَا وَكَذَا مَعَهَا بَعِيرٌ عَلَيْهِ مَزَادَتَانِ، فَأْتِيَا بِهَا» ، فَأَتَيَا الْمَرْأَةَ، فَوجَدَاهَا قَدْ رَكِبَتْ بين مزادتيها عَلَى الْبَعِيرِ، فَقَالَا لَهَا: أَجِيبِي رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَتْ: مَنْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ؟ أَهَذَا الصَّابِئُ؟ قَالَا: هَذَا الَّذِي تَعْنِينَ وَهُوَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ حَقًّا، فَجَاءَا بِهَا، فَأَمَرَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَجَعَلَ فِي إِنَاءٍ مِنْ مُزَادَتَيْهَا شَيْئًا، ثُمَّ قَالَ مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ أَنْ يَقُولَ، ثُمَّ أَعَادَ الْمَاءَ فِي الْمَزَادَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ أَمَرَ بِعُرَى الْمَزَادَتَيْنِ فَفُتِحَتْ، ثُمَّ أَمَرَ النَّاسَ فَمَلَئُوا آنِيَتَهُمْ وَأسْقِيتَهُمْ، فَلَمْ يَدَعُوا إِنَاءً وَلَا سِقَاءً إِلَّا مَلَئُوهُ، فَقَالَ عِمْرَانُ: فَكَانَ يُخَيَّلُ إِلَيَّ أَنَّهُمَا لَمْ يَزْدَادَا إِلَّا امْتِلَاءً، قَالَ: فَأَمَرَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِثَوْبِهَا فَبُسِطَ، ثُمَّ أَصْحَابَهُ، فَجَاءُوا مِنْ أَزْوَادِهِمْ حَتَّى مَلَأَ لَهَا ثَوْبَهَا، ثُمَّ قَالَ: «اذْهَبِي فَإِنَّا لَمْ نَأْخُذْ مِنْ مَائِكَ شَيْئًا، وَلَكِنَّ اللَّهَ سَقَانَا» ، فَجَاءَتْ أَهْلَهَا، فَأَخْبَرَتْهُمْ، فَقَالَتْ: جِئْتُكُمْ مِنْ عِنْدِ أَسْحَرَ النَّاسِ، أَوْ إِنَّهُ لِرَسُولُ اللَّهِ حَقًّا، قَالَ: فَجَاءَ أَهْلُ ذَلِكَ الْحَيِّ فَأَسْلَمُوا كُلُّهُمْ
entries.isnad_en: Ma'mar reported from 'Awf, from Abu Raja' al-'Utaridi, from 'Imran b. al-Husayn: “
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ and his Companions were on a journey and suffered severe thirst. He sent two men of his Companions—'Ali and al-Zubayr, or someone else—saying, ‘You will find a woman in a certain place with a camel carrying two water skins. Bring her here.’ They found her riding between the two skins and told her to come to the Messenger of God ﷺ. She asked, ‘Who is the Messenger of God? That man who has left his religion?’ They replied, ‘That is the man you mean, and he truly is God's Messenger.’ They brought her to him. He ordered some water taken from her two skins into a vessel, said what God willed him to say, and returned the water to the two skins. He had their mouths opened and ordered the people to fill their vessels and water skins. Not a single vessel or water skin was left unfilled. 'Imran said: ‘It seemed to me that her two skins only became fuller.’ The Prophet ﷺ ordered her cloth spread out and asked his Companions to bring some of their travel provisions, filling it for her. He told her, ‘Go. We have taken nothing from your water; rather, God has given us drink.’ She returned to her people and told them, ‘I have come from the greatest sorcerer of people—or else he really is God's Messenger.’ Her whole clan came and embraced Islam.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ رَبَاحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كُنَّا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي بَعْضِ أَسْفَارِهِ إِذْ مَالَ - أَوْ قَالَ: مَادَ - عَنِ الرَّاحِلَةِ، قَالَ: فَدَعَمْتُهُ بِيَدِي حَتَّى اسْتَيْقَظَ، ثُمَّ مَالَ فَدَعَمْتُهُ بِيَدِي حَتَّى اسْتَيْقَظَ، فَقَالَ: «اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْ أَبَا قَتَادَةَ كَمَا حَفِظَنِي هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةَ، مَا أَرَانَا إِلَّا قَدْ شَقَقْنَا عَلَيْكَ، تَنَحَّ عَنِ الطَّرِيقِ» قَالَ: فَتَنَحَّى عَنِ الطَّرِيقِ، فَأَنَاخَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَأَنَخْنَا مَعَهُ، فَتَوَسَّدَ كُلٌّ مِنَّا ذِرَاعَ رَاحِلَتِهِ، فَمَا اسْتيقَظَنَا حَتَّى أَشْرَقَتِ الشَّمْسُ وَمَا اسْتيقَظَنَا إِلَّا بِصَوْتِ الصُّرَدِ فَقُلْنَا: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، هَلَكْنَا، فَقَالَ: «لَمْ تَهْلِكُوا، إِنَّ الصَّلَاةَ لَا تَفُوتُ النَّائِمَ، إِنَّمَا تَفُوتُ الْيَقْظَانَ» ثُمَّ قَالَ: «هَلْ مِنْ مَاءٍ فَأَتَيْتُهُ بِمِيضَأَةٍ - وَهِيَ الْإِدَوَاةُ - قَالَ أَبُو قَتَادَةَ: فَقَضَى حَاجَتَهُ، ثُمَّ جَاءَنِي فَتَوَضَّأَ، ثُمَّ دَفَعَهَا إِلَيَّ، ثُمَّ قَالَ لِي:» احْفَظْهَا لَعَلَّهُ أَنْ يَكُونَ لِبَقِيَّتِهَا نَبَأٌ «قَالَ: فَأَمَرَ بِلَالًا، فَنَادَى وَصَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ تَحَوَّلَ مِنْ مَكَانِهِ ذَلِكَ، فَأَمَرَهُ فَأَقَامَ فَصَلَّى بِنَا الصُّبْحَ، قَالَ: ثُمَّ سَارَ الْجَيْشُ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ» إِنْ يُطِيعُوا أَبَا بَكْرٍ، وَعُمَرَ يَرْفُقُوا بِأَنْفُسِهِمْ، وَإِنْ يَعْصُوهُمَا يَشُقُّوا عَلَى أَنْفُسِهِمْ «، قَالَ: وَكَانَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ، وَعُمَرُ أشَارَا عَلَيْهِمْ أَلَّا يَنْزِلُوا حَتَّى يَبْلُغُوا الْمَاءَ، وَقَالَ بَقِيَّةُ النَّاسِ: بَلْ نَنْزِلُ حَتَّى يَأْتِيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَنَزَلُوا فَجِئْنَاهُمْ فِي نَحْرِ الظَّهِيرَةِ وَقَدْ هَلَكُوا مِنَ الْعَطَشِ، قَالَ: فَدَعَانِي بِالْمِيضَأَةِ، فَأَتَيْتُهُ بِهَا فَاسْتَأْبَطَهَا، ثُمَّ جَعَلَ يَصُبُّ لَهُمْ، ثُمَّ قَالَ:» §اشْرَبُوا وَتَوَضَّئُوا «فَفَعَلُوا وَمَلَئُوا كُلَّ إِنَاءٍ كَانَ مَعَهُمْ، حَتَّى جَعَلَ يَقُولُ:» هَلْ مِنْ عَالٍّ " ثُمَّ رَدَّهَا إِلَيَّ، فَيُخَيَّلُ إِلَيَّ أَنَّهَا كَمَا أَخَذَهَا مِنِّي، وَكَانُوا اثْنَيْنِ وَسَبْعِينَ رَجُلًا
entries.isnad_en: Ma'mar reported from Qatada, from 'Abd Allah b. Rabah, from Abu Qatada: “
entries.matn_en: We were traveling with the Prophet ﷺ when he began to tilt—or sway—on his mount. I supported him with my hand until he awoke, and when he swayed again I supported him again. He said, ‘O God, protect Abu Qatada as he protected me tonight. I believe we have put you to hardship. Move off the road.’ We moved aside and made our mounts kneel. The Messenger of God ﷺ lay down, and each of us used his camel's foreleg as a pillow. We did not wake until the sun had risen; it was the cry of a shrike that awakened us. We said, ‘Messenger of God, we are ruined.’ He replied, ‘You are not ruined. Prayer is not missed by someone asleep; it is missed by someone awake.’ He asked whether anyone had water. I brought him an ablution vessel, a leather water container. He relieved himself, then came and performed ablution, returned it to me and said, ‘Keep this; there may be something remarkable in what remains.’ He ordered Bilal to call the prayer, prayed two cycles, moved from that place, then instructed him to give the commencement call, and led us in the dawn prayer. The army went on. The Prophet ﷺ said, ‘Had they obeyed Abu Bakr and 'Umar they would have spared themselves hardship; by disobeying them they brought hardship on themselves.’ Abu Bakr and 'Umar had advised the soldiers not to stop before reaching water, while the others insisted on stopping until the Messenger of God ﷺ caught up. We reached them at the height of noon and they were nearly overcome with thirst. He asked me for the water container, and I brought it. He tucked it beneath his arm and poured water for them, saying, ‘Drink and perform ablution.’ They did so and filled every vessel they had, until he kept asking, ‘Is anyone still thirsty?’ Then he handed it back to me, and it appeared to contain as much as when he took it. They were seventy-two men.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْجَحْشِيِّ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنَا أَشْيَاخُنَا، «
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ جَحْشٍ جَاءَ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَوْمَ أُحُدٍ وَقَدْ ذَهَبَ سَيْفُهُ، §فَأَعْطَاهُ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَسِيبًا مِنْ نَخْلٍ، فَرَجَعَ فِي يَدِهِ سَيْفًا»
entries.isnad_en: Ma'mar reported from Sa'id ibn 'Abd al-Rahman al-Jahshi, who said that their elders told them: “
entries.matn_en: 'Abd Allah b. Jahsh came to the Prophet ﷺ at Uhud after losing his sword. The Prophet ﷺ gave him a date-palm stalk, which became a sword in his hand.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ الْأَحْوَلِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سَرْجِسَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: تَرَوْنَ هَذَا الشَّيْخَ - يَعْنِي نَفْسَهُ - فَإِنِّي كَلَّمْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَأَكَلْتُ مَعَهُ، §وَرَأَيْتُ الْعَلَامَةَ الَّتِي بَيْنَ كَتِفَيْهِ، وَهِيَ إِلَى نُغْضِ كَتِفِهِ الْيُسْرَى، كَأَنَّهُ جُمْعٌ - يَعْنِي الْكَفَّ الْمُجْتَمِعَ - عَلَيْهَا خِيلَانٍ كَهَيْئَةِ الثَّوَالِيلِ "
entries.isnad_en: Ma'mar reported from 'Asim al-Ahwal, from 'Abd Allah b. Sarjis, who said: “
entries.matn_en: You see this old man—meaning himself? I spoke with the Messenger of God ﷺ, ate with him, and saw the mark between his shoulders near the upper part of his left shoulder blade. It was like a clenched hand, with moles resembling small warts upon it.”

sections.title_en: Signs Granted Early to People of Certainty
sections.title_ar: بَابُ مَا يُعَجَّلُ لِأَهْلِ الْيَقِينِ مِنَ الْآيَاتِ

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، «
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ أُسَيْدَ بْنَ حُضَيْرٍ وَرَجُلًا مِنَ الْأَنْصَارِ تَحَدَّثَا عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي حَاجَةٍ لَهُمَا، حَتَّى ذَهَبَ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ سَاعَةٌ فِي لَيْلَةٍ شَدِيدَةِ الظُّلْمَةِ، ثُمَّ خَرَجَا مِنْ عِنْدِهِ يَنْقَلِبَانِ، وَبِيَدِ كُلِّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا عُصَيَّةٌ، §فَأَضَاءَتْ عَصَا أَحَدِهِمَا لَهُمَا حَتَّى مَشَيَا فِي ضَوْئِهَا، حَتَّى إِذَا افْتَرَقَ بِهِمَا الطَّرِيقُ أَضَاءَتْ لِلْآخَرِ عَصَاهُ، فَسَارَ كُلُّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا فِي ضَوْءِ عَصَاهُ حَتَّى بَلَغَ أَهْلَهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Ma'mar reported from Thabit, from Anas: “
entries.matn_en: Usayd b. Hudayr and another man of the Helpers spoke with the Messenger of God ﷺ about some need of theirs until part of a very dark night had passed. They left him to return home, each carrying a small staff. One man's staff shone and lit their way as they walked. When their roads divided, the other man's staff also shone; each traveled by the light of his own staff until he reached his family.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ وَاسِعٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الْعَلَاءِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ أَخِي عَامِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ قَيْسٍ «
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ عَامِرًا كَانَ يَأْخُذُ عَطَاءَهُ، فَيَجْعَلُهُ فِي طَرَفِ رِدَائِهِ §فَلَا يَلْقَى أَحَدًا مِنَ الْمَسَاكِينِ يَسْأَلُهُ إِلَّا أَعْطَاهُ، فَإِذَا دَخَلَ عَلَى أَهْلِهِ رَمَى بِهَا إِلَيْهِمْ، فَيَعُدُّونَهَا فيَجِدُونَهَا سَوَاءً كَمَا أُعْطِيَهَا»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq reported from Ma'mar, from Muhammad b. Wasi', from Abu al-'Ala' b. 'Abd Allah, whose nephew (the nephew of 'Amir b. 'Abd Qays) informed him: “
entries.matn_en: 'Amir used to collect his stipend and put it into the corner of his cloak. Whenever he encountered a needy person asking him, he gave to him. But when he returned home and threw the remainder to his family, they counted it and found it equal to the full sum he had received.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كَانَ مُطَرِّفُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الشِّخِّيرِ، وَصَاحِبٌ لَهُ، سَرَيَا فِي لَيْلَةٍ مُظْلِمَةٍ، فَإِذَا طَرْفُ سَوْطِ أَحَدِهِمَا عِنْدَهُ ضَوْءٌ، فَقَالَ لِصَاحِبِهِ: أَمَا إِنَّا لَوْ حَدَّثَنَا النَّاسَ بِهَذَا كَذَّبُونَا فَقَالَ مُطَرِّفٌ: «§الْمُكَذِّبُ أَكْذَبُ» يَقُولُ: الْمُكَذِّبُ بِنِعْمَةِ اللَّهِ أَكْذَبُ
entries.isnad_en: Ma'mar reported from Qatada: “
entries.matn_en: Mutarrif b. 'Abd Allah b. al-Shikhkhir and a companion traveled by night in darkness, when the tip of one man's whip suddenly gave light. His companion said, ‘If we told people of this, they would call us liars.’ Mutarrif answered, ‘The denier is more false,’ meaning that someone who denies God's favor is the greater liar.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْجَحْشِيِّ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، «
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ سَفِينَةَ مَوْلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ §أَخْطَأَ الْجَيْشَ بِأَرْضِ الرُّومِ، - أَوْ أُسِرَ - فَانْطَلَقَ هَارِبًا يَلْتَمِسُ الْجَيْشَ، فَإِذَا بِالْأَسَدِ، فَقَالَ لَهُ: يَا أَبَا الْحَارِثِ، أَنَا مَوْلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَإِنَّ مِنْ أَمْرِي كَيْتَ وَكَيْتَ، فَأَقْبَلَ الْأَسَدُ لَهُ بَصْبَصَةٌ حَتَّى قَامَ إِلَى جَنْبِهِ، كُلَّمَا سَمِعَ صَوْتًا أَتَى إِلَيْهِ، ثُمَّ أَقْبَلَ يَمْشِي إِلَى جَنْبِهِ، فَلَمْ يَزَلْ كَذَلِكَ حَتَّى بَلَغَ الْجَيْشَ، ثُمَّ رَجَعَ الْأَسَدُ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq reported from Ma'mar, from Sa'id ibn 'Abd al-Rahman al-Jahshi, from Ibn al-Munkadir: “
entries.matn_en: Safina, the freedman of the Messenger of God ﷺ, became separated from the army in Roman territory—or was taken captive—and escaped in search of the army. He came upon a lion and said to it, ‘Abu al-Harith, I am the freedman of the Messenger of God ﷺ, and this is my predicament.’ The lion approached him, moving its tail, and stood beside him. Whenever it heard a sound, it went toward it and then returned to walk beside him. It continued accompanying him until he reached the army, whereupon it returned.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَامِرِ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ، عَنْ حَارِثَةَ بْنِ النُّعْمَانِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: مَرَرْتُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَمَعَهُ جِبْرِيلُ جَالِسٌ فِي الْمَقَاعِدِ، فَسَلَّمْتُ عَلَيْهِ، ثُمَّ أَجَزْتُ، فَلَمَّا رَجَعْتُ وَانْصَرَفَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ لِي: «هَلْ رَأَيْتَ الَّذِي كَانَ مَعِي» ؟ قُلْتُ: نَعَمْ، قَالَ: «§فَإِنَّهُ جِبْرِيلُ وَقَدْ رَدَّ عَلَيْكَ السَّلَامَ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq reported from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, from 'Abd Allah b. 'Amir b. Rabi'a, from Haritha b. al-Nu'man: “
entries.matn_en: I passed the Messenger of God ﷺ while Gabriel was seated with him at the gathering place. I greeted him and went on. Later the Prophet ﷺ asked me, ‘Did you see the one who was with me?’ I replied, ‘Yes.’ He said, ‘That was Gabriel, and he returned your greeting.’”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ، عَنْ مُعَاذِ بْنِ جَبَلٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كُنْتُ رِدْفَ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَقَالَ: «أَتَدْرِي يَا مُعَاذُ §مَا حَقُّ اللَّهِ عَلَى النَّاسِ؟» قَالَ: قُلْتُ: اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَعْلَمُ، قَالَ: «حَقُّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ أَنْ يَعْبُدُوهُ وَلَا يُشْرِكُوا بِهِ شَيْئًا، أَتَدْرِي يَا مُعَاذُ مَا حَقُّ النَّاسِ عَلَى اللَّهِ إِذَا فَعَلُوا ذَلِكَ؟» ، قَالَ: قُلْتُ: اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَعْلَمُ، قَالَ: «فَإنَّ حَقَّ النَّاسِ عَلَى اللَّهِ أَنْ لَا يُعَذِّبَهُمْ» قَالَ: قُلْتُ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، أَلَا أُبَشِّرُ النَّاسَ؟ قَالَ: «دَعْهُمْ يَعْمَلُونَ»
entries.isnad_en: Ma'mar reported from Abu Ishaq, from 'Amr b. Maymun, from Mu'adh b. Jabal: “
entries.matn_en: I was riding behind the Prophet ﷺ when he asked, ‘Mu'adh, do you know God's right over the people?’ I said, ‘God and His Messenger know best.’ He said, ‘His right over them is that they worship Him and associate nothing with Him. Do you know, Mu'adh, the people's right upon God if they do that?’ I said, ‘God and His Messenger know best.’ He said, ‘Their right upon God is that He not punish them.’ I said, ‘Messenger of God, shall I give people the good news?’ He replied, ‘Leave them to act.’”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ كُهَيْلِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كُنْتُ أَمْشِي مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي حَقٍّ لِبَعْضِ أَهْلِ الْمَدِينَةِ، فَقَالَ: «يَا أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، هَلَكَ الْمُكْثِرُونَ إِلَّا مَنْ قَالَ: كَذَا وَكَذَا، وَهَكَذَا وَهَكَذَا، وَقَلِيلٌ مَا هُمْ» ، ثُمَّ مَشَى سَاعَةً، ثُمَّ قَالَ: «يَا أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، §أَلَا أَدُلُّكَ عَلَى كَنْزٍ مِنْ كُنُوزِ الْجَنَّةِ؟» ، فَقُلْتُ: بَلَى يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، قَالَ: «تَقُولُ: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ، وَلَا مَلْجَأَ مِنَ اللَّهِ إِلَّا إِلَيْهِ» ، قَالَ: ثُمَّ مَشَى سَاعَةً فَقَالَ: «يَا أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، هَلْ تَدْرِي مَا حَقُّ اللَّهِ عَلَى النَّاسِ، وَمَا حَقُّ النَّاسِ عَلَى اللَّهِ؟» ، قَالَ: قُلْتُ: اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَعْلَمُ قَالَ: «حَقُّ اللَّهِ عَلَى النَّاسِ أَنْ يَعْبُدُوهُ وَلَا يُشْرِكُوا بِهِ شَيْئًا، فَإِذَا فَعَلُوا ذَلِكَ فَحَقٌّ عَلَى اللَّهِ أَنْ لَا يُعَذِّبَهُمْ»
entries.isnad_en: Ma'mar reported from Abu Ishaq, from Kuhayl b. Ziyad, from Abu Hurayra: “
entries.matn_en: I walked with the Messenger of God ﷺ in a walled garden belonging to some of the people of Medina. He said, ‘Abu Hurayra, those with abundant wealth are ruined—except those who give it away in this direction and that direction, and how few they are.’ After a while he asked, ‘Shall I direct you to a treasure from the treasures of Paradise?’ I said, ‘Yes, Messenger of God.’ He said, ‘Say: There is no power or strength except through God, the Most High, the Magnificent, and there is no refuge from God except with Him.’ After walking a while he asked, ‘Do you know God's right over people and people's right upon God?’ I said, ‘God and His Messenger know best.’ He replied, ‘God's right over people is that they worship Him without associating anything with Him. Once they do that, their right upon God is that He not punish them.’”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ: قَالَ لِي: أَلَا أُحَدِّثُكَ حَدِيثَيْنِ عَجِيبَيْنِ: أَخْبَرَنِي حُمَيْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: أَسْرَفَ رَجُلٌ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ، فَلَمَّا حَضَرَهُ الْمَوْتُ أَوْصَى بَنِيهِ، فَقَالَ: إِذَا أَنَا مِتُّ فَأَحْرِقُونِي، ثُمَّ اسْحَقُونِي، ثُمَّ اذْرُونِي فِي الرِّيحِ فِي الْبَحْرِ، فَوَاللَّهِ لَئِنْ قَدَرَ عَلَيَّ رَبِّي لَيُعَذِّبَنِّي عَذَابًا مَا عَذَّبَهُ أَحَدًا.. .، قَالَ: خَشْيَتَكَ، أَوْ قَالَ: عِقَابَكَ يَا رَبِّ، فَغَفَرَ لَهُ بِذَلِكَ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq reported from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, who said, “Shall I tell you two astonishing reports?” Humayd b. 'Abd al-Rahman informed him, from Abu Hurayra, that the Messenger of God ﷺ said: “
entries.matn_en: A man had sinned excessively against himself. When death approached, he told his sons, ‘When I die, burn me, grind my remains, and scatter them in the sea wind. By God, if my Lord is able to seize me, He will punish me as He has punished no one ...’ He said, ‘Out of fear of You—or fear of Your punishment, my Lord.’ So God forgave him for that.” [The original report is abbreviated with an ellipsis between these statements.]

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ الزُّهْرِيُّ: وَحَدَّثَنِي حُمَيْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: دَخَلَتِ امْرَأَةٌ النَّارَ فِي هِرَّةٍ رَبَطَتْهَا، فَلَا هِيَ أَطْعَمَتْهَا، وَلَا هِيَ أَرْسَلَتْهَا تَأْكُلُ مِنْ خَشَاشِ الْأَرْضِ حَتَّى مَاتَتْ» قَالَ الزُّهْرِيُّ: «وَذَلِكَ لِئَلَّا يَتَّكِلَ وَلَا يَأْيَسَ رَجُلٌ»
entries.isnad_en: Al-Zuhri also reported from Humayd b. 'Abd al-Rahman, from Abu Hurayra, that the Messenger of God ﷺ said: “
entries.matn_en: A woman entered the Fire because of a cat she confined. She neither fed it nor let it free to eat the small creatures of the ground before it died.” Al-Zuhri said: “This is so that a person should neither become complacent nor despair.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ أَبِي الْأَحْوَصِ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: كَانَتْ قَرْيَتَانِ إِحْدَاهُمَا صَالِحَةٌ، وَالْأُخْرَى ظَالِمَةٌ، فَخَرَجَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْقَرْيَةِ الظَّالِمَةِ يُرِيدُ الْقَرْيَةَ الصَّالِحَةَ، فَأَتَاهُ الْمَوْتُ حَيْثُ شَاءَ اللَّهُ، فَاخْتَصَمَ فِيهِ الْمَلَكُ وَالشَّيْطَانُ، فَقَالَ الشَّيْطَانُ: وَاللَّهِ مَا عَصَانِي قَطُّ، فَقَالَ الْمَلَكُ: إِنَّهُ قَدْ خَرَجَ يُرِيدُ التَّوْبَةَ، فَقَضَى بَيْنَهُمَا أَنْ يَنْظُرَ إِلَى أَيِّهِمَا أَقْرَبُ، فَوَجَدُوهُ أَقْرَبَ إِلَى الْقَرْيَةِ الصَّالِحَةِ بِشِبْرٍ فَغُفِرَ لَهُ» ، قَالَ مَعْمَرٌ: «وَسَمِعْتُ مَنْ يَقُولُ: قَرَّبَ اللَّهُ إِلَيْهِ الْقَرْيَةَ الصَّالِحَةَ»
entries.isnad_en: Ma'mar reported from Abu Ishaq, from Abu al-Ahwas, from Ibn Mas'ud: “
entries.matn_en: There were two villages, one righteous and one unjust. A man left the unjust village intending to reach the righteous one, but death overtook him wherever God willed. An angel and Satan disputed concerning him. Satan said, ‘By God, he never disobeyed me.’ The angel said, ‘But he set out intending to repent.’ Judgment was given that they should see to which village he lay closer. They found him one handspan closer to the righteous village, and he was forgiven.” Ma'mar added: “I heard someone say that God brought the righteous village closer to him.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ هَمَّامٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ يَقُولُ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «§
entries.matn_ar: دَخَلَتِ امْرَأَةٌ النَّارَ فِي هِرَّةٍ لَهَا - أَوْ هِرٍّ - رَبَطَتْهَا فَلَا هِيَ أَطْعَمَتْهَا، وَلَا هِيَ أَرْسَلَتْهَا تَقْضِمُ مِنْ خَشَاشِ الْأَرْضِ حَتَّى مَاتَتْ هَزْلًا»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq reported from Ma'mar, from Hammam, who heard Abu Hurayra say that the Messenger of God ﷺ said: “
entries.matn_en: A woman entered the Fire because of a female cat—or a male cat—she had tied up. She neither fed it nor released it to gnaw at the small creatures of the earth, until it died of starvation.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنِ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ، عَنْ أَبِي الدَّيْلَمِ، عَنْ مُعَاذِ بْنِ جَبَلٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: حَضَرَهُ الْمَوْتُ، فَقُلْنَا لَهُ: لَا نَرَاكَ إِلَّا قَدْ حُضِرْتَ، فَأَوْصِنَا، قَالَ: «فَأَنَا لَا أُرَانِي إِلَّا قَدْ حُضِرْتُ وَسَاءَ حِينُ الْكَذِبِ هَذَا، اعْلَمُوا أَنَّهُ §مَنْ مَاتَ وَهُوَ يُوقِنُ بِثَلَاثٍ: بِأَنَّ اللَّهَ رَبُّهُ، وَأَنَّ السَّاعَةَ آتِيَةٌ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهَا، وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ يَبْعَثُ مَنْ فِي الْقُبُورِ - قَالَ ابْنُ سِيرِينَ: فَإِمَّا قَالَ: - يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ، وَإِمَّا قَالَ: يَنْجُو مِنَ النَّارِ»
entries.isnad_en: Ma'mar reported from Ayyub, from Ibn Sirin, from Abu al-Daylam, from Mu'adh b. Jabal: “
entries.matn_en: When death came upon him, we said, ‘It appears that your time has come. Give us your counsel.’ He replied, ‘I too believe my time has come, and this is a terrible moment for lies. Know that whoever dies certain of three things—that God is his Lord, that the Hour is coming without doubt, and that God will raise those in the graves—’ Ibn Sirin was uncertain whether he said, ‘will enter Paradise’ or ‘will escape the Fire.’”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: سُئِلَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ عَنْ: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، هَلْ يَضُرُّ مَعَهَا عَمَلٌ كَمَا لَا يَنْفَعُ مَعَ تَرْكِهَا عَمَلٌ؟ فَقَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ: «§عَشِّ وَلَا تَغْتَرَّ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq reported from Ma'mar, from Qatada: “
entries.matn_en: Ibn 'Umar was asked about the words ‘There is no god but God’: Does a person's conduct do no harm alongside this declaration, just as no conduct avails one without it? He said, ‘Provide your evening meal, but do not be deceived.’” [A terse metaphor in the transmitted answer.]

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: لَمَّا قُبِضَ رَسُولُ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَادَ بَعْضُ أَصْحَابِهِ أَنْ يُوَسْوَسَ، فَكَانَ عُثْمَانُ مِمَّنْ كَانَ كَذَلِكَ، فَمَرَّ بِهِ عُمَرُ فَسَلَّمَ عَلَيْهِ فَلَمْ يُجِبْهُ، فَأَتَى عُمَرُ أَبَا بَكْرٍ فَقَالَ: أَلَا تَرَى عُثْمَانَ مَرَرْتُ بِهِ، فَسَلَّمْتُ عَلَيْهِ، فَلَمْ يَرُدَّ عَلَيَّ، قَالَ: انْطَلِقْ بِنَا إِلَيْهِ، فَمَرَّا بِهِ، فَسَلَّمَا عَلَيْهِ، فَرَدَّ عَلَيْهِمَا، فَقَالَ لَهُ أَبُو بَكْرٍ: مَا شَأْنُكَ؟ مَرَّ بِكَ أَخُوكَ آنِفًا فَسَلَّمَ عَلَيْكَ فَلَمْ تَرُدَّ عَلَيْهِ، فَقَالَ: مَا فَعَلْتُ، فَقَالَ عُمَرُ: بَلَى فَعَلْتَ، وَلَكِنَّهَا نَخْوَتُكُمْ يَا بَنِي أُمَيَّةَ، قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ: أَجَلَ، قَدْ فَعَلْتَ وَلَكِنْ أَمْرٌ مَا شَغَلَكَ عَنْهُ، فَقَالَ: إِنِّي كُنْتُ أَذْكُرُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَأَذْكُرُ أَنَّ اللَّهَ قَبَضَهُ قَبْلَ أَنْ نَسْأَلَهُ عَنْ نَجَاةِ هَذَا الْأَمْرِ، فَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ: فَإِنِّي قَدْ سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ ذَلِكَ، فَقَالَ عُثْمَانُ: فِدَاكَ أَبِي وَأُمِّي، فَأَنْتَ أَحَقُّ بِذَلِكَ، فَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ: قُلْتُ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، مَا نَجَاةُ هَذَا الْأَمْرِ الَّذِي نَحْنُ فِيهِ؟ قَالَ: «§مَنْ قَبِلَ الْكَلِمَةَ الَّتِي عَرَضْتُ عَلَى عَمِّي فَرَدَّهَا عَلَيَّ فَهِيَ لَهُ نَجَاةٌ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq reported from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri: “
entries.matn_en: When the Messenger ﷺ died, some of his Companions were nearly overwhelmed with troubled thoughts; 'Uthman was among them. 'Umar passed by him, greeted him and received no reply, so he complained to Abu Bakr. Abu Bakr said, ‘Come with me to him.’ They approached and greeted 'Uthman, and he answered. Abu Bakr asked, ‘What happened? Your brother greeted you earlier and you did not answer.’ 'Uthman said, ‘I did not do that.’ 'Umar retorted, ‘You did! But that is the pride of you Umayyads.’ Abu Bakr said, ‘You did, but something must have occupied you.’ 'Uthman explained, ‘I was remembering the Messenger of God ﷺ and that God took him before we could ask about the means of salvation in this matter.’ Abu Bakr said, ‘I did ask him about that.’ 'Uthman replied, ‘May my father and mother be sacrificed for you! You were the one most entitled to do so.’ Abu Bakr said: ‘I asked, “Messenger of God, what is the salvation for this matter in which we find ourselves?” He replied, “Whoever accepts the word that I offered my uncle, which he rejected, will find salvation in it.”’”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ: قَالَ ابْنُ مَسْعُودٍ: «إِنَّ §
entries.matn_ar: الرَّجُلَ لَيُحَدِّثُ بِالْحَدِيثِ، فَيَسْمَعُهُ مَنْ لَا يَبْلُغُ عَقْلُهُ فَهْمَ ذَلِكَ الْحَدِيثِ، فَيَكُونُ عَلَيْهِ فِتْنَةً»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq reported from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, from 'Ubayd God b. 'Abd Allah, who said that Ibn Mas'ud said: “
entries.matn_en: A man may relate a report, and someone whose understanding cannot grasp that report hears it; the report then becomes a source of trial for him.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي النَّضْرِ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «إِنَّ §
entries.matn_ar: اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ وَعَدَنِي أَنْ يُدْخِلَ الْجَنَّةَ مِنْ أُمَّتِي أَرْبَعَ مِائَةِ أَلْفٍ» قَالَ: فَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ: زِدْنَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «وَهَكَذَا» ، وَجَمَعَ كَفَّيْهِ، قَالَ: زِدْنَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، قَالَ: «وَهَكَذَا» ، وَجَمَعَ كَفَّيْهِ، فَقَالَ عُمَرُ: حَسْبُكَ يَا أَبَا بَكْرٍ، فَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ: دَعْنِي يَا عُمَرُ مَا عَلَيْكَ أَنْ يُدْخِلَنَا اللَّهُ الْجَنَّةَ كُلَّنَا، فَقَالَ عُمَرُ: إِنَّ اللَّهَ إِنْ شَاءَ أَدْخَلَ خَلْقَهُ الْجَنَّةَ بِكَفٍّ وَاحِدَةٍ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «صَدَقَ عُمَرُ»
entries.isnad_en: Ma'mar reported from Qatada, from Abu al-Nadr, from Anas, who said that the Messenger of God ﷺ said: “
entries.matn_en: God Almighty promised me that four hundred thousand of my community would enter Paradise.” Abu Bakr asked, “Grant us more, Messenger of God!” The Prophet ﷺ cupped his hands together and said, “And this much.” Abu Bakr again asked for more; the Prophet ﷺ repeated the gesture. 'Umar said, “Enough, Abu Bakr.” Abu Bakr replied, “Leave me alone, 'Umar! What would it cost you if God admitted all of us to Paradise?” 'Umar said, “If God wills, He can admit all His creation to Paradise in one handful.” The Prophet ﷺ said, “'Umar has spoken the truth.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «
entries.matn_ar: يَقُولُ اللَّهُ: §إِذَا هَمَّ عَبْدِي بِالْحَسَنَةِ فَاكْتُبُوهَا لَهُ حَسَنَةً، فَإِنْ عَمِلَهَا فَاكْتُبُوهَا عَشَرَةَ أَمْثَالِهَا، فَإِنْ هَمَّ بِالسَّيِّئَةِ فَعَمِلَهَا فَاكْتُبُوهَا وَاحِدَةً، وَإِنْ تَرَكَهَا فَاكْتُبُوهَا حَسَنَةً»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq reported from Ma'mar, from Hammam b. Munabbih, from Abu Hurayra, who said that the Messenger of God ﷺ said: “
entries.matn_en: God says: If My servant intends a good deed, record one good deed for him; if he does it, record ten like it. If he intends a bad deed and does it, record one bad deed; if he abandons it, record one good deed.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ، أَنَّ ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ،
entries.matn_ar: مَرَّ بِرَجُلٍ يُذَكِّرُ قَوْمًا فَقَالَ: «§يَا مُذَكِّرُ لَا تُقَنِّطِ النَّاسَ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq reported from Ma'mar, from al-A'mash, that Ibn Mas'ud
entries.matn_en: passed a man admonishing a group and said, “O preacher, do not make people despair.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كُنَّا يَوْمًا جُلُوسًا عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَقَالَ: «§يَطْلُعُ عَلَيْكُمُ الْآنَ مِنْ هَذَا الْفَجِّ رَجُلٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ» ، قَالَ: فَطَلَعَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْأَنْصَارِ تَنْطِفُ لِحْيَتُهُ مِنْ وُضُوئِهِ، قَدْ عَلَّقَ نَعْلَيْهِ فِي يَدِهِ الشِّمَالِ فَسَلَّمَ، فَلَمَّا كَانَ الْغَدُ، قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ، فَطَلَعَ ذَلِكَ الرَّجُلُ عَلَى مِثْلِ الْمَرَّةِ الْأُولَى، فَلَمَّا كَانَ الْيَوْمُ الثَّالِثُ، قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مِثْلَ مَقَالَتِهِ أَيْضًا، فَطَلَعَ ذَلِكَ الرَّجُلُ عَلَى مِثْلِ حَالِهِ الْأَوَّلِ، فَلَمَّا قَامَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ تَبِعَهُ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ فَقَالَ: إِنِّي لَاحَيْتُ أَبِي، فَأَقْسَمْتُ أَلَّا أَدْخُلَ عَلَيْهِ ثَلَاثًا، فَإِنْ رَأَيْتَ أَنْ تُؤْوِيَنِي إِلَيْكَ حَتَّى تَمْضِيَ الثَّلَاثُ فَعَلْتَ، قَالَ: نَعَمْ، قَالَ أَنَسٌ: كَانَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ يُحَدِّثُ أَنَّهُ بَاتَ مَعَهُ ثَلَاثَ لَيَالٍ، فَلَمْ يَرَهُ يَقُومُ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ شَيْئًا، غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ إِذَا تَعَارَّ انْقَلَبَ عَلَى فِرَاشِهِ، وَذَكَرَ اللَّهَ وَكَبَّرَ حَتَّى يَقُومَ لِصَلَاةِ الْفَجْرِ، قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ: غير أَنِّي لَمْ أَسْمَعْهُ يَقُولُ إِلَّا خَيْرًا، فَلَمَّا مَضَتِ الثَّلَاثُ، وَكِدْتُ أَحْتَقِرُ عَمَلَهُ، قُلْتُ: يَا عَبْدَ اللَّهِ، لَمْ يَكُنْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ وَالِدِي هِجْرَةٌ وَلَا غَضَبٌ، وَلَكِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ: «يَطْلُعُ الْآنَ عَلَيْكُمْ رَجُلٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ» ، فَطَلَعْتَ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ، فَأَرَدْتُ أَنْ آوِيَ إِلَيْكَ لَأَنْظُرَ مَا عَمَلُكَ، فَأَقْتَدِيَ بِكَ، فَلَمْ أَرَكَ تَعْمَلُ كَبِيرَ عَمَلٍ، فَمَا الَّذِي بَلَغَ بِكَ مَا قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ؟ قَالَ: مَا هُوَ إِلَّا مَا رَأَيْتَ قَالَ: فَانْصَرَفْتُ عَنْهُ، فَلَمَّا وَلَّيْتُ دَعَانِي فَقَالَ: مَا هُوَ إِلَّا مَا رَأَيْتَ، غَيْرَ أَنِّي لَا أَجِدُ فِي نَفْسِي عَلَى أَحَدٍ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ غِشًّا، وَلَا أَحْسُدُهُ عَلَى مَا أَعْطَاهُ اللَّهُ إِيَّاهُ إِلَيْهِ، فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ: هَذِهِ الَّتِي بَلَغَتْ بِكَ هِيَ الَّتِي لَا نُطِيقُ
entries.isnad_en: Ma'mar reported from al-Zuhri, who said that Anas b. Malik told him: “
entries.matn_en: One day, while we were seated with the Messenger of God ﷺ, he said, ‘A man of Paradise is about to come to you along this path.’ A man of the Helpers arrived with water dripping from his beard after ablution and his sandals held in his left hand. The next day the Prophet ﷺ made the same announcement and the same man appeared as before. On the third day it happened again. When the Prophet ﷺ departed, 'Abd Allah b. 'Amr b. al-'As followed the man and told him, ‘I have quarreled with my father and sworn not to enter his home for three nights. Could you host me until they pass?’ The man agreed. 'Abd Allah later related that he stayed with him three nights but did not see him rise to pray during the night. Whenever he awoke and turned in bed, he mentioned God and magnified Him until the dawn prayer. He spoke only good. After the three nights 'Abd Allah said, ‘I did not actually quarrel with my father. But I heard the Messenger of God ﷺ say three times that a man of Paradise was approaching, and each time you appeared. I wanted to stay with you and observe your deeds so I might imitate you, but I have not seen you perform extraordinary deeds. What brought you to the station the Messenger of God ﷺ described?’ The man said, ‘Only what you saw.’ As 'Abd Allah was leaving, he called him back and said, ‘It is only what you saw, except that I harbor no deceit or ill will toward any Muslim and do not envy anyone for what God has given him.’ 'Abd Allah replied, ‘That is what brought you there, and it is what we cannot manage.’”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ خُثَيْمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، أَنَّ عُبَيْدَ بْنَ عُمَيْرٍ،
entries.matn_ar: دَخَلَ عَلَى عَائِشَةَ فَقَالَتْ: «مَنْ هَذَا؟» ، فَقَالَ: عُبَيْدُ بْنُ عُمَيْرٍ، فَقَالَتْ: «عُمَيْرُ بْنُ قَتَادَةَ؟» ، فَقَالَ: نَعَمْ، قَالَتْ: «أَلَمْ أُحَدَّثْ أَنَّكَ تَجْلِسُ وَيُجْلَسُ إِلَيْكَ؟» ، قَالَ: بَلَى يَا أُمَّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، قَالَتْ: «§فَإِيَّاكَ وَإِهْلَاكَ النَّاسِ وَتَقْنِيطَهُمْ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq reported from Ma'mar, from Ibn Khuthaym, from Ibn Abi Mulayka: “'Ubayd b. 'Umayr
entries.matn_en: visited 'A'isha. She asked, ‘Who is this?’ He said, ‘'Ubayd b. 'Umayr.’ She asked, ‘[The son of] 'Umayr b. Qatada?’ He replied, ‘Yes.’ She said, ‘Have I not heard that you sit and people gather around you?’ He answered, ‘Yes, Mother of the Believers.’ She said, ‘Beware of destroying people and making them despair.’”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَجُلًا كَانَ فِي الْأُمَمِ الْمَاضِيَةِ يَجْتَهِدُ فِي الْعِبَادَةِ، وَيُشَدِّدُ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ، وَيُقَنِّطُ النَّاسَ مِنْ رَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ، ثُمَّ مَاتَ فَقَالَ: أَيْ رَبِّ مَا لِي عِنْدَكَ؟ قَالَ: النَّارُ، قَالَ: يَا رَبِّ، فَأَيْنَ عِبَادَتِي وَاجْتِهَادِي؟ فَقِيلَ لَهُ: §كُنْتَ تُقَنِّطُ النَّاسَ مِنْ رَحْمَتِي فِي الدُّنْيَا، وَأَنَا أُقَنِّطُكَ الْيَوْمَ مِنْ رَحْمَتِي "
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq reported from Ma'mar, from Zayd b. Aslam: “
entries.matn_en: A man in a former community exerted himself in worship and was severe with himself, but he also caused people to despair of God's mercy. When he died, he asked, ‘My Lord, what awaits me with You?’ He was told, ‘The Fire.’ He asked, ‘Lord, then what of my worship and diligence?’ He was told, ‘You caused people to despair of My mercy in the world, so today I make you despair of My mercy.’”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: قَرَأْنَا عَلَى عَبْدِ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ يَقُولُ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «§
entries.matn_ar: لَيْسَ وَاحِدٌ مِنْكُمْ بِمُنْجِيهِ عَمَلُهُ، وَلَكِنْ سَدِّدُوا وَقَارِبُوا» ، قَالُوا: وَلَا أَنْتَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ؟ قَالَ: «وَلَا أَنَا إِلَّا أَنْ يَتَغَمَّدَنِي اللَّهُ بِرَحْمَةٍ مِنْهُ وَفَضْلٍ» .،
entries.isnad_en: It was recited to 'Abd al-Razzaq through Ma'mar, from Hammam b. Munabbih, who heard Abu Hurayra say that the Messenger of God ﷺ said: “
entries.matn_en: None of you will be saved by his own deeds, but strive to act correctly and come as close as you can.” They asked, “Not even you, Messenger of God?” He answered, “Not even I, unless God envelops me in His mercy and grace.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَمَّنْ سَمِعَ الْحَسَنَ، وَابْنَ سِيرِينَ، يُحَدِّثَانِ
entries.matn_ar: مِثْلَهُ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، إِلَّا أَنَّهُ قَالَ: وَوَضَعَ يَدَهُ عَلَى رَأْسِهِ
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq reported from Ma'mar, from someone who heard al-Hasan and Ibn Sirin narrate
entries.matn_en: a similar statement from the Prophet ﷺ, except that this version says he placed his hand upon his head.

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنِ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: دَخَلَ خَالِدُ بْنُ الْوَاشِمَةِ عَلَى عَائِشَةَ بَعْدَ الْجَمَلِ، فَقَالَتْ: «مَا فَعَلَ فُلَانٌ؟» - تَعْنِي طَلْحَةَ - قَالَ: قُتِلَ يَا أُمَّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، قَالَتْ: «إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ، يَرْحَمُهُ اللَّهُ، مَا فَعَلَ فُلَانٌ؟» ، قَالَ: قُتِلَ، قَالَ: فَرَجَّعَتْ أَيْضًا، وَقَالَتْ: «يَرْحَمُهُ اللَّهُ» ، قَالَ: قُلْتُ: بَلْ نَحْنُ لِلَّهِ، وَإِنَّا لِلَّهِ عَلَى زَيْدٍ وَأَصْحَابِ زَيْدٍ - يَعْنِي زَيْدَ بْنَ صُوحَانَ - قَالَتْ: «وَقُتِلَ زَيْدٌ؟» ، قَالَ: قُلْتُ: نَعَمْ، قَالَتْ: «إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ، يَرْحَمُهُ اللَّهُ» ، قَالَ: قُلْتُ: يَا أُمَّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، هَذَا مِنْ جُنْدٍ، وَهَذَا مِنْ جُنْدٍ تَرَحَّمِينَ عَلَيْهِمْ جَمِيعًا، وَاللَّهِ لَا يَجْتَمِعُونَ أَبَدًا، قَالَتْ: «أَوَلَا تَدْرِي، §رَحْمَةُ اللَّهُ وَاسِعَةٌ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ»
entries.isnad_en: Ma'mar reported from Ayyub, from Ibn Sirin: “
entries.matn_en: Khalid b. al-Washima visited 'A'isha after the Battle of the Camel. She asked, ‘What happened to so-and-so?’—meaning Talha. He said, ‘He was killed, Mother of the Believers.’ She said, ‘We belong to God, and to Him we return. ؒ.’ She asked after another man, and when told he had been killed she again pronounced the return formula and prayed for mercy. Khalid said, ‘Then we belong to God, and so do Zayd and Zayd's companions’—meaning Zayd b. Suhan. She asked, ‘Was Zayd killed?’ He answered, ‘Yes.’ She said, ‘We belong to God, and to Him we return. ؒ.’ I said, ‘Mother of the Believers, this one belonged to one army and that one to another, yet you pray for mercy upon them all! By God, they will never be united.’ She replied, ‘Do you not know that God's mercy is vast and that He has power over all things?’”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «مَثَلُكُمْ وَمَثَلُ الْيَهُودِ، وَالنَّصَارَى كَمَثَلِ رَجُلٍ قَالَ: مَنْ أَسْتَأْجِرُهُ يَعْمَلُ إِلَى نِصْفِ النَّهَارِ بِقِيرَاطٍ، فَعَمِلَتِ الْيَهُودُ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: مَنْ أَسْتَأْجِرُهُ يَعْمَلُ إِلَى صَلَاةِ الْعَصْرِ بِقِيرَاطٍ، فَعَمِلَتِ النَّصَارَى، ثُمَّ قَالَ: مَنْ أَسْتَأْجِرُهُ يَعْمَلُ إِلَى اللَّيْلِ بِقِيرَاطَيْنِ، فَعَمِلْتُمْ أَنْتُمْ، فَلَكُمُ الْأَجْرُ مَرَّتَيْنِ، فَقَالَتِ الْيَهُودُ نَحْنُ أَكْثَرُ أَعْمَالًا وَأَقَلُّ أُجُورًا، فَقَالَ اللَّهُ: أَظُلِمْتُمْ مِنْ أُجُورِكُمْ شَيْئًا؟ قَالُوا: لَا، قَالَ: §فَإِنَّهُ فَضْلِي أُوتِيهِ مَنْ أَشَاءُ»
entries.isnad_en: Ma'mar reported from Ayyub, from Nafi', from Ibn 'Umar, who said that
entries.matn_en: the Messenger of God ﷺ said: “Your likeness and that of the Jews and Christians is like a man who offered employment until midday for one qirat. The Jews worked. He then offered work until the afternoon prayer for one qirat; the Christians worked. He then offered work until nightfall for two qirats, and you worked, receiving double wages. The Jews said, ‘We worked more and received less.’ God asked, ‘Have you been deprived of any part of your wages?’ They said, ‘No.’ He said, ‘That is My bounty; I grant it to whom I will.’”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ:
entries.matn_ar: دَخَلَ عَلَيَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَعِنْدِي امْرَأَةٌ حَسَنَةُ الْهَيْئَةِ، فَقَالَ: «مَنْ هَذِهِ؟» ، فَقُلْتُ: فُلَانَةُ بِنْتُ فُلَانٍ، وَهِيَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، لَا تَنَامُ اللَّيْلَ، فَقَالَ: «مَهْ §خُذُوا مِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تُطِيقُونَ، فَإنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَمَلُّ حَتَّى تَمَلُّوا، وَأَحَبُّ الْعَمَلِ إِلَى اللَّهِ مَا دَامَ عَلَيْهِ صَاحِبُهُ وَإِنْ قَلَّ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq reported from Ma'mar, from Hisham b. 'Urwa, from his father, from 'A'isha: “
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ entered while a well-dressed woman was with me. He asked, ‘Who is she?’ I said, ‘So-and-so, daughter of so-and-so; she does not sleep at night.’ He said, ‘Enough! Undertake only the deeds you can manage. God does not tire until you tire.
