entries.matn_ar: مَنْ وَلِيَ مِنْ أَمْرِ السُّلْطَانِ شَيْئًا، فَفَتَحَ بَابَهُ لِذِي الْحَاجَةِ، وَالْفَاقَةِ، وَالْفَقْرِ، يَفْتَحُ اللَّهُ أَبْوَابَ السَّمَاءِ لِحَاجَتِهِ وَفَاقَتِهِ، وَفَقْرِهِ، وَمَنْ أَغْلَقَ بَابَهُ دُونَ ذَوِي الْحَاجَةِ، وَالْفَاقَةِ، وَالْفَقْرِ، أَغْلَقَ اللَّهُ أَبْوَابَ السَّمَاءِ دُونَ حَاجَتِهِ، وَفَاقَتِهِ، وَفَقْرِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq transmitted from Ma'mar, from Zayd b. Rufay', from Haram b. Mu'awiya, who said that the Prophet ﷺ said: “
entries.matn_en: Whoever assumes some authority and opens his door to those in need, poverty, and destitution, God will open the gates of heaven to his own need, poverty, and destitution. Whoever closes his door against those in need, poverty, and destitution, God will close the gates of heaven against his need, poverty, and destitution.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ مَطَرٍ الْوَرَّاقِ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ بَعْضِ الطَّائِيِّينَ، عَنْ رَافِعِ الْخَيْرِ الطَّائِيِّ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: صَحِبْتُ أَبَا بَكْرٍ فِي غَزَاةٍ، فَلَمَّا قَفَلْنَا وَحَانَ مِنَ النَّاسِ تَفَرُّقٌ، قَالَ: قُلْتُ: يَا أَبَا بَكْرٍ، إِنَّ رَجُلًا صَحِبَكَ مَا صَحِبَكَ، ثُمَّ فَارَقَكَ لَمْ يُصِبْ مِنْكَ خَيْرًا لَقَدْ حَسُنَ فِي نَفْسِهِ، فَأَوْصِنِي وَلَا تُطَوِّلْ عَلَيَّ فَأَنْسَى، قَالَ: «يَرْحَمُكَ اللَّهُ، يَرْحَمُكَ اللَّهُ، بَارَكَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْكَ، بَارَكَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْكَ، §أَقِمِ الصَّلَاةَ الْمَكْتُوبَةَ لِوَقْتِهَا، وَأَدِّ زَكَاةَ مَالِكَ طَيِّبَةً بِهَا نَفْسُكَ، وَصُمْ رَمَضَانَ، وَحُجَّ الْبَيْتَ، وَاعْلَمْ أَنَّ الْهِجْرَةَ فِي الْإِسْلَامِ حَسَنٌ، وَأَنَّ الْجِهَادَ فِي الْهِجْرَةِ حَسَنٌ، وَلَا تَكُونَنَّ أَمِيرًا» قُلْتُ: أَمَّا قَوْلُكَ يَا أَبَا بَكْرٍ فِي الصَّلَاةِ، وَالصِّيَامِ، وَالزَّكَاةِ، وَالْحَجِّ، وَالْهِجْرَةِ، وَالْجِهَادِ فَهَذَا كُلُّهُ حَسَنٌ قَدْ عَرَفْتُهُ، وَأَمَّا قَوْلُكَ لَا أَكُونُ أَمِيرًا، وَاللَّهِ إِنَّهُ لَيُخَيَّلُ إِلَيَّ أَنَّ خِيَارَكُمُ الْيَوْمَ أُمَرَاؤُكُمْ، قَالَ: «إِنَّكَ قُلْتَ لِي: لَا تُطَوِّلْ عَلَيَّ، وَهَذَا حِينُ أُطَوِّلُ عَلَيْكَ، إِنَّ هَذِهِ الْإِمَارَةَ الَّتِي تُرَى الْيَوْمَ يَسِيرَةً، قَدْ أوْشَكَتْ أَنْ تَفشُوَ وَتَفْسَدَ حَتَّى يَنَالَهَا مَنْ لَيْسَ لَهَا بِأَهْلٍ، وَإِنَّهُ مَنْ يَكُنْ أَمِيرًا، فَإِنَّهُ مِنْ أَطْوَلِ النَّاسِ حِسَابًا، وَأغْلَظِهِ عَذَابًا، وَمَنْ لَا يَكُنْ أَمِيرًا، فَإِنَّهُ مِنْ أَيْسَرِ النَّاسِ حِسَابًا، وَأَهْوَنِهِ عَذَابًا، لِأَنَّ الْأُمَرَاءَ أَقْرَبُ النَّاسِ مِنْ ظُلْمِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، فَإِنَّمَا يَخْفِرُ اللَّهَ، إِنَّمَا هُمْ جِيرَانُ اللَّهِ وَعُوَّادُ اللَّهِ، وَاللَّهِ إِنَّ أَحَدَكُمْ لَتُصَابُ شَاةُ جَارِهِ - أَوْ بَعِيرُ جَارِهِ - فَيَبِيتُ وَارِمَ الْعَضَلِ، فَيَقُولُ: شَاةُ جَارِي، وَبَعِيرُ جَارِي، فَاللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَنْ يَغْضَبَ لِجِيرَانِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Ma'mar transmitted from Matar al-Warraq, from 'Amr b. Sa'id, from an unnamed member of the Tayyi' tribe, from Rafi' al-Khayr al-Ta'i, who said: “
entries.matn_en: I accompanied Abu Bakr on an expedition. When we returned and the people were about to disperse, I said: ‘Abu Bakr, a man could accompany you for so long and then part from you without having gained some good from you. Give me advice, but do not make it so long that I forget.’ He said: ‘May God have mercy on you, may God have mercy on you; may God bless you, may God bless you. Perform the prescribed prayers at their times, pay the alms on your property willingly, fast Ramadan, and make pilgrimage to the House. Know that emigration in Islam is good and that fighting in God's cause while in emigration is good. And never become a governor.’ I said: ‘I know that what you said about prayer, fasting, alms, pilgrimage, emigration, and struggle is good; but why say I should not be a governor? By God, it seems to me that the best of you today are your governors.’ He said: ‘You told me not to make the advice long, but this is where I must speak at length. This authority, which today seems easy, will soon spread and become corrupted, until people unfit for it obtain it. Whoever becomes a governor will face among the longest reckonings and the harshest punishments, whereas the one who does not will face among the easiest reckonings and lightest punishments. Governors are the people most likely to wrong the believers, thereby violating God's protection. The believers are God's neighbors and those who visit Him. By God, if one of you lost his neighbor's sheep—or his neighbor's camel—he would spend the night with his muscles swollen in distress, saying: “My neighbor's sheep! My neighbor's camel!” God has a greater right to be angered on behalf of His neighbors.’”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَمَّنْ، سَمِعَ الْحَسَنَ، قَالَ: قَالَ حُذَيْفَةُ: «§
entries.matn_ar: هَلَكَ أَصْحَابُ الْعُقَدِ وَرَبِّ الْكَعْبَةِ، وَاللَّهِ مَا عَلَيْهِمْ آسَى، وَلَكِنْ عَلَى مَنْ يَهْلَكُونَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَسَيَعْلَمُ الْغَالِبُونَ الْعِقْدَ خَطَّ مَنْ يَنْقُصُونَ»
entries.isnad_en: 20657 – 'Abd al-Razzaq informed us, from Ma'mar, from one who heard al-Hasan say:
entries.matn_en: Hudhayfa said: "The people of the pact ('uqad) are ruined, by the Lord of the Ka'ba! By God, I do not grieve over them; I grieve rather over those of the Companions of Muhammad, ﷺ, who will be destroyed. And those who prevail will come to know the pact—the portion of those they diminish." [The final clause is obscure in the Arabic; rendered literally.]

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، وَمُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ حِينَ بَعَثَ عَمْرَو بْنَ الْعَاصِ أَمِيرًا عَلَى الْجَيْشِ قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: إِنِّي لَأَبْعَثُ الرَّجُلَ وَأَدَعُ مَنْ هُوَ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِنْهُ، وَلَكِنَّهُ لَعَلَّهُ أَنْ يَكُونَ أَيْقَظَ عَيْنًا، وَأَشَدَّ سَفَرًا، أَوْ قَالَ: مَكِيدَةً»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq transmitted from Ma'mar, from Ayyub, from al-Hasan and Muhammad b. Sirin: When the Prophet ﷺ appointed 'Amr b. al-'As to command an army, he said: “
entries.matn_en: I may dispatch one man and leave behind someone I love more than him, because the one I dispatch may have a more watchful eye and be better at travel—or he said, at strategy.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنِ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ، أَنَّ
entries.matn_ar: عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ اسْتَعْمَلَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ عَلَى الْبَحْرَيْنِ، فَقَدِمَ بَعَشَرَةِ آلَافٍ، فَقَالَ لَهُ عُمَرُ: اسْتَأْثَرْتَ بِهَذِهِ الْأَمْوَالِ يَا عَدُوَّ اللَّهِ، وَعَدُوَّ كِتَابِهِ، قَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ: «لَسْتُ عَدُوَّ اللَّهِ، وَلَا عَدُوَّ كِتَابِهِ، وَلَكِنِّي عَدُوُّ مَنْ عَادَاهُمَا» ، قَالَ: فَمِنْ أَيْنَ هِيَ لَكَ؟ قَالَ: «خَيْلٌ لِي تَنَاتَجَتْ، وَغُلَّةُ رَقِيقٍ لِي، وَأُعْطِيَةٌ تَتَابَعَتْ عَلَيَّ» فَنَظَرُوهُ، فَوَجَدُوهُ كَمَا قَالَ، قَالَ: فَلَمَّا كَانَ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ، دَعَاهُ عُمَرُ لِيَسْتَعْمِلَهُ، فَأَبَى أَنْ يَعْمَلَ لَهُ، فَقَالَ: أتَكْرَهُ الْعَمَلَ وَقَدْ طَلَبَ الْعَمَلَ مَنْ كَانَ خَيْرًا مِنْكَ يُوسُفُ؟ قَالَ: «إِنَّ يُوسُفَ نَبِيٌّ ابْنُ نَبِيٍّ ابْنِ نَبِيٍّ، وَأَنَا أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ ابْنُ أُمَيْمَةَ أَخْشَى ثَلَاثًا وَاثْنَيْنِ» ، قَالَ لَهُ عُمَرُ: أَفَلَا قُلْتَ: خَمْسًا؟ قَالَ: «§لَا، أَخْشَى أَنْ أَقُولَ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ، وَأَقْضِيَ بِغَيْرِ حُكْمٍ، وَيُضْرَبَ ظَهْرِي، وَيُنْتَزَعَ مَالِي، وَيُشْتَمَ عِرْضِي»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq transmitted from Ma'mar, from Ayyub, from Ibn Sirin: 'Umar b. al-Khattab
entries.matn_en: appointed Abu Hurayra governor of Bahrain. When he returned with ten thousand, 'Umar said: “Have you appropriated these funds for yourself, enemy of God and His Book?” Abu Hurayra answered: “I am not an enemy of God or His Book, but an enemy of whoever is hostile to them.” 'Umar asked where the money had come from. He replied: “Horses of mine that bred, revenue from slaves of mine, and stipends that accumulated.” They investigated and found his account accurate. Later 'Umar invited him to accept another appointment, but he refused. 'Umar said: “Do you dislike public office when someone better than you—Joseph—asked for it?” He replied: “Joseph was a prophet, the son of a prophet, son of a prophet. I am Abu Hurayra, son of Umayma. I fear three things and two things.” 'Umar asked why he did not simply say five. He answered: “No. I fear speaking without knowledge, judging without justice, having my back beaten, my property seized, and my honor insulted.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ صَاحِبٍ لَهُ أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: وَيْلٌ لِلْأُمَنَاءِ، وَيْلٌ لِلْعُرَفَاءِ، لَيَتَمَنَّيَنَّ أَقْوَامٌ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ أَنَّهُمْ كَانُوا مُعَلَّقِينَ بِذَوَائِبِهِمْ مِنَ الثُّرَيَّا، وَأَنَّهُمْ لَمْ يَكُونُوا وَلُوا شَيْئًا قَطُّ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq transmitted from Ma'mar, from an associate of his, that Abu Hurayra said: “
entries.matn_en: Woe to the trustees! Woe to the district officials! On the Day of Resurrection some people will wish they had been suspended by the hair of their heads from the Pleiades rather than ever having held any office.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ طَاوُسٍ، أَوْ غَيْرِهِ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: لَمْ يُجْهِدِ الْبَلَاءُ مَنْ لَمْ يَتَوَلَّ يَتَامَى، أَوْ يَكُنْ قَاضِيًا بَيْنَ النَّاسِ فِي أَمْوَالِهِمْ، أَوْ أَمِيرًا عَلَى رِقَابِهِمْ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq transmitted from Ma'mar, from Ibn Tawus or someone else, from Tawus, who said: “
entries.matn_en: A person has not experienced the most exhausting trial unless he has managed orphans' affairs, judged between people concerning their property, or governed over their lives.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ أَبِي النَّجُودِ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ، كَانَ إِذَا بَعَثَ عُمَّالَهُ شَرَطَ عَلَيْهِمْ: «§
entries.matn_ar: أَلَّا تَرْكَبُوا بِرْذَوْنًا، وَلَا تَأْكُلُوا نَقِيًّا، وَلَا تَلْبَسُوا رَقِيقًا، وَلَا تُغلِقُوا أَبْوَابَكُمْ دُونَ حَوَائِجِ النَّاسِ، فَإِنْ فَعَلْتُمْ شَيْئًا مِنْ ذَلِكَ فَقَدْ حَلَّتْ بِكُمُ الْعُقُوبَةُ» ، قَالَ: ثُمَّ شَيَّعَهُمْ، فَإِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَرْجِعَ قَالَ: «إِنِّي لَمْ أُسَلِّطْكُمْ عَلَى دِمَاءِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ، وَلَا عَلَى أَعْرَاضِهِمْ، وَلَا عَلَى أَمْوَالِهِمْ، وَلَكِنِّي بَعَثْتُكُمْ لُتُقِيمُوا بِهِمُ الصَّلَاةَ، وَتَقْسِمُوا فَيْئَهُمْ، وَتَحْكُمُوا بَيْنَهُمْ بِالْعَدْلِ، فَإِنْ أَشْكَلَ عَلَيْكُمْ شَيْءٌ، فَارْفَعُوهُ إِلَيَّ، أَلَا فَلَا تَضْرِبُوا الْعَرَبَ فَتُذِلُّوهَا، وَلَا تُجَمِّرُوهَا فَتَفْتِنُوهَا، وَلَا تَعْتَلُّوا عَلَيْهَا فَتَحْرِمُوهَا، جَرِّدُوا الْقُرْآنَ، وَأَقِلُّوا الرِّوَايَةَ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، انْطَلِقُوا وَأَنَا شَرِيكُكُمْ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq transmitted from Ma'mar, from 'Asim b. Abi al-Najud: When 'Umar b. al-Khattab sent out his officials, he stipulated that they must
entries.matn_en: not ride fine foreign horses, eat refined foods, wear delicate clothing, or close their doors against people's needs. If they did, they would deserve punishment. He accompanied them on their departure and said: “I have not given you authority over the Muslims' blood, honor, or property. I have sent you to establish prayer among them, distribute their public revenues, and judge fairly. If anything is unclear, refer it to me. Do not beat the Arabs and thereby humiliate them; do not keep them stationed too long and thus tempt them; do not make pretexts to deprive them. Keep the Quran unadorned [or: undiluted], and reduce your narration from the Messenger of God ﷺ. Go, and I share responsibility with you.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ زُفَرَ الشَّامِيِّ يَرْفَعُهُ قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: خَيْرُ أُمَرَائِكُمُ الَّذِينَ تُحِبُّونَهُمْ وَيُحِبُّونَكُمْ، وَتَدْعُونَ لَهُمْ وَيَدْعُونَ لَكُمْ، وَشَرُّ أُمَرَائِكُمُ الَّذِينَ تُبْغِضُونَهُمْ وَيُبْغِضُونَكُمْ، وَتَلْعَنُونَهُمْ وَيَلْعَنُونَكُمْ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq transmitted from Ma'mar, from 'Uthman b. Zufar al-Shami, who raised the report [to the Prophet ﷺ]: “
entries.matn_en: The best of your rulers are those you love and who love you, for whom you pray and who pray for you. The worst are those you hate and who hate you, whom you curse and who curse you.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو - قَالَ مَعْمَرٌ: لَا أَعْلَمُهُ إِلَّا رَفَعَهُ - قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: الْمُقْسِطُونَ فِي الدُّنْيَا عَلَى مَنَابِرَ مِنْ لُؤْلُؤٍ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ بَيْنَ يَدَيِ الرَّحْمَنِ بِمَا أَقْسَطُوا فِي الدُّنْيَا»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq transmitted from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, from Ibn al-Musayyab, from 'Abd Allah b. 'Amr—Ma'mar said he believed the report was raised to the Prophet ﷺ: “
entries.matn_en: Those who deal justly in this world will stand on pulpits of pearl before the Merciful on the Day of Resurrection, because of the justice they practiced in this world.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ، قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: أَرَأَيْتُمْ إِنِ اسْتَعْمَلْتُ عَلَيْكُمْ خَيْرَ مَنْ أَعْلَمُ، وَأمَرْتُهُ بِالْعَدْلِ، أَقَضَيْتُ مَا عَلَيَّ؟» ، قَالُوا: نَعَمْ، قَالَ: «لَا، حَتَّى أَنْظُرَ فِي عَمَلِهِ، أَعَمِلَ مَا أَمَرْتُهُ أَمْ لَا»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq transmitted from Ma'mar, from Ibn Tawus, from his father: 'Umar b. al-Khattab asked: “
entries.matn_en: If I appoint over you the best person I know and command him to be just, have I fulfilled my responsibility?” They said yes. He said: “No—not until I examine his conduct to see whether he did what I ordered.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، أَوْ غَيْرِهِ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ هِلَالٍ، قَالَ: لَمَّا دَفَنَ عُمَرُ، أَبَا بَكْرٍ قَامَ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ، إِنَّ §اللَّهَ قَدِ ابْتَلَانِي بِكُمْ، وَابْتَلَاكُمْ بِي، وَخَلَفْتُ بَعْدَ صَاحِبِي، وَإِنَّهُ وَاللَّهِ لَا يَحْضُرُنِي شَيْءٌ مِنْ أُمُورِكُمْ، وَلَا يَغِيبُ عَنِّي مِنْهَا شَيْءٌ، فَآلُوا فِيهَا عَنْ أَهْلِ الْأَمَانَةِ وَالْإِجْزَاءِ» قَالَ: فَمَا زَالَ عَلَى ذَلِكَ حَتَّى مَضَى
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq transmitted from Ma'mar, from Ayyub or another transmitter, from Humayd b. Hilal: After burying Abu Bakr, 'Umar ascended the pulpit and said: “
entries.matn_en: People, God has tested me through you and tested you through me. I have succeeded my companion. By God, no matter of yours will come before me without my attending to it; and for matters beyond my presence, I will seek those who are trustworthy and competent.” He continued in this way until the end of his life.

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَمَّنْ، سَمِعَ الْحَسَنَ يَقُولُ: «§
entries.matn_ar: لَا تُمَكِّنْ أُذُنَيْكَ صَاحِبَ هَوًى، فَيُمْرِضَ قَلْبَكَ، وَلَا تُجِيبَنَّ أَمِيرًا، وَإِنْ دَعَاكَ لِتَقْرَأَ عِنْدَهُ سُورَةً مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ، فَإِنَّكَ لَا تَخْرُجُ مِنْ عِنْدَهُ إِلَّا شَرًّا مِمَّا دَخَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq transmitted from Ma'mar, from someone who heard al-Hasan say: “
entries.matn_en: Do not offer your ears to a person of deviant inclination, lest he make your heart ill. And do not respond to a ruler's invitation, even if he calls you to recite a chapter of the Quran before him, for you will emerge from his company in a worse state than when you entered.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ الْجُرَيْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ لِرَجُلٍ: «§
entries.matn_ar: لَا تَكُونَنَّ شُرْطِيًّا، وَلَا عَرِيفًا»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq transmitted from Ma'mar, from Sa'id al-Jurayri, from Abu Hurayra, who said to a man: “
entries.matn_en: Do not become a police officer or district supervisor.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ «
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ يَهُودِيًّا جَاءَ إِلَى عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ فَقَالَ لَهُ الْيَهُودِيُّ: إِنَّ ابْنَ هُرْمُزَ ظَلَمَنِي، فَلَمْ يَلْتَفِتْ إِلَيْهِ، ثُمَّ الثَّانِيَةَ، ثُمَّ الثَّالِثَةَ، فَلَمْ يَلْتَفِتْ إِلَيْهِ، فَقَالَ: إِنَّا نَجِدُ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ فِي التَّوْرَاةِ: أَنَّ §الْإِمَامَ لَا يَشْرَكُ فِي ظُلْمٍ وَلَا جَوْرٍ حَتَّى يُرْفَعَ إِلَيْهِ، فَإِذَا رُفِعَ إِلَيْهِ فَلَمْ يُغَيِّرْ شَرِكَ فِي الْجَوْرِ وَالظُّلْمِ، قَالَ: فَفَزِعَ لَهَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ وَأَرْسَلَ إِلَى ابْنِ هُرْمُزَ فَنَزَعَهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Ma'mar transmitted from al-Zuhri: A
entries.matn_en: Jewish man came to 'Abd al-Malik and complained that Ibn Hurmuz had wronged him. 'Abd al-Malik ignored him, even after a second and third appeal. The Jew then said: “We find in the Torah, the Book of God, that a ruler is not implicated in oppression until it is brought before him; once it has been brought before him, if he does not remedy it, he shares in the wrongdoing.” 'Abd al-Malik was alarmed and sent for Ibn Hurmuz and removed him from office.

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُسْلِمٍ الْخَوْلَانِيِّ، قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: مَثَلُ الْإِمَامِ كَمَثَلِ عَيْنٍ عَظِيمَةٍ صَافِيَةٍ طَيِّبَةِ الْمَاءِ، يَجْرِي مِنْهَا إِلَى نَهْرٍ عَظِيمٍ، فَيَخُوضُ النَّاسُ النَّهْرَ، فَيُكَدِّرُونَهُ وَيَعُودُ عَلَيْهِ صَفْوُ الْعَيْنِ، قَالَ: فَإِذَا كَانَ الْكَدَرُ مِنْ قِبَلِ الْعَيْنِ فَسَدَ النَّهْرُ، قَالَ: وَمَثَلُ الْإِمَامِ وَالنَّاسِ كَمَثَلِ فُسْطَاطٍ، لَا يَسْتَقِلُّ إِلَّا بِعَمُودٍ، وَلَا يَقُومُ الْعَمُودُ إِلَّا بِأَطْنَابٍ - أَوْ قَالَ: أَوْتَادٍ، فَكُلَّمَا نُزِعَ وَتَدٌ ازْدَادَ الْعَمُودُ وَهْنًا، وَلَا يَصْلُحُ النَّاسُ إِلَّا بِالْإِمَامِ، وَلَا يَصْلُحُ الْإِمَامُ إِلَّا بِالنَّاسِ»
entries.isnad_en: Ma'mar transmitted from Ayyub, from Abu Qilaba, from Abu Muslim al-Khawlani, who said: “
entries.matn_en: The ruler is like a great, clear, sweet spring feeding a mighty river. People wade into the river and muddy it, but the clear waters of the spring purify it again. Yet if the spring itself becomes muddy, the river is ruined. The ruler and his people are also like a tent: it cannot stand without a central pole, and the pole cannot stand without ropes—or, he said, pegs. Each peg pulled out makes the pole weaker, and so it is with a ruler and his people.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، قَالَ: سُئِلَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ: هَلْ كَانَ أَصْحَابُ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَضْحَكُونَ؟ قَالَ: «نَعَمْ، §
entries.matn_ar: وَالْإِيمَانُ فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ أَعْظَمُ مِنِ الْجِبَالِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq informed us, he said: Ma'mar informed us, from Qatada, who said: Ibn 'Umar was asked: Did the Companions of the Prophet, ﷺ, laugh? He said: 'Yes,
entries.matn_en: and faith in their hearts was greater than the mountains.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنِ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ، قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: كُنْتُ أَسْمَعُ الْحَدِيثَ مِنْ عَشْرٍ، اللَّفْظُ مُخْتَلِفٌ وَالْمَعْنَى وَاحِدٌ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq transmitted from Ma'mar, from Ayyub, from Ibn Sirin: “
entries.matn_en: I heard this meaning from ten men, each of whom used a different wording.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: كَانَ قُضَاةُ أَصْحَابِ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ سِتَّةً: عُمَرُ، وَعَلِيٌّ، وَأُبَيُّ بْنُ كَعْبٍ، وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْعُودٍ، وَأَبُو مُوسَى الْأَشْعَرِيُّ، وَزَيْدُ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ، فَكَانَ قَضَاءُ عُمَرَ، وَابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، وَالْأَشْعَرِيِّ يُوَافِقُ بَعْضُهُمْ بَعْضًا، وَكَانَ يَأْخُذُ بَعْضُهُمْ مِنْ بَعْضٍ، وَكَانَ قَضَاءُ عَلِيٍّ، وَأُبَيٍّ، وَزَيْدِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ يُشْبِهُ بَعْضُهُ بَعْضًا، وَكَانَ بَعْضُهُمْ يَأْخُذُ مِنْ بَعْضٍ، قَالَ: وَكَانَ زَيْدٌ يَأْخُذُ مِنْ عَلِيٍّ، وَأُبَيٍّ مَا بَدَا لَهُ»
entries.isnad_en: 20673 – 'Abd al-Razzaq informed us, saying: Ma'mar informed us, from Qatada, who said:
entries.matn_en: "The judges among the Companions of Muhammad, ﷺ, were six: 'Umar, 'Ali, Ubayy b. Ka'b, 'Abd Allah b. Mas'ud, Abu Musa al-Ash'ari and Zayd b. Thabit. The rulings of 'Umar, Ibn Mas'ud and al-Ash'ari agreed with one another, and some of them would take from others. And the rulings of 'Ali, Ubayy and Zayd b. Thabit resembled one another, and some of them would take from others." He said: "And Zayd would take from 'Ali and Ubayy whatever suited him."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ - رَجُلٍ مِنَ آلِ أَبِي رَبِيعَةَ - أَنَّهُ بَلَغَهُ أَنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ حِينَ اسْتُخْلِفَ قَعَدَ فِي بَيْتِهِ حَزِينًا، فَدَخَلَ عَلَيْهِ عُمَرُ، فَأَقْبَلَ عَلَى عُمَرَ يَلُومُهُ، وَقَالَ: أَنْتَ كَلَّفْتَنِي هَذَا، وَشَكَا إِلَيْهِ الْحُكْمَ بَيْنَ النَّاسِ، فَقَالَ لَهُ عُمَرُ: أَمَا عَلِمْتَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ: «إِنَّ §
entries.matn_ar: الْوَالِيَ إِذَا اجْتَهَدَ فَأَصَابَ الْحُكْمَ فَلَهُ أَجْرَانِ، وَإِذَا اجْتَهَدَ فَأَخْطَأَ فَلَهُ أَجْرٌ وَاحِدٌ» ، قَالَ: فَكَأَنَّهُ سَهَّلَ عَلَى أَبِي بَكْرٍ حَدِيثُ عُمَرَ
entries.isnad_en: Ma'mar transmitted from Musa b. Ibrahim, a man of the family of Abu Rabi'a, that he heard this account: When Abu Bakr became caliph, he sat at home grieving. 'Umar visited, and Abu Bakr reproached him: “You have imposed this on me,” lamenting the burden of deciding disputes among people. 'Umar said: “Do you not know that the Messenger of God ﷺ said: ‘
entries.matn_en: When a governor exerts his judgment and reaches the correct ruling, he receives two rewards; when he exerts his judgment and errs, he receives one reward’?” 'Umar's report appeared to ease Abu Bakr's concern.

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ أَنَّ عَلِيًّا، قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: الْقُضَاةُ ثَلَاثَةٌ: قَاضٍ اجْتَهَدَ فَأَخْطَأَ فِي النَّارِ، وَقَاضٍ رَأَى الْحَقَّ فَقَضَى بِغَيْرِهِ فِي النَّارِ، وَقَاضٍ اجْتَهَدَ فَأَصَابَ فِي الْجَنَّةِ»
entries.isnad_en: Ma'mar transmitted from Qatada that 'Ali said: “
entries.matn_en: Judges are three: one who exerts judgment and makes a mistake is in the Fire; one who knows the right yet rules contrary to it is in the Fire; and one who exerts judgment and is correct is in Paradise.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، قَالَ: كَتَبَ عُمَرُ إِلَى أَبِي مُوسَى: «§
entries.matn_ar: إِيَّاكَ وَالضَّجْرَةَ، وَالْغَضَبَ، وَالْغَلَقَ، وَالتَّأَذِّيَ بِالنَّاسِ عِنْدَ الْخُصُومَةِ» ، قَالَ: وَكَتَبَ إِلَيْهِ: «أَلَّا يَقْضِيَ إِلَّا أَمِيرٌ، فَإِنَّهُ أَهْيَبُ لِلظَّالِمِ، وَلِشَاهِدِ الزُّورِ، وَإِذَا جَلَسَ عِنْدَكَ الْخَصْمَانِ، فَرَأَيْتَ أَحَدَهُمَا يَتَعَمَّدُ الظُّلْمَ، فَأَوْجِعْ رَأْسَهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Ma'mar transmitted from Qatada: 'Umar wrote to Abu Musa: “
entries.matn_en: Beware of impatience, anger, anxiety, and taking offense at people during litigation.” He also wrote: “Let none judge but a governor, for he is more imposing to wrongdoers and false witnesses. When two disputants sit before you and you perceive one deliberately acting unjustly, give him a severe blow to the head.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنِ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ، أَنَّ عَلِيًّا، قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: اقْضُوا كَمَا كُنْتُمْ تَقْضُونَ حَتَّى تَكُونُوا جَمَاعَةً، فَإِنِّي أَخْشَى الِاخْتِلَافَ»
entries.isnad_en: Ma'mar transmitted from Ayyub, from Ibn Sirin, that 'Ali said: “
entries.matn_en: Judge as you used to judge, so that you may remain one community, for I fear division.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنِ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ، قَالَ لِابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ: «
entries.matn_ar: أَمَا بَلَغَنِي أَنَّكَ تَقْضِي وَلَسْتَ بِأَمِيرٍ» ، قَالَ: بَلَى، قَالَ: «§فَوَلِّ حَارَّهَا مَنْ تَوَلَّى قَارَّهَا»
entries.isnad_en: Ma'mar transmitted from Ayyub, from Ibn Sirin: Someone said to Ibn Mas'ud, “
entries.matn_en: Have I not heard that you judge cases though you are not governor?” He answered yes. The man said: “Leave the heat of it to whoever enjoys its coolness.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: قَرَأْنَا عَلَى عَبْدِ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «§
entries.matn_ar: مَنْ أَطَاعَنِي فَقَدْ أَطَاعَ اللَّهَ، وَمَنْ عَصَانِي فَقَدْ عَصَى اللَّهَ، وَمَنْ أَطَاعَ أَمِيرِي فَقَدْ أَطَاعَنِي، وَمَنْ عَصَى أَمِيرِي فَقَدْ عَصَانِي»
entries.isnad_en: The transmitters said: We recited to 'Abd al-Razzaq from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, from Abu Salama, from Abu Hurayra, who said that the Messenger of God ﷺ said: “
entries.matn_en: Whoever obeys me obeys God, and whoever disobeys me disobeys God. Whoever obeys my commander obeys me, and whoever disobeys my commander disobeys me.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ: «إِنَّهَا §
entries.matn_ar: سَتَكُونُ عَلَيْكُمْ أُمَرَاءُ يَتْرُكُونَ بَعْضَ مَا أُمِرُوا بِهِ، فَمَنْ نَاوَأَهُمْ نَجَا، وَمَنْ كَرِهَ سَلِمَ، أَوْ كَادَ يَسْلَمُ، وَمَنْ خَالَطَهُمْ فِي ذَلِكَ هَلَكَ، أَوْ كَادَ يَهْلِكُ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq transmitted from Ma'mar, from Ibn Tawus, from his father, that the Prophet ﷺ said: “
entries.matn_en: You will have rulers who neglect some of what they have been ordered to do. Whoever stands against them is saved; whoever dislikes their conduct is safe—or nearly so; but whoever joins them in it perishes—or nearly perishes.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: سَتَكُونُ عَلَيْكُمْ أُمَرَاءُ بَعْدِي فَيَعْمَلُونَ أَعْمَالًا تَعْرِفُونَ وَتُنْكِرُونَ، فَمَنَ أَنْكَرَ فَقَدْ بَرِئَ، وَمَنْ كَرِهَ فَقَدْ سَلِمَ، وَلَكِنْ مَنْ رَضِيَ وَشَايَعَ» ، قَالُوا: أَفَلَا نُقَاتِلُهُمْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ؟ قَالَ: «لَا، مَا صَلَّوْا»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq transmitted from Ma'mar, from Qatada, from al-Hasan, that the Prophet ﷺ said: “
entries.matn_en: After me you will have rulers whose deeds you both recognize and reject. Whoever rejects [their evil] is free of blame, and whoever hates it is safe, but not whoever approves of it and follows it.” They asked: “Should we not fight them, Messenger of God?” He answered: “No, as long as they pray.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ أَبِي رَجَاءٍ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ يَقُولُ: «§
entries.matn_ar: مَنْ خَرَجَ مِنَ الطَّاعَةِ شِبْرًا فَمَاتَ فَمِيتَتُهُ جَاهِلِيَّةٌ»
entries.isnad_en: Ma'mar transmitted from Ayyub, from Abu Raja', who said he heard Ibn 'Abbas say: “
entries.matn_en: Whoever withdraws a handspan from obedience and dies has died a death of the age of ignorance.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنِ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ، قَالَ: كَانَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرُ يَأْخُذَانِ عَلَى مَنْ دَخَلَ فِي الْإِسْلَامِ فَيَقُولَانِ: «§
entries.matn_ar: تُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ لَا تُشْرِكُ بِهِ شَيْئًا، وَتُصَلِّي الصَّلَاةَ الَّتِي افْتَرَضَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْكَ لِوَقْتِهَا، فَإنَّ فِي تَفْرِيطِهَا الْهَلَكَةُ، وَتُؤَدِّي زَكَاةَ مَالِكَ طَيِّبَةً بِهَا نَفْسُكَ، وَتَصُومُ رَمَضَانَ، وَتَحُجُّ الْبَيْتَ، وَتَسْمَعُ وَتُطِيعُ لِمَنْ وَلَّى اللَّهُ الْأَمْرَ» ، - قَالَ: وَزَادَ رَجُلًا مَرَّةً: «تَعْمَلُ لِلَّهِ وَلَا تَعْمَلُ لِلنَّاسِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq transmitted from Ma'mar, from Ayyub, from Ibn Sirin: Abu Bakr and 'Umar would require of anyone entering Islam: “
entries.matn_en: Believe in God without associating anything with Him; pray the prayers God has prescribed at their times, for neglecting them leads to ruin; pay the alms on your property willingly; fast Ramadan; perform pilgrimage to the House; and hear and obey whoever God appoints to authority.” On one occasion, one of them added to a man: “Work for God, not for people.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَخَذَ عَلَى رَجُلٍ دَخَلَ فِي الْإِسْلَامِ فَقَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: تُقِيمُ الصَّلَاةَ، وَتُؤْتِي الزَّكَاةَ، وَتَحُجُّ الْبَيْتَ، وَتَصُومُ رَمَضَانَ، وَإِنَّكَ لَا تَرَى نَارَ مُشْرِكٍ إِلَّا وَأَنْتَ لَهُ حَرْبٌ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq transmitted from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, that the Prophet ﷺ required of a man entering Islam: “
entries.matn_en: Establish prayer, give alms, perform pilgrimage to the House, fast Ramadan, and whenever you see the fire of a polytheist, be at war with him.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ حِينَ بَايَعَ النَّاسَ قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: إِنِّي لَا أُصَافِحُ النِّسَاءَ» ، فَلَمْ تَمَسَّ يَدُهُ يَدَ امْرَأَةٍ مِنْهُنَّ إِلَّا امْرَأَةً يَمْلِكُهَا
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq transmitted from Ma'mar, from Ibn Tawus, from his father: When the Prophet ﷺ accepted pledges from people, he said: “
entries.matn_en: I do not shake hands with women.” His hand did not touch any woman's hand among them, except that of a woman whom he owned.

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنْ جُنَادَةَ بْنِ أَبِي أُمَيَّةَ: أَنَّ عُبَادَةَ بْنَ الصَّامِتِ، قَالَ لَهُ: «§
entries.matn_ar: ادْنُ حَتَّى أُخْبِرَكَ بِمَا لَكَ وَمَا عَلَيْكَ، إِنَّ عَلَيْكَ السَّمْعَ وَالطَّاعَةَ فِي عُسْرِكَ وَيُسْرِكَ، وَمَكْرَهِكَ وَمَنْشَطِكَ، وَالْأَثَرَةُ عَلَيْكَ، وَأَلَّا تُنَازِعَ الْأَمْرَ أَهْلَهُ، إِلَّا أَنْ تُؤْمَرَ بِمَعْصِيَةِ اللَّهِ بَرَاحًا، فَإِنْ أُمِرْتَ بِخِلَافِ مَا فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ فَاتَّبِعْ كِتَابَ اللَّهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Ma'mar transmitted from Mansur, from Mujahid, from Junada b. Abi Umayya, that 'Ubada b. al-Samit said to him: “
entries.matn_en: Come closer so I may tell you your rights and obligations. You must hear and obey in difficulty and ease, in what you dislike and what you enjoy, even when others are preferred over you; you must not dispute authority with those holding it, unless you are commanded to commit an unmistakable act of disobedience to God. If you are commanded contrary to what is in God's Book, follow God's Book.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ، قَالَ: قَالَ عُبَادَةُ بْنُ الصَّامِتِ، لِجُنَادَةَ أَبِي أُمَيَّةَ: «
entries.matn_ar: يَا جُنَادَةُ أَلَا أُخْبِرُكَ بِالَّذِي لَكَ وَالَّذِي عَلَيْكَ؟ إِنَّ §عَلَيْكَ السَّمْعَ وَالطَّاعَةَ فِي عُسْرِكَ وَيُسْرِكَ، وَمَنْشَطِكَ وَمَكْرَهِكَ، وَفِي الْأَثَرَةِ عَلَيْكَ، وَأَنْ تَدَعَ لِسَانَكَ بِالْقَوْلِ، وَأَلَّا تُنَازِعَ الْأَمْرَ أَهْلَهُ، إِلَّا أَنْ تُؤْمَرَ بِمَعْصِيَةِ اللَّهِ بَرَاحًا، فَإِنْ أُمِرْتَ بِخِلَافِ مَا فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ فَاتَّبِعْ كِتَابَ اللَّهِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq transmitted from Ma'mar, from Ayyub, from Abu Qilaba, that 'Ubada b. al-Samit said to Junada b. Abi Umayya: “Junada,
entries.matn_en: shall I tell you your rights and obligations? You must hear and obey in hardship and ease, whether eager or reluctant, even when others are favored over you; restrain your tongue from speaking [against them]; and do not dispute authority with its holders unless you are commanded to disobey God openly. If you are commanded contrary to God's Book, follow God's Book.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ بُرْقَانَ، عَنْ لَيْثٍ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ أَبِي الْحَجَّاجِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَفِيفٍ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: أَتَيْتُ أَبَا بَكْرٍ وَهُوَ يُبَايِعُ النَّاسَ فَقَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: أَنَا أُبَايِعُكُمْ عَلَى السَّمْعِ وَالطَّاعَةِ لِلَّهِ وَلِكِتَابِهِ، ثُمَّ لِلْأَمِيرِ» قَالَ: فَتَعَلَّمْتُ ذَلِكَ، قَالَ: فَجِئْتُهُ فَقُلْتُ: أُبَايِعُكَ عَلَى السَّمْعِ وَالطَّاعَةِ لِلَّهِ وَلِكِتَابِهِ، ثُمَّ لِلْأَمِيرِ، قَالَ: فَصَعَّدَ فِيَّ الْبَصَرَ وَصَوَّبَ كَأَنِّي أَعْجَبْتُهُ، ثُمَّ بَايَعَنِي
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq transmitted from Ma'mar, from Ja'far b. Burqan, from Layth, from Thabit Abu al-Hajjaj, from Ibn 'Afif: “I came to Abu Bakr as he was taking people's pledges, saying: ‘
entries.matn_en: I receive your pledge to hear and obey God and His Book, and then the commander.’ I memorized those words, and came forward saying, ‘I pledge to hear and obey God and His Book, and then the commander.’ He looked me up and down, as though pleased with what I had said, and accepted my pledge.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ، قَالَ عُمَرُ: «
entries.matn_ar: مَا قِوَامُ هَذَا الْأَمْرِ يَا مُعَاذُ؟» ، قَالَ: الْإِسْلَامُ وَهِيَ الْفِطْرَةُ، وَالْإِخْلَاصُ وَهِيَ الْمِلَّةُ، وَالطَّاعَةُ وَهِيَ الْعِصْمَةُ، ثُمَّ سَيَكُونُ بَعْدَكَ اخْتِلَافٌ، قَالَ: ثُمَّ قَفَا عُمَرَ سَرِيرًا فَقَالَ: «أَمَا إِنَّ §سِنِيَّكَ خَيْرٌ مِنْ سِنِيِّهِمْ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq transmitted from Ma'mar, from Ayyub, from Abu Qilaba: 'Umar asked Mu'adh, “
entries.matn_en: What sustains this affair?” He said: “Islam, which is the natural disposition; sincerity, which is the religion; and obedience, which is protection. But disagreement will come after you.” Then he [Mu'adh, according to the wording] struck the back of 'Umar's couch and said: “Your years will be better than theirs.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، أَوْ غَيْرِهِ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ هِلَالٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ صَامِتٍ، قَالَ: لَمَّا قَدِمَ أَبُو ذَرٍّ عَلَى عُثْمَانَ قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: أَخَفْتَنِي، فَوَاللَّهِ لَوْ أَمَرْتَنِي أَنْ أَتَعَلَّقَ بعُرْوَةِ قَتَبٍ حَتَّى أَمُوتَ لَفَعَلْتُ»
entries.isnad_en: Ma'mar transmitted from Ayyub or another, from Humayd b. Hilal, from 'Abd Allah b. Samit: When Abu Dharr came before 'Uthman, he said: “
entries.matn_en: You have frightened me. By God, if you commanded me to cling to the strap of a pack-saddle until I died, I would do it.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي نَوْفَلُ بْنُ مُسَاحِقٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: بَيْنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ حُنَيْفٍ يُكَلِّمُ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ - وَكَانَ عَامِلًا لَهُ - قَالَ: فَأَغْضَبَهُ فَأَخَذَ عُمَرُ مِنَ الْبَطْحَاءِ قَبْضَةً فَرَجَمَهُ بِهَا، فَأَصَابَ حَجَرٌ مِنْهَا جَبِينَهُ فَشَجَّهُ، فَسَالَ الدَّمُ عَلَى لِحْيَتِهِ، فَكَأَنَّهُ نَدِمَ، فَقَالَ: امْسَحِ الدَّمَ عَنْ لِحْيتِكَ، فَقَالَ: «§لَا يَهْلِكُ هَذَا يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، فَوَاللَّهِ لَمَا انْتَهَكْتُ مِمَّنْ وَلَّيْتَنِي أَمْرَهُ، أَشَدُّ مِمَّا انْتَهَكْتَ مِنِّي» ، قَالَ: فَكَأَنَّهُ أَعْجَبَ عُمَرَ ذَلِكَ مِنْهُ وَزَادَهُ عِنْدَهُ خَيْرًا
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq transmitted from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, who said Naufal b. Musahiq told him:
entries.matn_en: While 'Uthman b. Hunayf, an official of 'Umar, was speaking to 'Umar b. al-Khattab, he angered him. 'Umar picked up a handful of stones from the gravel and threw them; one hit his forehead and cut it, sending blood down his beard. Apparently regretting it, 'Umar said: “Wipe the blood from your beard.” The official answered: “This is not what will destroy me, Commander of the Believers. By God, what I have violated against those you put under my authority is worse than what you have done to me.” 'Umar apparently admired that admission and esteemed him more highly.

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ مُطْعِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَجُلًا كَلَّمَ أَبَا بَكْرٍ فِي بَعْضِ وَلَايَتِهِ، فَقَالَ: وَاللَّهِ إِنَّكَ لَأَحَبُّ النَّاسِ إِلَيَّ رُشْدًا بَعْدَ نَفْسِي، قَالَ: «§وَمِنْ نَفْسِكَ فِي بَعْضِ الْأُمُورِ»
entries.isnad_en: Ma'mar transmitted from al-Zuhri, from Muhammad b. Jubayr b. Mut'im, from his father:
entries.matn_en: A man spoke with Abu Bakr about one of his appointments. Abu Bakr said: “By God, you are the person whose sound judgment I love most after my own.” The man said: “And even more than your own in certain matters.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنِ السَّائِبِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، أَنَّ رَجُلًا قَالَ لِعُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ: لَا أَخَافُ فِي اللَّهِ لَوْمَةَ لَائِمٍ خَيْرٌ لِي أَمْ أُقْبِلُ عَلَى نَفْسِي؟ فَقَالَ: «أَمَّا §مَنْ وَلِيَ مِنْ أَمْرِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ شَيْئًا، فَ
entries.matn_ar: لَا يَخَفْ فِي اللَّهِ لَوْمَةَ لَائِمٍ، وَمَنْ كَانَ خِلْوًا فَلْيُقْبِلْ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ، وَلْيَنْصَحْ لِوَلِيِّ أَمْرِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Ma'mar transmitted from al-Zuhri, from al-Sa'ib b. Yazid: A man asked 'Umar b. al-Khattab whether it was better for him to fear no one's reproach in God's cause or to concentrate on his own shortcomings. 'Umar said: “
entries.matn_en: Whoever holds responsibility for any matter of the Muslims should fear no reproach in God's cause; whoever has no office should attend to himself and sincerely advise his governor.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنِ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ، قَالَ: قَالَ أَبُو مَسْعُودٍ الْأَنْصَارِيُّ: «§
entries.matn_ar: كُنْتُ رَجُلًا حَمِيَّ الْأَنْفِ، عَزِيزَ النَّفْسِ، لَا يَسْتَقِلُّ مِنِّي سُلْطَانٌ، وَلَا غَيْرُهُ شَيْئًا، فَأَصْبَحْتُ تُخَيِّرُنِي امْرَأَتِي بَيْنَ أَنْ أَقَرَّ عَلَى رَغْمِ أَنْفِي وَقُبْحِ وَجْهِي، وَبَيْنَ أَنْ آخُذَ سَيْفِي، فَأَضْرِبَ بِهِ فَأَدْخُلَ النَّارَ، فَاخْتَرْتُ أَنْ أَقَرَّ عَلَى قُبْحِ وَجْهِي وَرَغْمِ أَنْفِي»
entries.isnad_en: Ma'mar transmitted from Ayyub, from Ibn Sirin, who reported Abu Mas'ud al-Ansari saying: “
entries.matn_en: I was once proud and fiercely independent, unwilling to accept even the slightest affront from ruler or anyone else. Now my wife offers me a choice: to bear humiliation and an unpleasant situation, or to take my sword, strike with it, and enter the Fire. I chose to remain despite humiliation and disgrace.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَجُلًا مِنْ حِمْصَ يُقَالُ لَهُ: كُرَيْبُ بْنُ سَيْفٍ أَوْ سَيْفُ بْنُ كُرَيْبٍ جَاءَ إِلَى عُثْمَانَ فَقَالَ: «مَا جَاءَ بِكَ، أَبِإِذْنٍ جِئْتَ أَمْ عَاصٍ؟» ، قَالَ: بَلْ نَصِيحَةُ أَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، قَالَ: «وَمَا نَصِيحَتُكَ؟» ، قَالَ: §لَا تَكِلِ الْمُؤْمِنَ إِلَى إِيمَانِهِ حَتَّى تُعْطِيَهُ مِنَ الْمَالِ مَا يُصْلِحُهُ - أَوْ قَالَ: مَا يُعِيشُهُ -، وَلَا تَكِلْ ذَا الْأَمَانَةِ إِلَى أَمَانَتِهِ حَتَّى تُطَالِعَهُ فِي عَمَلِكَ، وَلَا تُرْسِلِ السَّقِيمَ إِلَى الْبَرِيءِ لِيُبْرِئَهُ، فَإنَّ اللَّهَ يُبْرِئُ السَّقِيمَ، وَقَدْ يُسْقِمُ السَّقِيمُ الْبَرِيءَ، قَالَ: «مَا أَرَدْتَ إِلَّا الْخَيْرَ» قَالَ: فَرَدَّهُمْ وَهُمْ زَيْدُ بْنُ صُوحَانَ وَأَصْحَابُهُ
entries.isnad_en: Ma'mar transmitted from Ayyub, from Abu Qilaba:
entries.matn_en: A man from Hims called Kurayb b. Sayf—or Sayf b. Kurayb—came to 'Uthman. The caliph asked: “Did you come with permission or in rebellion?” He said: “I came to give sincere advice to the Commander of the Believers.” Asked what advice, he said: “Do not rely solely on a believer's faith: give him sufficient money for his welfare—or livelihood. Do not rely solely on a trustworthy man's honesty: inspect the work you entrust to him. And do not send someone sick among healthy people to make him well; God heals the sick, and the sick person may infect the healthy.” 'Uthman said: “You intended only good,” and sent back the men, among them Zayd b. Suhan and his associates.

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: إِقْرَارٌ بِبَعْضِ الظُّلْمِ خَيْرٌ مِنَ الْقِيَامِ فِيهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Ma'mar transmitted from Ibn Tawus, from his father, who said: “
entries.matn_en: Admitting to a measure of injustice is better than continuing to persist in it.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: لَقِيَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَبَا ذَرٍّ وَهُوَ يُحَرِّكُ رَأْسَهُ، فَقَالَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، أَتَعْجَبُ مِنِّي؟ قَالَ: «لَا، وَلَكِنْ مِمَّا تَلْقَوْنَ مِنْ أُمَرَائِكُمْ بَعْدِي» قَالَ: أَفَلَا آخُذُ سَيْفِي فَأَضْرِبُ بِهِ، قَالَ: «لَا، وَلَكِنِ §اسْمَعْ وَأَطِعْ وَإِنْ كَانَ عَبْدًا حَبَشِيًّا مُجَدَّعًا، فَانْقَدْ حَيْثُ مَا قَادَكَ، وَانْسَقْ حَيْثُ مَا سَاقَكَ، وَاعْلَمْ أَنَّ أَسْرَعَ أَرْضِ الْعَرَبِ خَرَابًا الْجَنَاحَانِ: مِصْرُ وَالْعِرَاقُ»
entries.isnad_en: Ma'mar transmitted from Qatada:
entries.matn_en: The Prophet ﷺ encountered Abu Dharr as he shook his head. Abu Dharr asked whether the Prophet ﷺ was amazed at him. He replied: “No, but at what you will encounter from your rulers after me.” Abu Dharr asked whether he should take his sword and strike. He replied: “No. Hear and obey even if it is a mutilated Ethiopian slave. Follow wherever he leads you and let yourself be driven wherever he drives you. Know that the two wings, Egypt and Iraq, are the parts of the Arab lands quickest to fall into ruin.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَجُلٌ لِعَامِرِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ وَهُوَ يُمَرِّضُهُ: أَوْصِ، قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: بِمَا أُوصِي؟ مَا لِي مَالٌ فَأُوصِيَ مِنْهُ، وَلَا يَدٌ عِنْدَ سُلْطَانٍ فَأُوصِيَهُ، وَلَكِنْ §أُوصِيكَ بِتَقْوَى اللَّهِ، وَأَنْ تَسْمَعَ وَتُطِيعَ مَنْ وَلَّى اللَّهُ أَمْرَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ»
entries.isnad_en: Ma'mar transmitted from Qatada: A man visiting 'Amir b. Qays during his illness asked him for final advice. He said: “
entries.matn_en: What can I bequeath? I have no property to dispose of, nor influence with a ruler to recommend someone. But I counsel you to fear God and to hear and obey whoever God places in charge of the Muslims.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ
entries.matn_ar: بَعَثَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ حُذَافَةَ عَلَى سَرِيَّةٍ، فَأَمَرَ أَصْحَابَهُ، فَأَوْقَدُوا نَارًا، ثُمَّ أمَرَهُمْ أَنْ يَثِبُوهَا فَجَعَلُوا يَثِبُونَهَا، فَجَاءَ شَيْخٌ لِيَثِبَهَا فَوَقَعَ فِيهَا، فَاحْتَرَقَ مِنْهُ بَعْضُ مَا احْتَرَقَ، فَذَكَرَ شَأْنَهُ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَقَالَ: «مَا حَمَلَكُمْ عَلَى ذَلِكَ؟» ، قَالُوا: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، كَانَ أَمِيرًا، وَكَانَتْ لَهُ طَاعَةٌ، قَالَ: «§أَيُّمَا أَمِيرٍ أَمَّرْتُهُ عَلَيْكُمْ، فأَمَرَكُمْ بِغَيْرِ طَاعَةِ اللَّهِ فَلَا تُطِيعُوهُ، فَإِنَّهُ لَا طَاعَةَ فِي مَعْصِيَةِ اللَّهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Ma'mar transmitted from Yahya b. Abi Kathir:
entries.matn_en: The Prophet ﷺ appointed 'Abd Allah b. Hudhafa over an expedition. He told his men to kindle a fire and commanded them to leap into it. They began to do so, and an elderly man jumped in and was partly burned. When the event was brought before the Messenger of God ﷺ, he asked why they had done it. They replied: “He was our commander and entitled to obedience.” He said: “Any commander I appoint over you who orders you to do something other than obey God—do not obey him. There is no obedience in disobedience to God.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ غَيْرِ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمْ، عَنِ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ، أَنَّ زِيَادًا،
entries.matn_ar: اسْتَعْمَلَ الْحَكَمَ الْغِفَارِيَّ، فَقَالَ عِمْرَانُ بْنُ الْحُصَيْنِ: وَدِدْتُ أَنِّي أَلْقَاهُ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَخْرُجَ، قَالَ: فَلَقِيَهُ فَقَالَ لَهُ عِمْرَانُ: أَمَا عَلِمْتَ - أَوْ قَالَ: أَمَا سَمِعْتَ - أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ: «§لَا طَاعَةَ لِأَحَدٍ فِي مَعْصِيَةِ اللَّهِ» ، قَالَ: بَلَى، قَالَ: فَذَاكَ الَّذِي أَرَدْتُ أَنْ أَقُولَ لَكَ
entries.isnad_en: Ma'mar transmitted from Ayyub, from several persons including Ibn Sirin:
entries.matn_en: Ziyad appointed al-Hakam al-Ghifari to office. 'Imran b. al-Husayn expressed a wish to meet him before his departure. When they met, 'Imran asked: “Do you not know—or have you not heard—the Messenger of God ﷺ say, ‘No obedience is due to anyone in disobedience to God’?” He replied that he had. 'Imran said: “That is what I wanted to tell you.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ الصِّدِّيقَ خَطَبَ فَقَالَ: أَمَا وَاللَّهِ مَا أَنَا بِخَيْرِكُمْ، وَلَقَدْ كُنْتُ لِمَقَامِي هَذَا كَارِهًا، وَلَوَدِدْتُ لَوْ مَنْ يَكْفِينِي فَتَظُنُّونَ أَنِّي أَعْمَلُ فِيكُمْ سُنَّةَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، إِذًا لَا أَقُومُ لَهَا «إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ §يُعْصَمُ بِالْوَحْيِ، وَكَانَ مَعَهُ مَلَكٌ» ، وَإِنَّ لِي شَيْطَانًا يَعْتَرِينِي، فَإِذَا غَضِبْتُ فَاجْتَنِبُونِي، لَا أُوثِرُ فِي أَشْعَارِكُمْ، وَلَا أَبْشَارِكُمْ أَلَا فَرَاعُونِي، فَإِنِ اسْتَقَمْتُ فَأَعِينُونِي، وَإِنْ زِغْتُ فَقَوِّمُونِي قَالَ الْحَسَنُ: «خُطْبَةٌ وَاللَّهِ مَا خُطِبَ بِهَا بَعْدَهُ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq transmitted from Ma'mar, from an unnamed man, from al-Hasan,
entries.matn_en: that Abu Bakr al-Siddiq preached: “By God, I am not the best of you. I was reluctant to assume this position and wished there were someone who could spare me from it. Do you think I can govern you exactly according to the practice of the Messenger of God ﷺ? I am not capable of that. The Messenger of God ﷺ was protected by revelation and an angel was with him. But I have a devil that overcomes me. When I become angry, avoid me, lest I deal unjustly with your hair or skin. Watch me closely: if I act straight, assist me; if I deviate, correct me.” Al-Hasan said: “By God, no sermon like it has been delivered since.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، قَالَ: وَحَدَّثَنِي بَعْضُ أَهْلِ الْمَدِينَةِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: خَطَبَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ فَقَالَ: «يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ §إِنِّي قَدْ وُلِّيتُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَلَسْتُ بِخَيْرِكُمْ، فَإِنْ ضَعُفْتُ فَقَوِّمُونِي، وَإِنْ أَحْسَنْتُ فَأَعِينُونِي، الصِّدْقُ أَمَانَةٌ، وَالْكَذِبُ خِيَانَةٌ، الضَّعِيفُ فِيكُمُ الْقَوِيُّ عِنْدِي حَتَّى أُزِيحَ عَلَيْهِ حَقَّهُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ، وَالْقَوِيُّ فِيكُمُ الضَّعِيفُ عِنْدِي حَتَّى آخُذَ مِنْهُ الْحَقَّ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ، لَا يَدَعُ قَوْمٌ الْجِهَادَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ إِلَّا ضَرَبَهُمُ اللَّهُ بِالْفَقْرِ، وَلَا ظَهَرَتْ - أَوْ قَالَ: شَاعَتِ - الْفَاحِشَةُ فِي قَوْمٍ إِلَّا عَمَّمَهُمُ الْبَلَاءُ، أَطِيعُونِي مَا أَطَعْتُ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ، فَإِذَا عَصَيْتُ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ فَلَا طَاعَةَ لِي عَلَيْكُمْ، قُومُوا إِلَى صَلَاتِكُمْ يَرْحَمْكُمُ اللَّهُ» قَالَ مَعْمَرٌ: وَأَخْبَرَنِيهِ بَعْضُ أَصْحَابِي
entries.isnad_en: Ma'mar said that a man from Medina told him:
entries.matn_en: Abu Bakr addressed the people: “I have been placed in charge of you, though I am not the best of you. If I weaken, put me right; if I do well, assist me. Truthfulness is a trust, and lying is betrayal. The weak among you is strong with me until, God willing, I secure his rights; the strong among you is weak with me until I take from him what is rightfully due. No people abandon fighting in God's cause without God striking them with poverty; and indecency does not become widespread among people without affliction overtaking them. Obey me so long as I obey God and His Messenger; if I disobey God and His Messenger, you owe me no obedience. Rise for your prayer, may God have mercy on you.” Ma'mar said that some of his companions also transmitted this to him.

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: بَيْنَا أَنَا نَائِمٌ رَأَيْتُ كَأَنِّي عَلَى قَلِيبٍ، فَنَزَعْتُ مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ، ثُمَّ قَامَ ابْنُ أَبِي قُحَافَةَ فَنَزَعَ ذَنُوبًا، أَوْ ذَنُوبَيْنِ، وَفِي نَزْعِهِ - وَلْيَغْفِرِ اللَّهُ لَهُ - ضَعْفٌ، ثُمَّ اسْتَحَالَتِ الرِّشَاءُ غَرْبًا، فَلَمْ أَرَ عَبْقَرِيًّا مِنَ النَّاسِ يَنْزِعُ نَزْعَ ابْنِ الْخَطَّابِ حَتَّى صَدَرَ النَّاسُ عَنْهُ بِعَطَنٍ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq transmitted from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, that the Prophet ﷺ said: “
entries.matn_en: While asleep I dreamed I was standing at a well and drawing as much water as God wished. Then the son of Abu Quhafa stood up and drew a bucket or two, and there was some weakness in his drawing—may God forgive him. Then the small water bucket became a large one. I have not seen a truly exceptional man draw as Ibn al-Khattab did, until the people departed with their animals watered and resting.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ،
entries.matn_ar: لَقِيَ مُعَاوِيَةَ - أَوْ قَالَ: وَفَدَ عَلَيْهِ - فَقَالَ لَهُ مُعَاوِيَةُ: حَاجَتَكَ؟ فَقَالَ: «حَاجَتِي §أَلَّا يُسْفَكَ دَمٌ دُونَكَ، فَإِنَّهُمْ كَذَلِكَ كَانُوا يَفْعَلُونَ، وَلَا يَجْلِسَ عَلَى هَذَا الْمِنْبَرِ غَيْرُكَ، وَأَنْ تُمْضِيَ الْأَعْطِيَةَ للمُحَرَّرِينَ، فَإنَّ عُمَرَ قَدْ أَمْضَى لَهُمْ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq transmitted from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri:
entries.matn_en: Ibn 'Umar met Mu'awiya—or came as part of a delegation to him. Mu'awiya asked what he needed. Ibn 'Umar said: “My request is that no blood be spilled on your behalf, for that is what they used to do; that no one other than you occupy this pulpit; and that you continue stipends for freed persons, for 'Umar had established them.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ لِبَنِي سَاعِدَةَ: «
entries.matn_ar:
مَنْ سَيِّدُكُمْ؟» ، قَالُوا: الْجَدُّ بْنُ قَيْسٍ، قَالَ: «لِمَ سَوَّدْتُمُوهُ؟» ، قَالُوا: إِنَّهُ أَكْثَرُنَا مَالًا، وَإِنَّا عَلَى ذَلِكَ لَنَزُنُّهُ بِالْبُخْلِ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «§وَأَيُّ دَاءٍ أَدْوَأُ مِنَ الْبُخْلِ» ، قَالُوا: فَمَنْ سَيِّدُنَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ؟ قَالَ: «بِشْرُ بْنُ الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ مَعْرُورٍ»
Al-Zuhri added: Al-Bara' b. Ma'rur was the first to face the Ka'ba both in life and death. While the Prophet ﷺ prayed toward Jerusalem in Mecca, al-Bara' faced the Ka'ba. The Prophet ﷺ sent word that he should pray toward Jerusalem, and he obeyed. As death approached, he instructed his family to turn him toward the Ka'ba.
قَالَ الزُّهْرِيُّ: وَالْبَرَاءُ بْنُ مَعْرُورٍ أَوَّلُ مَنِ اسْتَقْبَلَ الْكَعْبَةَ حَيًّا وَمَيِّتًا، كَانَ يُصَلِّي إِلَى الْكَعْبَةِ وَالنَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِمَكَّةَ يُصَلِّي إِلَى بَيْتِ الْمَقْدِسِ، فَأُخْبِرَ بِهِ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «§فَأَرْسَلَ إِلَيْهِ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ نَحْوَ بَيْتِ الْمَقْدِسِ» ، فَأَطَاعَ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَلَمَّا حَضَرَهُ الْمَوْتُ قَالَ لِأَهْلِهِ: «اسْتَقْبِلُوا بِيَ الْكَعْبَةَ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq transmitted from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, from 'Abd al-Rahman b. Ka'b b. Malik: The Prophet ﷺ asked the Banu Sa'ida: “
entries.matn_en: Who is your chief?” They replied: “Al-Jadd b. Qays.” He asked why they had made him chief. They answered: “He has the most wealth among us, though we suspect him of miserliness.” The Prophet ﷺ said: “What illness is worse than miserliness?” They asked who should be their chief. He replied: “Bishr b. al-Bara' b. Ma'rur.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ §أَجْوَدَ الْبَشَرِ كَمَا هُوَ إِلَّا أَنْ يَدْخُلَ شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ فَيُدَارِسَهُ جِبْرِيلُ الْقُرْآنَ فَلَهُوَ أَجْوَدُ مِنَ الرِّيحِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq transmitted from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, from 'Ubayd God b. 'Abd Allah, from Ibn 'Abbas, who said: “
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ was the most generous of people, as he always was; but when Ramadan arrived and Gabriel studied the Quran with him, he was more generous than the wind.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ غَيْلَانَ بْنِ جَرِيرٍ، عَنْ زِيَادِ بْنِ رَبَاحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ: «§
entries.matn_ar: مَنْ فَارَقَ الْجَمَاعَةَ، وَخَرَجَ مِنَ الطَّاعَةِ فَمَاتَ فَمِيتَتُهُ جَاهِلِيَّةٌ، وَمَنْ خَرَجَ عَلَى أُمَّتِي بِسَيْفِهِ فَيَضْرِبُ بَرَّهَا وَفَاجِرَهَا لَا يَتَحَاشَى مُؤْمِنًا لِإِيمَانِهِ، وَلَا يَفِي لِذِي عَهْدٍ بِعَهْدِهِ، فَلَيْسَ مِنْ أُمَّتِي، وَمَنْ قُتِلَ تَحْتَ رَايَةٍ عِمِّيَّةٍ يَغْضَبُ لِلْعَصَبِيَّةِ، أَوْ يُقَاتِلُ لِلْعَصَبِيَّةِ، أَوْ يَدْعُو إِلَى الْعَصَبِيَّةِ، فَقِتْلَتُهُ جَاهِلِيَّةٌ»
entries.isnad_en: Ma'mar transmitted from Ayyub, from Ghaylan b. Jarir, from Ziyad b. Rabah, from Abu Hurayra, who said he heard the Messenger of God ﷺ say: “
entries.matn_en: Whoever separates from the community, withdraws from obedience, and dies has died a death of the age of ignorance. Whoever rises against my community with his sword, striking its righteous and wicked alike, sparing no believer out of regard for his faith and honoring no covenant with those under treaty, does not belong to my community. Whoever is killed beneath a banner whose purpose is obscure, becoming angry for tribal partisanship, fighting for it, or calling to it, has suffered a death of the age of ignorance.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ أَبِي رَجَاءٍ الْعُطَارِدِيِّ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ يَقُولُ: «§
entries.matn_ar: مَنْ خَرَجَ مِنَ الطَّاعَةِ شِبْرًا فَمَاتَ فَمِيتَتُهُ جَاهِلِيَّةٌ»
entries.isnad_en: Ma'mar transmitted from Ayyub, from Abu Raja' al-'Utaridi, who said he heard Ibn 'Abbas say: “
entries.matn_en: Whoever withdraws a handspan from obedience and dies has died a death of the age of ignorance.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، قَالَ: بَلَغَنَا أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar:
أُمِرَ يَحْيَى بْنُ زَكَرِيَّا بِخَمْسِ كَلِمَاتٍ أَنْ يُبَلِّغَهُنَّ وَيُعَلِّمَهُنَّ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ، وَيَعْمَلَ بِهِنَّ، وَيَأْمُرَ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ أَنْ يَعْمَلُوا بِهِنَّ، فَكَأَنَّهُ أَبْطَأَ فَقِيلَ لِعِيسَى: مُرْ يَحْيَى أَنْ يَأْمُرَ بِهَذِهِ الْكَلِمَاتِ وَإِلَّا فَأْمُرْ بِهِنَّ أَنْتَ، فَقَالَ عِيسَى لِيَحْيَى ذَلِكَ، فَقَالَ يَحْيَى: لَا تَفْعَلْ، فَإِنِّي أَخَافُ إِنْ أَمَرْتُ بِهِنَّ أَنْ أُعَذَّبَ أَوْ يَخْسِفَ اللَّهُ بِيَ الْأَرْضَ، قَالَ: فَجَمَعَ يَحْيَى بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ فِي بَيْتِ الْمَقْدِسِ حَتَّى امْتَلَأَ الْمَسْجِدُ، ثُمَّ جَلَسُوا عَلَى شُرَفِهِ فَقَالَ: إِنَّ اللَّهَ أَمَرَنِي بِخَمْسِ كَلِمَاتٍ أَنْ أُعَلِّمَكُمُوهُنَّ وَآمُرَكُمْ أَنْ تَعْمَلُوا بِهِنَّ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: أُولَاهُنَّ: أَلَّا تُشْرِكُوا بِاللَّهِ شَيْئًا، فَإنَّ مَثَلَ مَنْ يُشْرِكُ بِاللَّهِ كَمَثَلِ رَجُلٍ اشْتَرَى عَبْدًا، فَجَعَلَهُ فِي دَارِهِ، وَقَالَ: هَذِهِ دَارِي وَهَذَا عَمَلِي، فَأَدِّ إِلَيَّ عَمَلَكَ، فَجَعَلَ يَعْمَلُ وَيُؤَدِّي عَمَلَهُ إِلَى غَيْرِ سَيِّدِهِ، فَأَيُّكُمْ يُحِبُّ أَنْ يَكُونَ لَهُ عَبْدٌ كَذَلِكَ، وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الَّذِي خَلَقَكُمْ وَرَزَقَكُمْ فَلَا تُشْرِكُوا بِهِ شَيْئًا، وَآمُرُكُمْ بِالصَّلَاةِ، فَإِذَا صَلَّيْتُمْ فَلَا تَلْتَفِتُوا فِي صَلَاتِكُمْ، فَإنَّ اللَّهَ يَنْصِبُ - حَسِبْتُهُ قَالَ - وَجْهَهُ لِعَبْدِهِ فِي صَلَاتِهِ مَا لَمْ يَلْتَفِتْ، قَالَ: وَآمُرُكُمْ بِالصَّدَقَةِ، فَإنَّ مَثَلَ الصَّدَقَةِ كَمَثَلِ رَجُلٍ أَخَذَهُ الْعَدُوُّ فَقَدَّمُوهُ لِيَضْرِبُوا عُنُقَهُ، فَقَالَ: مَا تَصْنَعُونَ بِضَرْبِ عُنُقِي، أَلَا أَفْتَدِي نَفْسِي مِنْكُمْ بِكَذَا وَكَذَا؟ قَالُوا: بَلَى، فَافْتَدَى نَفْسَهُ مِنْهُمْ، فَكَذَلِكَ الصَّدَقَةُ تُطْفِئُ الْخَطِيئَةَ، قَالَ: وَآمُرُكُمْ بِالصِّيَامِ، فَإنَّ مَثَلَ الصَّائِمِ كَمَثَلِ رَجُلٍ فِي قَوْمٍ مَعَهُ صُرَّةُ مِسْكٍ لَيْسَ مَعَ أَحَدٍ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ مِسْكٌ غَيْرُهُ، فَكُلُّهُمْ يُحِبُّ أَنْ يَجِدَ رِيحَهُ، فَكَذَلِكَ الصَّائِمُ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ أَطْيَبُ مِنْ رِيحِ الْمِسْكِ، وَآمُرُكُمْ بِذِكْرِ اللَّهِ، فَإنَّ مَثَلَ ذِكْرِ اللَّهِ كَمَثَلِ رَجُلٍ انْطَلَقَ فَارًّا مِنَ الْعَدُوِّ وَهُمْ يَطْلُبُونَهُ حَتَّى لَجَأَ إِلَى حِصْنٍ حَصِينٍ، فأفْلَتَ مِنْهُمْ، وَكَذَلِكَ الشَّيْطَانُ لَا يُحْرِزُ مِنْهُ إِلَّا ذِكْرُ اللَّهِ»
Yahya said: Al-Harith al-Ash'ari told me that the Prophet ﷺ said: “I command you five things: hearing, obedience, adherence to the community, emigration, and fighting in God’s cause. Whoever leaves the community by even a handspan has cast the bond of Islam from his neck until he returns; and whoever calls with a call of the age of ignorance is among those crouching in Hell.” A man asked: “Even if he prays and fasts?” He said: “Even if he prays and fasts. Call yourselves by the names God has given you: His servants, Muslims, believers.”
قَالَ يَحْيَى: فَأَخْبَرَنِي الْحَارِثُ الْأَشْعَرِيُّ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ: «وَأَنَا §آمُرُكُمْ بِخَمْسٍ: بِالسَّمْعِ، وَالطَّاعَةِ، وَالْجَمَاعَةِ، وَالْهِجْرَةِ، وَالْجِهَادِ - [٣٤١] - فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ، فَمَنَ خَرَجَ مِنَ الْجَمَاعَةِ قِيدَ شِبْرٍ فَقَدْ خَلَعَ رِبْقَةَ الْإِسْلَامِ مِنْ رَأْسِهِ حَتَّى يُرَاجِعَ، وَمَنْ دَعَا دَعْوَةَ جَاهِلِيَّةٍ فَإِنَّهُ مِنْ جُثَا جَهَنَّمَ» ، فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، وَإِنْ صَلَّى وَصَامَ؟ قَالَ: «نَعَمْ، وَإِنْ صَلَّى وَصَامَ، وَلَكِنْ تَسَمُّوا بِاسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي سَمَّاكُمْ عِبَادَ اللَّهِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ»
entries.isnad_en: Ma'mar transmitted from Yahya b. Abi Kathir, who said: “It reached us that the Messenger of God ﷺ said: ‘
entries.matn_en: John son of Zechariah was commanded to convey five instructions to the Children of Israel, teach them, act upon them, and command them to act. He delayed, so Jesus was told to command John to convey them, or else deliver them himself. When Jesus told John this, John said: “Do not do so. I fear that if you deliver them instead I will be punished or God will cause the earth to swallow me.” John gathered the Children of Israel at Jerusalem until the sanctuary was full and people sat on its upper levels. He said: “God has commanded me to teach you five instructions and to command you to practice them. First, associate nothing with God. Someone who associates others with God is like a slave whose master buys him, houses him, and tells him to give his earnings to that master, but the slave works and pays someone else. Which of you would want such a slave? God created and sustains you; do not associate anything with Him. I command you to pray, and when you pray do not turn aside, for God directs His face toward His praying servant so long as the servant does not turn away—if I recall the wording correctly. I command you to give charity: it is like a prisoner seized by an enemy who is about to be executed, and who says: ‘Will you let me ransom myself for such-and-such?’ They agree and he ransoms himself. Thus charity extinguishes sin. I command you to fast: the fasting person is like a man among a group carrying a pouch of musk when no one else has any; all want to smell it. The fasting person’s scent is more pleasant to God than musk. And I command you to remember God: remembrance is like a man fleeing pursuers who finds refuge in a fortified stronghold and escapes. Nothing shelters a person from Satan except remembrance of God.”’”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ قَامَ بِالْجَابِيَةِ خَطِيبًا، فَقَالَ: إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَامَ فِينَا مَقَامِي فِيكُمْ فَقَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: أَكْرِمُوا أَصْحَابِي؛ فَإِنَّهُمْ خِيَارُكُمْ، ثُمَّ الَّذِينَ يَلُونَهُمْ، ثُمَّ الَّذِينَ يَلُونَهُمْ، ثُمَّ يَظْهَرُ الْكَذِبُ حَتَّى يَحْلِفَ الْإِنْسَانُ عَلَى الْيَمِينِ لَا يُسْأَلُهَا، وَيَشْهَدَ عَلَى الشَّهَادَةِ لَا يُسْأَلُهَا، فَمَنْ سَرَّهُ بُحْبُوحَةُ الْجَنَّةِ فَعَلَيْهِ بِالْجَمَاعَةِ، فَإنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ مَعَ الْفَذِّ، وَهُوَ مِنَ الِاثْنَيْنِ أَبْعَدُ، وَلَا يَخْلُوَنَّ رَجُلٌ بِامْرَأَةٍ، فَإنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ ثَالِثُهُمْ، وَمَنْ سَرَّتْهُ حَسَنَتُهُ وَسَاءَتْهُ سَيِّئَتُهُ فَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq transmitted from Ma'mar, from 'Abd al-Malik b. 'Umayr, from 'Abd Allah b. al-Zubayr: 'Umar b. al-Khattab stood preaching at al-Jabiya and said: “The Messenger of God ﷺ once stood among us as I stand among you and said: ‘
entries.matn_en: Honor my Companions: they are the best of you, then those who follow them, then those after them. Thereafter lies will appear, until a man volunteers an oath without being asked and offers testimony without being asked. Whoever wishes the heartland of Paradise must remain with the community. Satan is with a solitary individual and farther from two. Let no man be alone with a woman, for Satan is their third. Whoever is pleased by his good deed and distressed by his evil deed is a believer.’”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ نَصْرِ بْنِ عَاصِمٍ اللَّيْثِيِّ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ الْيَشْكُرِيِّ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: خَرَجْتُ زَمَنَ فُتِحَتْ تُسْتَرُ حَتَّى قَدِمْتُ الْكُوفَةَ، فَدَخَلْتُ الْمَسْجِدَ فَإِذَا أَنَا بِحَلْقَةٍ فِيهَا رَجُلٌ صَدْعٌ مِنَ الرِّجَالِ، حَسَنُ الثَّغْرِ، يُعْرَفُ فِيهِ أَنَّهُ مِنْ رِجَالِ الْحِجَازِ، قَالَ: فَقُلْتُ: مَنِ الرَّجُلُ؟ قَالَ الْقَوْمُ: أَوَمَا تَعْرِفُهُ؟ قَالَ: قُلْتُ: لَا، قَالُوا: هَذَا حُذَيْفَةُ بْنُ الْيَمَانِ صَاحِبُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ: فَقَعَدْتُ، وَحَدَّثَ الْقَوْمَ أَنَّ النَّاسَ كَانُوا يَسْأَلُونَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنِ الْخَيْرِ، وَكُنْتُ أَسْأَلُهُ عَنِ الشَّرِّ، فَأَنْكَرَ ذَلِكَ الْقَوْمُ عَلَيْهِ، فَقَالَ لَهُمْ: إِنِّي سَأُحَدِّثُكُمْ مَا أَنْكَرْتُمْ مِنْ ذَلِكَ، جَاءَ الْإِسْلَامُ حِينَ جَاءَ فَجَاءَ أَمْرٌ لَيْسَ كَأَمْرِ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ، وَكُنْتُ قَدْ أُعْطِيتُ فِي الْقُرْآنِ فَهْمًا، فَكَانَ رِجَالٌ يَجِيئونَ فَيَسْأَلُونَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنِ الْخَيْرِ وَأَنَا أَسْأَلُهُ عَنِ الشَّرِّ، فَقُلْتُ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، §أَيَكُونُ بَعْدَ هَذَا الْخَيْرِ شَرٌّ كَمَا كَانَ قَبْلَهُ؟ قَالَ: «نَعَمْ» ، قَالَ: قُلْتُ: فَمَا الْعِصْمَةُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ؟ قَالَ: «السَّيْفُ» ، قُلْتُ: وَهَلْ بَعْدَ السَّيْفِ بَقِيَّةٌ؟ قَالَ: «نَعَمْ، تَكُونُ إِمَارَةٌ عَلَى أَقْذَاءٍ وَهُدْنَةٌ عَلَى دَخَنٍ» ، قَالَ: قُلْتُ: ثُمَّ مَاذَا؟ قَالَ: «ثُمَّ يَنْشَأُ دُعَاةُ الضَّلَالَةِ، فَإِنْ كَانَ لِلَّهِ فِي الْأَرْضِ يَوْمَئِذٍ خَلِيفَةٌ جَلَدَ ظَهْرَكَ وَأَخَذَ مَالَكَ، فَالْزَمْهُ وَإِلَّا فَمُتْ وَأَنْتَ عَاضٌّ عَلَى جِذْلِ شَجَرَةٍ» ، قَالَ: قُلْتُ: ثُمَّ مَاذَا؟ قَالَ: «ثُمَّ يَخْرُجُ الدَّجَّالُ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ مَعَهُ نَهَرٌ وَنَارٌ، مَنْ وَقَعَ فِي نَارِهِ وَجَبَ أَجْرُهُ وَحُطَّ وَزْرُهُ، وَمَنْ وَقَعَ فِي نَهَرِهِ وَجَبَ وَزْرُهُ وَحُطَّ أَجْرُهُ» ، قَالَ: قُلْتُ: ثُمَّ مَاذَا؟ قَالَ: «يُنْتَجُ الْمُهْرُ فَلَا يُرْكَبُ حَتَّى تَقُومَ السَّاعَةُ» ، قَالَ قَتَادَةُ: «الصَّدْعُ مِنَ الرِّجَالِ: الضَّرْبُ، وَقَوْلُهُ: فَمَا الْعِصْمَةُ مِنْهُ؟ قَالَ: السَّيْفُ» ، قَالَ مَعْمَرٌ: قَالَ قَتَادَةُ: نَضَعُهُ عَلَى أَهْلِ الرِّدَّةِ الَّتِي كَانَتْ فِي زَمَنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، وَأَمَّا قَوْلُهُ: «إِمَارَةٌ عَلَى أَقْذَاءٍ وَهُدْنَةٌ» يَقُولُ: صُلْحٌ، وَقَوْلُهُ: «عَلَى دَخَنٍ» : يَقُولُ عَلَى ضَغَائِنَ
entries.isnad_en: Ma'mar transmitted from Qatada, from Nasr b. 'Asim al-Laythi, from Khalid b. Khalid al-Yashkuri:
entries.matn_en: Around the conquest of Tustar he traveled to Kufa and entered a mosque, where a circle surrounded a well-built, pleasant-looking man, recognizably from the Hijaz. The people identified him as Hudhayfa b. al-Yaman. Khalid sat down, and Hudhayfa related: “People used to ask the Messenger of God ﷺ about good, but I asked him about evil.” The group objected, so he explained: “Islam came with a reality different from the age of ignorance, and I had been given an understanding of the Quran. I asked: ‘Messenger of God, will there be evil after this good, as there was before it?’ He said, ‘Yes.’ I asked, ‘What protection is there?’ He said, ‘The sword.’ I asked whether anything would remain after the sword. He said: ‘Yes, rule amid irritations and a truce clouded by rancor.’ I asked what would follow. He said: ‘Then callers to error will arise. If at that time God has a caliph on earth, hold fast to him even if he beats your back and seizes your property. Otherwise, die while biting onto the stump of a tree.’ I asked what came next. He said: ‘Then the Dajjal will appear, with a river and a fire. Whoever enters his fire will receive his reward and have his burden removed; whoever enters his river will incur his burden and lose his reward.’ I asked what would follow. He said: ‘A foal will be born that will not be ridden before the Hour comes.’” Qatada explained that the description of Hudhayfa means he was of moderate, well-proportioned build. Ma'mar reported Qatada's interpretation that “the sword” refers to the apostasy conflicts in Abu Bakr's time; the “truce” means reconciliation, while its “smoke” means hidden animosities.

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ يُثَيْعٍ، عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ بْنِ الْيَمَانِ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «أَيْ قَوْمِ §
entries.matn_ar: كَيْفَ أَنْتُمْ إِذَا سُئِلْتُمُ الْحَقَّ فأعْطَيْتُموهُ ثُمَّ مُنِعْتُمْ حَقَّكُمْ؟» ، قُلْنَا: مَنْ أَدْرَكَ ذَلِكَ مِنَّا صَبَرَ، قَالَ حُذَيْفَةُ: «دَخَلْتُمُوهَا إِذًا وَرَبِّ الْكَعْبَةِ» يَعْنِي الْجَنَّةَ
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq transmitted from Ma'mar, from Abu Ishaq, from Zayd b. Yuthay', from Hudhayfa b. al-Yaman, who said: “
entries.matn_en: People, what will you do when you are required to give what is due and do so, yet are denied your own rights?” They replied that whoever lived to see that would be patient. He said: “Then, by the Lord of the Ka'ba, you will enter it”—meaning Paradise.

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كَانَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ إِذَا نَهَى النَّاسَ عَنْ شَيْءٍ دَخَلَ إِلَى أَهْلِهِ - أَوْ قَالَ: جَمَعَ - فَقَالَ: «إِنِّي نَهَيْتُ عَنْ كَذَا وَكَذَا، §وَالنَّاسُ إِنَّمَا يَنْظُرُونَ إِلَيْكُمْ نَظَرَ الطَّيْرِ إِلَى اللَّحْمِ، فَإِنْ وَقَعْتُمْ وَقَعُوا، وَإِنْ هِبْتُمْ هَابُوا، وَإِنِّي وَاللَّهِ لَا أُوتَى بِرَجُلٍ مِنْكُمْ وَقَعَ فِي شَيْءٍ مِمَّا نَهَيْتُ عَنْهُ النَّاسَ، إِلَّا أَضْعَفْتُ لَهُ الْعُقُوبَةَ لِمَكَانِهِ مِنِّي، فَمَنْ شَاءَ فَلْيَتَقَدَّمْ وَمَنْ شَاءَ فَلْيَتَأَخَّرْ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq transmitted from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, from Salim, from his father:
entries.matn_en: Whenever 'Umar b. al-Khattab forbade the people something, he would gather his family and say: “I have forbidden this or that. People watch you as birds watch meat. If you fall into it, they will too; if you hold back, so will they. By God, if any of you is brought before me for doing what I forbade the people, I will double his punishment because of his relationship to me. Let anyone who wishes proceed, and anyone who wishes withdraw.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ زِيَادِ بْنِ عِلَاقَةَ، عَنْ عَرْفَجَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: مَنْ خَرَجَ عَلَى أُمَّتِي وَهُمْ مُجْتَمِعُونَ يُرِيدُ أَنْ يُفَرِّقَ بَيْنَهُمْ فَاقْتُلُوهُ كَائِنًا مَنْ كَانَ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq transmitted from Ma'mar, from Ziyad b. 'Ilaqa, from 'Arfaja, that the Prophet ﷺ said: “
entries.matn_en: Whoever rises against my community while it is united, intending to split it apart, kill him, whoever he may be.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ يُثَيْعٍ، عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ، قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: مَا مَشَى قَوْمٌ إِلَى سُلْطَانِ اللَّهِ فِي الْأَرْضِ لِيُذِلُّوهُ، إِلَّا أَذَلَّهُمُ اللَّهُ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَمُوتُوا»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq transmitted from Ma'mar, from Abu Ishaq, from Zayd b. Yuthay', from Hudhayfa, who said: “
entries.matn_en: No people go to the authority God has established on earth seeking to humiliate it without God humiliating them before they die.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ، أَنَّ أَبَا الدَّرْدَاءِ، قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: كَيْفَ أَنْتُمْ إِذَا لَعَنَتْكُمْ أُمَرَاؤُكُمْ عَلَانِيَةً، وَلَعَنْتُمُوهُمْ سِرًّا، فَهُنَالِكَ تَهْلِكُونَ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq transmitted from Ma'mar, from Ayyub, from Abu Qilaba, that Abu al-Darda' said: “
entries.matn_en: What will become of you when your rulers curse you publicly and you curse them secretly? At that point you will perish.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي الْمِسْوَرُ بْنُ مَخْرَمَةَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ وَفَدَ عَلَى مُعَاوِيَةَ، قَالَ: فَلَمَّا دَخَلْتُ عَلَيْهِ - حَسِبْتُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: سَلَّمْتُ عَلَيْهِ - ثُمَّ قَالَ: «مَا فَعَلَ طَعْنُكَ عَلَى الْأَئِمَّةِ يَا مِسْوَرُ؟» قَالَ: قُلْتُ: ارْفُضْنَا مِنْ هَذَا، أَوْ أَحْسِنْ فِيمَا قَدِمْنَا لَهُ، قَالَ: «لَتُكَلِّمَنَّ بِذَاتِ نَفْسِكَ» قَالَ: فَلَمْ أَدَعْ شَيْئًا أَعِيبُهُ بِهِ إِلَّا أَخْبَرْتُهُ بِهِ، قَالَ: «لَا أَبْرَأُ مِنَ الذُّنُوبِ فَهَلْ لَكَ ذُنُوبٌ تَخَافُ أَنْ تَهْلَكَ إِنْ لَمْ يَغْفِرْهَا اللَّهُ لَكَ؟» ، قَالَ: قُلْتُ: نَعَمْ، قَالَ: «§فَمَا يَجْعَلُكَ أَحَقَّ بِأَنْ تَرْجُوَ الْمَغْفِرَةَ مِنِّي، فَوَاللَّهِ لَمَا أَلِي مِنَ الْإِصْلَاحِ بَيْنَ النَّاسِ، وَإِقَامَةِ الْحُدُودِ، وَالْجِهَادِ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ، وَالْأُمُورِ الْعِظَامِ الَّتِي تُحْصِيهَا أَكْثَرُ مِمَّا تَلِي، وَإِنِّي لَعَلَى دِينٍ يَقْبَلُ اللَّهُ فِيهِ الْحَسَنَاتِ، وَيَعْفُو فِيهِ عَنِ السَّيِّئَاتِ، وَاللَّهِ مَعَ ذَلِكَ مَا كُنْتُ لِأُخَيَّرَ بَيْنَ اللَّهِ وَغَيْرِهِ، إِلَّا اخْتَرْتُ اللَّهَ عَلَى مَا سِوَاهُ» قَالَ: فَفَكَّرْتُ حِينَ قَالَ لِي مَا قَالَ، فَوَجَدْتُهُ قَدْ خَصَمَنِي، فَكَانَ إِذَا ذَكَرَهُ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ دَعَا لَهُ بِخَيْرٍ
entries.isnad_en: Ma'mar transmitted from al-Zuhri, from Humayd b. 'Abd al-Rahman, from al-Miswar b. Makhrama: “
entries.matn_en: I visited Mu'awiya, who said upon my arrival: ‘What has become of your criticism of the leaders, Miswar?’ I asked him to leave that topic aside and discuss the purpose of our visit. He insisted that I speak my mind. I mentioned everything I criticized about him. He replied: ‘I do not claim freedom from sins. Do you have sins that might destroy you unless God forgives them?’ I said yes. He asked: ‘Why are you more entitled to hope for forgiveness than I? By God, the efforts I undertake to reconcile people, enforce legal penalties, engage in God's cause, and handle major affairs are greater than those you undertake. I follow a religion in which God accepts good deeds and pardons evil ones, and by God, whenever I must choose between God and anything else, I choose God.’ I reflected on what he said and found that he had defeated my argument.” Thereafter, when al-Miswar mentioned him, he prayed for his welfare.

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ، عَنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ بْنِ رَافِعٍ، قَالَ: «إِنَّ §
entries.matn_ar: مِنْ شِرَارِ النَّاسِ مَنْ تُذِلُّهُ الشَّيَاطِينُ كَمَا يُذِلُّ أَحَدُكُمُ الْقَعُودَ مِنَ الْإِبِلِ تَكُونُ لَهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Ma'mar transmitted from al-A'mash, from al-Musayyab b. Rafi': “
entries.matn_en: Among the worst people are those whom the devils make submissive, just as one of you breaks in a young camel belonging to him.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ خُثَيْمٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ سَابِطٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ لِكَعْبِ بْنِ عُجْرَةَ: «
entries.matn_ar: أَعَاذَكَ اللَّهُ يَا كَعْبُ بْنَ عُجْرَةَ مِنْ إِمَارَةِ السُّفَهَاءِ» ، قَالَ: وَمَا §إِمَارَةُ السُّفَهَاءِ؟ قَالَ: «أُمَرَاءُ يَكُونُونَ بَعْدِي، لَا يَهْدُونَ بِهَدْيِي، وَلَا يَسْتَنُّونَ بِسُنَّتِي، فَمَنْ صَدَّقَهُمْ بِكَذِبِهِمْ، وَأَعَانَهُمْ عَلَى ظُلْمِهِمْ، فَأُولَئِكَ لَيْسُوا مِنِّي وَلَسْتُ مِنْهُمْ، وَلَا يَرِدُونَ عَلَيَّ حَوْضِي، وَمَنْ لَمْ يُصَدِّقْهُمْ عَلَى كَذِبِهِمْ، وَلَمْ يُعِنْهُمْ عَلَى ظُلْمِهِمْ فَأُولَئِكَ مِنِّي، وَأَنَا مِنْهُمْ، وَسَيَرِدُونَ عَلَيَّ حَوْضِي، يَا كَعْبُ بْنَ عُجْرَةَ، الصَّوْمُ جُنَّةٌ، وَالصَّدَقَةُ تُطْفِئُ الْخَطِيئَةَ، وَالصَّلَاةُ قُرْبَانٌ - أَوْ قَالَ: بُرْهَانٌ - يَا كَعْبُ بْنَ عُجْرَةَ، إِنَّهُ لَا يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ لَحْمٌ نَبَتَ مِنْ سُحْتٍ أَبَدًا النَّارُ أَوْلَى بِهِ، يَا كَعْبُ بْنَ عُجْرَةَ، النَّاسُ غَادِيَانِ فَمُبْتَاعٌ نَفْسَهُ، فَمُعْتِقُهَا أَوْ بَائِعُهَا فَمُوبِقُهَا»
entries.isnad_en: Ma'mar transmitted from Ibn Khuthaym, from 'Abd al-Rahman b. Sabit, from Jabir b. 'Abd Allah: The Prophet ﷺ said to Ka'b b. 'Ujra: “
entries.matn_en: May God protect you, Ka'b, from the rule of fools.” Asked what that meant, he said: “There will be rulers after me who neither follow my guidance nor practice my way. Whoever affirms their lies and helps their oppression does not belong to me, nor I to him, and will not come to my basin. Whoever neither affirms their lies nor helps their oppression belongs to me and I to him, and will come to my basin. Ka'b, fasting is a shield, almsgiving extinguishes sin, and prayer is an offering of nearness—or he said, a proof. No flesh nourished by illicit gain will ever enter Paradise; the Fire has a greater claim on it. People go out in the morning in two ways: one purchases his own soul and sets it free; the other sells his soul and destroys it.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ زَيْدِ بْنِ جُدْعَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar:
صَلَّى بِنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ ذَاتَ يَوْمٍ صَلَاةَ الْعَصْرِ بِنَهَارٍ، ثُمَّ قَامَ فَخَطَبَنَا إِلَى أَنْ غَابَتِ الشَّمْسُ، فَلَمْ يَدَعْ شَيْئًا مِمَّا يَكُونُ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ إِلَّا حَدَّثَنَاهُ، حَفِظَ ذَلِكَ مَنْ حَفِظَهُ، وَنَسِيَ ذَلِكَ مَنْ نَسِيَهُ، وَكَانَ مِمَّا قَالَ: «يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ، §الدُّنْيَا خَضِرَةٌ حُلْوَةٌ، وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ مُسْتَخْلِفُكُمْ فِيهَا فَنَاظِرٌ، كَيْفَ تَعْمَلُونَ، فَاتَّقُوا الدُّنْيَا وَاتَّقُوا النِّسَاءَ، أَلَا وَإِنَّ لِكُلِّ غَادِرٍ لِوَاءً يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ بِقَدْرِ غَدْرَتِهِ، يُنْصَبُ عِنْدَ اسْتِهِ بِحِذَائِهِ، وَلَا غَادِرَ أَعْظَمَ لِوَاءً مِنْ أَمِيرِ عَامَّةٍ»
He then discussed character: “A person may be quick to anger and quick to recover, with one trait balancing the other; or slow to anger and slow to recover, with one balancing the other. The best is slow to anger and quick to recover, the worst quick to anger and slow to recover. Anger is an ember kindled in a human heart. Do you not see the red eyes and swelling neck veins? When one of you feels this, let him sit down—or press himself against the ground.”
قَالَ: ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ الْأَخْلَاقَ فَقَالَ: «§يَكُونُ الرَّجُلُ سَرِيعَ - [٣٤٧] - الْغَضَبِ، سَرِيعَ الْفَيْئَةِ، فَهَذِهِ بِهَذِهِ، وَيَكُونُ بَطِيءَ الْغَضَبِ بَطِيءَ الْفَيْئَةِ، فَهَذِهِ بِهَذِهِ، فَخَيْرُهُمْ بَطِيءُ الْغَضَبِ سَرِيعُ الْفَيْئَةِ، وَشَرُّهُمْ سَرِيعُ الْغَضَبِ بَطِيءُ الْفَيْئَةِ، وَإِنَّ الْغَضَبَ جَمْرَةٌ فِي قَلْبِ ابْنِ آدَمَ تُوقَدُ، أَلَمْ تَرَوْا إِلَى حُمْرَةِ عَيْنَيْهِ، وَانْتِفَاخِ أَوْدَاجِهِ، فَإِذَا وَجَدَ أَحَدُكُمْ ذَلِكَ فَلْيَجْلِسْ، أَوْ قَالَ: لِيَلْصَقْ بِالْأَرْضِ»
He then discussed demanding and paying debts: “A person may demand graciously but pay poorly, or pay well but demand poorly; each trait balances the other. The best both demands and pays graciously; the worst behaves badly in both.”
قَالَ: ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ الْمُطَالَبَةَ، فَقَالَ: «§يَكُونُ الرَّجُلُ حَسَنَ الطَّلَبِ، سَيِّئَ الْقَضَاءِ، فَهَذِهِ بِهَذِهِ، أَوْ يَكُونُ حَسَنَ الْقَضَاءِ، سَيِّئَ الطَّلَبِ، فَهَذِهِ بِهَذِهِ، فَخَيْرُهُمُ الْحَسَنُ الطَّلَبِ الْحَسَنُ الْقَضَاءِ، وَشَرُّهُمُ السَّيِّئُ الطَّلَبِ السَّيِّئُ الْقَضَاءِ»
He continued: “People are created in different conditions: one is born a believer, lives as a believer and dies a believer; another is born an unbeliever, lives and dies an unbeliever; another is born and lives a believer but dies an unbeliever; and another is born and lives an unbeliever but dies a believer.”
ثُمَّ قَالَ: «إِنَّ §النَّاسَ خُلِقُوا عَلَى طَبَقَاتٍ، فَيُولَدُ الرَّجُلُ مُؤْمِنًا وَيَعِيشُ مُؤْمِنًا وَيَمُوتُ مُؤْمِنًا، وَيُولَدُ الرَّجُلُ كَافِرًا وَيَعِيشُ كَافِرًا وَيَمُوتُ كَافِرًا، وَيُولَدُ الرَّجُلُ مُؤْمِنًا وَيَعِيشُ مُؤْمِنًا وَيَمُوتُ كَافِرًا، وَيُولَدُ الرَّجُلُ كَافِرًا وَيَعِيشُ كَافِرًا وَيَمُوتُ مُؤْمِنًا»
He also said: “Nothing is better than a just word spoken before an unjust ruler. Do not let fear of people keep you from speaking the truth when you see it or witness it.” Abu Sa'id wept and said: “By God, we have been prevented from doing that.”
ثُمَّ قَالَ فِي حَدِيثِهِ: «§وَمَا شَيْءٌ أَفْضَلُ مِنْ كَلِمَةِ عَدْلٍ تُقَالُ عِنْدَ سُلْطَانٍ جَائِرٍ، فَلَا يَمْنَعَنَّ أَحَدَكُمُ اتِّقَاءُ النَّاسِ أَنْ يَتَكَلَّمَ بِالْحَقِّ إِذَا رَآهُ أَوْ شَهِدَهُ» ثُمَّ بَكَى أَبُو سَعِيدٍ فَقَالَ: قَدْ وَاللَّهِ مُنِعْنَا ذَلِكَ
He also said: “You will complete seventy nations, the best and most honored of them in God’s sight.” As sunset approached, he said: “What remains of this world, compared with what has passed, is like what remains of this day compared with the hours already gone.”
ثُمَّ قَالَ: «§وَإِنَّكُمْ تُتِمُّونَ سَبْعِينَ أُمَّةً، خَيْرُهَا وَأَكْرَمُهَا عَلَى اللَّهِ» ثُمَّ دَنَتِ الشَّمْسُ أَنْ تَغْرُبَ فَقَالَ: «وَإِنَّمَا مَا بَقِيَ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا فِيمَا مَضَى مِنْهَا مِثْلُ مَا بَقِيَ مِنْ يَوْمِكُمْ هَذَا فِيمَا مَضَى مِنْهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Ma'mar transmitted from 'Ali b. Zayd b. Jud'an, from Abu Nadra, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri: “
entries.matn_en: One day the Messenger of God ﷺ led us in the afternoon prayer early, then preached until sunset. He told us everything that would occur until the Day of Resurrection; some remembered it and others forgot. Among what he said was: ‘People, this world is green and sweet, and God has made you successors in it to observe how you behave. Beware of worldly life and beware of women. On the Day of Resurrection every traitor will have a banner corresponding to the magnitude of his treachery, erected behind him, at his backside. None will bear a greater banner of betrayal than the ruler of a population.’” The sermon continues in several separate unnumbered source paragraphs that follow.

entries.label: Entry
