'Abd Allah asked him to continue, but Nawf said that as a Companion of the Messenger ﷺ he had a greater right to speak. 'Abd Allah said: ‘These rulers have prevented us from transmitting reports.’ Nawf insisted that he relate something he heard directly. 'Abd Allah said that he heard the Messenger of God ﷺ say: ‘There will be another emigration after the first, when the best people migrate to the place Abraham migrated. Only the worst inhabitants of the earth will remain, cast out by their lands and abhorred by God. Fire will gather them along with apes and pigs; it will stay with them overnight where they stay, rest with them where they rest, and devour whoever falls behind.’”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: عَشْرُ آيَاتٍ بَيْنَ يَدَيِ السَّاعَةِ: طُلُوعُ الشَّمْسِ مِنْ مَغْرِبِهَا، وَالدُّخَانُ، وَالدَّجَّالُ، وَالدَّابَّةُ، وَنُزُولُ عِيسَى، وَنَارٌ تَسُوقُ النَّاسَ إِلَى الْمَحْشَرِ، وَخُرُوجُ يَأْجُوجَ وَمَأْجُوجَ، وَخَسْفٌ فِي جَزِيرَةِ الْعَرَبِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq transmitted from Ma'mar, from Ibn Tawus, from his father: “
entries.matn_en: Ten signs will precede the Hour: the sun rising in the west, smoke, the Dajjal, the Beast, the descent of Jesus, a fire driving people to the gathering, the emergence of Gog and Magog, and a sinking of the earth in the Arabian Peninsula.” [Only eight signs are expressly enumerated in this source wording.]

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ، عَنْ رَبِيعَةَ الْجُرَشِيِّ، قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: عَشْرُ آيَاتٍ بَيْنَ يَدَيِ السَّاعَةِ: خَسْفٌ بِالْمَشْرِقِ، وَخَسْفٌ بِالْمَغْرِبِ، وَخَسْفٌ بِحِجَازِ الْعَرَبِ، وَالرَّابِعَةُ الدَّجَّالُ، وَالْخَامِسَةُ عِيسَى، وَالسَّادِسَةُ دَابَّةُ الْأَرْضِ، وَالسَّابِعَةُ الدُّخَانُ، وَالثَّامِنَةُ خُرُوجُ يَأْجُوجَ وَمَأْجُوجَ، وَالتَّاسِعَةُ رِيحٌ بَارِدَةٌ طَيِّبَةٌ يُرْسِلُهَا اللَّهُ فَيَقْبِضُ بِتِلْكَ الرِّيحِ نَفْسَ كُلِّ مُؤْمِنٍ، وَالْعَاشِرَةُ طُلُوعُ الشَّمْسِ مِنْ مَغْرِبِهَا»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq transmitted from Ma'mar, from 'Abd al-Malik b. 'Umayr, from an unnamed man, from Rabi'a al-Jurashi: “
entries.matn_en: Ten signs will precede the Hour: a sinking of the earth in the east, a sinking in the west, a sinking in the Arabian Hijaz, the Dajjal, Jesus, the Beast of the earth, smoke, Gog and Magog, a gentle cold wind that God sends to take the soul of every believer, and the sun rising in the west.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «§
entries.matn_ar: لَا تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ حَتَّى يَمُرَّ الْمَرْءُ بِقَبْرِ أَخِيهِ فَيَقُولَ: يَا لَيْتَنِي مَكَانَكَ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq transmitted from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, from an unnamed man, from Abu Hurayra, who reported the Messenger of God ﷺ saying: “
entries.matn_en: The Hour will not come until a person passes his brother's grave and says, ‘Would that I were in your place.’”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، قَالَ: بَلَغَنَا أَنَّهُ «§
entries.matn_ar: يَشْتَدُّ الْبَلَاءُ حَتَّى يَمُرَّ الرَّجُلُ بِقَبْرِ أَخِيهِ فَيَقُولَ: يَا لَيْتَنِي مَكَانَكَ، لَيْسَ بِهِ شَوقٌ إِلَى لِقَاءِ اللَّهِ، وَلَكِنْ لِمَا يَرَى مِنْ شِدَّةِ الْبَلَاءِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq transmitted from Ma'mar, from Qatada: “It reached us that
entries.matn_en: suffering will grow so severe that a man passing his brother's grave will say, ‘Would that I were in your place,’ not because he longs to meet God but because of the severity of the troubles he sees.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «§
entries.matn_ar: لَا تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ حَتَّى تَضْطَرِبَ أَلْيَاتُ نِسَاءِ دَوْسٍ حَوْلَ ذِي الْخَلَصَةِ، وَكَانَتْ صَنَمًا تَعْبُدُهَا دَوْسٌ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ بِتَبَالَةَ» قَالَ مَعْمَرٌ: «وَسَمِعْتُ غَيْرَ الزُّهْرِيِّ يَقُولُ: عَلَى ذَلِكَ الْحَجَرِ بَيْتٌ بُنِيَ الْيَوْمَ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq transmitted from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, from Ibn al-Musayyab, from Abu Hurayra, who said that the Messenger of God ﷺ said: “
entries.matn_en: The Hour will not come until the women of Daws sway their buttocks around Dhu al-Khalasa,” an idol which Daws worshipped in the age of ignorance at Tabala. Ma'mar added that he heard someone other than al-Zuhri say that a building had since been built upon that stone.

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ:
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ خَرَجَ حِينَ زَاغَتِ الشَّمْسُ وَصَلَّى الظُّهْرَ، فَلَمَّا سَلَّمَ قَامَ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ فَذَكَرَ فِي السَّاعَةِ، وَذَكَرَ أَنَّ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ أُمُورًا عِظَامًا، ثُمَّ قَالَ: «مَنْ أَحَبَّ أَنْ يَسْأَلَ عَنْ شَيْءٍ فَلْيَسْأَلْ عَنْهُ، فَوَاللَّهِ لَا تَسْأَلُونِي عَنْ شَيْءٍ إِلَّا حَدَّثْتُكُمْ بِهِ مَا دُمْتُ فِي مَقَامِي هَذَا» قَالَ أَنَسٌ: فَأَكْثَرَ النَّاسُ الْبُكَاءَ حِينَ سَمِعُوا ذَلِكَ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَأَكْثَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَنْ يَقُولَ: «سَلُونِي سَلُونِي» قَالَ: فَقَامَ إِلَيْهِ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ: أَيْنَ مُدْخَلُهُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ؟ قَالَ: «النَّارُ» قَالَ: وَقَامَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ حُذَافَةَ فَقَالَ: مَنْ أَبِي يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ؟ قَالَ: «أَبُوكَ حُذَافَةُ» ، قَالَ: ثُمَّ أَكْثَرَ أَنْ يَقُولَ: «سَلُونِي» ، قَالَ فَبَرَكَ عُمَرُ عَلَى رُكْبَتَيْهِ وَقَالَ: رَضِينَا بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا، وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دِينًا، وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ رَسُولًا، قَالَ: فَسَكَتَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ حِينَ قَالَ عُمَرُ ذَلِكَ، ثُمَّ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «أَلَا وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ §لَقَدْ عُرِضَتْ عَلَيَّ الْجَنَّةُ وَالنَّارُ آنِفًا فِي عُرْضِ هَذَا الْحَائِطِ، وَأَنَا أُصَلِّي فَلَمْ أَرَ كَالْيَوْمِ فِي الْخَيْرِ وَالشَّرِّ»
entries.isnad_en: Ma'mar transmitted from al-Zuhri, who said Anas b. Malik told him: “
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ came out at midday, prayed the noon prayer, then mounted the pulpit and spoke of the Hour and great events preceding it. He said: ‘Anyone who wishes to ask me something should ask. By God, whatever you ask, I will answer while standing here.’ People wept, and he repeatedly said: ‘Ask me.’ A man stood and asked where he would enter; the Prophet ﷺ said: ‘The Fire.’ 'Abd Allah b. Hudhafa asked who his father was. The Prophet ﷺ said: ‘Your father is Hudhafa.’ He continued inviting questions, until 'Umar knelt and said: ‘We are content with God as Lord, Islam as religion, and Muhammad ﷺ as Messenger.’ The Prophet ﷺ fell silent, then said: ‘By Him in whose hand is my soul, Paradise and the Fire were shown to me just now across this wall while I was praying. I have never seen anything like what I saw today of good and evil.’”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ الزُّهْرِيُّ: وَأَخْبَرَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَتِ أُمُّ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ حُذَافَةَ: مَا رَأَيْتُ ابْنًا قَطُّ أَعَقَّ مِنْكَ، أَكُنْتَ تَأْمَنُ أَنْ تَكُونَ أُمُّكَ قَدْ قَارَفَتْ بَعْضَ مَا قَارَفَ أَهْلُ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ، فَتَفْضَحَهَا عَلَى أَعْيُنِ النَّاسِ؟ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ: «§وَاللَّهِ لَوْ أَلْحَقَنِي بِعَبْدٍ أَسْوَدَ لَلَحِقْتُ»
entries.isnad_en: Al-Zuhri said that 'Ubayd God b. 'Abd Allah b. 'Utba reported: 'Abd Allah b. Hudhafa's
entries.matn_en: mother said to him: “I have never seen a more undutiful son! Were you so certain that your mother had not done something people did in the age of ignorance, that you risked exposing her publicly?” 'Abd Allah replied: “By God, had he attributed me to a Black slave, I would have acknowledged him as my father.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنِ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ، أَنَّ ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ، قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: كَأَنِّي بِالتُّرْكِ قَدْ أَتَتْكُمْ عَلَى بَرَاذِينَ مُجَذَّمَةِ الْآذَانِ حَتَّى تَرْبِطَهَا بِشَطِّ الْفُرَاتِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq transmitted from Ma'mar, from Ayyub, from Ibn Sirin, that Ibn Mas'ud said: “
entries.matn_en: I can almost see the Turks arriving among you on small foreign horses whose ears are cut, until they tether them on the banks of the Euphrates.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنِ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرَةَ، قَالَ: قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ: «§
entries.matn_ar: أَوْشَكَ بَنُو قَنْطُورَاءَ أَنْ يُخْرِجُوكُمْ مِنْ أَرْضِ الْعِرَاقِ» قَالَ: قُلْتُ: ثُمَّ نَعُودُ؟ قَالَ: «وَذَلِكَ أَحَبُّ إِلَيْكَ، ثُمَّ تَعُودُونَ وَيَكُونُ لَكُمْ بِهَا سَلْوَةٌ مِنْ عَيْشٍ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq transmitted from Ma'mar, from Ayyub, from Ibn Sirin, from 'Abd al-Rahman b. Abi Bakra: 'Abd Allah b. 'Amr b. al-'As said: “
entries.matn_en: The Banu Qantura' will soon drive you out of Iraq.” I asked whether we would return. He said: “That is what you most wish to know! Yes, you will return and enjoy a measure of life there.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ بُرْقَانَ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ الْأَصَمِّ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: تُضَافُ الْعَرَبُ إِلَى مَنَازِلِهَا الْأُولَى حَتَّى يَكُونُ خَيْرُ مَالِهَا الشَّاةَ وَالْبَعِيرَ» قَالَ: وَيَقُولُ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ: «إِلَّا امْرَأَةً كَيِّسَةً تَتَّخِذُ سِقَاءً أَوْ سِقَائَيْنِ أَوْ مَزَادَةً أَوْ مَزَادَتَيْنِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq transmitted from Ma'mar, from Ja'far b. Burqan, from Yazid b. al-Asamm, from Abu Hurayra: “
entries.matn_en: The Arabs will be driven back to their original homelands until their most valuable wealth consists of sheep and camels.” Abu Hurayra also spoke of a resourceful woman taking one or two water skins, or one or two larger leather vessels [the report ends here].

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ لَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ: لَأُحَدِّثَنَّكُمْ حَدِيثًا لَا تَجِدُونَ أَحَدًا يُحَدِّثُكُمُوهُ بَعْدِي، سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ: «إِنَّ §مِنْ أَشْرَاطِ السَّاعَةِ أَنْ يَذْهَبَ الْعِلْمُ، وَيَظْهَرَ الْجَهْلُ، وَيُشْرَبَ الْخَمْرُ، وَيَفْشُوَ الزِّنَا، وَيَقِلَّ الرِّجَالُ، وَيَكْثُرَ النِّسَاءُ، حَتَّى يَكُونَ قَيِّمَ خَمْسِينَ امْرَأَةً رَجُلٌ وَاحِدٌ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq told us: Ma'mar told us, from Qatada:
entries.matn_en: Anas b. Malik said to us: "I will narrate to you a hadith that you will find no one narrating to you after me. I heard the Messenger of God ﷺ say: 'Among the signs of the Hour are that knowledge will depart, ignorance will appear, wine will be drunk, fornication will spread, men will become few and women many, until one man will be the guardian of fifty women.'"

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَيَّاشِ بْنِ أَبِي رَبِيعَةَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ: «§تَجِيءُ رِيحٌ بَيْنَ يَدَيِ السَّاعَةِ فَيُقْبَضُ فِيهَا رُوحُ كُلِّ مُؤْمِنٍ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Ayyub, from Nafi', from 'Ayyash b. Abi Rabi'a:
entries.matn_en: I heard the Prophet ﷺ say: "A wind will come before the Hour, in which the soul of every believer will be taken."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْجَحْشِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «§
entries.matn_ar: بَيْنَ يَدَيِ السَّاعَةِ سُنُونٌ خَوَادِعُ يُخَوَّنُ فِيهَا الْأَمِينُ، وَيُؤْتَمَنُ فِيهَا الْخَائِنُ، وَتَنْطِقُ الرُّوَيْبِضَةُ فِي أَمْرِ الْعَامَّةِ» قَالَ: قِيلَ: وَمَا الرُّوَيْبِضَةُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ؟ قَالَ: «سِفْلَةُ النَّاسِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Sa'id ibn 'Abd al-Rahman al-Jahshi, from 'Abdullah b. Dinar, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "
entries.matn_en: Before the Hour there will be deceptive years in which the trustworthy will be accused of betrayal, the traitor will be trusted, and the ruwaybida will speak on the affairs of the public." It was asked: "What is the ruwaybida, Messenger of God?" He said: "The lowly among people."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ سُهَيْلِ بْنِ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «§
entries.matn_ar: يَحْسُرُ الْفُرَاتُ عَنْ جَبَلٍ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ، فَيَقْتَتِلُ النَّاسُ عَلَيْهِ، فَيُقْتَلُ مِنْ كُلِّ مِائَةٍ تِسْعُونَ - أَوْ قَالَ تِسْعَةٌ وَتِسْعُونَ - كُلُّهُمْ يَرَى أَنَّهُ يَنْجُو»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq told us: Ma'mar told us, from Suhayl b. Abi Salih, from his father, from Abu Hurayra: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "
entries.matn_en: The Euphrates will uncover a mountain of gold, and people will fight over it. Ninety out of every hundred (or he said ninety-nine) will be killed, and each of them will think that he will be the one to survive."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: ذُكِرَ شَيْءٌ عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ لَا أَحْفَظُهُ إِلَّا أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «ذَاكَ عِنْدَ نَسْخِ الْقُرْآنِ» قَالَ: فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ كَالْأَعْرَابِيِّ: مَا نَسْخُ الْقُرْآنِ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ؟ قَالَ: فَسَكَتَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ سَاعَةً، وَقَالَ: «مِثْلُ هَذَا، §يَذْهَبُ أُمَّتُهُ وَيَبْقَى قَوْمٌ طُوَالُ الْأَعْنَاقِ هَكَذَا - وَجَمَعَ يَدَيْهِ ثُمَّ مَدَّهُمَا وَأَشَارَ - كَالْأَنْعَامِ» قَالُوا: أَوَلَا نُقْرِئُهُ أَبْنَاءَنَا وَأَزْوَاجَنَا؟ قَالَ: «قَدْ قَرَأَتِ الْيَهُودُ وَالنَّصَارَى»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Ayyub, from Abu Qilaba:
entries.matn_en: Something was mentioned in the presence of the Prophet ﷺ that I do not remember, except that he said: "That will be at the time of the naskh of the Qur'an." A man like a Bedouin said: "What is the naskh of the Qur'an, Messenger of God?" The Prophet ﷺ was silent for a while, then said: "Like this: his community will pass away, and a people will remain, long of neck like this" (he brought his hands together, then stretched them apart, gesturing) "like cattle." They said: "Shall we not teach it to our sons and wives?" He said: "The Jews and Christians have read it."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: لَيَأْتِيَنَّ عَلَى النَّاسِ زَمَانٌ، وَخَيْرُ مَنَازِلِهِمُ الَّتِي نَهَى عَنْهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ الْبَادِيَةُ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Ibn Tawus, from his father, who said: "
entries.matn_en: A time will surely come upon people when the best of their dwellings will be that which the Messenger of God ﷺ forbade: the desert."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ، قَالَ: «إِنَّ §
entries.matn_ar: فِي الْبَحْرِ شَيَاطِينَ مَسْجُونَةً أَوْثَقَهَا سُلَيْمَانُ، يُوشَكُ أَنْ تَخْرُجَ فَتَقْرَأَ عَلَى النَّاسِ قُرْآنًا»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Ibn Tawus, from his father, from 'Abdullah b. 'Amr b. al-'As, who said: "
entries.matn_en: In the sea there are imprisoned devils whom Solomon bound. They are about to come out and recite a Qur'an to the people."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ أَشْعَثَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ شَهْرِ بْنِ حَوْشَبٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: جَاءَ ذِئْبٌ إِلَى رَاعِي غَنَمٍ فَأَخَذَ مِنْهَا شَاةً، فَطَلَبَهُ الرَّاعِي حَتَّى انْتَزَعَهَا مِنْهُ، قَالَ: صَعِدَ الذِّئْبُ عَلَى تَلٍّ فَأَقْعَى وَاسْتَقَرَّ، وَقَالَ: عَمَدْتَ إِلَى رِزْقٍ رَزَقَنِيهِ اللَّهُ أَخَذْتَهُ، ثُمَّ انْتَزَعْتَهُ مِنِّي؟ قَالَ الرَّجُلُ: تَاللَّهِ لَئِنْ رَأَيْتُ كَالْيَوْمِ ذِئْبًا يَتَكَلَّمُ، قَالَ الذِّئْبُ: أَعْجَبُ مِنْ هَذَا رَجُلٌ فِي النُّخَيْلَاتِ بَيْنَ الْحَرْثَيْنِ، يُخْبِرُكُمْ بِمَا مَضَى وَبِمَا هُوَ كَائِنٌ بَعْدَكُمْ، قَالَ: وَكَانَ الرَّجُلُ يَهُودِيًّا، فَجَاءَ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَصَدَّقَهُ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، ثُمَّ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «§إِنَّهَا أَمَارَةٌ مِنْ أَمَارَاتٍ بَيْنَ يَدَيِ السَّاعَةِ، قَدْ أَوْشَكَ الرَّجُلُ أَنْ يَخْرُجَ فَلَا يَرْجِعَ حَتَّى يُحَدِّثَهُ نَعْلَاهُ وَسَوْطُهُ بِمَا أَحْدَثَ أَهْلُهُ بَعْدَهُ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Ash'ath b. 'Abdullah, from Shahr b. Hawshab, from Abu Hurayra:
entries.matn_en: A wolf came to a shepherd and took a sheep from his flock. The shepherd pursued it until he snatched the sheep back. The wolf climbed a hill, sat on its haunches and settled, and said: "You went after a provision God had provided for me, you took it, and then you snatched it from me?" The man said: "By God, I have never seen the like of today, a wolf speaking!" The wolf said: "More astonishing than this is a man among the palm groves between the two lava fields, who tells you of what has passed and of what will be after you." The man was a Jew. He came to the Prophet ﷺ, and the Prophet ﷺ confirmed his story. Then the Prophet ﷺ said: "It is a sign among the signs before the Hour. A man is about to go out and not return until his sandals and his whip tell him what his family did after he left."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي زِيَادٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الْكَنُودِ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: مَثَلُ الدُّنْيَا كَمَثَلِ ثَغْبٍ» ، قَالَ: قُلْنَا: وَمَا الثَّغْبُ؟ قَالَ: «الْغَدِيرُ ذَهَبَ صَفْوُهُ وَبَقِيَ كَدَرُهُ، فَالْمَوْتُ يُحِبُّهُ كُلُّ مُؤْمِنٍ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Yazid b. Abi Ziyad, from Abu al-Kanud, from Ibn Mas'ud, who said: "
entries.matn_en: The likeness of the world is that of a thaghb." We said: "What is a thaghb?" He said: "A pool whose clear water has gone and whose murk remains, so every believer loves death."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ وَهْبِ بْنِ جَابِرٍ الْحَيَوَانِيِّ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كُنْتُ عِنْدَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ، فَقَدِمَ عَلَيْهِ قَهْرَمَانٌ مِنَ الشَّامِ، وَقَدْ بَقِيَتْ لَيْلَةٌ مِنْ رَمَضَانَ، فَقَالَ لَهُ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ: هَلْ تَرَكْتَ عِنْدَ أَهْلِي مَا يَكْفِيهِمْ؟ قَالَ: قَدْ تَرَكْتُ عِنْدَهُمْ نَفَقَةً، فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ عَزَمْتُ عَلَيْكَ لَمَا رَجَعْتَ وَتَرَكْتَ لَهُمْ مَا يَكْفِيهِمْ، فَإِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ: «§كَفَى إِثْمًا أَنْ يُضَيِّعَ الرَّجُلُ مَنْ يَقُوتُ» قَالَ: ثُمَّ أَنْشَأَ يُحَدِّثُنَا، قَالَ: " إِنَّ الشَّمْسَ إِذَا غَرَبَتْ سَلَّمَتْ وَسَجَدَتْ وَاسْتَأْذَنَتْ، قَالَ: فَيُؤْذَنُ لَهَا، حَتَّى إِذَا كَانَ يَوْمًا غَرَبَتْ، فَسَلَّمَتْ وَسَجَدَتْ وَاسْتَأْذَنَتْ، فَلَا يُؤْذَنُ لَهَا، فَتَقُولُ: أَيْ رَبِّ، إِنَّ الْمَسِيرَ بَعِيدٌ، وَإِنِّي لَا يُؤْذَنُ لِي، لَا أَبْلُغُ، قَالَ: فَتُحْبَسُ مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ، ثُمَّ يُقَالُ لَهَا: اطْلُعِي مِنْ حَيْثُ غَرَبْتِ، قَالَ: فَمِنْ يَوْمَئِذٍ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ {لَا يَنْفَعُ نَفْسًا إِيمَانُهَا لَمْ تَكُنْ آمَنَتْ مِنْ قَبْلُ} [الأنعام: ١٥٨]
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq told us: Ma'mar told us, from Abu Ishaq, from Wahb b. Jabir al-Khaywani, who said:
entries.matn_en:
I was with 'Abdullah b. 'Amr b. al-'As when a steward came to him from Syria, one night of Ramadan remaining. 'Abdullah said to him: "Have you left my family what suffices them?" He said: "I left them some provision." 'Abdullah said: "I adjure you to go back and leave them what suffices them, for I heard the Messenger of God ﷺ say: 'It is sin enough for a man to neglect those whom he sustains.'" Then he began to tell us: "When the sun sets it gives greeting, prostrates and asks permission, and it is given permission. Until one day it sets, gives greeting, prostrates and asks permission, and is not given permission. It says: 'My Lord, the journey is long, and if I am not given permission I will not arrive.' It is held back as long as God wills. Then it is said to it: 'Rise from where you set.' From that day until the Day of Resurrection: 'It will not benefit a soul its faith if it had not believed before' [6:158]."

He said: And he mentioned Gog and Magog, and said: "A man among them does not die until a thousand are born to him from his loins. Behind them are three nations whose number none knows but God: Mansik, Tawil and Tawis."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ مَطَرٍ، وَغَيْرِهِ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «§
entries.matn_ar: لَتُمْلَأَنَّ أَيْدِيكُمْ مِنَ الْعَجَمِ، ثُمَّ لَيَصِيرُنَّ أُسْدًا لَا يَفِرُّونَ، ثُمَّ لَيَضْرِبُنَّ أَعْنَاقَكُمْ، وَلَيَأْكُلُنَّ فَيْئَكُمْ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Matar and others, from al-Hasan, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "
entries.matn_en: Your hands will be filled from the non-Arabs. Then they will become lions who do not flee, then they will strike your necks and eat your spoils."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: قَرَأْنَا عَلَى عَبْدِ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ هِلَالٍ الْعَدَوِيِّ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ سَمَّاهُ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: إِنَّا لَجُلُوسٌ عِنْدَهُ بِالْكُوفَةِ إِذْ هَاجَتْ رِيحٌ حَمْرَاءُ، فَجَعَلَ النَّاسُ يَقُولُونَ: قَامَتِ السَّاعَةُ، حَتَّى جَاءَ رَجُلٌ لَيْسَ لَهُ هِجِّيرَى، يَقُولُ: قَدْ قَامَتِ السَّاعَةُ يَا ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ، قَدْ قَامَتِ السَّاعَةُ يَا ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ فَاسْتَوَى جَالِسًا وَغَضِبَ، وَكَانَ مُتَّكِئًا، فَقَالَ: وَاللَّهِ §لَا تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ حَتَّى لَا يُقْسَمَ مِيرَاثٌ، وَلَا يُفْرَحَ بِغَنِيمَةٍ، وَقَالَ: إِنَّهَا سَتَكُونُ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَ هَؤُلَاءِ رِدَّةٌ - قَالَ حُمَيْدٌ: فَقُلْتُ لِلرَّجُلِ: الرُّومَ تَعْنِي؟ قَالَ: نَعَمْ - وَيَسْتَمِدُّ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ بَعْضُهُمْ بَعْضًا، فَيُقْتَلُونَ، فَتَشْتَرِطُ شُرْطَةً لِلْمَوْتِ ألَّا يَرْجِعُوا إِلَّا غَالِبِينَ، فَيَقْتَتِلُونَ حَتَّى يَحُولَ بَيْنَهُمُ اللَّيْلُ، فَيَفِيءُ هَؤُلَاءِ وَيَفِيءُ هَؤُلَاءِ، وَكُلٌّ غَيْرُ غَالِبٍ، وَتَفْنَى الشُّرْطَةُ، ثُمَّ الْيَوْمَ الثَّانِي كَذَلِكَ، ثُمَّ الْيَوْمَ الثَّالِثَ كَذَلِكَ، ثُمَّ الْيَوْمَ الرَّابِعَ يَنهَدُ إِلَيْهِمْ بَقِيَّةُ الْمُسْلِمِينَ فَيُقْتَلُونَ مَقْتَلَةً لَمْ يُرَ مِثْلُهَا، حَتَّى إِنَّ بَنِي الْأَبِ كَانُوا يَتَعَادَوْنَ عَلَى مِائَةٍ لَا يَبْقَى مِنْهُمْ إِلَّا الرَّجُلُ «، قَالَ ابْنُ مَسْعُودٍ: أفَيُقْسَمُ هَاهُنَا مِيرَاثٌ؟ - قَالَ مَعْمَرٌ: وَكَانَ قَتَادَةُ يَصِلُ هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ - قَالَ: فَيَنْطَلِقُونَ حَتَّى يَدْخُلُوا قُسْطَنْطِينِيَّةَ، فَيَجِدُونَ فِيهَا مِنَ الصَّفْرَاءِ وَالْبَيْضَاءِ، مَا أَنَّ الرَّجُلَ يَتَحَجَّلُ حَجْلًا، فَبَيْنَا هُمْ كَذَلِكَ إِذْ جَاءَهُمُ الصَّرِيخُ أَنَّ الدَّجَّالَ قَدْ خَلَفَ فِي دِيَارِكُمْ، فَيَرْفُضُونَ مَا فِي أَيْدِيهِمْ، قَالَ ابْنُ مَسْعُودٍ: أفَيُفْرَحُ هَاهُنَا بِغَنِيمَةٍ؟ فَيَبْعَثُونَ مِنْهُمْ طَلِيعَةً عَشَرَةَ فَوَارِسَ، أَوِ اثْنَيْ عَشَرَ، قَالَ ابْنُ مَسْعُودٍ: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ» إِنِّي لَأَعْرِفُ أَسْمَاءَهُمْ وَقَبَائِلَهُمْ، وَأَلْوَانَ خُيُولِهِمْ، هُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ خَيْرُ فَوَارِسَ فِي الْأَرْضِ، فَيُقَاتِلُهُمُ الدَّجَّالُ فَيُسْتَشْهَدُونَ "
entries.isnad_en: We read to 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Ayyub, from Humayd b. Hilal al-'Adawi, from a man he named, from Ibn Mas'ud, who said:
entries.matn_en:
We were sitting with him in Kufa when a red wind blew, and people began to say: "The Hour has come!" Then a man came who had no other cry, saying: "The Hour has come, Ibn Mas'ud! The Hour has come, Ibn Mas'ud!" He sat upright and became angry, for he had been reclining, and said: "By God, the Hour will not come until no inheritance is divided and no one rejoices over spoils." And he said: "There will be a war/apostasy between you and those people." Humayd said: I said to the man: "You mean the Romans?" He said: "Yes."

[He continued:] "The believers will call on one another for reinforcement and be killed. A detachment will pledge itself to death, not to return except victorious. They will fight until night comes between them, and each side withdraws with neither having prevailed, and the detachment is annihilated. Then the second day is the same, then the third day the same. Then on the fourth day the remainder of the Muslims will rise against them, and a slaughter will take place the like of which has never been seen, so that brothers of one father would count themselves off to reach a hundred, and none of them would remain but one man."

Ibn Mas'ud said: "Would an inheritance be divided here?" (Ma'mar said: Qatada used to give this hadith a continuous chain.) He said: "They proceed until they enter Constantinople, and find in it so much gold and silver that a man goes hopping along [under the load]. While they are so engaged, the cry comes to them that the Dajjal has taken their place among your homes, so they abandon what is in their hands." Ibn Mas'ud said: "Would one rejoice over spoils here?" "They send out a vanguard of ten horsemen, or twelve." Ibn Mas'ud said: The Prophet ﷺ said: "I know their names, their tribes and the colors of their horses. They are that day the best horsemen on earth." The Dajjal fights them and they are martyred.

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنِ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ، عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ أَوْسٍ الدَّوْسِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ، قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: يَكُونُ عَلَى الرُّومِ مَلِكٌ لَا يَعْصُونَهُ - أَوْ لَا يَكَادُونَ يَعْصُونَهُ -، فَيَجِيءُ حَتَّى يَنْزِلَ بِأَرْضِ كَذَا وَكَذَا» ، قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ: «أَنَا مَا نَسَيْتُهَا» ، قَالَ: «وَيَسْتَمِدُّ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ بَعْضُهُمْ بَعْضًا حَتَّى يَمُدَّهُمْ أَهْلُ عَدَنَ أَبْيَنَ عَلَى قَلَصَاتِهِمْ» ، قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ: «إِنَّهُ لَفِي الْكِتَابِ مَكْتُوبٌ: فَيَقْتَتِلُونَ عَشْرًا لَا يَحْجُزُ بَيْنَهُمْ إِلَّا اللَّيْلُ، لَيْسَ لَكُمْ طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مَا فِي إِدَاوِيكُمْ، لَا تَكِلُّ سُيُوفُهُمْ وَيباركهم وَلَا نِسَائِهِمْ، وَأَنْتُمْ أَيْضًا كَذَلِكَ، ثُمَّ يَأْمُرُ مَلِكُهُمْ بِالسُّفُنِ فَيَنْحَرِفُ - يَعْنِي مَلِكَ الرُّومِ - قَالَ: ثُمَّ يَقُولُ: مَنْ شَاءَ الْآنَ فَلْيَفِرَّ، فيجَعَلُ اللَّهُ الدَّبْرَةَ عَلَيْهِمْ، فَيُقْتَلُونَ مَقْتَلَةً لَمْ يُرَ مِثْلُهَا - أَوْ لَا يُرَى مِثْلُهَا -، حَتَّى إِنَّ الطَّائِرَ لَيَمُرُّ بِهِمْ فَيَقَعُ مَيِّتًا مِنْ نَتْنِهِمْ، لِلشَّهِيدِ يَوْمَئِذٍ كِفْلَانِ عَلَى مَنْ مَضَى قَبْلَهُ مِنَ الشُّهَدَاءِ، وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِ يَوْمَئِذٍ كِفْلَانِ عَلَى مَنْ مَضَى مِنْهُمْ قَبْلَهُ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، قَالَ: وَبَقِيَّتُهُمْ لَا يُزَلْزِلُهُمْ شَيْءٌ أَبَدًا، وَبَقِيَّتُهُمْ يُقَاتِلُ الدَّجَّالَ» قَالَ ابْنُ سِيرِينَ: فَكَانَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَلَامٍ يَقُولُ: «إِنْ أَدْرَكَنِي هَذَا الْقِتَالُ وَأَنَا مَرِيضٌ فَاحْمِلُونِي عَلَى سَرِيرِي حَتَّى تَجْعَلُونِي بَيْنَ الصَّفَّيْنِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq told us: Ma'mar told us, from Ayyub, from Ibn Sirin, from 'Uqba b. Aws al-Dawsi, from 'Abdullah b. 'Amr b. al-'As, who said: "
entries.matn_en:
The Romans will have a king whom they do not disobey, or hardly disobey. He will come until he camps in such-and-such a land." 'Abdullah said: "I have not forgotten it." He said: "The believers will call on one another for reinforcement until the people of Aden Abyan reinforce them on their young camels." 'Abdullah said: "It is written in the Book: 'They will fight for ten days with nothing separating them but the night. You will have no food except what is in your water-skins. Their swords do not tire…' [the words 'wa-yubarikuhum wa-la nisa'ihim' are corrupt] '…and you likewise. Then their king, meaning the king of the Romans, orders the ships and turns away. Then he says: "Whoever wishes, let him flee now." God turns the rout against them, and they are slain in a slaughter the like of which has not been seen, or will not be seen, so that a bird passes by them and falls dead from their stench. The martyr that day has a double share over the martyrs before him, and the believer that day a double share over the believers before him. The remainder of them will never be shaken by anything, and the remainder of them will fight the Dajjal.'"

Ibn Sirin said: 'Abdullah b. Salam used to say: "If this battle reaches me while I am sick, carry me on my bed until you place me between the two ranks."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «§
entries.matn_ar: يَذْهَبُ كِسْرَى فَلَا يَكُونُ كِسْرَى بَعْدَهُ، وَيَذْهَبُ قَيْصَرُ فَلَا يَكُونُ قَيْصَرٌ بَعْدَهُ، وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ لَتُنْفَقَنَّ كُنُوزُهُمَا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, from Ibn al-Musayyab, from Abu Hurayra: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "
entries.matn_en: Kisra will perish and there will be no Kisra after him; Caesar will perish and there will be no Caesar after him. By the One in whose hand is my soul, their treasures will be spent in the way of God."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ يَقُولُ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «§
entries.matn_ar: هَلَكَ كِسْرَى، ثُمَّ لَا يَكُونُ كِسْرَى بَعْدَهُ، وَقَيْصَرُ لَيَهْلِكَنَّ، ثُمَّ لَا يَكُونُ قَيْصَرٌ بَعْدَهُ، وَلتُنْفَقَنَّ كُنُوزُهُمَا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Hammam b. Munabbih, that he heard Abu Hurayra say: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "
entries.matn_en: Kisra has perished, and there will be no Kisra after him. Caesar will surely perish, and there will be no Caesar after him. Their treasures will surely be spent in the way of God."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ، قَالَ: قَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: لَا تَذْهَبُ اللَّيَالِي وَالْأَيَّامُ حَتَّى يَغْزُوَ الْعَادِي رُومِيَّةَ، فَيَفْعَلَ إِلَى الْقُسْطَنْطِينِيَّةِ فَيَرَى أَنْ قَدْ فَعَلَ، وَلَا تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ حَتَّى يَسُوقَ النَّاسَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ قَحْطَانَ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq told us: Ma'mar told us, from Ibn Abi Dhi'b, from Sa'id al-Maqburi, who said: Abu Hurayra said: "
entries.matn_en: The nights and days will not pass until the raider attacks Rumiya [Rome], does [the same] to Constantinople, and thinks he has accomplished it. And the Hour will not come until a man from Qahtan drives the people." [The first sentence is obscure.]

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ:
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مَرَّ بِابْنِ صَيَّادٍ فِي نَفَرٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِهِ، مِنْهُمْ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ، وَهُوَ يَلْعَبُ مَعَ الْغِلْمَانِ عِنْدَ أُطُمِ بَنِي مَغَالَةَ وَهُوَ غُلَامٌ، فَلَمْ يَشْعُرْ حَتَّى ضَرَبَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ ظَهْرَهُ بِيَدِهِ، فَقَالَ: «§أَتَشْهَدُ أَنِّي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ؟» ، فَنَظَرَ إِلَيْهِ ابْنُ صَيَّادٍ فَقَالَ: أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ رَسُولُ الْأُمِّيِّينَ، قَالَ ابْنُ صَيَّادٍ لِلنَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَتَشْهَدُ أَنِّي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ؟ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «آمَنْتُ بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ» فَقَالَ لَهُ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «مَا يَأْتِيكَ؟» ، قَالَ ابْنُ صَيَّادٍ: يَأْتِينِي صَادِقٌ وَكَاذِبٌ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «خُلِّطَ عَلَيْكَ الْأَمْرُ» ، ثُمَّ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «إِنِّي قَدْ خَبَأْتُ لَكَ خَبِيئًا» وَخَبَأَ لَهُ {يَوْمَ تَأْتِي السَّمَاءُ بِدُخَانٍ مُبِينٍ} [الدخان: ١٠] ، فَقَالَ ابْنُ صَيَّادٍ: هُوَ الدُّخُّ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «اخْسَأْ، فَلَنْ تَعْدُوَ قَدْرَكَ» فَقَالَ عُمَرُ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، ائْذَنْ لِي فِيهِ فَأَضْرِبَ عُنُقَهُ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «إِنْ يَكُ هُوَ فَلَنْ تُسَلَّطَ عَلَيْهِ، وَإِنْ لَا يَكُنْ هُوَ فَلَا خَيْرَ لَكَ فِي قَتْلِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq told us: Ma'mar told us, from al-Zuhri, from Salim, from Ibn 'Umar:
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ passed by Ibn Sayyad with a group of his Companions, among them 'Umar b. al-Khattab. He was playing with the boys at the fortress of Banu Maghala, and he was a boy. He did not notice until the Messenger of God ﷺ struck his back with his hand and said: "Do you testify that I am the Messenger of God?" Ibn Sayyad looked at him and said: "I testify that you are the messenger of the unlettered." Ibn Sayyad said to the Prophet ﷺ: "Do you testify that I am the messenger of God?" The Prophet ﷺ said: "I believe in God and His messenger." Then the Prophet ﷺ said to him: "What comes to you?" Ibn Sayyad said: "A truthful one and a liar come to me." The Prophet ﷺ said: "The matter has been confused for you." Then the Messenger of God ﷺ said: "I have concealed something for you," and he concealed for him [the verse] "the Day when the sky brings a clear smoke" [44:10]. Ibn Sayyad said: "It is the dukh." The Prophet ﷺ said: "Begone! You will not exceed your measure." 'Umar said: "Messenger of God, permit me to strike his neck." The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "If he is the one, you will not be given power over him, and if he is not, there is no good for you in killing him."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سِنَانِ بْنِ أَبِي سِنَانٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ حُسَيْنَ بْنَ عَلِيٍّ، يُحَدِّثُ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ خَبَأَ لِابْنِ صَيَّادٍ دُخَانًا، فَسَأَلَهُ عَمَّا خَبَأَ لَهُ، فَقَالَ: دُخٌّ فَقَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: اخْسَأْ فَلَنْ تَعْدُوَ قَدْرَكَ» - أَجَلَكَ - فَلَمَّا وَلَّى قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مَا قَالَ: فَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ: دُخٌّ، وَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ: بَلْ قَالَ: رِيحٌ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «§قَدِ اخْتَلَفْتُمْ وَأَنَا بَيْنَ أَظْهُرِكُمْ، وَأَنْتُمْ بَعْدِي أَشَدُّ اخْتِلَافًا»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, from Sinan b. Abi Sinan, that he heard Husayn b. 'Ali narrate that the Prophet ﷺ concealed [the word] "smoke" for Ibn Sayyad and asked him what he had concealed, and he said: "Dukh." He said: "
entries.matn_en: Begone! You will not exceed your measure" (or: your term). When he turned away, the Prophet ﷺ said: "What did he say?" Some said: "Dukh," and others said: "No, he said rih [wind]." The Prophet ﷺ said: "You have differed while I am among you, and after me you will differ even more."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ غَيْرِ وَاحِدٍ، قَالَ: قَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ:
entries.matn_ar: انْطَلَقَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَأُبَيُّ بْنُ كَعْبٍ يَوْمًا إِلَى النَّخْلِ الَّتِي فِيهَا ابْنُ صَيَّادٍ، حَتَّى إِذَا دَخَلَا النَّخْلَ §طَفِقَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَتَّقِي بِجُذُوعِ النَّخْلِ وَهُوَ يَخْتِلُ ابْنَ صَيَّادٍ، أَنْ يَسْمَعَ مِنِ ابْنِ صَيَّادٍ شَيْئًا قَبْلَ أَنْ يَرَاهُ، وَابْنُ صَيَّادٍ مُضْطَجِعٌ عَلَى فِرَاشِهِ فِي قَطِيفَةٍ لَهُ فِيهَا زَمْزَمَةٌ، قَالَ: فَرَأَتْ أُمُّهُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَهُوَ يَتَّقِي بِجُذُوعِ النَّخْلِ فَقَالَتْ: أَيْ صَافِ - وَهُوَ اسْمُهُ - هَذَا مُحَمَّدٌ فَثَارَ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «لَوْ تَرَكْتِهِ بَيَّنَ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, from Salim, from several people. Ibn 'Umar said:
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ and Ubayy b. Ka'b went one day to the palm grove where Ibn Sayyad was. When they entered the grove, the Messenger of God ﷺ began to shield himself behind the trunks of the palms, stealthily approaching Ibn Sayyad to hear something from him before he saw him. Ibn Sayyad was lying on his bed in a velvet cloth in which there was a murmuring. His mother saw the Messenger of God ﷺ shielding himself behind the trunks and said: "Saf" (his name), "this is Muhammad!" He rose up. The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "If she had left him, he would have made things clear."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي النَّاسِ فَأَثْنَى عَلَى اللَّهِ بِمَا هُوَ أَهْلُهُ، ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ الدَّجَّالَ فَقَالَ: «إِنِّي لَأُنْذِرُكُمُوهُ وَمَا مِنْ نَبِيٍّ إِلَّا قَدْ أَنْذَرَهُ قَوْمَهُ، لَقَدْ أَنْذَرَهُ نُوحٌ قَوْمَهُ، وَلَكِنِّي سَأَقُولُ لَكُمْ فِيهِ قَوْلًا لَمْ يَقُلْهُ نَبِيُّ لِقَوْمِهِ: تَعْلَمُونَ §أَنَّهُ أَعْوَرُ، وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ لَيْسَ بِأَعْوَرَ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, from Salim, from Ibn 'Umar, who said:
entries.matn_en:
The Messenger of God ﷺ stood among the people, praised God as He deserves, then mentioned the Dajjal and said: "I warn you of him. There was no prophet who did not warn his people of him; Noah warned his people. But I will tell you something about him that no prophet told his people: you know that he is one-eyed, and that God is not one-eyed."

[This continuation is in the supplied English only; it is not in the Arabic text.] Al-Zuhri said: 'Umar b. Thabit al-Ansari told me that some of the Companions of the Prophet ﷺ told him that the Messenger of God ﷺ said that day to the people, warning them of the trial of the Dajjal: "None of you will see his Lord until he dies. And between his [the Dajjal's] eyes is written 'unbeliever,' which is read by whoever dislikes his deeds."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أخبرنا عبد الرزاق عن معمر عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ شَهْرِ بْنِ حَوْشَبٍ، عَنِ أَسْمَاءَ بِنْتِ يَزِيدَ الْأَنْصَارِيَّةِ قَالَتْ:
entries.matn_ar: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي بَيْتِي فَذَكَرَ §الدَّجَّالَ فَقَالَ: «إِنَّ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ ثَلَاثَ سِنِينَ: سَنَةٌ تُمْسِكُ السَّمَاءُ ثُلُثَ قَطْرِهَا، وَالْأَرْضُ ثُلُثَ نَبَاتِهَا، وَالثَّانِيَةُ تُمْسِكُ السَّمَاءُ ثُلُثَيْ قَطْرِهَا، وَالْأَرْضُ ثُلُثَيْ نَبَاتِهَا، وَالثَّالِثَةُ تُمْسِكُ السَّمَاءُ قَطْرَهَا كُلَّهُ، وَالْأَرْضُ نَبَاتَهَا كُلَّهُ، فَلَا تَبْقَى ذَاتُ ظِلْفٍ وَلَا ذَاتُ ضِرْسٍ مِنَ الْبَهَائِمِ إِلَّا هَلَكَتْ، وَإِنَّ مِنْ أَشَدِّ النَّاسِ فِتْنَةً أَنَّهُ يَأْتِي الْأَعْرَابِيَّ فَيَقُولُ: أَرَأَيْتَ إِنْ أَحْيَيْتُ لَكَ إِبِلًا، أَلَسْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّنِي رَبُّكَ؟ قَالَ: فَيَقُولُ: بَلَى، فَيَتَمَثَّلُ لَهُ الشَّيْطَانُ نَحْوَ إِبِلِهِ كَأَحْسَنِ مَا تَكُونُ ضُرُوعًا، وَأَعْظَمِهِ أَسْنِمَةً، قَالَ: وَيَأْتِي الرَّجُلَ قَدْ مَاتَ أَخُوهُ وَمَاتَ أَبُوهُ، فَيَقُولُ: أَرَأَيْتَ إِنْ أَحْيَيْتُ لَكَ أَبَاكَ وَأَحْيَيْتُ لَكَ أَخَاكَ، أَلَيْسَ تَعْلَمُ أَنِّي رَبُّكَ؟ فَيَقُولُ بَلَى، فَيَتَمَثَّلُ لَهُ الشَّيْطَانُ نَحْوَ أَبِيهِ وَنَحْوَ أَخِيهِ» ، قَالَتْ: ثُمَّ خَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ لِحَاجَةٍ لَهُ ثُمَّ رَجَعَ، قَالَتْ: وَالْقَوْمُ فِي اهْتِمَامٍ وَغَمٍّ مِمَّا حَدَّثَهُمْ بِهِ، قَالَتْ: فَأَخَذَ بِلُحْمَتَيِ الْبَابِ وَقَالَ: «مَهْيَمْ أَسْمَاءُ» ، قَالَتْ: قُلْتُ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، لَقَدْ خَلَعْتَ أَفْئِدَتَنَا بِذِكْرِ الدَّجَّالِ، قَالَ: «إِنْ يَخْرُجْ وَأَنَا حَيٌّ فَأَنَا حَجِيجُهُ، وَإِلَّا فَإِنَّ رَبِّي خَلِيفَتِي مِنْ بَعْدِي عَلَى كُلِّ مُؤْمِنٍ» ، قَالَتْ أَسْمَاءُ: فَقُلْتُ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، وَاللَّهِ إِنَّا لَنَعْجِنُ عَجِينَتَنَا فَمَا نَخْبِزُهَا حَتَّى نَجُوعَ، فَكَيْفَ بِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَئِذٍ؟ قَالَ: «يُجْزِئُهُمْ مَا يُجْزِئُ أَهْلَ السَّمَاءِ مِنَ التَّسْبِيحِ وَالتَّقْدِيسِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Qatada, from Shahr b. Hawshab, from Asma' bint Yazid al-Ansariyya, who said:
entries.matn_en:
The Messenger of God ﷺ was in my house and mentioned the Dajjal. He said: "Before him are three years. In the first, the sky withholds a third of its rain and the earth a third of its plants. In the second, the sky withholds two-thirds of its rain and the earth two-thirds of its plants. In the third, the sky withholds all its rain and the earth all its plants, so that no cloven-hoofed or molar-toothed animal remains but perishes. Among the most severe trials is that he will come to a Bedouin and say: 'Do you see, if I revive your camels for you, will you not know that I am your Lord?' He will say: 'Yes.' So Satan will take the shape of his camels, with the finest udders and the largest humps. And he will come to a man whose brother and father have died and say: 'Do you see, if I revive your father and your brother for you, will you not know that I am your Lord?' He will say: 'Yes,' and Satan will take the shape of his father and his brother."

She said: Then the Messenger of God ﷺ went out for a need of his and returned, while the people were in anxiety and distress over what he had told them. She said: He took hold of the two doorposts and said: "What is it, Asma'?" I said: "Messenger of God, you have wrenched out our hearts by mentioning the Dajjal." He said: "If he emerges while I am alive, I will be the one to argue against him. Otherwise my Lord is my successor over every believer." Asma' said: I said: "Messenger of God, by God, we knead our dough and do not bake it before we are hungry. How will the believers be that day?" He said: "What suffices the people of heaven will suffice them: glorification and sanctification."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ خُثَيْمٍ، عَنْ شَهْرِ بْنِ حَوْشَبٍ، عَنِ أَسْمَاءَ بِنْتِ يَزِيدَ قَالَتْ: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «§
entries.matn_ar: يَمْكُثُ الدَّجَّالُ فِي الْأَرْضِ أَرْبَعِينَ سَنَةً، السَّنَةُ كَالشَّهْرِ، وَالشَّهْرُ كَالْجُمُعَةِ، وَالْجُمُعَةُ كَالْيَوْمِ، وَالْيَوْمُ كَاضْطِرَامِ السَّعَفَةِ فِي النَّارِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq told us: Ma'mar told us, from Ibn Khuthaym, from Shahr b. Hawshab, from Asma' bint Yazid, who said: The Prophet ﷺ said: "
entries.matn_en: The Dajjal will remain on earth forty years: the year like a month, the month like a week, the week like a day, and the day like the flaring of a palm frond in fire."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرَةَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: أَكْثَرَ النَّاسُ فِي مُسَيْلِمَةَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَقُولَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِيهِ شَيْئًا، فَقَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ خَطِيبًا فَقَالَ: " أَمَّا بَعْدُ، §فَفِي شَأْنِ هَذَا الدَّجَّالِ الَّذِي قَدْ أَكْثَرْتُمْ فِيهِ، وَإِنَّهُ كَذَّابٌ مِنْ ثَلَاثِينَ كَذَّابًا يَخْرُجُونَ بَيْنَ يَدَيِ الْمَسِيحِ وَإِنَّهُ لَيْسَ مِنْ بَلَدٍ إِلَّا يَبْلُغُهُ رُعْبُ الْمَسِيحِ إِلَّا الْمَدِينَةَ، عَلَى كُلِّ نَقْبٍ مِنْ أَنْقَابِهَا مَلَكَانِ يَذُبَّانِ عَنْهَا رُعْبَ الْمَسِيحِ
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, from Talha b. 'Ubaydillah b. 'Awf, from Abu Bakra, who said:
entries.matn_en: People talked a great deal about Musaylima before the Messenger of God ﷺ said anything about him. So the Messenger of God ﷺ stood to give a sermon and said: "To proceed. Concerning this Dajjal about whom you have talked so much: he is a liar, one of thirty liars who will come forth before the Messiah [i.e., the false Messiah]. There is no land that the terror of the Messiah will not reach, except Medina. At every pass of Medina are two angels who ward off from it the terror of the Messiah."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ، أَنَّ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيَّ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ حَدِيثًا طَوِيلًا عَنِ الدَّجَّالِ فَقَالَ فِيمَا يُحَدِّثُنَا: «§
entries.matn_ar: يَأْتِي الدَّجَّالُ وَهُوَ مُحَرَّمٌ عَلَيْهِ أَنْ يَدْخُلَ نِقَابَ الْمَدِينَةِ، فَيَخْرُجُ إِلَيْهِ رَجُلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ هُوَ خَيْرُ النَّاسِ - أَوْ مِنْ خَيْرِهِمْ - فَيَقُولُ: أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ الدَّجَّالُ الَّذِي حَدَّثَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ حَدِيثَهُ، فَيَقُولُ الدَّجَّالُ: أَرَأَيْتُمْ إِنْ قَتَلْتُ هَذَا ثُمَّ أَحْيَيْتُهُ، أَتَشُكُّونَ فِي الْأَمْرِ؟ فَيَقُولُونَ: لَا، فَيَقْتُلُهُ ثُمَّ يُحْيِيهِ، فَيَقُولُ حِينَ يُحْيَى: وَاللَّهِ مَا كُنْتُ قَطُّ أَشَدَّ بَصِيرَةً فِيكَ مِنِّي الْآنَ، قَالَ: فَيُرِيدُ قَتْلَهُ الثَّانِيَةَ فَلَا يُسَلَّطُ عَلَيْهِ» ، قَالَ مَعْمَرٌ: «وَبَلَغَنِي أَنَّهُ يُجْعَلُ عَلَى حَلْقِهِ صَفِيحَةٌ مِنْ نُحَاسٍ، وَبَلَغَنِي أَنَّهُ الْخَضِرُ الَّذِي يَقْتُلُهُ الدَّجَّالُ ثُمَّ يُحْيِيهِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq told us: Ma'mar told us, from al-Zuhri, who said: 'Ubaydullah b. 'Abdillah b. 'Utba told me that Abu Sa'id al-Khudri said: The Messenger of God ﷺ told us a long hadith about the Dajjal, and among what he told us was: "
entries.matn_en:
The Dajjal will come, and it is forbidden for him to enter the passes of Medina. A man will go out to him that day who is the best of people, or among the best of them, and will say: 'I testify that you are the Dajjal about whom the Messenger of God ﷺ told us.' The Dajjal will say: 'Do you see, if I kill this man and then bring him back to life, will you doubt the matter?' They will say: 'No.' So he will kill him and then revive him. When he is revived he will say: 'By God, I have never had more insight into you than I have now.' Then he will want to kill him a second time, but will not be given power over him."

Ma'mar said: "It has reached me that a plate of copper is placed over his throat. And it has reached me that he is al-Khidr, whom the Dajjal kills and then revives."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هَارُونَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «§
entries.matn_ar: يَتَّبِعُ الدَّجَّالَ مِنْ أُمَّتِي سَبْعُونَ أَلْفًا عَلَيْهِمُ السِّيجَانُ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Abu Harun, from Abu Sa'id, who said: The Prophet ﷺ said: "
entries.matn_en: Seventy thousand of my community will follow the Dajjal, wearing sijan [green/Persian shawls]."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، يَرْوِيهِ قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: عَامَّةُ مَنْ يَتَّبِعُ الدَّجَّالَ يَهُودُ أَصْبَهَانَ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Yahya b. Abi Kathir, narrating it, who said: "
entries.matn_en: Most of those who follow the Dajjal are the Jews of Isfahan."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: نَادَى مُنَادٍ بِالْكُوفَةِ: الدَّجَّالُ قَدْ خَرَجَ، فَجَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى حُذَيْفَةَ بْنِ أَسِيدٍ فَقَالَ لَهُ: أَنْتَ جَالِسٌ هَاهُنَا وَأَهْلُ الْكُوفَةِ يُقَاتِلُونَ الدَّجَّالَ، فَقَالَ لَهُ حُذَيْفَةُ: «اجْلِسْ» ، ثُمَّ جَاءَ عَرِيفُهُمْ فَقَالَ: أَنْتُمَا هَاهُنَا جَالِسَانِ وَأَهْلُ الْكُوفَةِ يُطَاعِنُونَ الدَّجَّالَ، فَقَالَ لَهُ حُذَيْفَةُ: «اجْلِسْ» ، فَمَكَثُوا قَلِيلًا، ثُمَّ جَاءَ آخَرُ فَقَالَ: إِنَّهَا كَذْبَةُ صَبَّاغٍ، فَقَالُوا لِحُذَيْفَةَ: حَدِّثْنَا عَنِ الدَّجَّالِ، فَإِنَّكَ لَمْ تَحْبِسْنَا إِلَّا وَعِنْدَكَ مِنْهُ عِلْمٌ، فَقَالَ حُذَيْفَةُ: «§لَوْ خَرَجَ الدَّجَّالُ الْيَوْمَ إِلَّا وَدَفَنَهُ الصِّبْيَانُ بِالْخَذَفِ، وَلَكِنَّهُ يَخْرُجُ فِي قِلَّةٍ مِنَ النَّاسِ، وَنَقْصٍ مِنَ الطَّعَامِ، وَسُوءِ ذَاتِ بَيْنٍ، وَخَفْقَةٍ مِنَ الدِّينِ، فَتُطوَى لَهُ الْأَرْضُ كَطَيِّ فَرْوَةِ الْكَبْشِ، فَيَأْتِي الْمَدِينَةَ، فَيَأْخُذُ خَارِجَهَا وَيَمْنَعُ دَاخِلَهَا، مَكْتُوبٌ بَيْنَ عَيْنَيْهِ كَافِرٌ، يَقْرَأُهُ كُلُّ مُؤْمِنٍ كَاتَبٍ وَأُمِّيٍّ، لَا يُسَخَّرُ لَهُ مِنَ الْمَطِيِّ إِلَّا الْحِمَارُ، فَهُوَ رِجْسٌ عَلَى رِجْسٍ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Qatada, who said:
entries.matn_en:
A crier called out in Kufa: "The Dajjal has come out!" A man came to Hudhayfa b. Asid and said: "You are sitting here while the people of Kufa are fighting the Dajjal?" Hudhayfa said to him: "Sit." Then their chief came and said: "You two are sitting here while the people of Kufa are jousting the Dajjal?" Hudhayfa said to him: "Sit." They waited a little, then another came and said: "It was a dyer's lie." They said to Hudhayfa: "Tell us about the Dajjal, for you would not have kept us here unless you had knowledge of him." Hudhayfa said: "If the Dajjal came out today, the boys would bury him with pebbles. But he will come out when people are few, food is scarce, relations are bad, and religion is slack. The earth will be folded for him like the folding of a ram's fleece. He will come to Medina, seize its outskirts and be barred from its interior. Between his eyes is written 'unbeliever,' which every believer, literate or unlettered, will read. No mount will be subjected to him except the donkey. He is filth upon filth."

[This continuation is in the supplied English only; it is not in the Arabic text.] And Hudhayfa said: "I fear for you something other than the Dajjal more than him." It was asked: "What is that?" He said: "Trials like patches of the dark night." It was asked: "Which people are best in them, Abu Surayha?" He said: "The wealthy who is obscure." It was asked: "Which are worst in them?" He said: "The orator in full voice and the rider who hastens." One of the two men said: "By God, I am neither wealthy nor obscure." Hudhayfa said: "Then be like the weanling camel: no back to be ridden and no udder to be milked."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عَامِرٍ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «
entries.matn_ar: إِنَّ §رَأْسَ الدَّجَّالِ مِنْ وَرَائِهِ حُبُكٌ حُبُكٌ، وَإِنَّهُ سَيَقُولُ: أَنَا رَبُّكُمْ، فَمَنْ قَالَ: أَنْتَ رَبِّي افْتُتِنَ، وَمَنْ قَالَ: كَذَبْتَ، رَبِّيَ اللَّهُ وَعَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَإِلَيْهِ أُنِيبُ، فَلَا يَضُرُّهُ، أَوْ قَالَ: فَلَا فِتْنَةَ عَلَيْهِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq told us: Ma'mar told us, from Ayyub, from Abu Qilaba, from Hisham b. 'Amir, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "
entries.matn_en: The Dajjal's head, from behind, is full of tight curls. He will say: 'I am your Lord.' Whoever says 'You are my Lord' is tried. Whoever says 'You lie; my Lord is God, in Him I trust and to Him I turn,' will not be harmed," or he said: "there will be no trial upon him."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ شَبِيبٍ، عَنِ الْعُرْيَانِ بْنِ الْهَيْثَمِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: وَفَدْتُ عَلَى مُعَاوِيَةَ، فَبَيْنَا أَنَا عِنْدَهُ إِذْ دَخَلَ رَجُلٌ عَلَيْهِ طِمْرَانِ، فَرَحَّبَ بِهِ مُعَاوِيَةُ وَأَجْلَسَهُ عَلَى السَّرِيرِ، فَقُلْتُ: مَنْ هَذَا يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ؟ فَقَالَ: أَمَا تَعْرِفُ هَذَا؟ هَذَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ قُلْتُ: أَهَذَا الَّذِي يَقُولُ: لَا يَعِيشُ النَّاسُ بَعْدَ مِائَةِ سَنَةٍ، فَأَقْبَلَ عَلَيَّ وَقَالَ: «أَوَقُلْتُ ذَلِكَ أَنَا؟ تَجِدُهُمْ يَعِيشُونَ بَعْدَ مِائَةِ سَنَةٍ دَهْرًا طَوِيلًا، وَلَكِنَّ هَذِهِ الْأُمَّةَ أُجِّلَتْ ثَلَاثِينَ وَمِائَةَ سَنَةٍ» قَالَ: ثُمَّ قَالَ لِى: «مِمَّنْ أَنْتَ؟» ، قَالَ: قُلْتُ: مِنْ أَهْلِ الْعِرَاقِ - أَوْ قَالَ: مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكُوفَةِ - قَالَ: «تَعْرِفُ كُوثَى؟» ، قَالَ: قُلْتُ: نَعَمْ، قَالَ: «§مِنْهَا يَخْرُجُ الدَّجَّالُ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Muhammad b. Shabib, from al-'Uryan b. al-Haytham, who said:
entries.matn_en: I came as part of a delegation to Mu'awiya. While I was with him a man wearing two worn garments came in. Mu'awiya welcomed him and seated him on the couch. I said: "Who is this, Commander of the Faithful?" He said: "Do you not know him? This is 'Abdullah b. 'Amr b. al-'As." I said: "Is this the one who says that people will not live after a hundred years?" He turned to me and said: "Did I say that? You will find them living a long time after a hundred years. But this community has been given a term of a hundred and thirty years." Then he said to me: "Where are you from?" I said: "From the people of Iraq," or he said: "of Kufa." He said: "Do you know Kutha?" I said: "Yes." He said: "From it the Dajjal will emerge."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ كَعْبٍ، قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: يَخْرُجُ الدَّجَّالُ مِنَ الْعِرَاقِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Ibn Tawus, from his father, from Ka'b, who said: "
entries.matn_en: The Dajjal will emerge from Iraq."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: وُلِدَ ابْنُ صَيَّادٍ أَعْوَرَ مُخْتَتَنًا»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Hisham b. 'Urwa, from his father, who said: "
entries.matn_en: Ibn Sayyad was born one-eyed and circumcised."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: لَقِيتُ ابْنَ صَيَّادٍ يَوْمًا وَمَعَهُ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْيَهُودِ، فَإِذَا عَيْنُهُ قَدْ طَفِيَتْ، وَكَانَتْ عَيْنُهُ خَارِجَةً مِثْلَ عَيْنِ الْجَمَلِ، فَلَمَّا رَأَيْتُهَا قُلْتُ: يَا ابْنَ صَيَّادٍ أَنْشُدُكَ اللَّهَ، مَتَى طَفِيَتْ عَيْنُكَ؟ - أَوْ نَحْوَ هَذَا - قَالَ: لَا أَدْرِي وَالرَّحْمَنِ، فَقُلْتُ: كَذَبْتَ، لَا تَدْرِي وَهِيَ فِي رَأْسِكَ، قَالَ: فَمَسَحَهَا، قَالَ: فَنَخَرَ ثَلَاثًا، فَزَعَمَ الْيَهُودِيُّ أَنِّي ضَرَبْتُ بِيَدِي عَلَى صَدْرِهِ، قَالَ: وَلَا أَعْلَمُنِي فَعَلْتُ ذَلِكَ اخْسَأْ، فَلَنْ تَعْدُوَ قَدْرَكَ، قَالَ: أَجَلْ، لَعَمْرِي لَا أَعْدُو قَدْرِي، قَالَ: فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لِحَفْصَةَ فَقَالَتْ: «اجْتَنِبْ هَذَا الرَّجُلَ، فَإِنَّا نَتَحَدَّثُ أَنَّ §الدَّجَّالَ يَخْرُجُ عِنْدَ غَضْبَةٍ يَغْضَبُهَا»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, from Salim, from Ibn 'Umar, who said:
entries.matn_en: I met Ibn Sayyad one day with a Jewish man. His eye had gone dim, and it protruded like the eye of a camel. When I saw it I said: "Ibn Sayyad, I adjure you by God, when did your eye go dim?" (or words like this). He said: "I do not know, by the Merciful." I said: "You lie! You do not know, and it is in your head?" He wiped it and snorted three times. The Jew claimed that I struck him on his chest with my hand. [Ibn 'Umar] said: "I do not recall doing that. [I said:] 'Begone! You will not exceed your measure.'" He said: "Indeed, by my life, I will not exceed my measure." I mentioned this to Hafsa, and she said: "Avoid this man, for we have been saying that the Dajjal will emerge at a moment of anger that he will become angry."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ، قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: أَشَدُّ النَّاسِ عَلَى الدَّجَّالِ بَنُو تَمِيمٍ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Ayyub, from Abu Qilaba, who said: "
entries.matn_en: The people most severe against the Dajjal are Banu Tamim."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ الثَّقَفِيُّ، أَنَّهُ أَخْبَرَهُ رَجُلٌ، مِنَ الْأَنْصَارِ، عَنْ بَعْضِ أَصْحَابِ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: ذَكَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ §الدَّجَّالَ فَقَالَ: «يَأْتِي سِبَاخَ الْمَدِينَةِ، وَهُوَ مُحَرَّمٌ عَلَيْهِ أَنْ يَدْخُلَ نِقَابَهَا، فَتَنْتَفِضُ الْمَدِينَةُ بِأَهْلِهَا نَفْضَةً أَوْ نَفْضَتَيْنِ، وَهِيَ الزَّلْزَلَةُ، فَيَخْرُجُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْهَا كُلُّ مُنَافِقٍ وَمُنَافِقَةٍ، ثُمَّ يُوَلِّي الدَّجَّالُ قِبَلَ الشَّامِ، حَتَّى يَأْتِيَ بَعْضَ جِبَالِ الشَّامِ فَيُحَاصِرَهُمْ، وَبَقِيَّةُ الْمُسْلِمِينَ يَوْمَئِذٍ مُعْتَصِمُونَ بِذِرْوَةِ جَبَلٍ مِنْ جِبَالِ الشَّامِ، فَيُحَاصِرَهُمُ الدَّجَّالُ نَازِلًا بِأَصْلِهِ، حَتَّى إِذَا طَالَ عَلَيْهِمُ الْبَلَاءُ، قَالَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ: يَا مَعْشَرَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ، حَتَّى مَتَى أَنْتُمْ هَكَذَا وَعَدُوُّ اللَّهِ نَازِلٌ بِأَرْضِكُمْ هَكَذَا، هَلْ أَنْتُمْ إِلَّا بَيْنَ إِحْدَى الْحُسْنَيَيْنِ، بَيْنَ أَنْ يَسْتَشْهِدَكُمُ اللَّهُ أَوْ يُظْهِرَكُمْ، فَيُبَايِعُونَ عَلَى الْمَوْتِ بَيْعَةً يَعْلَمُ اللَّهُ أَنَّهَا الصِّدْقُ مِنْ أَنْفُسِهِمْ، ثُمَّ تأخُذُهُمْ ظُلْمَةٌ لَا يُبْصِرُ امْرُؤٌ فِيهَا كَفَّهُ، قَالَ: فَيَنْزِلُ ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ فَيَحْسِرُ عَنِ أَبْصَارِهِمْ، وَبَيْنَ أَظْهُرِهِمْ رَجُلٌ عَلَيْهِ لَأْمَتُهُ يَقُولُونَ: مَنْ أَنْتَ يَا عَبْدَ اللَّهِ؟ فَيَقُولُ: أَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ وَرَسُولُهُ، وَرُوحُهُ، وَكَلِمَتُهُ، عِيسَى ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ، اخْتَارُوا بَيْنَ إِحْدَى ثَلَاثٍ: بَيْنَ أَنْ يَبْعَثَ اللَّهُ عَلَى الدَّجَّالِ وَجُنُودِهِ عَذَابًا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ، أَوْ يَخْسِفَ بِهِمُ الْأَرْضَ، أَوْ يُسَلِّطَ عَلَيْهِمْ سِلَاحَكُمْ، وَيَكُفَّ سِلَاحَهُمْ عَنْكُمْ، فَيَقُولُونَ: هَذِهِ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، أَشْفَى لِصُدُورِنَا وَلِأَنْفُسِنَا، فَيَوْمَئِذٍ تَرَى الْيَهُودِيَّ الْعَظِيمَ الطَّوِيلَ، الْأَكُولَ الشَّرُوبَ، لَا تُقِلُّ يَدُهُ سَيْفَهُ مِنَ الرِّعْدَةِ، فَيَقُومُونَ إِلَيْهِمْ فيُسَلَّطُونَ عَلَيْهِمْ، وَيَذُوبُ الدَّجَّالُ حِينَ يَرَى ابْنَ مَرْيَمَ كَمَا يَذُوبُ الرَّصَاصُ، حَتَّى يَأْتِيَهُ أَوْ يُدْرِكَهُ عِيسَى فَيَقْتُلَهُ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, who said: 'Amr b. Abi Sufyan al-Thaqafi told me that a man of the Ansar told him, from some of the Companions of Muhammad ﷺ, who said:
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ mentioned the Dajjal and said: "He will come to the salt flats of Medina, and it is forbidden for him to enter its passes. Medina will shake with its people once or twice, and that is the earthquake. Every hypocrite, man and woman, will go out to him from it. Then the Dajjal will turn toward Syria until he reaches some of the mountains of Syria and besieges them. The remainder of the Muslims that day will be taking refuge on the summit of one of the mountains of Syria, and the Dajjal will besiege them, encamped at its base. When the affliction has lasted long upon them, a man among the Muslims will say: 'Muslims, how long will you remain like this, with the enemy of God camped in your land like this? Are you not between one of the two best outcomes: that God make you martyrs or give you victory?' So they will pledge allegiance to die, a pledge that God knows to be sincere from their very selves. Then a darkness will seize them in which a man cannot see his palm. Then the son of Mary will descend and lift the veil from their sight, and among them will be a man in his armor. They will say: 'Who are you, servant of God?' He will say: 'I am the servant of God and His messenger, His spirit and His word, 'Isa b. Maryam. Choose one of three: that God send down upon the Dajjal and his troops a punishment from the sky, or cause the earth to swallow them, or empower your weapons against them and withhold their weapons from you.' They will say: 'This last one, Messenger of God, is more healing for our chests and our selves.' That day you will see the huge, tall Jew, a great eater and drinker, whose hand cannot lift his sword for trembling. They will rise against them and be given power over them. The Dajjal will melt when he sees the son of Mary, as lead melts, until 'Isa reaches him or overtakes him and kills him."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ ثَعْلَبَةَ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ، عَنْ مُجَمِّعِ بْنِ جَارِيَةَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ: «§يَقْتُلُ ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ الدَّجَّالَ بِبَابِ لُدٍّ، أَوْ إِلَى جَانِبِ لُدٍّ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, from 'Abdullah b. 'Ubaydillah b. Tha'laba al-Ansari, from 'Abdullah b. Zayd al-Ansari, from Mujammi' b. Jariya, who said:
entries.matn_en: I heard the Messenger of God ﷺ say: "The son of Mary will kill the Dajjal at the gate of Ludd, or beside Ludd."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ عُمَرَ سَأَلَ رَجُلًا مِنَ الْيَهُودِ عَنْ شَيْءٍ فَحَدَّثَهُ، فَصَدَّقَهُ عُمَرُ، فَقَالَ لَهُ عُمَرُ: «§قَدْ بَلَوْتُ صِدْقَكَ، فَأَخْبِرْنِي عَنِ الدَّجَّالِ» قَالَ: وَإِلَهِ الْيَهُودِ لِيَقْتُلَنَّهُ ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ بِفِنَاءِ لُدٍّ "
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, from Salim, from his father:
entries.matn_en: 'Umar asked a Jewish man about something, and he told him, and 'Umar believed him. 'Umar said to him: "I have tested your truthfulness, so tell me about the Dajjal." He said: "By the God of the Jews, the son of Mary will kill him in the courtyard of Ludd."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: يُقَاتِلُكُمُ الْيَهُودُ فَتُسَلَّطُونَ عَلَيْهِمْ حَتَّى يَقُولَ الْحَجَرُ: يَا مُسْلِمُ هَذَا يَهُودِيُّ وَرَائِي فَاقْتُلْهُ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, from Salim, from Ibn 'Umar: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "
entries.matn_en: The Jews will fight you and you will be given power over them, until the stone says: 'Muslim, there is a Jew behind me; kill him!'"

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، أَوْ غَيْرِهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ، قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: يَنْزِلُ ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ عَلَيْهِ لَأْمَتُهُ، وَمُمَصَّرَتَانِ بَيْنَ الْأَذَانِ وَالْإِقَامَةِ، فَيَقُولُونَ لَهُ: تَقَدَّمْ، فَيَقُولُ: بَلْ يُصَلِّي بِكُمْ إِمَامُكُمْ، أَنْتُمْ أُمَرَاءُ بَعْضِكُمْ عَلَى بَعْضٍ» ،
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Ayyub or another, from Ibn Sirin, who said: "
entries.matn_en: The son of Mary will descend wearing his armor and two light-dyed garments, between the call to prayer and the iqama. They will say to him: 'Step forward.' He will say: 'No, your own imam will lead you in prayer. You are leaders of one another.'"

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كَانَ ابْنُ سِيرِينَ يُرَى أَنَّهُ الْمَهْدِيُّ الَّذِي يُصَلِّي وَرَاءَهُ عِيسَى
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, who said:
entries.matn_en: Ibn Sirin held that he [the imam] is the Mahdi behind whom 'Isa will pray.

sections.title_en: The Descent of ʿĪsā ibn Maryam, Peace Be Upon Them Both
sections.title_ar: بَابُ نُزُولِ عِيسَى ابْنِ مَرْيَمَ عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلَامُ

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ يَقُولُ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «
entries.matn_ar: وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ §لَيُوشِكَنَّ أَنْ يَنْزِلَ فِيكُمُ ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ حَكَمًا عَدْلًا، وَإِمَامًا مُقْسِطًا، يَكْسِرُ الصَّلِيبَ، وَيَقْتُلُ الْخِنْزِيرَ، وَيَضَعُ الْجِزْيَةَ، وَيَفِيضُ الْمَالُ حَتَّى لَا يَقْبَلَهُ أَحَدٌ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab, that he heard Abu Hurayra say: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "
entries.matn_en: By the One in whose hand is my soul, the son of Mary is about to descend among you as a just ruler and an equitable imam. He will break the cross, kill the swine, abolish the jizya, and wealth will overflow until no one will accept it."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، مَوْلَى أَبِي قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «§
entries.matn_ar: كَيْفَ بِكُمْ إِذَا نَزَلَ فِيكُمُ ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ حَكَمًا، فَأَمَّكُمْ - أَوْ قَالَ: إِمَامُكُمْ - مِنْكُمْ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, from Nafi', the freedman of Abu Qatada, from Abu Hurayra, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "
entries.matn_en: How will you be when the son of Mary descends among you as a judge, and your imam (or he said: he who leads you) is from among you?"

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ حَنْظَلَةَ الْأَسْلَمِيِّ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ يَقُولُ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «
entries.matn_ar: وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ §لَيُهِلَّنَّ ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ مِنْ فَجِّ الرَّوْحَاءِ بِالْحَجِّ أَوْ بِالْعُمْرَةِ لَيُثَنِّيَنَّهُمَا»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, from Hanzala al-Aslami, that he heard Abu Hurayra say: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "
entries.matn_en: By the One in whose hand is my soul, the son of Mary will enter ihram from Fajj al-Rawha' for Hajj or 'Umra, or he will perform both."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، يَرْوِيهِ قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: يَنْزِلُ عِيسَى ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ إِمَامًا هَادِيًا وَمِقْسَطًا عَادِلًا، فَإِذَا نَزَلَ كَسَرَ الصَّلِيبَ، وَقَتَلَ الْخِنْزِيرَ، وَوَضَعَ الْجِزْيَةَ، وَتَكُونُ الْمِلَّةُ وَاحِدَةً، وَيُوضَعُ الْأَمْرُ فِي الْأَرْضِ، حَتَّى أَنَّ الْأَسَدَ لِيَكُونُ مَعَ الْبَقَرِ تَحْسِبُهُ ثَوْرَهَا، وَيَكُونُ الذِّئْبُ مَعَ الْغَنَمِ تَحْسِبُهُ كَلْبَهَا، وَتُرْفَعُ حُمَةُ كُلِّ ذَاتِ حُمَةٍ حَتَّى يَضَعَ الرَّجُلُ يَدَهُ عَلَى رَأْسِ الْحَنَشِ فَلَا يَضُرُّهُ، وَحَتَّى تُفِرَّ الْجَارِيَةُ الْأَسَدَ، كَمَا يُفَرُّ وَلَدُ الْكَلْبِ الصَّغِيرِ، وَيُقَوَّمَ الْفَرَسُ الْعَرَبِيُّ بِعِشْرِينَ دِرْهَمًا، وَيُقَوَّمَ الثَّوْرُ بِكَذَا وَكَذَا، وَتَعُودَ الْأَرْضُ كَهَيْئَتِهَا عَلَى عَهْدِ آدَمَ، وَيَكُونَ الْقِطْفُ - يَعْنِي الْعِنْقَادَ - يَأْكُلُ مِنْهُ النَّفَرُ ذُو الْعَدَدِ، وَتَكُونَ الرُّمَّانَةُ يَأْكُلُ مِنْهَا النَّفَرُ ذُو الْعَدَدِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Ibn Tawus, from his father, narrating it, who said: "
entries.matn_en: 'Isa b. Maryam will descend as a guiding imam and an equitable, just ruler. When he descends he will break the cross, kill the swine and abolish the jizya. There will be one creed, and affairs on earth will be set right, so that the lion will be with the cows and you would think it their bull, and the wolf will be with the sheep and you would think it their dog. The venom of every venomous creature will be removed, so that a man will put his hand on the head of a snake and it will not harm him, and a girl will drive off a lion as a small puppy is driven off. A thoroughbred Arabian horse will be valued at twenty dirhams, and a bull at such-and-such. The earth will return to its condition in the time of Adam. A grape cluster (meaning the 'inqad) will be eaten from by a group of many people, and a pomegranate will feed a group of many people."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: لَا تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ حَتَّى يَنْزِلَ عِيسَى ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ إِمَامًا مُقْسِطًا وَبيتر قُرَيْشٌ الْإِجَارَةَ، وَيَقْتُلُ الْخِنْزِيرَ، وَيَكْسِرُ الصَّلِيبَ، وَتُوضَعُ الْجِزْيَةُ، وَتَكُونُ السَّجْدَةُ وَاحِدَةً لِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ، وَتَضَعُ الْحَرْبُ أَوْزَارَهَا، وَتُمْلَأُ الْأَرْضُ مِنَ الْإِسْلَامِ كَمَا تُمْلَأُ الْآبَارُ مِنَ الْمَاءِ، وَتَكُونُ الْأَرْضُ كَمَا ثَوْرُ الْوَرِقِ - يَعْنِي الْمَائِدَةَ -، وَتُرْفَعُ الشَّحْنَاءُ وَالْعَدَاوَةُ، وَيَكُونُ الذِّئْبُ فِي الْغَنَمِ كَأَنَّهُ كَلْبُهَا، وَيَكُونُ الْأَسَدُ فِي الْإِبِلِ كَأَنَّهُ فَحْلُهَا»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Zayd b. Aslam, from a man, from Abu Hurayra, who said: "
entries.matn_en: The Hour will not come until 'Isa b. Maryam descends as an equitable imam… [the words 'wa-biytar Quraysh al-ijara' are corrupt]. He will kill the swine, break the cross, and the jizya will be abolished. There will be one prostration, to the Lord of the worlds. War will lay down its burdens, and the earth will be filled with Islam as wells are filled with water. The earth will be like a silver bowl (meaning a table), and rancor and enmity will be lifted. The wolf will be among the sheep as if it were their dog, and the lion among the camels as if it were their stud."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «
entries.matn_ar: إِنَّ §الْأَنْبِيَاءَ إِخْوَةٌ لِعَلَّاتٍ، دِينُهُمْ وَاحِدٌ، وَأُمَّهَاتُهُمْ شَتَّى، وَإِنَّ أَوْلَاهُمْ بِي عِيسَى ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ، لِأَنَّهُ لَيْسَ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَهُ رَسُولٌ، وَإِنَّهُ نَازِلٌ فِيكُمْ، فَاعْرِفُوهُ، رَجُلٌ مَرْبُوعُ الْخَلْقِ، إِلَى الْبَيَاضِ وَالْحُمْرَةِ، يَقْتُلُ الْخِنْزِيرَ، وَيَكْسِرُ الصَّلِيبَ، وَيَضَعُ الْجِزْيَةَ، وَلَا يَقْبَلُ غَيْرَ الْإِسْلَامِ، وَتَكُونُ الدَّعْوَةُ وَاحِدَةً لِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ، وَيُلْقِي اللَّهُ فِي زَمَانِهِ الْأَمْنَ، حَتَّى يَكُونَ الْأَسَدُ مَعَ الْبَقَرِ، وَالذِّئْبُ مَعَ الْغَنَمِ، وَيَلْعَبُ الصِّبْيَانُ بِالْحَيَّاتِ، لَا يَضُرُّ بَعْضُهُمْ بَعْضًا»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Qatada, from a man, from Abu Hurayra, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "
entries.matn_en: The prophets are half-brothers: their religion is one and their mothers are various. The closest of them to me is 'Isa b. Maryam, for there is no messenger between him and me. He will descend among you, so recognize him: a man of medium build, with a complexion tending to white and red. He will kill the swine, break the cross and abolish the jizya, and will accept nothing but Islam. The call will be one, to the Lord of the worlds, and God will cast security over his time, so that the lion will be with the cows and the wolf with the sheep, and children will play with snakes without harming one another."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ بُرْقَانَ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنَ الْأَصَمِّ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كُنْتُ أَسْمَعُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ يَقُولُ: «§تَرَوْنِي شَيْخًا كَبِيرًا قَدْ كَادَتْ تَرْقُوَتَايَ تَلْتَقِيَانِ مِنَ الْكِبَرِ، وَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لَأَرْجُو أَنْ أُدْرِكَ عِيسَى، وَأُحَدِّثَهُ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَيُصَدِّقَنِي»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Ja'far b. Burqan, from Yazid b. al-Asamm, who said:
entries.matn_en: I used to hear Abu Hurayra say: "You see me an old man, my collarbones almost touching from age. By God, I hope to live to meet 'Isa, and to tell him about the Messenger of God ﷺ, and that he will confirm me."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنِ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «§
entries.matn_ar: لَا تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ عَلَى أَحَدٍ يَقُولُ: اللَّهُ اللَّهُ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Thabit, from Anas, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "
entries.matn_en: The Hour will not come upon anyone who says: 'God, God.'"

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: إِنَّ شِرَارَ النَّاسِ، أَوْ §مِنْ شِرَارِ النَّاسِ، مَنْ تُدْرِكُهُمُ السَّاعَةُ وَهُمْ أَحْيَاءٌ، وَمَنْ يَتَعَجَّلُ بِالشَّهَادَةِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُسْأَلَ عَنْهَا، وَمَنْ يَتَّخِذُ الْقُبُورَ مَسَاجِدَ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Abu Ishaq, from al-Harith, from 'Ali, who said: "
entries.matn_en: Among the worst of people (or: the worst of people) are those the Hour overtakes while they are alive, those who hasten to give testimony before being asked for it, and those who take graves as places of prayer."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ يَقُولُ: «
entries.matn_ar: إِنَّ §السَّاعَةَ لَتَقُومُ عَلَى الرَّجُلَيْنِ، وَهُمَا يَنْشُرَانِ الثَّوْبَ يَتَبَايَعَانِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Muhammad b. Ziyad, who said: I heard Abu Hurayra say: "
entries.matn_en: The Hour will come upon two men who are spreading out a garment, trading in it."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ التَّيْمِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ النَّهْدِيِّ، عَنْ سَلْمَانَ، قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: تَدْنُو الشَّمْسُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مِنْ رُءُوسِ النَّاسِ قَابَ قَوْسٍ - أَوْ قَالَ: قَابَ قَوْسَيْنِ - وَتُعْطَى حَرَّ عَشْرَ سِنِينَ، وَلَيْسَ عَلَى بَشَرٍ مِنَ النَّاسِ يَوْمَئِذٍ طَحْرَبَةٌ، وَلَا تُرَى يَوْمَئِذٍ عَوْرَةُ مُؤْمِنٍ وَلَا مُؤْمِنَةٍ، وَلَا يَضُرُّ حَرُّهَا يَوْمَئِذٍ مُؤْمِنًا وَلَا مُؤْمِنَةً، وَتَطْبُخُ الْكَافِرَ طَبْخًا حَتَّى يَقُولَ جَوْفُ أَحَدِهِمْ: غِقْ غِقْ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Sulayman al-Taymi, from Abu 'Uthman al-Nahdi, from Salman, who said: "
entries.matn_en: On the Day of Resurrection the sun will draw near to people's heads to within a bow's length (or he said: two bows' length), and it will be given the heat of ten years. No human being that day will have a shred [of cloud or cloth] upon him. The nakedness of no believer, man or woman, will be seen, and its heat will not harm any believer, man or woman. It will cook the unbeliever until the belly of one of them says: 'Ghiq, ghiq.'"

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «§
entries.matn_ar: تَتْرُكُونَ الْمَدِينَةَ خَيْرَ مَا كَانَتْ، لَا يَغْشَاهَا إِلَّا الْعَوَافِ، عَوَافِي الطَّيْرِ وَالسِّبَاعِ، وَآخِرُ مَنْ يُحْشَرُ رَاعِيَانِ مِنْ مُزَيْنَةَ يَنْعِقَانِ بِغَنَمِهِمَا، فَيَجِدَانِهَا وُحُوشًا، حَتَّى إِذَا بَلَغَا ثَنِيَّةَ الْوَدَاعِ خَرَّا عَلَى وَجُوهِهِمَا، مَنْ يُرِدِ اللَّهُ بِهِ خَيْرًا يُفَقِّهْهُ فِي الدِّينِ» ، قَالَ الزُّهْرِيُّ: «فَيَجِيءُ الثَّعْلَبُ حَتَّى يَرْقُدَ تَحْتَ الْمِنْبَرِ فَيَقْضِي وَسَنَهُ مَا يُهَيِّجُهُ أَحَدٌ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, from a man, from Abu Hurayra, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "
entries.matn_en: You will leave Medina in its best state, with none frequenting it but the 'awafi, the seekers of food among birds and beasts of prey. The last to be gathered will be two shepherds of Muzayna calling to their sheep. They will find it full of wild animals, and when they reach Thaniyyat al-Wada' they will fall on their faces. Whomever God wishes good, He gives understanding of the religion." Al-Zuhri said: "The fox will come and lie down under the pulpit and finish its sleep, and no one will disturb it."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو يَعْقُوبَ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ مَطَرٍ الْوَرَّاقِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ الْأَسْلَمِيِّ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: شَكَّ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ زِيَادٍ فِي الْحَوْضِ، وَكَانَتْ فِيهِ حَرُورِيَّةٌ، فَقَالَ: أَرَأَيْتُمُ الْحَوْضَ الَّذِي يُذْكَرُ، مَا أُرَاهُ شَيْئًا، قَالَ: فَقَالَ لَهُ نَاسٌ مِنْ صَحَابَتِهِ: فَإِنَّ عِنْدَكَ رَهْطًا مِنْ أَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَأَرْسِلْ إِلَيْهِمْ فَاسْأَلْهُمْ، فَأَرْسَلَ إِلَى رَجُلٍ مِنْ مُزَيْنَةَ فَسَأَلَهُ عَنِ الْحَوْضِ، فَحَدَّثَهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ: أَرْسِلْ إِلَى أَبِي بَرْزَةَ الْأَسْلَمِيِّ فَأَتَاهُ وَعَلَيْهِ ثَوْبَا حِبَرٍ، قَدِ ائْتَزَرَ بِوَاحِدٍ، وَارْتَدَى بِالْآخَرِ، قَالَ: وَكَانَ رَجُلًا لَحِيمًا إِلَى الْقِصَرِ، فَلَمَّا رَآهُ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ ضَحِكَ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: إِنَّ مُحَمَّدِيَّكُمْ هَذَا لَدَحْدَاحٌ، قَالَ: فَفَهِمَهَا الشَّيْخُ، فَقَالَ: وَاعَجَبَاهُ، أَلَا أُرَانِي فِي قَوْمِي يَعُدُّونَ صَحَابَةَ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَارًا، قَالَ: فَقَالَ لَهُ جُلَسَاءُ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ: إِنَّمَا أَرْسَلَ إِلَيْكَ الْأَمِيرُ لِيَسْأَلَكَ عَنِ الْحَوْضِ، هَلْ سَمِعْتَ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِيهِ شَيْئًا؟ قَالَ: نَعَمْ، سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَذْكُرُهُ، فَمَنْ كَذَبَ بِهِ فَلَا سَقَاهُ اللَّهُ مِنْهُ، قَالَ: ثُمَّ نَفَضَ رِدَاءَهُ وَانْصَرَفَ غَضْبَانَ، قَالَ: فَأَرْسَلَ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ إِلَى زَيْدِ بْنِ الْأَرْقَمِ فَسَأَلَهُ عَنِ الْحَوْضِ، فَحَدَّثَهُ حَدِيثًا مُوَنَّقًا أَعْجَبَهُ، فَقَالَ: إِنَّمَا سَمِعْتُ هَذَا مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ؟ قَالَ: لَا، وَلَكِنْ حَدَّثَنِيهِ أَخِي، قَالَ: فَلَا حَاجَةَ لَنَا فِي حَدِيثِ أَخِيكَ، فَقَالَ أَبُو سَبْرَةَ، رَجُلٌ مِنْ صَحَابَةِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ: فَإِنَّ أَبَاكَ حِينَ انْطَلَقَ وَافِدًا إِلَى مُعَاوِيَةَ انْطَلَقْتُ مَعَهُ، فَلَقِيتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ فَحَدَّثَنِي مِنْ فِيهِ إِلَى فِيَّ حَدِيثًا سَمِعَهُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَأَمْلَاهُ عَلَيَّ وَكَتَبْتُهُ، قَالَ: فَإِنِّي أَقْسَمْتُ عَلَيْكَ لَمَا أَعْرَقْتَ هَذَا الْبِرْذَوْنَ حَتَّى تَأْتِيَنِي بِالْكِتَابِ، قَالَ: فَرَكِبْتُ الْبِرْذَوْنَ فَرَكَضْتُهُ حَتَّى عَرِقَ، فَأَتَيْتُهُ بِالْكِتَابِ، فَإِذَا فِيهِ هَذَا مَا حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ: «إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُبْغِضُ الْفُحْشَ وَالتَّفَحُّشَ، وَالَّذِي نَفْسُ مُحَمَّدٍ بِيَدِهِ §لَا تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ حَتَّى يَظْهَرَ الْفُحْشُ وَالتَّفَحُّشُ، وَسُوءُ الْجِوَارِ، وَقَطِيعَةُ الْأَرْحَامِ، وَحَتَّى يُخَوَّنَ الْأَمِينُ، وَيُؤْتَمَنَ الْخَائِنُ، وَالَّذِي نَفْسُ مُحَمَّدٍ بِيَدِهِ إِنَّ أَسْلَمَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ، لَمَنْ سَلِمَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ مِنْ لِسَانِهِ وَيَدِهِ، وَإِنَّ أَفْضَلَ الْهِجْرَةِ لَمَنْ هَجَرَ مَا نَهَاهُ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ إِنَّ مَثَلَ الْمُؤْمِنِ كَمَثَلِ الْقِطْعَةِ مِنَ الذَّهَبِ نَفَخَ عَلَيْهَا صَاحِبُهَا فَلَمْ تَتَغَيَّرْ وَلَمْ تَنْقُصْ، وَالَّذِي نَفْسُ مُحَمَّدٍ بِيَدِهِ، إِنَّ مَثَلَ الْمُؤْمِنِ كَمَثَلِ النَّخْلَةِ أَكَلَتْ طَيِّبًا وَوَضَعَتْ طَيِّبًا، وَوَقَعَتْ فَلَمْ تُكْسَرْ وَلَمْ تَفْسُدْ، أَلَا وَإِنَّ لِي حَوْضًا مَا بَيْنَ نَاحِيَتَيْهِ كَمَا بَيْنَ أَيْلَةَ إِلَى مَكَّةَ - أَوْ قَالَ: صَنْعَاءَ إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ -، وَإِنَّ فِيهِ مِنَ الْأَبَارِيقِ مَثَلَ الْكَوَاكِبِ، هُوَ أَشَدُّ بَيَاضًا مِنَ اللَّبَنِ، وَأَحْلَى مِنَ الْعَسَلِ، مَنْ شَرِبَ مِنْهُ لَمْ يَظْمَأْ بَعْدَهَا أَبَدًا» قَالَ أَبُو سَبْرَةَ: فَأَخَذَ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ الْكِتَابَ، فَجَزِعْتُ عَلَيْهِ، فَلَقِيَ يَحْيَى بْنَ يَعْمُرَ فَشَكَوْتُ ذَلِكَ إِلَيْهِ، فَقَالَ: وَاللَّهِ لَأَنَا أَحْفَظُ لَهُ مِنِّي لِسُورَةٍ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ، فَحَدَّثَنِي بِهِ كَمَا كَانَ فِي الْكِتَابِ سَوَاءُ
entries.isnad_en: Ahmad b. Khalid told us: Abu Ya'qub told us: 'Abd al-Razzaq told us: Ma'mar told us, from Matar al-Warraq, from 'Abdullah b. Buraydah al-Aslami, who said: '
entries.matn_en:
Ubaydullah b. Ziyad doubted the Pond, and there was a Haruri [Khariji] streak in him. He said: "The Pond that is mentioned, I do not think it is anything."
