Some of his companions said to him: "There is a group of the Prophet's Companions with you. Send for them and ask them." So he sent for a man of Muzayna and asked him about the Pond, and he told him. Then he said: "Send for Abu Barza al-Aslami." He came wearing two striped garments, one as a waist-wrapper and the other as a cloak. He was a stout man, short. When 'Ubaydullah saw him he laughed and said: "This Muhammadan of yours is a little dumpling." The old man understood, and said: "How astonishing! Have I come to find myself among my own people who count the Companions of Muhammad ﷺ a disgrace?" 'Ubaydullah's companions said to him: "The amir only sent for you to ask about the Pond. Did you hear anything from the Messenger of God ﷺ about it?" He said: "Yes. I heard the Messenger of God ﷺ mention it, and whoever denies it, may God not give him a drink from it." Then he shook out his cloak and left angry.

Then 'Ubaydullah sent for Zayd b. al-Arqam and asked him about the Pond. He told him a well-crafted hadith that pleased him. He said: "Did you hear this yourself from the Messenger of God ﷺ?" He said: "No, my brother told it to me." He said: "We have no need of your brother's hadith." Abu Sabra, a man among 'Ubaydullah's companions, said: "When your father went as a delegate to Mu'awiya I went with him. I met 'Abdullah b. 'Amr b. al-'As, and he narrated to me, mouth to mouth, a hadith he had heard from the Messenger of God ﷺ. He dictated it to me and I wrote it down." He said: "I adjure you not to let this pony stop until you bring me the writing." So I rode the pony and drove it until it sweated, and I brought him the writing. In it was: "This is what 'Abdullah b. 'Amr b. al-'As narrated to me, that he heard the Messenger of God ﷺ say:

'God hates obscenity and indecency. By the One in whose hand is the soul of Muhammad, the Hour will not come until obscenity and indecency appear, along with bad neighborliness and the severing of kinship ties, and until the trustworthy are accused of betrayal and the traitor is trusted. By the One in whose hand is the soul of Muhammad, the most secure of Muslims is he from whose tongue and hand Muslims are safe, and the best emigration is that of one who abandons what God has forbidden him. By the One in whose hand is my soul, the likeness of the believer is that of a piece of gold: its owner blows on it and it does not change or diminish. By the One in whose hand is the soul of Muhammad, the likeness of the believer is that of the date palm: it eats what is good and drops what is good, and when it falls it is not broken or spoiled. And indeed I have a Pond; the distance between its two sides is like the distance from Ayla to Mecca (or he said: from Sanaa to Medina). In it are pitchers like the stars. It is whiter than milk and sweeter than honey. Whoever drinks from it will never thirst afterward.'"

Abu Sabra said: 'Ubaydullah took the writing, and I was distressed over it. Then I met Yahya b. Ya'mar and complained of that to him. He said: "By God, I know it better than I know a sura of the Qur'an," and he narrated it to me exactly as it was in the writing.

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ، عَنْ مَعْدَانَ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ، عَنْ ثَوْبَانَ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «§
entries.matn_ar: أَنَا عِنْدَ حَوْضِي أَذُودُ النَّاسَ عَنْهُ لِأَهْلِ الْيَمَنِ، إِنِّي لَأَضْرِبُهُمْ بِعَصَايَ حَتَّى يَرْفَضَّ عَلَيْهِمْ، وَإِنَّهُ لَيَغُتُّ فِيهِ مِيزَابَانِ مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ، أَحَدُهُمَا مِنْ وَرِقٍ وَالْآخَرُ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ، طُولُهُمَا مَا بَيْنَ بُصْرَى وَصَنْعَاءَ - أَوْ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْلَةَ وَمَكَّةَ، أَوْ قَالَ: مِنْ مَقَامِي هَذَا إِلَى عُمَانَ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq told us: Ma'mar told us, from Qatada, from Salim b. Abi al-Ja'd, from Ma'dan b. Abi Talha, from Thawban, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "
entries.matn_en: I will be at my Pond, driving people away from it for the people of Yemen. I will strike them with my staff until it overflows upon them. Two spouts from Paradise pour into it, one of silver and the other of gold. Their length is the distance between Busra and Sanaa, or between Ayla and Mecca, or he said: from this place of mine to 'Uman."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «
entries.matn_ar: لَيَرِدَنَّ عَلَيَّ نَاسٌ مِنْ أَصْحَابِي فَيُحَلَّئُونَ عَنِ الْحَوْضِ - يَعْنِي يُنَحَّوْنَ - فَلَأَقُولَنَّ: يَا رَبِّ، أَصْحَابِي أَصْحَابِي، فَيَقُولُ: §إِنَّكَ لَا عِلْمَ لَكَ بِمَا أَحْدَثُوا بَعْدَكَ، إِنَّهُمُ ارْتَدُّوا عَلَى أَدْبَارِهِمُ الْقَهْقَرَى»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, from Abu Hurayra, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "
entries.matn_en: Some of my Companions will come to me and be driven from the Pond," meaning pushed away. "I will say: 'My Lord, my Companions, my Companions!' He will say: 'You have no knowledge of what they innovated after you. They turned back on their heels.'"

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، قَالَ: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «§
entries.matn_ar: لَيُرْفَعَنَّ لِي نَاسٌ مِنْ أَصْحَابِي حَتَّى إِذَا رَأَيْتُهُمْ وَرَأَوْنِي اخْتُلِجُوا دُونِي، فَلَأَقُولَنَّ: يَا رَبِّ، أَصْحَابِي أَصْحَابِي، فَيُقَالُ: إِنَّكَ لَا تَدْرِي مَا أَحْدَثُوا بَعْدَكَ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from a man, from al-Hasan, who said: The Prophet ﷺ said: "
entries.matn_en: Some of my Companions will be raised up to me, until when I see them and they see me, they will be snatched away from me. I will say: 'My Lord, my Companions, my Companions!' It will be said: 'You do not know what they innovated after you.'"

sections.title_en: Those Who Come Out of the Fire

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ اللَّيْثِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ النَّاسُ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، هَلْ نَرَى رَبَّنَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ؟ فَقَالَ: «هَلْ تُضَارُّونَ فِي رُؤْيَةِ الشَّمْسِ لَيْسَ دُونَهَا سَحَابٌ؟» قَالُوا: لَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، قَالَ: «فَإِنَّكُمْ تَرَوْنَهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ كَذَلِكَ يَجْمَعُ اللَّهُ النَّاسَ فَيَقُولُ: §مَنْ كَانَ يَعْبُدُ شَيْئًا فَلْيَتْبَعْهُ» ، قَالَ: «فَيَتْبَعُ مَنْ كَانَ يَعْبُدُ الشَّمْسَ الشَّمْسَ، وَيَتْبَعُ مَنْ كَانَ يَعْبُدُ الْقَمَرَ الْقَمَرَ، وَيَتْبَعُ مَنْ كَانَ يَعْبُدُ الطَّوَاغِيتَ الطَّوَاغِيتَ، وَتَبْقَى هَذِهِ الْأُمَّةُ فِيهَا مُنَافِقُوهَا، فَيَأْتِيهِمُ اللَّهُ فِي غَيْرِ الصُّورَةِ الَّتِي يَعْرِفُونَ، فَيَقُولُ: أَنَا رَبُّكُمْ، فَيَقُولُونَ: نَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْكَ هَذَا مَكَانُنَا، حَتَّى يَأْتِيَنَا رَبُّنَا، فَإِذَا جَاءَ رَبُّنَا عَرَفْنَاهُ، فَيَأْتِيهِمُ اللَّهُ فِي الصُّورَةِ الَّتِي يَعْرِفُونَ، فَيَقُولُ: أَنَا رَبُّكُمْ، فَيَقُولُونَ: أَنْتَ رَبُّنَا فَيَتَّبِعُونَهُ، قَالَ: وَيُضْرَبُ الْجِسْرُ عَلَى جَهَنَّمَ فَأَكُونُ أَوَّلَ مَنْ يُجِيزُ، وَدَعْوَةُ الرُّسُلِ يَوْمَئِذٍ: اللَّهُمَّ سَلِّمْ سَلِّمْ، وَبِهِ كَلَالِيبُ مِثْلُ شَوْكِ السَّعْدَانِ، هَلْ رَأَيْتُمْ شَوْكَ السَّعْدَانِ؟» ، قَالُوا: نَعَمْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، قَالَ: «فَإِنَّهَا مِثْلُ شَوْكِ السَّعْدَانِ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ لَا يَعْلَمُ قَدْرَ عِظَمِهَا إِلَّا اللَّهُ، قَالَ: فَتَخْطَفُ النَّاسَ بِأَعْمَالِهِمْ، فَمِنْهُمُ الْمُوبَقُ بِعَمَلِهِ، وَمِنْهُمُ الْمُخَرْدَلُ ثُمَّ يَنْجُو، حَتَّى إِذَا فَرَغَ اللَّهُ مِنَ الْقَضَاءِ بَيْنَ عِبَادِهِ، وَأَرَادَ أَنْ يُخْرِجَ مِنَ النَّارِ مَنْ أَرَادَ أَنْ يَرْحَمَ مِمَّنْ كَانَ يَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، أَمَرَ الْمَلَائِكَةَ أَنْ يُخْرِجُوهُمْ، فَيَعْرِفُونَهُمْ بِعَلَامَةِ آثَارِ السُّجُودِ» ، قَالَ: «وَحَرَّمَ اللَّهُ عَلَى النَّارِ أَنْ تَأْكُلَ مِنِ ابْنِ آدَمَ أَثَرَ السُّجُودِ، قَالَ: فَيُخْرِجُونَهُمْ قَدِ امْتُحِشُوا، فَيُصَبُّ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنْ مَاءٍ يُقَالُ لَهُ: الْحَيَاةُ، فَيَنْبُتُونَ نَبَاتَ الْحِبَّةِ فِي حَمِيلِ السَّيْلِ، قَالَ: وَيَبْقَى رَجُلٌ مُقْبِلٌ بِوَجْهِهِ إِلَى النَّارِ فَيَقُولُ: يَا رَبِّ، قَدْ قَشَبَنِي رِيحُهَا، وَأَحْرَقَنِي ذَكَاؤُهَا، فَاصْرِفْ وَجْهِي عَنِ النَّارِ، قَالَ: فَلَا يَزَالُ يَدْعُو اللَّهَ فَيَقُولُ: لَعَلِّي إِنْ أَعْطَيْتُكَ أَنْ تَسْأَلَنِي غَيْرَهُ، فَيَقُولُ: لَا وَعِزَّتِكَ لَا أَسْأَلُكَ غَيْرَهُ» ، قَالَ: «فَيَصْرِفُ وَجْهَهُ عَنِ النَّارِ» ، قَالَ: «ثُمَّ يَقُولُ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ: يَا رَبِّ قَرِّبْنِي إِلَى بَابِ الْجَنَّةِ، فَيَقُولُ: أَوَلَيْسَ قَدْ زَعَمْتَ أَلَّا تَسْأَلَنِي غَيْرَهُ؟ وَيْلَكَ يَا ابْنَ آدَمَ مَا أَغْدَرَكَ، فَلَا يَزَالُ يَدْعُو، فَيَقُولُ: لَعَلِّي إِنْ أَعْطَيْتُكَ ذَلِكَ أَنْ تَسْأَلَنِي غَيْرَهُ، فَيَقُولُ: لَا وَعِزَّتِكَ، لَا أَسْأَلُكَ غَيْرَهُ، وَيُعْطِي اللَّهَ مِنْ عُهُودٍ وَمَوَاثِيقَ أَلَّا يَسْأَلَهُ غَيْرَهُ» ، قَالَ: «فَيُقَرِّبُهُ إِلَى بَابِ الْجَنَّةِ» ، قَالَ: «فَإِذَا دَنَا مِنْهَا انْفَهَقَتْ لَهُ الْجَنَّةُ، فَإِذَا رَأَى مَا فِيهَا سَكَتَ مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ أَنْ يَسْكُتَ، ثُمَّ يَقُولُ: رَبِّ أَدْخِلْنِي الْجَنَّةَ، قَالَ: فَيَقُولُ: أَوَلَيْسَ قَدْ زَعَمْتَ أَلَّا تَسْأَلَنِي غَيْرَهُ؟ أَوَلَيْسَ قَدْ أَعْطَيْتَ عُهُودَكَ وَمَوَاثِيقَكَ أَلَّا تَسْأَلَنِي غَيْرَهُ؟ وَيْلَكَ يَا ابْنَ آدَمَ مَا أَغْدَرَكَ، فَيَقُولُ: يَا رَبِّ، لَا تَجْعَلْنِي أَشْقَى خَلْقِكَ، فَلَا يَزَالُ يَدْعُو حَتَّى يُؤْذَنَ لَهُ بِالدُّخُولِ فِيهَا، فَإِذَا دَخَلَ قِيلَ لَهُ: تَمَنَّ مِنْ كَذَا» قَالَ: «فَيَتَمَنَّى، ثُمَّ يُقَالُ لَهُ: تَمَنَّ مِنْ كَذَا، تَمَنَّ مِنْ كَذَا» ، قَالَ: «فَيَتَمَنَّى حَتَّى تَنْقَطِعَ بِهِ الْأَمَانِيُّ، فَيُقَالُ لَهُ: هَذَا لَكَ وَمِثْلُهُ مَعَهُ» قَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ: وَذَلِكَ الرَّجُلُ آخِرُ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ دُخُولًا الْجَنَّةَ، قَالَ: وَأَبُو سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيُّ جَالِسٌ مَعَ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ لَا يُغَيِّرُ عَلَيْهِ شَيْئًا مِنْ حَدِيثِهِ حَتَّى انْتَهَى إِلَى قَوْلِهِ: هَذَا لَكَ وَمِثْلُهُ مَعَهُ، فَقَالَ أَبُو سَعِيدٍ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ: «هَذَا لَكَ وَعَشَرَةُ أَمْثَالِهِ» ، فَقَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ: حَفِظْتُ: وَمِثْلُهُ مَعَهُ
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq told us: Ma'mar told us, from al-Zuhri, from 'Ata' b. Yazid al-Laythi, from Abu Hurayra, who said:
entries.matn_en:
The people said: "Messenger of God, will we see our Lord on the Day of Resurrection?" He said: "Do you have difficulty seeing the sun when there is no cloud beneath it?" They said: "No, Messenger of God." He said: "Then you will see Him on the Day of Resurrection in the same way. God will gather the people and say: 'Whoever used to worship something, let him follow it.'" He said: "So those who worshiped the sun will follow the sun, those who worshiped the moon will follow the moon, and those who worshiped the false deities will follow the false deities. This community will remain, with its hypocrites among it. God will come to them in a form other than the one they know and say: 'I am your Lord.' They will say: 'We seek refuge in God from you. This is our place until our Lord comes to us, and when our Lord comes we will recognize Him.' Then God will come to them in the form they know and say: 'I am your Lord.' They will say: 'You are our Lord,' and follow Him.

"The bridge will be set over Hell, and I will be the first to cross. The prayer of the messengers that day will be: 'O God, save, save.' On it are hooks like the thorns of the sa'dan. Have you seen the thorns of the sa'dan?" They said: "Yes, Messenger of God." He said: "They are like the thorns of the sa'dan, except that none knows how great they are but God. They snatch people according to their deeds. Some are destroyed by their deeds, and some are thrown down and cut, then escape.

"When God has finished judging between His servants, and wishes to bring out of the Fire those He wishes to show mercy to among those who testified that there is no god but God, He commands the angels to bring them out, and they recognize them by the mark of the traces of prostration. God has forbidden the Fire to consume the mark of prostration on the son of Adam. They bring them out burnt, and water called 'Life' is poured over them, and they sprout as a seed sprouts in the silt carried by a flood.

"A man remains, facing the Fire, and says: 'My Lord, its wind has poisoned me and its blaze has burned me. Turn my face away from the Fire.' He keeps calling on God. God says: 'Perhaps, if I give you this, you will ask Me for something else.' He says: 'No, by Your might, I will not ask You for anything else.' So He turns his face away from the Fire. Then after that he says: 'My Lord, bring me near to the gate of Paradise.' God says: 'Did you not claim that you would not ask Me for anything else? Woe to you, son of Adam, how treacherous you are!' He keeps calling, and God says: 'Perhaps, if I give you that, you will ask Me for something else.' He says: 'No, by Your might, I will not ask You for anything else,' and he gives God covenants and pledges not to ask anything else. So He brings him near to the gate of Paradise. When he draws near to it, Paradise opens wide for him, and when he sees what is in it he is silent for as long as God wills. Then he says: 'My Lord, let me enter Paradise.' God says: 'Did you not claim that you would not ask Me for anything else? Did you not give your covenants and pledges that you would not ask Me for anything else? Woe to you, son of Adam, how treacherous you are!' He says: 'My Lord, do not make me the most wretched of Your creation.' He keeps calling until he is permitted to enter it. When he has entered it, it is said to him: 'Wish for such-and-such.' He wishes. Then it is said to him: 'Wish for such, wish for such,' until his wishes are exhausted, and it is said to him: 'This is yours, and its like with it.'"

Abu Hurayra said: "That man is the last of the people of Paradise to enter Paradise." Abu Sa'id al-Khudri was sitting with Abu Hurayra and did not correct anything in his narration until he reached "This is yours, and its like with it." Then Abu Sa'id said: "I heard the Messenger of God ﷺ say: 'This is yours, and ten times its like.'" Abu Hurayra said: "I memorized: 'and its like with it.'"

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «
entries.matn_ar: إِذَا خَلَصَ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ مِنَ النَّارِ وَأَمِنُوا، فَمَا مُجَادَلَةُ أَحَدِكُمْ لِصَاحِبِهِ فِي الْحَقِّ يَكُونُ لَهُ عَلَيْهِ فِي الدُّنْيَا بِأَشَدَّ مِنْ مُجَادَلَةِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ لِرَبِّهِمْ فِي إِخْوَانِهِمُ الَّذِينَ أُدْخِلُوا النَّارَ، قَالَ: يَقُولُونَ: رَبَّنَا، إِخْوَانُنَا كَانُوا يُصَلُّونَ مَعَنَا، وَيَصُومُونَ مَعَنَا، وَيَحُجُّونَ مَعَنَا، فَأَدْخَلْتَهُمُ النَّارَ، قَالَ: فَيَقُولُ: §اذْهَبُوا فَأَخْرِجُوا مَنْ عَرَفْتُمْ مِنْهُمْ، فَيَأْتُونَهُمْ فَيَعْرِفُونَهُمْ بِصُوَرِهِمْ، لَا تَأْكُلُ النَّارُ صُوَرَهُمْ، فَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ أَخَذَتْهُ النَّارُ إِلَى أَنْصَافِ سَاقَيْهِ، وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ أَخَذَتْهُ إِلَى كَفَّيْهِ، فَيُخْرِجُونَ فَيَقُولُونَ: رَبَّنَا قَدْ أَخْرَجْنَا مَنْ أَمَرْتَنَا، قَالَ: ثُمَّ يَقُولُ: أَخْرِجُوا مَنْ كَانَ فِي قَلْبِهِ مِثْقَالُ دِينَارٍ مِنَ الْإِيمَانِ، ثُمَّ مَنْ كَانَ فِي قَلْبِهِ وَزْنُ نِصْفِ دِينَارٍ، حَتَّى يَقُولَ: أَخْرِجُوا مَنْ كَانَ فِي قَلْبِهِ مِثْقَالُ ذَرَّةٍ، - قَالَ أَبُو سَعِيدٍ: فَمَنْ لَمْ يُصَدِّقْ بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ فَلْيَقْرَأْ هَذِهِ الْآيَةَ: {إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَظْلِمُ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ وَإِنْ تَكُ حَسَنَةً يُضَاعِفْهَا وَيُؤْتِ مِنْ لَدُنْهُ أَجْرًا عَظِيمًا} [النساء: ٤٠] - قَالَ: فَيَقُولُونَ: رَبَّنَا قَدْ أَخْرَجْنَا مَنْ أَمَرْتَنَا فَلَمْ يَبْقَ فِي النَّارِ أَحَدٌ فِيهِ خَيْرٌ، قَالَ: ثُمَّ يَقُولُ اللَّهُ: شَفَعَتِ الْمَلَائِكَةُ، وَشَفَعَتِ الْأَنْبِيَاءُ، وَشَفَعَ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ، وَبَقِيَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ، قَالَ: فَيَقْبِضُ قَبْضَةً مِنَ النَّارِ - أَوْ قَالَ: قَبْضَتَيْنِ - نَاسًا لَمْ يَعْمَلُوا لِلَّهِ خَيْرًا قَطُّ، قَدِ احْتَرَقُوا حَتَّى صَارُوا حُمَمًا، قَالَ: فَيُؤْتَى بِهِمْ إِلَى مَاءٍ يُقَالُ لَهُ: الْحَيَاةُ، فَيُصَبُّ عَلَيْهِمْ، فَيَنْبُتُونَ كَمَا تَنْبُتُ الْحِبَّةُ فِي حَمِيلِ السَّيْلِ، قَالَ: فَيَخْرُجُونَ مِنْ أَجْسَادِهِمْ مِثْلَ اللُّؤْلُؤِ، وَفِي أَعْنَاقِهِمُ الْخَاتَمُ عُتَقَاءُ اللَّهِ، قَالَ: فَيُقَالُ لَهُمْ: ادْخُلُوا الْجَنَّةَ، فَمَا تَمَنَّيْتُمْ وَرَأَيْتُمْ مِنْ شَيْءٍ فَهُوَ لَكُمْ، قَالَ: فَيَقُولُونَ: رَبَّنَا أَعْطَيْتَنَا مَا لَمْ تُعْطِ أَحَدًا مِنَ الْعَالَمِينَ، قَالَ: فَيَقُولُ: فَإِنَّ لَكُمْ عِنْدِي أَفْضَلَ مِنْهُ، فَيَقُولُونَ: رَبَّنَا وَمَا أَفْضَلُ مِنْ ذَلِكَ؟ فَيَقُولُ: رِضَائِي عَنْكُمْ، فَلَا أَسْخَطُ عَلَيْكُمْ أَبَدًا»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq told us: Ma'mar told us, from Zayd b. Aslam, from 'Ata' b. Yasar, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "
entries.matn_en:
When the believers have been delivered from the Fire and feel safe, the pleading of one of you with his companion over a right he owes him in this world is no more intense than the pleading of the believers with their Lord for their brothers who were entered into the Fire. They say: 'Our Lord, our brothers used to pray with us, fast with us and perform Hajj with us, and You entered them into the Fire.' He says: 'Go and bring out whomever you recognize among them.' They come to them and recognize them by their forms, for the Fire does not consume their forms. Some of them the Fire had taken up to the middle of their shins, and some up to their hands. They bring them out and say: 'Our Lord, we have brought out those You commanded us to.' Then He says: 'Bring out whoever has in his heart faith equal to the weight of a dinar,' then 'whoever has the weight of half a dinar,' until He says: 'Bring out whoever has in his heart the weight of an atom.'"

(Abu Sa'id said: "Whoever does not believe this hadith, let him read this verse: 'Indeed God does not wrong by even an atom's weight; and if it is a good deed He multiplies it and gives from Himself a great reward' [4:40].")

"They say: 'Our Lord, we have brought out those You commanded us to, and no one with any good remains in the Fire.' Then God says: 'The angels have interceded, the prophets have interceded, and the believers have interceded, and the Most Merciful of the merciful remains.' He takes a handful from the Fire (or he said: two handfuls), people who never did any good for God, who have burned until they became charcoal. They are brought to a water called 'Life' and it is poured over them, and they sprout as a seed sprouts in the silt carried by a flood. They come out of their bodies like pearls, with a seal on their necks, the freed ones of God. It is said to them: 'Enter Paradise. Whatever you wish for and whatever you see is yours.' They say: 'Our Lord, You have given us what You have given to none of the worlds.' He says: 'I have for you with Me something better than it.' They say: 'Our Lord, what is better than that?' He says: 'My pleasure with you, so that I will never be angry with you.'"

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ بْنِ أَبَانَ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عِكْرِمَةَ يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: إِنَّ §اللَّهَ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى إِذَا فَرَغَ مِنَ الْقَضَاءِ بَيْنَ خَلْقِهِ أَخْرَجَ كِتَابًا مِنْ تَحْتِ الْعَرْشِ فِيهِ: رَحْمَتِي سَبَقَتْ غَضَبِي، وَأَنَا أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ، فَيُخْرِجُ مِنَ النَّارِ مِثْلَ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ - أَوْ قَالَ: مِثْلَيْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ، قَالَ الْحَكَمُ: لَا أَعْلَمُهُ إِلَّا قَالَ: مِثْلَيْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ، فَأَمَّا: مِثْلَ، فَلَا أَشُكُّ، مَكْتُوبٌ منهِمْ - وَأَشَارَ الْحَكَمُ إِلَى فَخِذِهِ - عُتَقَاءُ اللَّهِ «قَالَ: فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ لِعِكْرِمَةَ: يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَقُولُ: {يُرِيدُونَ أَنْ يَخْرُجُوا مِنَ النَّارِ وَمَا هُمْ بِخَارِجِينَ مِنْهَا} [المائدة: ٣٧] قَالَ:» وَيْلَكَ أُولَئِكَ أَهْلُهَا الَّذِينَ هُمْ أَهْلُهَا "
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from al-Hakam b. Aban, that he heard 'Ikrima say: "
entries.matn_en:
When God, blessed and exalted, has finished judging between His creatures, He brings out a book from beneath the Throne in which is written: 'My mercy has preceded My wrath, and I am the Most Merciful of the merciful.' Then He brings out of the Fire the like of the people of Paradise, or twice the number of the people of Paradise." (Al-Hakam said: "I know only that he said 'twice the number of the people of Paradise.' As for 'the like,' I have no doubt.") "Written on them" (al-Hakam pointed to his thigh) "is: 'Freed ones of God.'"

A man said to 'Ikrima: "Abu 'Abdillah, God says: 'They wish to come out of the Fire, but they are not to come out of it' [5:37]." He said: "Woe to you! Those are its rightful people, who are truly its people."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، وَثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ - أَوْ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ - قَالَ: «إِنَّ §أَقْوَامًا سَيَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ النَّارِ قَدْ أَصَابَهُمْ سَفْعٌ مِنَ النَّارِ عُقُوبَةً بِذُنُوبٍ عَمِلُوهَا، ثُمَّ لَيُخْرِجَنَّهُمُ اللَّهُ بِفَضْلِ رَحْمَتِهِ، فَيَدْخُلُونَ الْجَنَّةَ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq told us: Ma'mar told us, from Qatada and Thabit, from Anas, that he heard the Messenger of God ﷺ (or he said: that the Messenger of God ﷺ said): "
entries.matn_en: Some people will come out of the Fire, touched by a scorching of the Fire as a punishment for sins they committed. Then God will bring them out by the grace of His mercy, and they will enter Paradise."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ زَيْدِ بْنِ جُدْعَانَ، عَنْ يُوسُفَ بْنِ مِهْرَانَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ وَهُوَ يَقُولُ: «
entries.matn_ar: إِنَّهُ §سَيَخْرُجُ بَعْدَكُمْ قَوْمٌ يُكَذِّبُونَ بِالرَّجْمِ، وَيُكَذِّبُونَ بِالدَّجَّالِ، وَيُكَذِّبُونَ بِالْحَوْضِ، وَيُكَذِّبُونَ بِعَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ، وَيُكَذِّبُونَ بِقَوْمٍ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ النَّارِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq told us: Ma'mar told us, from 'Ali b. Zayd b. Jud'an, from Yusuf b. Mihran, from Ibn 'Abbas, who said: I heard 'Umar b. al-Khattab say: "
entries.matn_en: After you a people will arise who deny stoning, deny the Dajjal, deny the Pond, deny the punishment of the grave, and deny that a people will come out of the Fire."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي هَارُونَ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَذْكُرُ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: إِنَّ قَوْمًا سَيَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ النَّارِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Sufyan, from Abu Harun, that he heard Abu Hurayra relate from the Prophet ﷺ that he said: "
entries.matn_en: A people will come out of the Fire."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ، عَنْ طَلْقِ بْنِ حَبِيبٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قُلْتُ لِجَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ أَرَأَيْتَ هَذِهِ الْآيَةَ: {يُرِيدُونَ أَنْ يَخْرُجُوا مِنَ النَّارِ وَمَا هُمْ بِخَارِجِينَ مِنْهَا} [المائدة: ٣٧] ؟ وَأَنْتَ تَزْعُمُ أَنَّ قَوْمًا يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ النَّارِ، قَالَ: أَشْهَدُ أَنَّ هَذِهِ الْآيَةَ نَزَلَتْ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَآمَنَّا بِهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ تُؤْمِنَ بِهَا، وَصَدَّقْنَا بِهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ تُصُدِّقَ بِهَا، وَأَشْهَدُ أَنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ مَا أُخْبِرُكَ: «§أَنَّ قَوْمًا يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ النَّارِ» فَقَالَ طَلْقٌ: لَا جَرَمَ، وَاللَّهِ لَا أُجَادِلُكَ أَبَدًا
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from a man, from Talq b. Habib, who said:
entries.matn_en: I said to Jabir b. 'Abdillah: "What do you make of this verse: 'They wish to come out of the Fire, but they are not to come out of it' [5:37], when you claim that a people come out of the Fire?" He said: "I testify that this verse was revealed to the Messenger of God ﷺ, and we believed in it before you believed in it, and we affirmed it before you affirmed it. And I testify that I heard the Messenger of God ﷺ say what I am telling you: 'A people will come out of the Fire.'" Talq said: "Of course! By God, I will never argue with you."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: إِنَّ قَوْمًا سَيَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ النَّارِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Abu Nadra, from Jabir b. 'Abdillah, from the Prophet ﷺ, who said: "
entries.matn_en: A people will come out of the Fire."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ يَقُولُ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «
entries.matn_ar: إِنَّ §لِكُلِّ نَبِيٍّ دَعْوَةً يَدْعُو بِهَا، وَإِنِّي أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَخْبَأَ دَعْوَتِي شَفَاعَةً لِأُمَّتِي يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Hammam b. Munabbih, that he heard Abu Hurayra say: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "
entries.matn_en: Every prophet has a prayer with which he calls, and I wish to store up my prayer as intercession for my community on the Day of Resurrection."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، وَعَاصِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ، عَنْ عَوْفِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ الْأَشْجَعِيِّ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كُنَّا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي سَفَرٍ، فَنَزَلْنَا لَيْلَةً، فَقُمْتُ أَطْلُبُ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَلَمْ أَجِدْهُ، وَوَجَدْتُ مُعَاذَ بْنَ جَبَلٍ، وَأَبَا مُوسَى الْأَشْعَرِيَّ فَقَالَا: مَا حَاجَتُكَ؟ فَقُلْتُ: أَيْنَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ؟ فَقَالَ: لَا نَدْرِي، فَبَيْنَا نَحْنُ عَلَى ذَلِكَ إِذْ سَمِعْنَا فِي أَعْلَى الْوَادِي هَدِيرًا كَهَدِيرِ الرَّحَا، فَلَمْ نَلْبَثْ أَنْ جَاءَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقُلْنَا: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، فَقَدْنَاكَ اللَّيْلَةَ، فَقَالَ: «إِنَّهُ §أَتَانِي آتٍ مِنْ رَبِّي فَخَيَّرَنِي بَيْنَ أَنْ تَكُونَ أُمَّتِي شَطْرَ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ، وَبَيْنَ الشَّفَاعَةِ، فَاخْتَرْتُ الشَّفَاعَةَ» ، فَقُلْنَا: يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ ادْعُ اللَّهَ أَنْ يَجْعَلَنَا مِنْ أَهْلِ الشَّفَاعَةِ، فَقَالَ: «اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْهُمْ مِنْ أَهْلِهَا» ، ثُمَّ أَتَيْنَا الْقَوْمَ فَأَخْبَرْنَاهُمْ فَقَالُوا: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، ادْعُ اللَّهَ أَنْ يَجْعَلَنَا مِنْ أَهْلِ شَفَاعَتِكَ، فَقَالَ: «اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْهُمْ مِنْ أَهْلِهَا» ثُمَّ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «أُشْهِدُكُمْ أَنَّ شَفَاعَتِي لِكُلِّ مَنْ مَاتَ لَا يُشْرِكُ بِاللَّهِ شَيْئًا»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Qatada and 'Asim, from Abu Qilaba, from 'Awf b. Malik al-Ashja'i, who said:
entries.matn_en: We were with the Messenger of God ﷺ on a journey and camped one night. I got up looking for the Prophet ﷺ and did not find him, but I found Mu'adh b. Jabal and Abu Musa al-Ash'ari. They said: "What do you need?" I said: "Where is the Messenger of God ﷺ?" They said: "We do not know." While we were thus, we heard from the upper part of the valley a roaring like the roaring of a millstone, and it was not long before the Prophet ﷺ came. We said: "Messenger of God, we missed you tonight." He said: "One came to me from my Lord and gave me a choice between my community being half of the people of Paradise and intercession, and I chose intercession." We said: "Prophet of God, ask God to make us among the people of intercession." He said: "O God, make them among its people." Then we came to the others and told them, and they said: "Messenger of God, ask God to make us among the people of your intercession." He said: "O God, make them among its people." Then the Messenger of God ﷺ said: "I make you witnesses that my intercession is for everyone who dies not associating anything with God."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: قرأنا على عبد الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ: قَالَ أَبُو الْقَاسِمِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «إِنَّ §أَوَّلَ زُمْرَةٍ تَلِجُ فِي الْجَنَّةِ وُجُوهُهُمْ عَلَى صُورَةِ الْقَمَرِ لَيْلَةَ الْبَدْرِ، لَا يَمْتَخِطُونَ، وَلَا يَبْصُقُونَ، وَلَا يَتَغَوَّطُونَ، آنِيَتُهُمْ وَأَمْشَاطُهُمْ مِنَ الذَّهَبِ وَالْفِضَّةِ، وَمَجَامِرُهُمُ الْأَلُوَّةُ، وَرَشْحُهُمُ الْمِسْكُ، لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ مِنْهُمْ زَوْجَتَانِ، يُرَى مُخُّ سَاقِهَا مِنْ وَرَاءِ اللَّحْمِ مِنَ الْحُسْنِ، لَا اخْتِلَافَ بَيْنَهُمْ وَلَا تَبَاغُضَ، قُلُوبُهُمْ عَلَى قَلْبٍ وَاحِدٍ، يُسَبِّحُونَ اللَّهَ بُكْرَةً وَعَشِيًّا»
entries.isnad_en: We read to 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Hammam b. Munabbih, who said:
entries.matn_en: I heard Abu Hurayra say: Abu al-Qasim, the Messenger of God ﷺ, said: "The first group to enter Paradise will have faces in the form of the moon on the night of the full moon. They will not blow their noses, spit or defecate. Their vessels and combs will be of gold and silver, their censers of aloeswood, and their sweat musk. Each of them will have two wives, the marrow of whose shins can be seen through the flesh from their beauty. There will be no disagreement or mutual hatred among them; their hearts will be as one heart. They will glorify God morning and evening."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ الْأَوْدِيِّ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: إِنَّ §الْمَرْأَةَ مِنَ الْحُورِ الْعِينِ لَيُرَى مُخُّ سَاقِهَا مِنْ وَرَاءِ اللَّحْمِ وَالْعَظْمِ مِنْ تَحْتِ سَبْعِينَ حُلَّةً، كَمَا يُرَى الشَّرَابُ الْأَحْمَرُ فِي الزُّجَاجَةِ الْبَيْضَاءِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq told us: Ma'mar told us, from Abu Ishaq, from 'Amr b. Maymun al-Awdi, from Ibn Mas'ud, who said: "
entries.matn_en: The woman among the houris will have the marrow of her shin seen through the flesh and bone, from beneath seventy robes, as red drink is seen in a white glass."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ بْنِ أَبَانَ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عِكْرِمَةَ يَقُولُ: «
entries.matn_ar: إِنَّ §الرَّجُلَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ لَيَلْبَسُ الْحُلَّةَ فَتَلَوَّنَ فِي سَاعَةٍ سَبْعِينَ لَوْنًا، وَإِنَّ الرَّجُلَ مِنْهُمْ لَيَرَى وَجْهَهُ فِي وَجْهِ زَوْجَتِهِ، وَإِنَّهَا لَتَرَى وَجْهَهَا فِي وَجْهِهِ، وَإِنَّهُ لَيَرَى وَجْهَهُ فِي نَحْرِهَا، وَإِنَّهَا لَتَرَى وَجْهَهَا فِي نَحْرِهِ، وَإِنَّهُ لَيَرَى وَجْهَهُ فِي مِعْصَمِهَا، وَإِنَّهَا لَتَرَى وَجْهَهَا فِي سَاعِدِهِ، وَإِنَّهُ لَيَرَى وَجْهَهُ فِي سَاقِهَا، وَإِنَّهَا لَتَرَى وَجْهَهَا فِي سَاقِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq told us: Ma'mar told us, from al-Hakam b. Aban, that he heard 'Ikrima say: "
entries.matn_en: A man of the people of Paradise will put on a robe and it will change into seventy colors in an hour. A man among them will see his face in his wife's face, and she will see her face in his. He will see his face in her neck, and she will see her face in his neck. He will see his face in her wrist, and she will see her face in his forearm. He will see his face in her shin, and she will see her face in his shin."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، قَالَ: بَلَغَنَا «
entries.matn_ar: إِنَّ §نَخْلَ الْجَنَّةِ جُذُوعُهَا مِنْ ذَهَبٍ، وَكَرَانِيفُهَا مِنْ ذَهَبٍ، وَأَقْنَاؤُهَا مِنْ ذَهَبٍ، وَشَمَارِيخُهَا مِنْ ذَهَبٍ، وَتَفَارِيقُهَا مِنْ ذَهَبٍ، وَسَعَفُهَا كِسْوَةُ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ كَأَحْسَنِ حُلَلٍ رَآهَا النَّاسُ قَطُّ، وَجَرِيدُهَا مِنْ ذَهَبٍ، وَعَرَاجِينُهَا مِنْ ذَهَبٍ، وَرُطَبُهَا أَمْثَالُ الْقِلَالِ أَشَدُّ بَيَاضًا مِنَ اللَّبَنِ وَالْفِضَّةِ، وَأَحْلَى مِنَ الْعَسَلِ وَالسُّكَّرِ، وَأَلْيَنُ مِنَ السَّمْنِ وَالزُّبْدِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Zayd b. Aslam, who said: "
entries.matn_en: It has reached us that the palm of Paradise has trunks of gold, leaf-bases of gold, branches of gold, fruit-stalks of gold and [other parts] of gold. Its fronds are the clothing of the people of Paradise, like the finest garments people have ever seen. Its midribs are of gold and its date-stalks are of gold. Its fresh dates are like large jars, whiter than milk and silver, sweeter than honey and sugar, and softer than ghee and butter."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، أَوْ غَيْرِهِ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: نَخْلُ الْجَنَّةِ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ، وَكَرَانِيفُهَا زُمُرُّدٌ، أَوْ جُذُوعُهَا زُمُرُّدٌ، وَكَرَانِيفُهَا ذَهَبٌ، وَسَعَفُهَا كِسْوَةٌ لِأَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ، وَرُطَبُهَا كَالدِّلَاءِ، أَشَدُّ بَيَاضًا مِنَ اللَّبَنِ، وَأَلْيَنُ مِنَ الزُّبْدِ، وَأَحْلَى مِنَ الْعَسَلِ لَيْسَ لَهُ عَجَمٌ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Qatada or another, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr, who said: "
entries.matn_en: The palm of Paradise is of gold. Its leaf-bases are emerald (or its trunks are emerald and its leaf-bases gold). Its fronds are clothing for the people of Paradise, and its fresh dates are like buckets, whiter than milk, softer than butter and sweeter than honey, with no stone."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ أَبَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ، قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: يُؤْتَوْنَ بِالطَّعَامِ وَالشَّرَابِ، فَإِذَا أَكَلُوا وَشَرِبُوا أُتُوا بِالشَّرَابِ الطَّهُورِ، فَشَرِبُوهُ فَطَهَّرَهُمْ وَتَضْمُرُ لِذَلِكَ بُطُونُهُمْ، وَيَفِيضُ عَرَقًا وَجَشَأً مِنْ جُلُودِهِمْ مِثْلَ رِيحِ الْمِسْكِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Aban, from Abu Qilaba, who said: "
entries.matn_en: They will be brought food and drink. When they have eaten and drunk they will be brought the pure drink, and they will drink it and it will purify them, and their bellies will become lean because of it. Sweat and belching will flow from their skins with the scent of musk."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، يَرْوِيهِ قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: أَهْلُ الْجَنَّةِ أَبْنَاءُ ثَلَاثِينَ، جُرْدٌ مُرْدٌ، مُكَحَّلُونَ عَلَى صُورَةِ آدَمَ، وَكَانَ طُولُهُ سِتُّونَ ذِرَاعًا»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Qatada, narrating it, who said: "
entries.matn_en: The people of Paradise are thirty years old, beardless and smooth-skinned, with kohl-lined eyes, in the form of Adam, whose height was sixty cubits."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُرَّةَ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: أَنْهَارُ الْجَنَّةِ تُفَجَّرُ مِنْ جَبَلِ مِسْكٍ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq told us: Ma'mar told us, from al-A'mash, from 'Abdullah b. Murra, from Masruq, who said: "
entries.matn_en: The rivers of Paradise burst forth from a mountain of musk."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ هَمَّامٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «
entries.matn_ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَقُولُ: §أَعْدَدْتُ لِعِبَادِي الصَّالِحِينَ مَا لَا عَيْنٌ رَأَتْ، وَلَا أُذُنٌ سَمِعَتْ، وَلَا خَطَرَ عَلَى قَلْبِ بَشَرٍ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Hammam, from Abu Hurayra, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "
entries.matn_en: God says: 'I have prepared for My righteous servants what no eye has seen, no ear has heard, and has never occurred to the heart of any human.'"

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنِ الْعَلَاءِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: حَائِطُ الْجَنَّةِ مَبْنِيُّ لَبِنَةٌ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ، وَلَبِنَةٌ مِنْ فِضَّةٍ، وَدَرَجُهَا الْيَاقُوتُ وَاللُّؤْلُؤُ» ، قَالَ: «وَكُنَّا نَتَحَدَّثُ أَنَّ رَضْرَاضَ أَنْهَارِهَا لُؤْلُؤٌ، وَتُرَابُهَا الزَّعْفَرَانُ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq told us: Ma'mar told us, from Qatada, from al-'Ala' b. Ziyad, from Abu Hurayra, who said: "
entries.matn_en: The wall of Paradise is built of one brick of gold and one brick of silver, and its steps are ruby and pearl." He said: "We used to say that the gravel of its rivers is pearl and its soil is saffron."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنِ أَنَسٍ: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: إِنَّ §فِي الْجَنَّةِ شَجَرَةً يَسِيرُ الرَّاكِبُ فِي ظِلِّهَا مِائَةَ عَامٍ لَا يَقْطَعَهَا»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq told us: Ma'mar told us, from Qatada, from Anas, that the Prophet ﷺ said: "
entries.matn_en: In Paradise there is a tree in whose shade a rider travels a hundred years without crossing it."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ هَمَّامٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «
entries.matn_ar: إِنَّ §فِي الْجَنَّةِ شَجَرَةً يَسِيرُ الرَّاكِبُ فِي ظِلِّهَا مِائَةَ عَامٍ لَا يَبْلُغُهَا»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Hammam, that he heard Abu Hurayra say: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "
entries.matn_en: In Paradise there is a tree in whose shade a rider travels a hundred years without reaching [its end]."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يُحَدِّثُ مِثْلَ هَذَا قَالَ: وَيَقُولُ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ: «
entries.matn_ar: اقْرَءُوا إِنْ شِئْتُمْ: {وَظِلٍّ مَمْدُودٍ} [الواقعة: ٣٠]»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq told us: Ma'mar told us, from Muhammad b. Ziyad, that he heard Abu Hurayra narrate the like of this. He said: And Abu Hurayra used to say: "
entries.matn_en: Recite, if you wish: 'and extended shade' [56:30]."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنِ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: تَفَاحَمُوا أَوْ تَفَاخَرُوا يَوْمًا عِنْدَ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ فَقَالُوا: الرِّجَالُ أَكْثَرُ فِي الْجَنَّةِ أَمِ النِّسَاءُ؟ فَقَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ: أَوَلَيْسَ قَدْ قَالَ أَبُو الْقَاسِمِ: «إِنَّ §أَوَّلَ زُمْرَةٍ يَدْخُلُونَ الْجَنَّةَ وُجُوهُهُمْ مِثْلُ الْقَمَرِ لَيْلَةَ الْبَدْرِ، ثُمَّ الَّذِينَ يَلُونَهُمْ، ثُمَّ الَّذِينَ يَلُونَهُمْ، ثُمَّ الَّذِينَ يَلُونَهُمْ كَأَضْوَاءِ كَوْكَبٍ دُرِّيٍّ فِي السَّمَاءِ، كَذَلِكَ لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ مِنْهُمْ زَوْجَتَانِ اثْنَتَانِ يُرَى مُخُّ سَاقِهَا مِنْ وَرَاءِ اللَّحْمِ، وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ مَا فِيهَا عَزَبٌ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Ayyub, from Ibn Sirin, who said:
entries.matn_en: They vied or boasted one day in the presence of Abu Hurayra and said: "Are men more numerous in Paradise or women?" Abu Hurayra said: "Did Abu al-Qasim not say: 'The first group to enter Paradise will have faces like the moon on the night of the full moon, then those who follow them, then those who follow them, then those who follow them, like the light of a brilliant star in the sky. Likewise each of them will have two wives, the marrow of whose shin can be seen through the flesh. And by the One in whose hand is my soul, there is no bachelor in it'?"

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، قَالَ: قِيلَ: §
entries.matn_ar: هَلْ يَتَزَاوَرُونَ أَهْلُ الْجَنَّةِ؟ قَالَ: «نَعَمْ عَلَى الْمَآثِرِ.. .»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Yahya b. Abi Kathir, who said: It was asked: "
entries.matn_en: Do the people of Paradise visit one another?" He said: "Yes, according to their [meritorious deeds]…" [the text is elliptical]

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، وَأَنَسٍ قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: يَقُولُ أَهْلُ الْجَنَّةِ: انْطَلِقُوا بِنَا إِلَى السُّوقِ، فَيَنْطَلِقُونَ إِلَى كُثْبَانٍ مِنْ مِسْكٍ، فَيَجْلِسُونَ عَلَيْهَا وَيَتَحَدَّثُونَ، وَتَهُبُّ عَلَيْهِمْ تِلْكَ الرِّيحُ ثُمَّ يَرْجِعُونَ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq told us: Ma'mar told us, from Qatada and Anas, who said: "
entries.matn_en: The people of Paradise will say: 'Let us go to the market.' They will go to dunes of musk and sit on them and talk, and that wind will blow on them, and then they will return."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، أَنَّ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: الْخَيْمَةُ: دُرَّةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ مُجَوَّفَةٌ فَرْسَخٌ فِي فَرْسَخٍ، لَهَا أَرْبَعَةُ آلَافِ بَابٍ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq told us: Ma'mar told us, from Qatada, that Ibn 'Abbas said: "
entries.matn_en: The tent is a single hollow pearl, a league by a league, with four thousand doors of gold."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ مُعَانِقٍ، أَوْ أَبِي مُعَانِقٍ - عَنْ أَبِي مَالِكٍ الْأَشْعَرِيِّ، قَالَ: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ
entries.matn_ar: إِنَّ §فِي الْجَنَّةِ غُرْفَةً يُرَى ظَاهِرُهَا مِنْ بَاطِنِهَا، وَبَاطِنُهَا مِنْ ظَاهِرِهَا، أَعَدَّهَا اللَّهُ لِمَنْ أَطْعَمَ الطَّعَامَ، وَتَابَعَ الصَّلَاةَ وَالصِّيَامَ، وَقَامَ بِاللَّيْلِ وَالنَّاسُ نِيَامٌ "
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Yahya b. Abi Kathir, from Ibn Mu'aniq or Abu Mu'aniq, from Abu Malik al-Ash'ari, who said: The Prophet ﷺ said: "
entries.matn_en: In Paradise there is a chamber whose outside can be seen from its inside and whose inside from its outside. God has prepared it for those who feed others, who keep up prayer and fasting, and who pray at night while people sleep."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ، عَنْ ثَوْبَانَ، مَوْلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ يَهُودِيًّا جَاءَ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَقَالَ: يَا مُحَمَّدُ أَسْأَلُكَ فَتُخْبِرُنِي، قَالَ: فَرَكَضَهُ ثَوْبَانُ بِرِجْلِهِ، فَقَالَ: قُلْ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، قَالَ: لَا نَدْعُوهُ إِلَّا مَا سَمَّاهُ أَهْلُهُ، فَقَالَ لَهُ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «وَهَلْ يَنْفَعُكَ ذَلِكَ شَيْئًا؟» ، قَالَ: أَسْمَعُ بِأُذُنَيَّ، وَأُبْصِرُ بِعَيْنَيَّ، قَالَ: فَسَكَتَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ ثُمَّ قَالَ: «سَلْ» ، قَالَ: أَرَأَيْتَ قَوْلَهُ: {§يَوْمَ تُبَدَّلُ الْأَرْضُ غَيْرَ الْأَرْضِ وَالسَّمَوَاتُ} أَيْنَ النَّاسُ يَوْمَئِذٍ؟ قَالَ: «فِي الظُّلْمَةِ دُونَ الْجِسْرِ» ، قَالَ: فَمَنْ أَوَّلُ مَنْ يُجِيزُ؟ قَالَ: «فُقَرَاءُ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ، أَوْ قَالَ: فُقَرَاءُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ» ، قَالَ: فَمَا نُزُلُهُمْ أَوَّلَ مَا يَدْخُلُونَهَا؟ قَالَ: «كَبِدُ الْحُوتِ» ، قَالَ: فَمَا طَعَامُهُمْ عَلَى أَثَرِ ذَلِكَ؟ قَالَ: «كَبِدُ النُّونِ» ، قَالَ: فَمَا شَرَابُهُمْ عَلَى أَثَرِ ذَلِكَ؟ قَالَ: «السَّلْسَبِيلُ» ، قَالَ: صَدَقْتَ، قَالَ: أَفَلَا أَسْأَلُكَ عَنْ شَيْءٍ لَا يَعْلَمُهُ إِلَّا نَبِيُّ أَوْ رَجُلٌ أَوِ اثْنَانِ؟ قَالَ: «وَمَا هُوَ؟» ، قَالَ: عَنْ شَبَهِ الْوَلَدِ، قَالَ: «مَاءُ الرَّجُلِ بَيْضَاءُ غَلِيظَةٌ، وَمَاءُ الْمَرْأَةِ صَفْرَاءُ رَقِيقَةٌ، فَإِذَا عَلَا مَاءُ الرَّجُلِ مَاءَ الْمَرْأَةِ أَذْكَرَ بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ، وَمِنْ قِبَلِ ذَلِكَ الشَّبَهُ، وَإِذَا عَلَا مَاءُ الْمَرْأَةِ مَاءَ الرَّجُلِ أَنْثَى بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ، وَمِنْ قِبَلِ ذَلِكَ الشَّبَهُ» ، قَالَ: فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ، مَا كَانَ عِنْدِي فِي شَيْءٍ مِمَّا سَأَلَنِي عَنْهُ عِلْمٌ حَتَّى أَنْبَأَنِيهِ اللَّهُ فِي مَجْلِسِي هَذَا»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Yahya b. Abi Kathir, from a man, from Thawban, the freedman of the Messenger of God ﷺ:
entries.matn_en:
A Jew came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: "Muhammad, I will ask you and you will tell me." Thawban kicked him with his foot and said: "Say: 'Messenger of God.'" He said: "We call him only by what his family named him." The Prophet ﷺ said to him: "Does that benefit you at all?" He said: "I hear with my ears and see with my eyes." The Prophet ﷺ was silent, then said: "Ask." He said: "What about His words: 'the Day when the earth will be changed into another earth, and the heavens' [14:48]? Where will the people be that day?" He said: "In the darkness before the bridge." He said: "Who is the first to cross?" He said: "The poor of the Emigrants," or he said: "the poor of the believers." He said: "What is their first welcome-food when they enter it?" He said: "The liver of the whale." He said: "What is their food after that?" He said: "The liver of the nun." He said: "What is their drink after that?" He said: "Salsabil." He said: "You have spoken truly." Then he said: "Shall I not ask you about something that none knows but a prophet or one or two men?" He said: "What is it?" He said: "About the resemblance of the child." He said: "The man's fluid is white and thick, and the woman's is yellow and thin. When the man's fluid rises above the woman's, a male is born by God's permission, and from that comes the resemblance. When the woman's fluid rises above the man's, a female is born by God's permission, and from that comes the resemblance."

The Prophet ﷺ said: "By the One in whose hand is my soul, I had no knowledge of anything he asked me about until God informed me of it in this very sitting of mine."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ يَقُولُ: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «
entries.matn_ar: وَاللَّهِ §لَقِيدُ سَوْطِ أَحَدِكُمْ مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ خَيْرٌ لَهُ مِمَّا بَيْنَ السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Hammam b. Munabbih, that he heard Abu Hurayra say: The Prophet ﷺ said: "
entries.matn_en: By God, the space of one of your whips in Paradise is better for him than what is between the heavens and the earth."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: .. . §مَنْ دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ نَعِمَ فَلَا يَبْأَسُ، وَخُلِّدَ فَلَا يَمُوتُ.. .»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Ibn Tawus, from his father, who said: "
entries.matn_en: …Whoever enters Paradise enjoys bliss and does not suffer, and is made eternal and does not die…" [the text is incomplete]

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: أَهْلُ الْجَنَّةِ يَنْكِحُونَ النِّسَاءَ، وَلَا يَلِدْنَ، لَيْسَ فِيهَا مَنِيٌّ وَلَا مَنِيَّةٌ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Ibn Tawus, from his father, who said: "
entries.matn_en: The people of Paradise will have intercourse with women, but the women will not give birth. There is no semen there and no death."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ، سَمِعَ الْحَسَنَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «§قِيدُ قَوْسِ أَحَدِكُمْ فِي الْجَنَّةِ خَيْرٌ لَهُ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا وَمَا فِيهَا» ،
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from a man who heard al-Hasan say:
entries.matn_en: The Prophet ﷺ said: "The space of a bow of one of you in Paradise is better for him than the world and what is in it."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ الْخُرَاسَانِيِّ،
entries.matn_ar: مِثْلُ حَدِيثِ طَاوُسٍ فِي النِّكَاحِ
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from 'Ata' al-Khurasani, [narrated]
entries.matn_en: the like of Tawus's report on sexual intercourse.

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ، أَنَّ أَبَا الدَّرْدَاءِ، قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: لَيْسَ فِيهَا مَنِيُّ وَلَا مَنِيَّةٌ، إِنَّمَا يَدْحُمُونَهُنَّ دَحْمًا»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Yahya b. Sa'id, from a man, that Abu al-Darda' said: "
entries.matn_en: There is no semen in it and no death. They simply thrust into them."

sections.title_en: Description of the People of the Fire

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ هِلَالٍ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ، سَمَّاهُ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ عُتْبَةَ بْنَ غَزْوَانَ خَطَبَ النَّاسَ بِالْبَصْرَةِ، فَقَالَ: «إِنَّ الدُّنْيَا قَدْ آذَنَتْ بِصَرْمٍ، وَوَلَّتْ حَذَّاءَ، وَلَمْ يَبْقَ إِلَّا صُبَابَةٌ كَصُبَابَةِ الْإِنَاءِ، وَأَنْتُمْ مُتَحَمَّلُونَ إِلَى دَارِ ذِي مُقَامَةٍ، فَانْتَقِلُوا خَيْرَ مَا بِحَضْرَتِكُمْ، أَلَا فَلَقَدْ بَلَغَنِي أَنَّ الْحَجَرَ يُقْذَفُ مِنْ شَفِيرِ جَهَنَّمَ فَيَهْوِي فِيهَا سَبْعِينَ خَرِيفًا، حَتَّى يَبْلُغَ قَعْرَهَا، وَايْمُ اللَّهِ لَتُمْلَأَنَّ، أَفَعَجِبْتُمْ؟ أَلَا وَإِنَّ مَا بَيْنَ مِصْرَاعَيِ الْجَنَّةِ مَسِيرَةُ أَرْبَعِينَ سَنَةً، وَايْمُ اللَّهِ لَيَأْتِيَنَّ عَلَيْهِ يَوْمٌ وَهُوَ كَظِيظٌ بِالزِّحَامِ، أَلَا §فَلَقَدْ رَأَيْتُنِي سَابِعَ سَبْعَةٍ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مَا لَنَا طَعَامٌ إِلَّا وَرَقُ الشَّجَرِ وَالْبَشَامُ، حَتَّى قَرِحَتْ أَشْدَاقُنَا، وَلَقَدْ وَجَدْتُ أَنَا وَسَعْدُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ نَمِرَةً فَشَقَقْنَاهَا إِزَارَيْنِ، فَمَا بَقِيَ مِنَّا أَيُّهَا السَّبْعَةُ إِلَّا أَمِيرُ عَامَّةٍ، وَسَتُجَرِّبُونَ الْأُمَرَاءَ بَعْدَنَا، أَلَا وَإِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ أَنْ أَكُونَ فِي نَفْسِي عَظِيمًا، وَفِي أَعْيُنِ النَّاسِ صَغِيرًا، أَلَا وَإِنَّهَا لَمْ تَكُنْ نُبُوَّةٌ إِلَّا تَنَاسَخَتْ حَتَّى تَكُونَ مُلْكًا»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq told us: Ma'mar told us, from Ayyub, from Humayd b. Hilal, from a man he named, that
entries.matn_en: 'Utba b. Ghazwan addressed the people in Basra and said: "The world has announced its departure and has turned away swiftly, and nothing is left of it but dregs like the dregs in a vessel. You are being transferred to an abode of permanence, so move to it with the best you have at hand. It has reached me that a stone thrown from the edge of Hell falls for seventy autumns before it reaches the bottom, and by God it will be filled. Do you wonder? And the distance between the two leaves of the gate of Paradise is a journey of forty years, and by God a day will come upon it when it is crowded to bursting. I have seen myself as the seventh of seven with the Messenger of God ﷺ. We had no food but the leaves of trees and basham, until our mouths were sore. Sa'd b. Malik and I found a striped cloak and tore it into two waist-wrappers. None of us seven remains but is the governor of some region, and you will experience rulers after us. I seek refuge in God from being great in my own eyes and small in the eyes of people. No prophethood ever existed but it was succeeded, until it becomes kingship."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ: قَالَ مُعَاذُ بْنُ جَبَلٍ: «§
entries.matn_ar: لَوْ أَنَّ صَخْرَةً زِنَةَ سَبْعِ خَلِفَاتٍ بِشُحُومِهِنَّ وَلُحُومِهِنَّ وَأَوْلَادِهِنَّ، يُرْمَى بِهَا مِنْ شَفِيرِ جَهَنَّمَ لَهَوَتْ مَا بَيْنَ شَفِيرِهَا وَقَعْرِهَا سَبْعِينَ خَرِيفًا حَتَّى تَبْلُغَ قَعْرَهَا»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, who said: Mu'adh b. Jabal said: "
entries.matn_en: If a rock the weight of seven pregnant she-camels, with their fat, their flesh and their offspring, were thrown from the edge of Hell, it would fall between its edge and its bottom for seventy autumns before reaching the bottom."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ يَقُولُ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «
entries.matn_ar: تَحَاجَّتِ الْجَنَّةُ وَالنَّارُ، فَقَالَتِ النَّارُ: أُوثِرْتُ بِالْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ وَالْمُتَجَبِّرِينَ، وَقَالَتِ الْجَنَّةُ: فَمَا لِي لَا يَدْخُلُنِي إِلَّا ضُعَفَاءُ النَّاسِ وَسَقَطُهُمْ وَعُرَاتُهُمْ؟ فَقَالَ اللَّهُ لِلْجَنَّةِ: §إِنَّمَا أَنْتِ رَحْمَتِي أَرْحَمُ بِكِ مَنْ أَشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِي، وَقَالَ لِلنَّارِ: إِنَّمَا أَنْتِ عَذَابِي أُعَذِّبُ بِكِ مَنْ أَشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِي، وَلِكُلِّ وَاحِدَةٍ مِنْكُمَا مِلْؤُهَا، فَأَمَّا النَّارُ فَإِنَّهُمْ يُلْقَوْنَ فِيهَا {وَتَقُولُ هَلْ مِنْ مَزِيدٍ} [ق: ٣٠] ، فَلَا تَمْتَلِئُ حَتَّى يَضَعَ رِجْلَهُ - أَوْ قَالَ: قَدَمَهُ - فِيهَا فَتَقُولَ: قَطٍ قَطٍ قَطٍ، فَهُنَالِكَ تُمْلَأُ وَتَنْزَوِي بَعْضُهَا إِلَى بَعْضٍ، وَلَا يَظْلِمُ اللَّهُ مِنْ خَلْقِهِ أَحَدًا، وَأَمَّا الْجَنَّةُ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ يُنْشِئُ لَهَا مَا شَاءَ» .
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Hammam b. Munabbih, that he heard Abu Hurayra say: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "
entries.matn_en: Paradise and Hell disputed. Hell said: 'I have been favored with the arrogant and the tyrannical.' Paradise said: 'What is the matter with me that only the weak among people, their lowly and their rabble enter me?' God said to Paradise: 'You are My mercy; through you I show mercy to whomever I will of My servants.' And He said to Hell: 'You are My punishment; through you I punish whomever I will of My servants. Each of you shall have its fill.' As for Hell, they will be thrown into it, 'and it will say: Are there any more?' [50:30], and it will not be filled until He places His foot (or he said: His step) in it, and it says: 'Enough, enough, enough.' Then it is filled and its parts draw together, and God wrongs none of His creation. As for Paradise, God creates for it whomever He wills."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ مَعْمَرٌ وَأَخْبَرَنِي أَيُّوبُ، عَنِ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ، عَنِ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ
entries.matn_ar: مِثْلَهُ،
entries.isnad_en: Ma'mar said: and Ayyub told me, from Ibn Sirin, from Abu Hurayra, from the Prophet ﷺ,
entries.matn_en: the like of it.

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَجُلًا يُحَدِّثُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ بِحَدِيثِ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ هَذَا، فَقَامَ رَجُلٌ فَانْتَقَضَ فَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ: «
entries.matn_ar: مَا فَرَّقَ مِنْ هَؤُلَاءِ، يَجِدُونَ عِنْدَ مُحْكَمِهِ، وَيَهْلِكُونَ عِنْدَ مُتَشَابِهِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Ibn Tawus, from his father, who said: I heard a man narrating this hadith of Abu Hurayra to Ibn 'Abbas, and a man stood up and shuddered. Ibn 'Abbas said: "
entries.matn_en: What do these people fear? They find gentleness at its clear verses and perish at its ambiguous ones."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: بَلَغَنِي أَنَّ §النَّارَ حِينَ خُلِقَتْ كَادَتْ أَفْئِدَةُ الْمَلَائِكَةِ تَطِيرُ، فَلَمَّا خُلِقَ آدَمُ سَكَنَتْ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Ibn Tawus, from his father, who said: "
entries.matn_en: It has reached me that when the Fire was created, the hearts of the angels almost flew away, and when Adam was created they calmed."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «§
entries.matn_ar: نَارُكُمْ هَذِهِ الَّتِي يُوقِدُ بَنُو آدَمَ جُزْءٌ وَاحِدٌ مِنْ سَبْعِينَ جُزْءًا مِنْ حَرِّ جَهَنَّمَ» ، قَالُوا: وَاللَّهِ إِنْ كَانَتْ لَكَافِيَةً يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، قَالَ: «فَإِنَّهَا فُضِّلَتْ عَلَيْهَا بِتِسْعَةٍ وَسِتِّينَ جُزْءًا، كُلُّهَا مِثْلُ حَرِّهَا»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Hammam b. Munabbih, from Abu Hurayra, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "
entries.matn_en: This fire of yours that the sons of Adam kindle is one part in seventy parts of the heat of Hell." They said: "By God, it would have been sufficient, Messenger of God." He said: "It has been exceeded by sixty-nine parts, each of them like its heat."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، أَنَّ عِكْرِمَةَ مَوْلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ: «إِنَّ §
entries.matn_ar: أَهْوَنَ أَهْلِ النَّارِ عَذَابًا رَجُلٌ يَطَأُ جَمْرَةً يَغْلِي مِنْهَا دِمَاغُهُ» ، فَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ الصِّدِّيقُ: وَمَا كَانَ جُرْمُهُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ؟ قَالَ: «كَانَتْ لَهُ مَاشِيَةٌ يَغْشَى بِهَا الزَّرْعَ وَيُؤْذِيهِ، وَحَرَّمَهُ اللَّهُ وَمَا حَوْلَهُ غَلْوَةً بِسَهْمٍ - أَوْ قَالَ: رَمْيَةً بِحَجَرٍ - فَاحْذَرُوا أَلَّا يُسْحَتَ الرَّجُلُ مَالَهُ فِي الدُّنْيَا، وَيُهْلِكُ نَفْسَهُ فِي الْآخِرَةِ» ، قَالَ: «وَإِنَّ أَدْنَى أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ مَنْزِلَةً، وَأَسْفَلَهُمْ دَرَجَةً رَجُلٌ لَا يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ بَعْدَهُ أَحَدٌ، يُفْسَحُ لَهُ فِي بَصَرِهِ مَسِيرَةَ مِائَةِ عَامٍ فِي قُصُورٍ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ، وَخِيَامٍ مِنْ لُؤْلُؤٍ لَيْسَ فِيهَا مَوْضِعُ شِبْرٍ إِلَّا مَعْمُورٌ، يُغْدَى عَلَيْهِ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ، وَيُرَاحُ بِسَبْعِينَ أَلْفَ صَحْفَةٍ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ لَيْسَ مِنْهَا صَحْفَةٌ، إِلَّا فِيهَا لَوْنٌ لَيْسَ فِي الْآخَرِ مِثْلُهُ، شَهْوَتُهُ فِي آخِرِهَا كَشَهْوَتِهِ فِي أَوَّلِهَا، لَوْ نَزَلَ بِهِ جَمِيعُ أَهْلِ الدُّنْيَا لَوَسَّعَ عَلَيْهِمْ مِمَّا أُعْطِيَ، لَا يُنْقِصُ ذَلِكَ مِمَّا أُوتِيَ شَيْئًا»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Isma'il b. Abi Sa'id, that 'Ikrima, the freedman of Ibn 'Abbas, told him that the Messenger of God ﷺ said: "
entries.matn_en:
The lightest in punishment among the people of the Fire is a man who treads on an ember by which his brain boils." Abu Bakr al-Siddiq said: "What was his offense, Messenger of God?" He said: "He had livestock with which he would go among crops and damage them. God made it forbidden, with its surroundings to the distance of an arrow's shot, or he said: a stone's throw. So beware lest a man destroy his wealth in this world and ruin himself in the next."

He said: "And the lowest of the people of Paradise in station and the lowest in rank is a man after whom no one else will enter Paradise. His sight will be extended for him over a journey of a hundred years, in palaces of gold and tents of pearl, with not a span of space in them that is not inhabited. Every morning and evening he will be served seventy thousand golden platters, none of which has a color that the others do not. His appetite at the end of them will be as at the beginning. If all the people of the world were to come to him as guests, he would accommodate them from what he has been given, and that would not diminish anything of what he has been given."

sections.title_en: Saying "May Satan Perish," and Burning Books
sections.title_ar: بَابُ قَوْلِ: تَعِسَ الشَّيْطَانُ، وَتَحْرِيقِ الْكُتُبِ

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي تَمِيمَةَ الْهُجَيْمِيِّ، عَنْ مَنْ كَانَ رَدِيفَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كُنْتُ رِدْفَهُ عَلَى حِمَارٍ، فَعَثَرَ الْحِمَارُ، فَقُلْتُ: تَعِسَ الشَّيْطَانُ، فَقَالَ لِيَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «§لَا تَقُلْ: تَعِسَ الشَّيْطَانُ، فَإِنَّكَ إِذَا قُلْتَ: تَعِسَ الشَّيْطَانُ، تَعَاظَمَ فِي نَفْسِهِ، وَقَالَ: صَرَعْتُهُ بِقُوَّتِي، وَإِذَا قُلْتَ: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، تَصَاغَرَتْ إِلَيْهِ نَفْسُهُ حَتَّى يَكُونَ أَصْغَرَ مِنَ الذُّبَابِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from 'Asim, from Abu Tamima al-Hujaymi, from the one who rode behind the Messenger of God ﷺ, who said:
entries.matn_en: I was riding behind him on a donkey, and the donkey stumbled, and I said: "May Satan perish." The Prophet ﷺ said to me: "Do not say: 'May Satan perish.' If you say 'May Satan perish,' he swells in his own estimation and says: 'I threw him down by my strength.' But if you say 'In the name of God,' he shrinks until he is smaller than a fly."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: لَمَّا لَعَنَ اللَّهُ إِبْلِيسَ أُهْبِطَ إِلَى الْأَرْضِ رَنَّ وَنَخَرَ، فَلُعِنَ مَنْ فَعَلَهُمَا»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Mansur, from Mujahid, who said: "
entries.matn_en: When God cursed Iblis and he was cast down to earth, he wailed and snorted, so whoever does these two things is cursed."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ طَاوُسٍ، قَالَ: «كَانَ أَبِي §
entries.matn_ar: يُحَرِّقُ الصُّحُفَ إِذَا اجْتَمَعَتْ عِنْدَهُ فِيهَا الرَّسَائِلُ فِيهَا بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Ibn Tawus, who said: "My father
entries.matn_en: used to burn sheets when letters accumulated with him that contained 'In the name of God, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.'"

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، قَالَ: أَحْرَقَ أَبِي يَوْمَ الْحَرَّةِ كُتُبَ فِقْهٍ كَانَتْ لَهُ، قَالَ: فَكَانَ يَقُولُ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: لَأَنْ تَكُونَ عِنْدِي أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِنْ أَنْ يَكُونَ لِي مِثْلُ أَهْلِي وَمَالِي»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Hisham b. 'Urwa, who said: My father burned, on the day of al-Harra, some books of jurisprudence that he had. He used to say afterward: "
entries.matn_en: To have them with me is dearer to me than to have the like of my family and my wealth."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الثَّوْرِيِّ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ «أَنَّهُ §
entries.matn_ar: كَرِهَ أَنْ تُحَرَّقَ الصُّحُفُ إِذَا كَانَ فِيهَا ذِكْرُ اللَّهِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from al-Thawri, from Mughira, from Ibrahim, that "
entries.matn_en: he disliked that sheets be burned when they contained the mention of God."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «§
entries.matn_ar: خُلِقَتِ الْمَلَائِكَةُ مِنْ نُورٍ، وَخُلِقَ الْجَانُّ مِنْ مَارِجٍ مِنْ نَارٍ، وَخُلِقَ آدَمُ مِمَّا وُصِفَ لَكُمْ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, from 'Urwa, from 'A'isha, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "
entries.matn_en: The angels were created from light, the jinn were created from a smokeless flame of fire, and Adam was created from what has been described to you."

sections.title_en: One Whose Intercession Stands Against One of God's Penalties
sections.title_ar: بَابُ مَنْ حَالَتْ شَفَاعَتُهِ دُونَ حَدٍّ

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ الْخُرَاسَانِيِّ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: أَلَا تَقُولُونَ: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، فَإِنَّهُمَا أَلْفَانِ مِنْ كَلَامِ اللَّهِ بِالْوَاحِدَةِ عَشْرٌ، وَبِالْعَشْرِ مِائَةٌ، وَبِالْمِائَةِ أَلْفٌ، وَمَنْ زَادَ زَادَهُ اللَّهُ، وَمَنِ اسْتَغْفَرَ غَفَرَ اللَّهُ لَهُ، وَمَنْ حَالَتْ شَفَاعَتُهُ دُونَ حَدٍّ مِنْ حُدُودِ اللَّهِ، فَقَدْ ضَادَّ اللَّهَ فِي حُكْمِهِ، وَمَنْ أَعَانَ عَلَى خَصْمٍ دُونَ حَقٍّ أَوْ بِمَا لَا يَعْلَمُ، كَانَ فِي سَخَطِ اللَّهِ حَتَّى يَنْزِعَ، وَمَنْ تَبَرَّأَ مِنْ وَلَدٍ لِيَفْضَحَهُ فِي الدُّنْيَا، فَضَحَهُ اللَّهُ عَلَى رُءُوسِ الْخَلَائِقِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ، وَمَنْ بَهَتَ مُؤْمِنًا بِمَا لَا يَعْلَمُ، جَعَلَهُ اللَّهُ فِي رَدْغَةِ الْخَبَالِ حَتَّى يَأْتِيَ بِالْمَخْرَجِ مِمَّا قَالَ، وَمَنْ مَاتَ وَعَلَيْهِ دَيْنٌ أُخِذَ مِنْ حَسَنَاتِهِ، لَا دِينَارٌ وَلَا دِرْهَمٌ، وَرَكْعَتَيِ الْفَجْرِ حَافِظُوا عَلَيْهِمَا فَإِنَّ فِيهِمَا رُغَبَ الدَّهْرِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from 'Ata' al-Khurasani, from Ibn 'Umar, that he said: "
entries.matn_en: Will you not say: 'There is no god but God' and 'Glory be to God and praise be to Him'? They are two thousand of the words of God: for each one, ten; for ten, a hundred; for a hundred, a thousand. Whoever adds, God adds for him; whoever seeks forgiveness, God forgives him. Whoever's intercession stands in the way of one of God's penalties has opposed God in His ruling. Whoever aids against an adversary without right, or with what he does not know, is in God's wrath until he desists. Whoever disowns a child in order to disgrace him in this world, God will disgrace him before all creation on the Day of Resurrection. Whoever slanders a believer with what he does not know, God will place him in the mire of ruin until he brings a way out of what he said. Whoever dies owing a debt, it is taken from his good deeds, for there is neither dinar nor dirham there. And as for the two rak'as of dawn, guard them, for in them is the best of the age."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ صَبِيغًا قَدِمَ عَلَى عُمَرَ فَقَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: مَنْ أَنْتَ؟» ، فَقَالَ: أَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ صَبِيغٌ، فَسَأَلَهُ عُمَرُ عَنْ أَشْيَاءَ، فَعَاقَبَهُ، قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ: فِي عِلْمِي أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «§وَحَرَّقَ كُتُبَهُ، وَكَتَبَ إِلَى أَهْلِ الْبَصْرَةِ: أَلَّا تُجَالِسُوهُ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Ibn Tawus, from his father: Sabigh came to 'Umar, and he said: "
entries.matn_en: Who are you?" He said: "I am 'Abdullah Sabigh." 'Umar asked him about some matters and punished him. Abu Bakr said: "To my knowledge he said: 'and he burned his books and wrote to the people of Basra not to sit with him.'"

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: خَرَجَتِ الْحَرُورِيَّةُ، فَقِيلَ لِصَبِيغٍ: إِنَّهُ قَدْ خَرَجَ قَوْمٌ يَقُولُونَ كَذَا وَكَذَا، قَالَ: هَيْهَاتَ قَدْ نَفَعَنِي اللَّهُ بِمَوْعِظَةِ الرَّجُلِ الصَّالِحِ، قَالَ: «وَكَانَ عُمَرُ §ضَرَبَهُ حَتَّى سَالَتِ الدِّمَاءُ عَلَى رِجْلَيْهِ» ، أَوْ قَالَ: عَلَى عَقِبَيْهِ
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, who said:
entries.matn_en: The Haruriyya [Khawarij] emerged, and it was said to Sabigh: "A people have come out saying such and such." He said: "Impossible! God has benefited me through the admonition of the righteous man." He said: "'Umar had beaten him until the blood ran down his legs," or he said: "his heels."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ: جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ يَسْتَعِينُ بِهِ عَلَى ابْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، وَكَانَ عَامِلًا فَقَالَ لَهُ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ: «§
entries.matn_ar: أَنْتَ امْرُؤٌ ظَلُومٌ لَا يَحِلُّ لِأَحَدٍ أَنْ يَشْفَعَ لَكَ، وَلَا يَدْفَعَ عَنْكَ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Ibn Tawus, from his father, who said: A man came to Ibn 'Abbas seeking his help against Ibn al-Zubayr, who was a governor. Ibn 'Abbas said to him: "
entries.matn_en: You are an unjust man. It is not lawful for anyone to intercede for you or to defend you."

sections.title_en: The Strength of the Prophet ﷺ
sections.title_ar: بَابُ قُوَّةِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي زِيَادٍ - قَالَ: أَحْسِبُهُ - عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ، قَالَ: §
entries.matn_ar: صَارَعَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَبَا رُكَانَةَ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ، وَكَانَ شَدِيدًا، فَقَالَ: شَاةٌ بِشَاةٍ، فَصَرَعَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَ أَبُو رُكَانَةَ: عَاوِدْنِي، فَصَارَعَهُ، فَصَرَعَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَيْضًا، فَقَالَ: عَاوِدْنِي فِي أُخْرَى، فَعَاوَدَهُ، فَصَرَعَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، أَيْضًا، فَقَالَ أَبُو رُكَانَةَ: هَذَا أَقُولُ لِأَهْلِي: شَاةٌ أَكَلَهَا الذِّئْبُ، وَشَاةٌ تَكَسَّرَتْ، فَمَاذَا أَقُولُ لِلثَّالِثَةِ؟ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «مَا كُنَّا لِنَجْمَعَ عَلَيْكَ أَنْ نَصْرَعَكَ وَنُغْرِمَكَ خُذْ غَنَمَكَ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Yazid b. Abi Ziyad (he said: I think), from 'Abdullah b. al-Harith, who said:
entries.matn_en: The Prophet ﷺ wrestled Abu Rukana in the pre-Islamic period, and he was a strong man. He said: "A sheep for a sheep." The Messenger of God ﷺ threw him. Abu Rukana said: "Take me on again." So he wrestled him and the Messenger of God ﷺ threw him again. He said: "Again." He wrestled him again and the Messenger of God ﷺ threw him again. Abu Rukana said: "What do I say to my family? One sheep a wolf ate, one sheep broke [its limb]. What shall I say about the third?" The Prophet ﷺ said: "We would not combine against you both throwing you and fining you. Take your sheep."

sections.title_en: The Likeness of This Community, and Other Matters

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنِ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: فَزِعَ أَهْلُ الْمَدِينَةِ مَرَّةً، فَرَكِبَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَرَسًا كَأَنَّهُ مُقْرِفٌ، فَرَكَضَهُ فِي آثَارِهِمْ، فَلَمَّا رَجَعَ قَالَ: «§وَجَدْنَاهُ بَحْرًا»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq told us: Ma'mar told us, from Thabit, from Anas, who said:
entries.matn_en: The people of Medina were alarmed once, and the Prophet ﷺ rode a horse that seemed like a mediocre one and galloped it in their tracks. When he returned he said: "We found it a sea."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «
entries.matn_ar: مَثَلُكُمْ وَمَثَلُ الْيَهُودِ وَالنَّصَارَى كَمَثَلِ رَجُلٍ قَالَ: مَنْ أَسْتَأْجِرُهُ يَعْمَلُ إِلَى نِصْفِ النَّهَارِ بِقِيرَاطٍ؟ فَعَمِلَتِ الْيَهُودُ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: مَنْ أَسْتَأْجِرُهُ يَعْمَلُ إِلَى صَلَاةِ الْعَصْرِ بِقِيرَاطٍ؟ فَعَمِلَتِ النَّصَارَى، ثُمَّ قَالَ: مَنْ أَسْتَأْجِرُهُ يَعْمَلُ إِلَى اللَّيْلِ بِقِيرَاطَيْنِ، فَعَمِلْتُمْ أَنْتُمْ، فَلَكُمُ الْأَجْرُ مَرَّتَيْنِ، فَقَالَتِ الْيَهُودُ وَالنَّصَارَى: نَحْنُ أَكْثَرُ عَمَلًا وَأَقَلُّ أُجُورًا، فَقَالَ اللَّهُ: §أَظَلَمْتُكُمْ مِنْ أُجُورِكُمْ شَيْئًا؟ قَالُوا: لَا، قَالَ: فَإِنَّهُ فَضْلِي أُوتِيهِ مَنْ أَشَاءُ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq told us: Ma'mar told us, from Ayyub, from Nafi', from Ibn 'Umar, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "
entries.matn_en: Your likeness and the likeness of the Jews and Christians is that of a man who said: 'Who will work for me until midday for one qirat?' The Jews worked. Then he said: 'Who will work for me until the afternoon prayer for one qirat?' The Christians worked. Then he said: 'Who will work for me until night for two qirats?' And you worked. So yours is the reward twice over. The Jews and Christians said: 'We did more work and received less pay.' God said: 'Did I wrong you of anything of your wages?' They said: 'No.' He said: 'It is My bounty; I give it to whom I will.'"

sections.title_en: A Man Begins With Himself in a Letter
sections.title_ar: بَابُ الرَّجُلِ يَبْدَأُ بِنَفْسِهِ فِي الْكِتَابِ

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: قَرَأْتُ كِتَابًا: مِنَ الْعَلَاءِ بْنِ الْحَضْرَمِيِّ إِلَى مُحَمَّدٍ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Ayyub, who said: "
entries.matn_en: I read a letter: 'From al-'Ala' b. al-Hadrami to Muhammad, Messenger of God.'"

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي مَنْ، سَمِعَ ابْنَ سِيرِينَ، يَقُولُ: «
entries.matn_ar: كَانَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ §إِذَا كَتَبَ: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ، كَتَبَ: أَمَّا بَعْدُ، مِنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, who said: One who heard Ibn Sirin told me that he said: "
entries.matn_en: When Ibn 'Umar wrote 'In the name of God, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful,' he wrote: 'To proceed: from 'Abdullah b. 'Umar.'"

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، أَوْ غَيْرِهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، قَالَ: «كَانَ §
entries.matn_ar: عُمَّالُ عُمَرَ إِذَا كَتَبُوا إِلَيَّهُ بَدَءُوا بِأَنْفُسِهِمْ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq told us: Ma'mar told us, from Ayyub or
entries.matn_en: another, from Nafi', who said: "When 'Umar's governors wrote to him, they began with themselves." [This continuation is in the supplied English only; it is not in the Arabic text.] He said: Ziyad found a letter from al-Nu'man b. Muqarrin to 'Abdullah 'Umar, Commander of the Faithful, and Ziyad said: "These people were only Bedouins." Ma'mar said: "Ayyub sometimes began with the name of the other man when he wrote to him, if that man was a tribal chief."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: كَانَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ يَأْمُرُ غِلْمَانَهُ §إِذَا كَتَبُوا إِلَيْهِ أَنْ يَبْدَءُوا بِأَنْفُسِهِمْ، وَإِلَّا لَمْ أَرُدَّ إِلَيْكُمْ جَوَابًا»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq told us: Ma'mar told us, from Ayyub, from Nafi', who said: "
entries.matn_en: Ibn 'Umar used to order his servants, when they wrote to him, to begin with themselves, 'otherwise I will not return an answer to you.'"

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ الرَّبِيعِ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أَبِي خَالِدٍ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: كَتَبَ أَبُو عُبَيْدَةَ بْنُ الْجَرَّاحِ، وَمُعَاذُ بْنُ جَبَلٍ: لِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ عُمَرَ أَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Qays b. al-Rabi', from Isma'il b. Abi Khalid, from al-Sha'bi, who said: "
entries.matn_en: Abu 'Ubayda b. al-Jarrah and Mu'adh b. Jabal wrote: 'To 'Abdullah 'Umar, Commander of the Faithful.'"

sections.title_en: The Wives of the Prophet ﷺ
sections.title_ar: بَابُ أَزْوَاجِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ لَهَا: «§
entries.matn_ar: هَذَا جِبْرِيلُ وَهُوَ يَقْرَأُ عَلَيْكِ السَّلَامَ» ، فَقَالَتْ: وَعَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ، تَرَى مَا لَا نَرَى
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq told us: Ma'mar told us, from al-Zuhri, from 'Urwa, from 'A'isha: The Prophet ﷺ said to her: "
entries.matn_en: This is Jibril, and he conveys greetings of peace to you." She said: "And upon him be peace, and God's mercy and blessings. You see what we do not see."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، قَالَ: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ لِجِبْرِيلَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: أَبْطَأْتَ عَنِّي حَتَّى اشْتَقْنَا إِلَيْكَ» ، فَقَالَ: وَنَحْنُ إِلَيْكَ أَشْوَقُ، فَإِذَا أَتَيْتَ عَائِشَةَ فَأَقْرِئْهَا السَّلَامَ
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Qatada, who said: The Prophet ﷺ said to Jibril: "
entries.matn_en: You were slow in coming to me, until we longed for you." He said: "And we long for you even more. When you go to 'A'isha, convey my greetings of peace to her."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنِ أَنَسٍ: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: حَسْبُكَ مِنْ نِسَاءِ الْعَالَمِينَ مَرْيَمُ بِنْتُ عِمْرَانَ، وَخَدِيجَةُ بِنْتُ خُوَيْلِدٍ، وَفَاطِمَةُ بِنْتُ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَآسِيَةُ امْرَأَةُ فِرْعَوْنَ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq told us: Ma'mar told us, from Qatada, from Anas, that the Prophet ﷺ said: "
entries.matn_en: Enough for you among the women of the worlds are Maryam bint 'Imran, Khadija bint Khuwaylid, Fatima bint Muhammad ﷺ, and Asiya, the wife of Pharaoh."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، قَالَ: تُوُفِّيَتْ خَدِيجَةُ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «§
entries.matn_ar: أُرِيتُ لِخَدِيجَةَ بَيْتًا مِنْ قَصَبٍ لَا صَخَبَ فِيهِ، وَلَا نَصَبَ» وَهُوَ قَصَبُ اللُّؤْلُؤِ
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq told us: Ma'mar told us, from al-Zuhri, from 'Urwa, who said: Khadija died, and the Prophet ﷺ said: "
entries.matn_en: I was shown for Khadija a house of reed in which there is no clamor and no toil." It is the pearl reed.

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنِ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ: بَلَغَ صَفِيَّةَ أَنَّ حَفْصَةَ قَالَتْ: بِنْتُ يَهُودِيٍّ، فَبَكَتْ، فَدَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَهِيَ تَبْكِي، فَقَالَ لَهَا: «مَا شَأْنُكِ؟» ، فَقَالَتْ: قَالَتْ لِي حَفْصَةُ إِنِّي بِنْتُ يَهُودِيٍّ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «§
entries.matn_ar: إِنَّكِ لَبِنْتُ نَبِيٍّ، وَإِنَّكِ لَتَحْتَ نَبِيٍّ، فَبِمَ تَفْخَرُ عَلَيْكِ؟» ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: «اتَّقِي اللَّهَ يَا حَفْصَةُ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq told us: Ma'mar told us, from Thabit, from Anas, who said: It reached Safiyya that Hafsa had said: "A Jew's daughter," and she wept. The Prophet ﷺ came in to her while she was weeping and said to her: "What is the matter with you?" She said: "Hafsa said to me that I am the daughter of a Jew." The Prophet ﷺ said: "
entries.matn_en: You are the daughter of a prophet, and you are married to a prophet. So what can she boast of over you?" Then he said: "Fear God, Hafsa."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، قَالَ: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ شَاكِيًا، وَعِنْدَهُ أَزْوَاجُهُ، فَقَالَتْ صَفِيَّةُ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، لَوَدِدْتُ أَنَّ الَّذِي بِكَ بِي، قَالَ: فَتَغَامَزَ بِهَا أَزْوَاجُ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «§
entries.matn_ar: أَعِبْتُنَّهَا، فَوَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ إِنَّهَا لَصَادِقَةٌ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq told us: Ma'mar told us, from Zayd b. Aslam, who said: The Prophet ﷺ was ill, and his wives were with him. Safiyya said: "Messenger of God, I wish that what afflicts you afflicted me." The wives of the Prophet ﷺ winked at one another about her, and the Prophet ﷺ said: "
entries.matn_en: Do you mock her? By the One in whose hand is my soul, she is truthful."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْعَاصِ: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ اسْتَعْذَرَ أَبَا بَكْرٍ مِنْ عَائِشَةَ، وَلَمْ يَخْشَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَنْ يَنَالَهَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ بِالَّذِي نَالَهَا، قَالَ: فَرَفَعَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ بِيَدِهِ فَلَطَمَ فِي صَدْرِ عَائِشَةَ، فَوَجَدَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَقَالَ لِأَبِي بَكْرٍ: «§
entries.matn_ar: مَا أَنَا بِمُسْتَعْذِرِكَ مِنْهَا بَعْدَ فَعْلَتِكَ هَذِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, from Yahya b. Sa'id ibn al-'As: The Prophet ﷺ appealed to Abu Bakr concerning 'A'isha, and the Prophet ﷺ had not feared that Abu Bakr would do to her what he did. Abu Bakr raised his hand and slapped 'A'isha on the chest, and the Prophet ﷺ was displeased at that and said to Abu Bakr: "
entries.matn_en: I will not appeal to you against her after this deed of yours."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ مَعْمَرٌ: وَأَخْبَرَنِي رَجُلٌ، مِنْ عَبْدِ الْقَيْسِ: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ
