entries.matn_ar: دَعَا أَبَا بَكْرٍ فَاسْتَعْذَرَهُ مِنْ عَائِشَةَ، فَبَيْنَا هُمَا عِنْدَهُ، قَالَتْ: إِنَّكَ لَتَقُولُ إِنَّكَ لَنَبِيُّ، فَقَامَ إِلَيْهَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ فَضَرَبَ خَدَّهَا، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «§مَهْ يَا أَبَا بَكْرٍ، مَا لِهَذَا دَعَوْنَاكَ»
entries.isnad_en: Ma'mar said: A man from 'Abd al-Qays told me that the Prophet ﷺ
entries.matn_en: called Abu Bakr and appealed to him concerning 'A'isha. While they were with him she said: "You say that you are a prophet!" Abu Bakr rose to her and struck her cheek. The Prophet ﷺ said: "Stop, Abu Bakr! It was not for this that we called you."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ: اجْتَمَعْنَ أَزْوَاجُ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَأَرْسَلْنَ فَاطِمَةَ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَقُلْنَ لَهَا: قُولِي لَهُ: إِنَّ نِسَاءَكَ قَدِ اجْتَمَعْنَ، وَهُنَّ يَنْشُدْنَكَ الْعَدْلَ فِي بِنْتِ أَبِي قُحَافَةَ، قَالَتْ: فَدَخَلْتُ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَهُوَ مَعَ عَائِشَةَ فِي مِرْطِهَا، فَقاُلْتُ لَهُ: إِنَّ نِسَاءَكَ أَرْسَلْنَنِي إِلَيْكَ وَهُنُّ يَنْشُدْنَكَ الْعَدْلَ فِي بِنْتِ أَبِي قُحَافَةَ، فَقَالَ لَهَا النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «§
entries.matn_ar: أَتُحِبِّينَنِي؟» ، قَالَتْ: نَعَمْ، قَالَ: «فَأَحِبِّيهَا» ، قَالَ: فَرَجَعْتُ إِلَيْهِمْ، فَأَخْبَرْتُهُنَّ مَا قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَقُلْنَ إِنَّكِ لَمْ تَصْنَعِي شَيْئًا، فَارْجِعِي إِلَيْهِ، قَالَتْ فَاطِمَةُ: وَاللَّهِ لَا أَرْجِعُ إِلَيْهِ فِيهَا أَبَدًا، قَالَ الزُّهْرِيُّ: وَكَانَتْ بِنْتَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ حَقًّا، فَأَرْسَلْنَ زَيْنَبَ بِنْتَ جَحْشٍ، قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ: وَهِيَ الَّتِي كَانَتْ تُسَامِينِي مِنْ أَزْوَاجِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَأَتَتِ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَتْ: إِنَّ أَزْوَاجَكَ أَرْسَلْنَنِي إِلَيْكَ وَهُنَّ يَنْشُدْنَكَ الْعَدْلَ فِي بِنْتِ أَبِي قُحَافَةَ، قَالَتْ: ثُمَّ أَقْبَلَتْ عَلَيَّ فَشَتَمَتْنِي، قَالَتْ: فَجَعَلْتُ أُرَاقِبُ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَأَنْظُرُ طَرْفَهُ، هَلْ يَأْذَنُ لِي فِي أَنْ أَنْتَصِرَ مِنْهَا، قَالَتْ: فَلَمْ يَتَكَلَّمْ، فَشَتَمَتْنِي حَتَّى ظَنَنْتُ أَنَّهُ لَا يَكْرَهُ أَنْ أَنْتَصِرَ مِنْهَا، فَاسْتَقْبَلْتُهَا، فَلَمْ أَلْبَثْ أَنْ أَفْحَمْتُهَا، فَقَالَ لَهَا النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «إِنَّهَا ابْنَةُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ» ، قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ: «وَلَمْ أَرَ امْرَأَةً خَيْرًا، وَأَكْثَرَ صَدَقَةً، وَأَوْصَلَ لِلرَّحِمِ، وَأَبْذَلَ لِنَفْسِهَا فِي كُلِّ شَيْءٍ يُتَقَرَّبُ بِهِ إِلَى اللَّهِ مِنْ زَيْنَبَ، مَا عَدَا سَوْرَةً مِنْ غَرْبَةِ حَدٍّ كَانَ فِيهَا يُوشِكُ مِنْهَا الْفِيئَةُ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, from 'Urwa, from 'A'isha, who said: The wives of the Prophet ﷺ gathered together and sent Fatima to the Prophet ﷺ. They said to her: "Say to him: 'Your women have gathered and they implore you for fairness regarding the daughter of Abu Quhafa.'" She said: I went in to the Prophet ﷺ while he was with 'A'isha under her wrap, and I said to him: "Your wives sent me to you, and they implore you for fairness regarding the daughter of Abu Quhafa." The Prophet ﷺ said to her: "
entries.matn_en:
Do you love me?" She said: "Yes." He said: "Then love her." She said: I returned to them and told them what the Prophet ﷺ had said. They said: "You have accomplished nothing; go back to him." Fatima said: "By God, I will never go back to him about her." Al-Zuhri said: "She was truly the daughter of the Messenger of God ﷺ."

So they sent Zaynab bint Jahsh. 'A'isha said: "She was the one among the wives of the Prophet ﷺ who rivaled me." She came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: "Your wives sent me to you, and they implore you for fairness regarding the daughter of Abu Quhafa." 'A'isha said: Then she turned to me and reviled me. I kept watching the Prophet ﷺ and looking at his eye, to see whether he would permit me to retaliate against her. He did not speak, and she reviled me until I thought that he would not mind my retaliating. So I faced her and it was not long before I had silenced her. The Prophet ﷺ said to her: "She is the daughter of Abu Bakr." 'A'isha said: "I have not seen a woman better, more charitable, more mindful of kinship ties, or more self-sacrificing in everything by which one draws near to God than Zaynab, except for a sharpness of temper in her, from which she would quickly return."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كُنْتُ عِنْدَ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ، فَكَأَنَّهُ تَنَاوَلَ عَائِشَةَ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ: يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، أَلَا أُحَدِّثُكَ عَنْ رَجُلٍ مِنْ أَهْلِ الشَّامِ كَانَ قَدْ أُوتِيَ حِكْمَةً؟ قَالَ: مَنْ هُوَ؟ قُلْتُ: هُوَ أَبُو مُسْلِمٍ الْخَوْلَانِيُّ، وَسَمِعَ أَهْلَ الشَّامِ كَأَنَّهُمْ يَتَنَاوَلُونَ مِنْ عَائِشَةَ، فَقَالَ: «§أُخْبِرُكُمْ بِمَثَلِكُمْ وَمَثَلِ أُمِّكُمْ هَذِهِ، كَمَثَلِ عَيْنَيْنِ فِي رَأْسٍ تُؤْذِيَانِ صَاحِبَهُمَا، وَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ يُعَاقِبَهُمَا إِلَّا بِالَّذِي هُوَ خَيْرٌ لَهُمَا» ، قَالَ: فَسَكَتَ، قَالَ الزُّهْرِيُّ: أَخْبَرَنِيهِ أَبُو إِدْرِيسَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُسْلِمٍ الْخَوْلَانِيِّ
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, who said:
entries.matn_en: I was with al-Walid b. 'Abd al-Malik, and it was as if he spoke ill of 'A'isha. I said to him: "Commander of the Faithful, shall I tell you about a man of Syria who had been given wisdom?" He said: "Who is he?" I said: "Abu Muslim al-Khawlani." He had heard the Syrians seeming to speak ill of 'A'isha, and he said: "I will tell you of your likeness and the likeness of this mother of yours. It is like two eyes in a head that hurt their owner, who cannot punish them except by what is best for them." He fell silent. Al-Zuhri said: Abu Idris told me this from Abu Muslim al-Khawlani.

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سَرْجِسَ، قَالَ: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذَا خَرَجَ مُسَافِرًا يَقُولُ: «§
entries.matn_ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ، وَكَآبَةِ الْمُنْقَلَبِ، وَالْحَوْرِ بَعْدَ الْكَوْرِ، وَسُوءِ الْمَنْظَرِ فِي الْأَهْلِ وَالْمَالِ» قُلْنَا لِعَبْدِ الرَّزَّاقِ: مَا الْحَوْرُ بَعْدَ الْكَوْرِ؟ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ مَعْمَرًا يَقُولُ: «هُوَ الْكِسَاءُ» ، قُلْنَا: وَمَا الْكِسَاءُ؟ قَالَ: «هُوَ الرَّجُلُ يَكُونُ صَالِحًا، ثُمَّ يَتَحَوَّلُ فَيَكُونُ امْرَأَ سُوءٍ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from 'Asim, from 'Abdullah b. Sarjis, who said: When the Prophet ﷺ set out on a journey he would say: "
entries.matn_en: O God, I seek refuge in You from the hardship of travel, the gloom of return, decline after increase, and an evil sight in family and wealth." We said to 'Abd al-Razzaq: "What is 'decline after increase'?" He said: I heard Ma'mar say: "It is al-kisa'." We said: "What is al-kisa'?" He said: "A man who is righteous and then changes and becomes a bad man."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ: قَالَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ: «§
entries.matn_ar: سَافِرُوا تَصِحُّوا»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq told us: Ma'mar told us, from Ibn Tawus, from his father, who said: 'Umar b. al-Khattab said: "
entries.matn_en: Travel and you will be healthy."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي زِيَادٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، قَالَ: صَحِبْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ فَكَانَ إِذَا طَلَعَ الْفَجْرُ رَفَعَ صَوْتَهُ فَقَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: سَمِعَ سَامِعٌ بِحَمْدِ اللَّهِ وَنِعْمَتِهِ وَحُسْنِ بَلَائِهِ عَلَيْنَا، اللَّهُمَّ صَاحِبْنَا فَأَفْضِلْ عَلَيْنَا، اللَّهُمَّ عَائِذٌ بِكَ مِنْ جَهَنَّمَ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq told us: Ma'mar told us, from Yazid b. Abi Ziyad, from Mujahid, who said: I accompanied Ibn 'Umar, and when dawn broke he would raise his voice and say: "
entries.matn_en: A listener has heard of God's praise, His favor and His good trial of us. O God, accompany us and bestow upon us. O God, we seek refuge in You from Hell."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ، §
entries.matn_ar: كَرِهَ أَنْ يُسَافِرَ الرَّجُلُ وَحْدَهُ، وَقَالَ: «أَرَأَيْتُمْ إِنْ مَاتَ مَنْ أَسْأَلُ عَنْهُ؟»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Qatada, that 'Umar b. al-Khattab
entries.matn_en: disliked a man's traveling alone, and said: "Do you see, if he dies, whom do I ask about him?"

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: قَامَ سَعْدُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ يَبُولُ ثُمَّ رَجَعَ، فَقَالَ: إِنِّي لَأَجِدُ فِي ظَهْرِي شَيْئًا» ، فَلَمْ يَلْبَثْ أَنْ مَاتَ، فَنَاحَتْهُ الْجِنُّ فَقَالُوا: [البحر السريع] قَتَلْنَا سَيِّدَ الْخَزْرَجِ ... سَعْدَ بْنَ عُبَادَهْ رَمَيْنَاهُ بِسَهْمَيْنِ ... فَلَمْ نُخْطِ فُؤَادَهْ
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Qatada, who said: "

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، قَالَ: قَالَ أَصْحَابُ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِنَّهُ يَمْرَضُ الرَّجُلُ الَّذِي كُنَّا نَرَى أَنَّهُ صَالِحٌ، فَيَشْتَدُّ عَلَيْهِ عِنْدَ مَوْتِهِ، وَيَمْرَضُ الَّذِي كُنَّا لَا نَرَى فِيهِ خَيْرًا، فَيُهَوَّنَ عَلَيْهِ عِنْدَ مَوْتِهِ، فَقَالَ: «إِنَّ §
entries.matn_ar: الْمُؤْمِنَ يَبْقَى عَلَيْهِ مِنْ ذُنُوبِهِ عِنْدَ مَوْتِهِ، فَيَشْتَدُّ عَلَيْهِ بِهَا، لِأَنْ يَلْقَى اللَّهَ وَلَا حَسَنَةَ لَهُ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq told us: Ma'mar told us, from Qatada, who said: The Companions of the Prophet ﷺ said: "The man we thought righteous falls sick and it is severe upon him at his death, while the man in whom we saw no good falls sick and it is made easy for him at his death." He said: "
entries.matn_en: The believer has some of his sins remaining at his death, so it is made severe on him because of them, [while the other] will meet God with no good deed to his name." [The last clause is elliptical.]

sections.title_en: The Likeness of the Believer Who Does Not Read the Qurʾān
sections.title_ar: بَابُ مَثَلِ الْمُؤْمِنِ الَّذِي لَا يَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنِ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ: أَحْسِبُهُ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى الْأَشْعَرِيِّ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: مَثَلُ الْمُؤْمِنِ الَّذِي يَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ مَثَلُ الْأُتْرُجَّةِ طَعْمُهَا طَيِّبٌ وَرِيحُهَا طَيِّبٌ، وَمَثَلُ الْمُؤْمِنِ الَّذِي لَا يَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ كَمَثَلِ التَّمْرَةِ طَعْمُهَا طَيِّبٌ وَلَا رِيحَ لَهَا، وَمَثَلُ الْمُنَافِقِ الَّذِي يَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ كَمَثَلِ الرَّيْحَانِ رِيحُهُ طَيِّبٌ وَلَيْسَ لَهُ طَعْمٌ، وَمَثَلُ الْمُنَافِقِ الَّذِي لَا يَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ كَمَثَلِ الْحَنْظَلَةِ رِيحُهَا مُنْتِنٌ وَطَعْمُهَا مُنْتِنٌ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq told us: Ma'mar told us, from Qatada, from Anas (he said: I think from Abu Musa al-Ash'ari), that the Messenger of God ﷺ said: "
entries.matn_en: The likeness of the believer who reads the Qur'an is that of the citron: its taste is good and its scent is good. The likeness of the believer who does not read the Qur'an is that of the date: its taste is good and it has no scent. The likeness of the hypocrite who reads the Qur'an is that of basil: its scent is good and it has no taste. The likeness of the hypocrite who does not read the Qur'an is that of the colocynth: its smell is foul and its taste is foul."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ يَزْدَوَيْهِ، عَنْ يَعْفُرَ بْنِ رُوذِيٍّ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ عُبَيْدَ بْنَ عُمَيْرٍ وَهُوَ يَقُصُّ يَقُولُ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «
entries.matn_ar: مَثَلُ الْمُنَافِقِ كَمَثَلِ الشَّاةِ الرَّابِضَةِ بَيْنَ الْغَنَمَيْنِ» ، فَقَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ: وَيْلَكُمْ لَا تَكْذِبُوا عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «§مَثَلُ الْمُنَافِقِ كَمَثَلِ الشَّاةِ الْبَاعِرَةِ بَيْنَ الْغَنَمَيْنِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from 'Uthman b. Yazdawayh, from Ya'fur b. Rudhi, who said: I heard 'Ubayd b. 'Umayr preaching, saying: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "
entries.matn_en: The likeness of the hypocrite is that of the ewe lying down between two flocks." Ibn 'Umar said: "Woe to you, do not lie about the Messenger of God ﷺ! 'The likeness of the hypocrite is that of the ba'ira ewe between two flocks.'" [The usual wording is 'a'ira, "wandering"; the text here reads ba'ira.]

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «§
entries.matn_ar: لَا حِلْفَ فِي الْإِسْلَامِ، وَتَمَسَّكُوا بِحِلْفِ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "
entries.matn_en: There is no alliance in Islam, and hold fast to the alliances of the pre-Islamic period."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ هَمَّامٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ يَقُولُ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «§
entries.matn_ar: لَا يَسُبَّ أَحَدُكُمُ الدَّهْرَ، فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الدَّهْرُ، وَلَا يَقُلْ أَحَدُكُمْ لِلْعِنَبِ الْكَرْمَ، فَإِنَّ الْكَرْمَ الرَّجُلُ الْمُسْلِمُ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Hammam, that he heard Abu Hurayra say: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "
entries.matn_en: Let none of you curse time, for God is time. And let none of you call the grape karm, for the karm is the Muslim man."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، وَأَخْبَرَنِي أَيُّوبُ، عَنِ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar; and Ayyub told me, from Ibn Sirin, from Abu Hurayra, from the Prophet ﷺ. [Only the chain is given; the text is not quoted.]

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ: «قَالَ اللَّهُ: §
entries.matn_ar: يُؤْذِينِي ابْنُ آدَمَ يَقُولُ: يَا خَيْبَةَ الدَّهْرِ، فَلَا يَقُولَنَّ أَحَدُكُمْ يَا خَيْبَةَ الدَّهْرِ، فَإِنِّي أَنَا الدَّهْرُ أُقَلِّبُهُ لَيْلَهُ وَنَهَارَهُ، فَإِذَا شِئْتُ قَبَضْتُهُمَا»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, from Ibn al-Musayyab, from Abu Hurayra, from the Prophet ﷺ, who said: "God said: '
entries.matn_en: The son of Adam harms Me: he says, "O the misfortune of time!" So let none of you say "O the misfortune of time," for I am time. I turn over its night and day, and when I wish I will seize them both.'"

sections.title_en: Greasy Residue and Boasting of the People of the Pre-Islamic Period

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «§
entries.matn_ar: مَنْ نَامَ وَفِي يَدِهِ رِيحُ غَمَرٍ فَأَصَابَهُ شَيْءٌ، فَلَا يَلُومَنَّ إِلَّا نَفْسَهُ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, from 'Ubaydullah b. 'Abdillah, who said: The Prophet ﷺ said: "
entries.matn_en: Whoever sleeps with the smell of greasy meat residue on his hand and something befalls him should blame no one but himself."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْكَرِيمِ الْجَزَرِيِّ، قَالَ: وَجَدَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مِنْ رَجُلٍ رِيحَ غَمَرٍ، فَقَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: هَلَّا غَسَلْتَ مِنْهُ يَدَكَ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from 'Abd al-Karim al-Jazari, who said: The Prophet ﷺ detected the smell of greasy residue on a man and said: "
entries.matn_en: Why did you not wash your hand of it?"

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «§
entries.matn_ar: لَا تَفْخَرُوا بِآبَائِكُمُ الَّذِينَ هَلَكُوا فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ، فَوَاللَّهِ لَلْجُعَلُ يُدَهْدِهُ الْخُرْءَ عِنْدَ مَنْخَرِهِ خَيْرٌ مِنْهُمْ، وَمَثَلُ ذَلِكَ كَمَثَلِ مَلِكٍ ابْتَنَى دَارًا، وَصَنَعَ طَعَامًا، وَجَعَلَ يَدْعُو النَّاسَ إِلَى طَعَامِهِ، فَبَعَثَ مَلِكًا عَلَيْهِ ثِيَابٌ رَثَّةٌ، فَدَخَلَ فَجَعَلُوا يَدْفَعُونَهُ يَقُولُونَ لَهُ: اخْرُجْ، فَقَالَ: أَلَيْسَ إِنَّمَا صَنَعْتُمْ طَعَامَكُمْ هَذَا لِيَأْكُلَهُ النَّاسُ؟ قَالُوا: بَلَى، وَلَكِنَّ مِثْلَكَ لَا يَأْكُلُهُ، إِنَّمَا يَأْكُلُ طَعَامَ الْمَلِكِ الْأَبْرَارُ، قَالَ: فَخَرَجَ، ثُمَّ رَجَعَ وَعَلَيْهِ هَيْئَةٌ حَسَنَةٌ فَمَرَّ بِهِمْ، وَلَمْ يَدْخُلْ، فَاشْتَدُّوا إِلَيْهِ - أَوْ قَالَ: ابْتَدَرُوا إِلَيْهِ - يَدَعُونَهُ فَأَبَى أَنْ يَأْتِيَ مَعَهُمْ، فَقَالُوا: إِنَّكَ إِنْ لَمْ تَأْتِ مَعَنَا ضَرَبَنَا الْمَلِكُ إِنْ أُخْبِرَ أَنَّكَ مَرَرْتَ هَاهُنَا، قَالَ: فَجَعَلَ يَغْمِسُ ثِيَابَهُ فِي الطَّعَامِ فَذَلِكَ مَثَلُهُمْ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Ayyub, from 'Ikrima, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "
entries.matn_en: Do not boast of your fathers who perished in the pre-Islamic period. By God, the dung beetle rolling dung by its nostril is better than they. The likeness of that is that of a king who built a house, prepared food, and began inviting people to his food. He sent a king in worn clothes, who entered, and they began to push him away, saying to him: 'Get out!' He said: 'Did you not make this food of yours for people to eat?' They said: 'Yes, but one like you does not eat it. Only the righteous eat the king's food.' So he left, then came back in fine appearance and passed by them without entering. They rushed to him (or he said: hastened to him), inviting him, but he refused to come with them. They said: 'If you do not come with us, the king will beat us if he is told that you passed by here.' So he began dipping his clothes in the food. That is their likeness."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، وَعَلِيِّ بْنِ زَيْدِ بْنِ جُدْعَانَ قَالَا: كَانَ بَيْنَ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ وَسَلْمَانَ الْفَارِسِيِّ شَيْءٌ، فَقَالَ سَعْدٌ وَهُمْ فِي مَجْلِسٍ: انْتَسِبْ يَا فُلَانُ، فَانْتَسَبَ، ثُمَّ قَالَ لِلْآخَرِ، ثُمَّ لِلْآخَرِ، حَتَّى بَلَغَ سَلْمَانَ، فَقَالَ: انْتَسِبْ يَا سَلْمَانُ، قَالَ: مَا أَعْرِفُ لِي أَبًا فِي الْإِسْلَامِ، وَلَكِنِّي سَلْمَانُ ابْنُ الْإِسْلَامِ، فَنَمَى ذَلِكَ إِلَى عُمَرَ، فَقَالَ عُمَرُ لِسَعْدٍ وَلَقِيَهُ: «انْتَسِبْ يَا سَعْدُ» ، فَقَالَ: أُشْهِدُكَ اللَّهَ يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، قَالَ: وَكَأَنَّهُ عَرَفَ، فَأَبَى أَنْ يَدَعَهُ حَتَّى انْتَسَبَ، ثُمَّ قَالَ لِلْآخَرِ حَتَّى بَلَغَ سَلْمَانَ، فَقَالَ: «انْتَسِبْ يَا سَلْمَانُ» ، فَقَالَ: أَنْعَمَ اللَّهُ عَلَيَّ بِالْإِسْلَامِ، فَأَنَا سَلْمَانُ ابْنُ الْإِسْلَامِ، قَالَ عُمَرُ: «قَدْ عَلِمَتْ قُرَيْشٌ أَنَّ الْخَطَّابَ كَانَ أَعَزَّهُمْ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ، وَأَنَا عُمَرُ ابْنُ الْإِسْلَامِ أَخُو سَلْمَانَ فِي الْإِسْلَامِ، أَمَا وَاللَّهِ لَوْلَا لَعَاقَبْتُكَ عُقُوبَةً يَسْمَعُ بِهَا أَهْلُ الْأَمْصَارِ، أَمَا عَلِمْتَ - أَوَمَا سَمِعْتَ - §
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَجُلًا انْتَمَى إِلَى تِسْعَةِ آبَاءٍ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ، فَكَانَ عَاشِرُهُمْ فِي النَّارِ، وَانْتَمَى رَجُلٌ إِلَى رَجُلٍ فِي الْإِسْلَامِ، وَتَرَكَ مَا فَوْقَ ذَلِكَ، فَكَانَ مَعَهُ فِي الْجَنَّةِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Qatada and 'Ali b. Zayd b. Jud'an, who both said: There was something between Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas and Salman al-Farisi. Sa'd said in an assembly: "Trace your lineage, so-and-so," and he did, then he said it to another, and another, until he reached Salman. He said: "Trace your lineage, Salman." He said: "I know no father of mine in Islam, but I am Salman, son of Islam." This reached 'Umar. When he met Sa'd, 'Umar said to him: "Trace your lineage, Sa'd." He said: "I ask you by God, Commander of the Faithful." (He said: it was as if he knew.) But 'Umar refused to let him go until he traced his lineage. Then he said it to the next, until he reached Salman, and said: "Trace your lineage, Salman." He said: "God blessed me with Islam, so I am Salman, son of Islam." 'Umar said: "Quraysh knew that al-Khattab was the mightiest of them in the pre-Islamic period, and I am 'Umar, son of Islam, brother of Salman in Islam. By God, were it not for [that], I would have punished you with a punishment that the people of the cities would hear of. Did you not know, or did you not hear,
entries.matn_en: that a man ascribed himself to nine fathers in the pre-Islamic period, and the tenth of them was in the Fire, while another man ascribed himself to a man in Islam and left aside whatever was above that, and he was with him in Paradise?"

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، «أَنَّ §
entries.matn_ar: الْأَنْصَارَ تَلَقَّتْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ حِينَ قَدِمَ الْمَدِينَةَ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, from 'Urwa b. al-Zubayr: "
entries.matn_en: The Ansar went out to meet the Messenger of God ﷺ when he came to Medina."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ وَاثِلَةَ، أَنَّ نَافِعَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الْحَارِثِ،
entries.matn_ar: تَلَقَّى عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ إِلَى عُسْفَانَ، فَقَالَ لَهُ عُمَرُ: مَنِ اسْتَخْلَفْتَ عَلَى أَهْلِ الْوَادِي؟ - يَعْنِي أَهْلَ مَكَّةَ - قَالَ: ابْنَ أَبْزَى، قَالَ: مَنِ ابْنُ أَبْزَى؟ قَالَ: رَجُلٌ مِنْ مَوَالِيَّ، قَالَ: اسْتَخْلَفْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ مَوْلًى؟ قَالَ: إِنَّهُ قَارِئٌ لِكِتَابِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ: أَمَا إِنَّ نَبِيَّكُمْ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ: «إِنَّ §اللَّهَ يَرْفَعُ بِهَذَا الْقُرْآنِ أَقْوَامًا وَيَضَعُ بِهِ آخَرِينَ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, who said: 'Amr b. Wathila told me that Nafi' b. 'Abd al-Harith
entries.matn_en: went out to meet 'Umar b. al-Khattab at 'Usfan. 'Umar said to him: "Whom did you appoint over the people of the valley?" (meaning the people of Mecca). He said: "Ibn Abza." He said: "Who is Ibn Abza?" He said: "A man from among my freedmen." He said: "You appointed a freedman over them?" He said: "He is a reciter of the Book of God." He said: "Your Prophet ﷺ said: 'God raises some peoples by means of this Qur'an and lowers others by it.'"

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْجَحْشِيِّ، عَنْ بَعْضِ أَشْيَاخِهِمْ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ
entries.matn_ar: انْطَلَقَ إِلَى رَجُلٍ مِنَ الْأَنْصَارِ يَلْتَمِسُهُ، فَلَمْ يَجِدْهُ فَجَلَسَ حَتَّى جَاءَ الرَّجُلُ، فَلَمَّا رَأَى النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَضَعَ فِي وَسَطِهِ حَبْلًا، ثُمَّ ارْتَقَى نَخْلَةً لَهُ فَقَطَعَ مِنْهَا عَذْقًا، فَقَرَّبَهُ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، ثُمَّ دَخَلَ غَنَمَهُ فَأَخَذَ شَاةً لِيَذْبَحَهَا، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «اجْتَنِبِ الدَّرَّ» ، قَالَ: فَقَالَ لَهُ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ حِينَ فَرَغَ: «إِذَا جَاءَنَا سَبْيٌ فَأْتِنَا» ، قَالَ: فَجَاءَ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ سَبْيٌ، فَقَسَمَهُ بَيْنَ النَّاسِ حَتَّى لَمْ يَبْقَ عِنْدَهُ إِلَّا عَبْدَانِ، فَجَاءَ الْأَنْصَارِيُّ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «اخْتَرْ أَيَّهُمَا شِئْتَ» ، قَالَ: بَلْ أَنْتَ، فَخِرْ لِي يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، قَالَ: فَمَسَحَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِحْدَى يَدَيْهِ عَلَى الْأُخْرَى مَرَّتَيْنِ وَهُوَ يَقُولُ: «§الْمُسْتَشَارُ أَمِينٌ الْمُسْتَشَارُ أَمِينٌ خُذْ هَذَا - لِأَحَدِهِمَا - فَإِنِّي قَدْ رَأَيْتُهُ يُصَلِّي»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Sa'id ibn 'Abd al-Rahman al-Jahshi, from some of their elders, that the Messenger of God ﷺ
entries.matn_en: went to a man of the Ansar looking for him, and did not find him, so he sat until the man came. When the man saw the Prophet ﷺ he tied a rope around his waist, climbed one of his palm trees and cut off a date cluster and brought it close to the Prophet ﷺ. Then he went into his flock and took a sheep to slaughter. The Prophet ﷺ said: "Avoid the milch ones." When he had finished, the Prophet ﷺ said to him: "When captives come to us, come to us." Then captives came to the Prophet ﷺ and he distributed them among the people until only two male slaves were left with him. The Ansari came, and the Prophet ﷺ said: "Choose whichever of them you wish." He said: "No, you, Messenger of God, choose for me." The Prophet ﷺ rubbed one hand over the other twice, saying: "The one consulted is trusted. The one consulted is trusted. Take this one" (of one of them), "for I have seen him pray."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كَانَ مَجْلِسُ عُمَرَ مُغْتَصًّا مِنَ الْقُرَّاءِ شَبَابًا كَانُوا أَوْ كُهُولًا، فَرُبَّمَا اسْتَشَارَهُمْ فَيَقُولُ: «§لَا يَمْنَعُ أَحَدًا مِنْكُمْ حَدَاثَةُ سِنِّهِ أَنْ يُشِيرَ بِرَأْيِهِ، فَإِنَّ الْعِلْمَ لَيْسَ عَلَى حَدَاثَةِ السِّنِّ وَلَا قِدَمِهِ، وَلَكِنَّ اللَّهَ يَضَعُهُ حَيْثُ شَاءَ» ، قَالَ: وَكَانَ يُجَالِسُهُ ابْنُ أَخٍ لِعُيَيْنَةَ بْنِ حِصْنٍ قَالَ: فَجَاءَ عُيَيْنَةُ إِلَى عُمَرَ فَقَالَ: وَاللَّهِ مَا تَقُولُ الْعَدْلَ، وَلَا تُعْطِي الْجَزْلَ، قَالَ: فَهَمَّ عُمَرُ بِهِ، فَقَالَ ابْنُ أَخِيهِ: يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَقُولُ: {خُذِ الْعَفْوَ وَأْمُرْ بِالْعُرْفِ وَأَعْرِضْ عَنِ الْجَاهِلِينَ} [الأعراف: ١٩٩] ، وَإِنَّ هَذَا مِنَ الْجَاهِلِينَ، قَالَ: فَتَرَكَهُ عُمَرُ، فَلَمَّا وُلِّيَ عُثْمَانُ جَاءَهُ عُيَيْنَةُ فَقَالَ: إِنَّ عُمَرَ أَعْطَانَا فَأَغْنَانَا فَاتَّقَانَا
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, who said:
entries.matn_en: 'Umar's assembly was crowded with Qur'an reciters, whether young or middle-aged, and he would sometimes consult them, saying: "Let not the youth of anyone among you prevent him from offering his opinion, for knowledge does not depend on youth or age, but God places it wherever He wills." A nephew of 'Uyayna b. Hisn used to sit with him. 'Uyayna came to 'Umar and said: "By God, you do not speak justly, and you do not give generously." 'Umar was about to act against him, but his nephew said: "Commander of the Faithful, God says: 'Take what is easy, enjoin what is right, and turn away from the ignorant' [7:199], and this man is among the ignorant." So 'Umar left him. When 'Uthman took office, 'Uyayna came to him and said: "'Umar gave us and enriched us, so he guarded against us." [The last phrase, fa-ttaqana, is ambiguous.]

sections.title_en: Kissing the Head and the Hand, and Other Matters
sections.title_ar: بَابُ تَقْبِيلِ الرَّأْسِ وَالْيَدِ وَغَيْرِ ذَلِكَ

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ، قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: لَوْلَا أَنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ §قَبَّلَ رَأْسَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، لَرَأَيْتُ أَنَّهَا مِنْ أَخْلَاقِ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq told us: Ma'mar told us, from 'Asim, from Ibn Sirin, who said: "
entries.matn_en: Had Abu Bakr not kissed the head of the Messenger of God ﷺ, I would have considered it among the manners of the pre-Islamic period."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، قَالَ: كَانَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ يُحَدِّثُ، «أَنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ §
entries.matn_ar: كَشَفَ وَجْهَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ ثُمَّ أَكَبَّ عَلَيْهِ فَقَبَّلَهُ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq told us: Ma'mar told us, from al-Zuhri, from Abu Salama, who said: Ibn 'Abbas used to narrate "that Abu Bakr
entries.matn_en: uncovered the face of the Messenger of God ﷺ, then bent over him and kissed it."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، قَالَ: كَانَ يُقَالُ: «§
entries.matn_ar: نِعِمَّا لِلْعَبْدِ أَنْ يَكُونَ عَفَلَتُهُ فِيمَا أَحَلَّ اللَّهُ لَهُ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq told us: Ma'mar told us, from Qatada, who said: It used to be said: "
entries.matn_en: How good for a servant that his heedless diversion be in what God has made lawful for him." [The word is written 'afalatuhu; probably ghaflatuhu.]

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ عِيسَى بْنِ حِطَّانَ، عَنْ مُسْلِمِ بْنِ سَلَّامٍ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ طَلْقٍ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ: «§
entries.matn_ar: إِذَا فَسَا أَحَدُكُمْ فَلْيَتَوَضَّأْ، وَلَا تَأْتُوا النِّسَاءَ فِي أَسْتَاهِهَا إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَسْتَحْيِي مِنَ الْحَقِّ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq told us: Ma'mar told us, from 'Asim, from 'Isa b. Hittan, from Muslim b. Sallam, from 'Ali b. Talq, who said: I heard the Messenger of God ﷺ say: "
entries.matn_en: When one of you passes wind, let him perform ablution. And do not approach women in their rear passages; God is not shy of the truth."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ: وَأَخْبَرَنِي سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ دَاوُدَ بْنِ مَاحَانَ، قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: رَأَيْتُ الثَّوْرِيَّ، وَمَعْمَرًا §حِينَ الْتَقَيَا احْتَضَنَا وَقَبَّلَ كُلُّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا صَاحِبَهُ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq said: Sulayman b. Dawud b. Mahan told me, who said: "
entries.matn_en: I saw al-Thawri and Ma'mar when they met: they embraced, and each of them kissed his companion."

sections.title_en: Approaching a Woman in Her Rear

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ سُهَيْلِ بْنِ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ مَخْلَدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «إِنَّ §
entries.matn_ar: الَّذِي يَأْتِي الْمَرْأَةَ فِي دُبُرِهَا لَا يَنْظُرُ اللَّهُ إِلَيْهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq told us: Ma'mar told us, from Suhayl b. Abi Salih, from al-Harith b. Makhlad, from Abu Hurayra, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "God will not look, on the Day of Resurrection, at
entries.matn_en: the man who approaches a woman in her rear."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ: سُئِلَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ عَنِ §
entries.matn_ar: الَّذِي يَأْتِي امْرَأَتَهُ فِي دُبُرِهَا، فَقَالَ: «هَذَا يُسَائِلُنِي عَنِ الْكُفْرِ» ،
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq told us: Ma'mar told us, from Ibn Tawus, from his father, who said: Ibn 'Abbas was asked about
entries.matn_en: a man who approaches his wife in her rear, and he said: "This man is asking me about disbelief."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي مَنْ، سَمِعَ عِكْرِمَةَ يُحَدِّثُ، «
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ ضَرَبَ رَجُلًا فِي مِثْلِ ذَلِكَ» ،
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, who said: One who heard 'Ikrima narrating told me "
entries.matn_en: that 'Umar b. al-Khattab struck a man in a case like that."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: ٢٠٩٥٥ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ ابْنَ الْمُسَيِّبِ، وَأَبَا سَلَمَةَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ ذَلِكَ «
entries.matn_ar: فَكَرِهَاهُ وَنَهَيَانِي عَنْهُ» ،
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, who said: I asked Ibn al-Musayyab and Abu Salama b. 'Abd al-Rahman about that, "
entries.matn_en: and they disliked it and forbade me from it."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَمْرٍو، قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: هِيَ اللُّوطِيَّةُ الصُّغْرَى» ،
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Qatada, that 'Abdullah b. 'Amr said: "
entries.matn_en: It is the lesser sodomy."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ، أَنَّهُ سُئِلَ عَنْ ذَلِكَ، فَقَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: وَهَلْ يَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ إِلَّا كَافِرٌ؟» ،
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Qatada, from Abu al-Darda', that he was asked about that and said: "
entries.matn_en: Does anyone do that except a disbeliever?"

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ لَيْثٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: مَنْ أَتَى ذَلِكَ فَقَدْ كَفَرَ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Layth, from Mujahid, from Abu Hurayra, that he said: "
entries.matn_en: Whoever does that has disbelieved."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ خُثَيْمٍ، عَنْ صَفِيَّةَ بِنْتِ شَيْبَةَ قَالَتْ:
entries.matn_ar: لَمَّا قَدِمَ الْمُهَاجِرُونَ الْمَدِينَةَ أَرَادُوا أَنْ يَأْتُوا النِّسَاءَ فِي أَدْبَارِهِنَّ فِي فُرُوجِهِنَّ، فَأَنْكَرْنَ ذَلِكَ، فَجِئْنَ إِلَى أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ فَذَكَرْنَ لَهَا ذَلِكَ، فَسَأَلَتِ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنْ ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ: {§نِسَاؤُكُمْ حَرْثٌ لَكُمْ فَأْتُوا حَرْثَكُمْ أَنَّى شِئْتُمْ} [البقرة: ٢٢٣] «سِمَامًا وَاحِدًا»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq told us: Ma'mar told us, from Ibn Khuthaym, from Safiyya bint Shayba, who said:
entries.matn_en: When the Emigrants came to Medina they wanted to have intercourse with women from behind, in their vaginas. The women objected to that and came to Umm Salama and told her of it. She asked the Prophet ﷺ about it, and he recited: "Your women are a tilth for you, so come to your tilth however you wish" [2:223], and said: "Through one opening."

sections.title_en: Lifting a Stone, and the Shying of a Mount

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ: مَرَّ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ وَقَدْ ذَهَبَ بَصَرُهُ بِقَوْمٍ يَرْفَعُونَ حَجَرًا، فَقَالَ: «مَا شَأْنُهُمْ؟» ، فَقِيلَ لَهُ: يَرْفَعُونَ حَجَرًا يَنْظُرُونَ أَيُّهُمْ أَقْوَى، فَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ: «§
entries.matn_ar: عُمَّالُ اللَّهِ أَقْوَى مِنْ هَؤُلَاءِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Ibn Tawus, from his father, who said: Ibn 'Abbas, after he had lost his sight, passed by some people lifting a stone and said: "What is the matter with them?" He was told: "They are lifting a stone to see which of them is stronger." Ibn 'Abbas said: "God's
entries.matn_en: workers are stronger than these."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ أَبَانَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ رَكِبَ بَغْلَةً فَنَفَرَتْ بِهِ، فَقَالَ لِرَجُلٍ: «§
entries.matn_ar: امْسَحْهَا وَاقْرَأْ عَلَيْهَا قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Aban, that the Prophet ﷺ rode a mule and it shied with him, and he said to a man: "
entries.matn_en: Stroke it and recite over it: 'Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of the daybreak.'"

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ كَثِيرِ بْنِ أَفْلَحَ، مَوْلَى أَبِي أَيُّوبَ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ: كَانَ ابْنُ سَلَامٍ يَدْخُلُ عَلَى رُءُوسِ قُرَيْشٍ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَأْتِيَ أَهْلَ مِصْرَ، فَيَقُولُ لَهُمْ: «§
entries.matn_ar: لَا تَقْتُلُوا هَذَا الرَّجُلَ» - يَعْنِي عُثْمَانَ - فَيَقُولُونَ وَاللَّهِ مَا نُرِيدُ قَتْلَهُ، قَالَ أَفْلَحُ: فَخَرَجَ وَهُوَ مُتَّكِئٌ عَلَى يَدَيَّ فَيَقُولُ: «وَاللَّهِ لَتَقْتُلُنَّهُ» ، قَالَ: وَقَالَ لَهُمُ ابْنُ سَلَامٍ حِينَ حُصِرَ: «اتْرُكُوا هَذَا الرَّجُلَ أَرْبَعِينَ لَيْلَةً، فَوَاللَّهِ لَئِنْ تَرَكْتُمُوهُ لَيَمُوتَنَّ إِلَيْهَا» ، فَأَبَوْا، ثُمَّ خَرَجَ إِلَيْهِمْ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ بِأَيَّامٍ، فَقَالَ: «اتْرُكُوهُ خَمْسَ عَشْرَةَ، فَوَاللَّهِ لَئِنْ تَرَكْتُمُوهُ لَيَمُوتَنَّ إِلَيْهَا»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq told us: Ma'mar told us, from al-Zuhri, from Kathir b. Aflah, the freedman of Abu Ayyub al-Ansari, from his father, who said: Ibn Salam used to go in to the chiefs of Quraysh before the people of Egypt came, and say to them: "
entries.matn_en: Do not kill this man," meaning 'Uthman. They would say: "By God, we do not want to kill him." Aflah said: He went out leaning on my hands and said: "By God, you will kill him." He said: And Ibn Salam said to them when ['Uthman] was besieged: "Leave this man alone for forty nights; by God, if you leave him alone, he will die within that time." They refused. Then he went out to them some days later and said: "Leave him for fifteen; by God, if you leave him alone he will die within that time."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ هِلَالٍ، قَالَ: قَالَ لَهُمُ ابْنُ سَلَامٍ: «إِنَّ §
entries.matn_ar: الْمَلَائِكَةَ لَمْ تَزَلْ مُحِيطَةً بِمَدِينَتِكُمْ هَذِهِ مُنْذُ قَدِمَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ حَتَّى الْيَوْمِ، فَوَاللَّهِ لَئِنْ قَتَلْتُمُوهُ لَيَذْهَبُنَّ، ثُمَّ لَا يَعُودُوا أَبَدًا، فَوَاللَّهِ لَا يَقْتُلُهُ رَجُلٌ مِنْكُمْ إِلَّا لَقِيَ اللَّهَ أَجْذَمَ لَا يَدَ لَهُ، وَإِنَّ سَيْفَ اللَّهِ لَمْ يَزَلْ مَغْمُودًا عَنْكُمْ، وَإِنَّكُمْ وَاللَّهِ لَئِنْ قَتَلْتُمُوهُ لَيَسُلَّنَّهُ اللَّهُ، ثُمَّ لَا يُغْمِدُهُ عَنْكُمْ - إِمَّا قَالَ: أَبَدًا، وَإِمَّا قَالَ: إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ، وَمَا قُتِلَ نَبِيُّ قَطُّ إِلَّا قُتِلَ بِهِ سَبْعُونَ أَلْفًا، وَلَا خَلِيفَةٌ إِلَّا قُتِلَ بِهِ خَمْسَةٌ وَثَلَاثُونَ أَلْفًا قَبْلَ أَنْ يَجْتَمِعُوا» ، وَذَكَرَ «أَنَّهُ قُتِلَ عَلَى دَمِ يَحْيَى بْنِ زَكَرِيَّا سَبْعُونَ أَلْفًا»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Ayyub, from Humayd b. Hilal, who said: Ibn Salam said to them: "
entries.matn_en: The angels have not ceased to surround this city of yours since the Messenger of God ﷺ came to it until today. By God, if you kill him they will leave and never return. By God, no man among you will kill him but he will meet God leprous, with no hand. The sword of God has remained sheathed against you, and by God, if you kill him God will draw it and will not sheathe it against you (either he said 'ever' or he said 'until the Day of Resurrection'). No prophet was ever killed but seventy thousand were killed on his account, and no caliph but thirty-five thousand were killed on his account before they became united." And he mentioned "that seventy thousand were killed for the blood of Yahya b. Zakariyya."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَمَّنْ سَمِعَ ابْنَ سِيرِينَ يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: بَعَثَ عُثْمَانُ سَلِيطَ بْنَ سَلِيطٍ، وَعَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ عَتَّابِ بْنِ أُسَيْدٍ فَقَالَ: اذْهَبَا إِلَى ابْنِ سَلَامٍ فَتَنَكَّرَا لَهُ كَأَنَّكُمَا أَتَاوِيَّانِ، فَقُولَا لَهُ: إِنَّهُ كَانَ مِنْ أَمْرِ النَّاسِ مَا قَدْ تَرَى، فَبِمَ تَأْمُرُنَا؟ فَأَتَيَا ابْنَ سَلَامٍ فَقَالَا لَهُ نَحْوَ مَقَالَتِهِ، فَقَالَ لِأَحَدِهِمَا: «أَنْتَ فُلَانُ بْنُ فُلَانٍ» ، وَقَالَ لِلْآخَرِ: «أَنْتَ فُلَانُ بْنُ فُلَانٍ، بَعَثَكُمَا أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، فَاقْرَأَا عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامَ، § وَأَخْبِرَاهُ أَنَّهُ مَقْتُولٌ، فَلْيَكُفَّ فَإِنَّهُ أَقْوَى لِحُجَّتِهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ» ، فَأَتَيَاهُ، فَأَخْبَرَاهُ، فَقَالَ عُثْمَانُ: عَزَمْتُ عَلَيْكُمْ لَا يُقَاتِلُ مَعِي مِنْكُمْ أَحَدٌ، فَقَالَ مَرْوَانُ: وَأَنَا أَعْزِمُ عَلَى نَفْسِي لَأُقَاتِلَنَّ، فَقَاتَلَ فَضُرِبَ عَلَى عُنُقِهِ فَلَمْ يَزَلْ مُلْقِيًا ذَقْنَهُ عَلَى صَدْرِهِ حَتَّى مَاتَ
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from one who heard Ibn Sirin say: 'Uthman
entries.matn_en: sent Salit b. Salit and 'Abd al-Rahman b. 'Attab b. Usayd and said: "Go to Ibn Salam and disguise yourselves from him as if you were strangers, and say to him: 'What has happened among the people is as you see; what do you command us?'" They came to Ibn Salam and said something like what he had told them to say. He said to one of them: "You are so-and-so, son of so-and-so," and to the other: "You are so-and-so, son of so-and-so. The Commander of the Faithful sent you. Convey greetings of peace to him and tell him that he will be killed, so let him hold back, for that is stronger for his case on the Day of Resurrection before God." They came back and told him. 'Uthman said: "I bind you by oath that none of you fight alongside me." Marwan said: "And I bind myself by oath that I will fight." So he fought and was struck on his neck, and he remained with his chin on his chest until he died.

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، قَالَ: قَالَ ابْنُ سَلَامٍ: «§
entries.matn_ar: لَئِنْ كَانَ قَتْلُ عُثْمَانَ هُدًى لَتَحْلُبُنَّ لَبَنًا، وَلَئِنْ كَانَ قَتْلُ عُثْمَانَ ضَلَالَةً لَتَحْلُبُنَّ دَمًا» ، قَالَ: وَقَالَ حُذَيْفَةُ: «طَارَتِ الْقُلُوبُ مَطَارَهَا، ثَكِلَتْ كُلَّ شُجَاعٍ بَطَلٍ مِنَ الْعَرَبِ أُمُّهُ الْيَوْمَ، وَاللَّهِ لَا يَأْتِيكُمْ بَعْدُ بَعْدَهُ هَذِهِ إِلَّا أَصْغَرُ أَبْتَرُ الْآخِرِ شَرٌّ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq told us: Ma'mar told us, from Qatada, who said: Ibn Salam said: "
entries.matn_en: If the killing of 'Uthman was right guidance, you will milk milk; and if the killing of 'Uthman was error, you will milk blood." And Hudhayfa said: "Hearts have flown from their places; the mother of every brave hero of the Arabs is bereaved of him today. By God, after this nothing will come to you but what is smaller and truncated, and the later is worse." [The last sentence is somewhat garbled.]

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ أَبَانَ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي سَلَّامٌ.. .، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ رَبَاحٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: دَخَلْتُ أَنَا وَأَبُو قَتَادَةَ عَلَى عُثْمَانَ وَهُوَ مَحْصُورٌ، فَاسْتَأْذَنَّاهُ فِي الْحَجِّ، فَأَذِنَ لَنَا، فَقُلْنَا: يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، قَدْ حَضَرَ مِنْ أَمْرِ هَؤُلَاءِ مَا قَدْ تَرَى، فَمَا تَأْمُرُنَا؟ قَالَ: «§عَلَيْكُمْ بِالْجَمَاعَةِ» ، قُلْنَا: فَإِنَّا نَخَافُ أَنْ تَكُونَ الْجَمَاعَةُ مَعَ هَؤُلَاءِ الَّذِينَ يُخَالِفُونَكَ، قَالَ: «الْزَمُوا الْجَمَاعَةَ حَيْثُ كَانَتْ» ، قَالَ: فَخَرَجْنَا مِنْ عِنْدِهِ، فَلَقِيتُ الْحَسَنَ بْنَ عَلِيٍّ دَاخِلًا عَلَيْهِ، فَرَجَعْنَا مَعَهُ لِنَسْمَعَ مَا يَقُولُ: قَالَ: أَنَا هَذَا يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، فَأْمُرْنِي بِأَمْرِكَ، قَالَ: «اجْلِسْ يَا ابْنَ أَخِي حَتَّى يَأْتِيَ اللَّهُ بِأَمْرِهِ، فَإِنَّهُ لَا حَاجَةَ لِي فِي الدُّنْيَا - أَوْ قَالَ: فِي الْقِتَالِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Aban, who said: Sallam told me… from 'Abdullah b. Rabah, who said:
entries.matn_en: Abu Qatada and I went in to 'Uthman while he was besieged, and asked his permission to perform the Hajj, and he gave us permission. We said: "Commander of the Faithful, the matter of these people is as you see; what do you command us?" He said: "Keep to the community." We said: "We fear that the community may be with those who oppose you." He said: "Keep to the community wherever it is." Then we left him, and I met al-Hasan b. 'Ali going in to him, so we returned with him to hear what he would say. He said: "Here I am, Commander of the Faithful; command me as you wish." He said: "Sit, my nephew, until God brings about His command, for I have no need of the world (or he said: of fighting)."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: دَخَلْتُ عَلَى عَائِشَةَ أَنَا وَعُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَدِيِّ بْنِ الْخِيَارِ، فَذَكَرْتُ عُثْمَانَ فَقَالَتْ: «يَا لَيْتَنِي كُنْتُ نَسْيًا مَنْسِيًّا، وَاللَّهِ §مَا انْتَهَكْتُ مِنْ عُثْمَانَ شَيْئًا إِلَّا قَدِ انْتُهِكَ مِنِّي مِثْلُهُ، حَتَّى لَوْ أَحْبَبْتُ قَتْلَهُ لَقُتِلْتُ» ، ثُمَّ قَالَتْ: «يَا عُبَيْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَدِيٍّ لَا يَغُرَّنَّكَ أَحَدٌ بَعْدَ النَّفَرِ الَّذِينَ تَعْلَمُ، فَوَاللَّهِ مَا احْتُقِرَتْ أَعْمَالُ أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ حَتَّى نَجَمَ الْقُرَّاءُ الَّذِينَ طَعَنُوا عَلَى عُثْمَانَ، فَقَرَءُوا قِرَاءَةً لَا يُقْرَأُ مِثْلُهَا، وَصَلَّوْا صَلَاةً لَا يُصَلَّى مِثْلُهَا، وَصَامُوا صِيَامًا لَا يُصَامُ مِثْلُهُ، وَقَالُوا قَوْلًا لَا نُحْسِنُ أَنْ نَقُولَ مِثْلَهُ، فَلَمَّا تَدَبَّرْتُ الصُّنْعَ إِذًا مَا يُقَارِبُونَ أَصْحَابَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَإِذَا سَمِعْتَ حُسْنَ قَوْلِ امْرِئٍ فَقُلْ: {اعْمَلُوا فَسَيَرَى اللَّهُ عَمَلَكُمْ وَرَسُولُهُ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ} [التوبة: ١٠٥] وَلَا يَسْتَخِفَّنَّكَ أَحَدٌ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, from 'Urwa, who said:
entries.matn_en: I went in to 'A'isha together with 'Ubaydullah b. 'Adi b. al-Khiyar, and I mentioned 'Uthman, and she said: "Would that I had been something forgotten and discarded! By God, I did not violate anything of 'Uthman's but the like of it was violated against me, so that had I wished him killed, I would have been killed." Then she said: "'Ubaydullah b. 'Adi, let no one deceive you after the group whom you know. By God, the deeds of the Companions of the Messenger of God ﷺ were not belittled until the reciters appeared who attacked 'Uthman. They recited a recitation like none other, prayed a prayer like none other, fasted a fast like none other, and spoke words the like of which we cannot speak. But when I considered their conduct, they were nowhere near the Companions of the Messenger of God ﷺ. So when you hear a man's fine speech, say: 'Act, for God will see your deeds, and so will His Messenger and the believers' [9:105], and let no one make light of you."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَجُلًا مِنْ قُرَيْشٍ يُقَالُ لَهُ ثُمَامَةُ كَانَ عَلَى صَنْعَاءَ، فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُ قَتْلُ عُثْمَانَ خَطَبَ فَبَكَى بُكَاءً شَدِيدًا، فَلَمَّا أَفَاقَ وَاسْتَفَاقَ قَالَ: «§الْيَوْمَ انْتُزِعَتْ خِلَافَةُ النُّبُوَّةِ مِنْ أُمَّةِ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَصَارَتْ مُلْكًا وَجَبْرِيَّةً مَنْ أَخَذَ شَيْئًا غَلَبَ عَلَيْهِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq told us: Ma'mar told us, from Ayyub, from Abu Qilaba,
entries.matn_en: that a man of Quraysh called Thumama was governor of Sanaa. When the news of the killing of 'Uthman reached him, he gave a sermon and wept bitterly. When he recovered and came to himself he said: "Today the caliphate of prophethood has been wrenched away from the community of Muhammad ﷺ and has become kingship and tyranny. Whoever seized something dominated it."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ، عَنْ زَهْدَمٍ، قَالَ: كُنَّا عِنْدَ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ يَوْمًا فَقَالَ: «وَاللَّهِ لَأُحَدِّثَنَّكُمْ بِحَدِيثٍ مَا هُوَ بِسِرٍّ وَلَا عَلَانِيَةٍ، مَا هُوَ بِسِرٍّ فَأَكْتُمُكُمُوهُ، وَلَا عَلَانِيَةٍ فَأَخْطُبُ بِهِ، وَإِنَّهُ §
entries.matn_ar: لَمَّا وُثِبَ عَلَى عُثْمَانَ فَقُتِلَ، قُلْتُ لِابْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ: اجْتَنِبْ هَذَا الْأَمْرَ فَسَتُكْفَاهُ، فَعَصَانِي وَمَا أُرَاهُ يَظْفَرُ، وَايْمُ اللَّهِ لَيَظْهَرَنَّ عَلَيْكُمُ ابْنُ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ، لِأَنَّ اللَّهَ قَالَ: {وَمَنْ قُتِلَ مَظْلُومًا فَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا لِوَلِيِّهِ سُلْطَانًا} [الإسراء: ٣٣] وَايْمُ اللَّهِ لَتَسِيرَنَّ فِيكُمْ قُرَيْشٌ بِسِيرَةِ فَارِسَ وَالرُّومِ» قَالَ: قُلْنَا: فَمَا تَأْمُرُنَا يَا ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ إِنْ أَدْرَكْنَا ذَلِكَ؟ قَالَ: «مَنْ أَخَذَ مِنْكُمْ بِمَا يَعْرِفُ نَجَا، وَمَنْ تَرَكَ وَأَنْتُمْ تَارِكُونَ كَانَ كَبَعْضِ هَذِهِ الْقُرُونِ الَّتِي هَلَكَتْ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq told us: Ma'mar told us, from Ayyub, from Abu Qilaba, from Zahdam, who said: We were with Ibn 'Abbas one day, and he said: "By God, I will tell you a hadith that is neither a secret nor public. It is not a secret that I would hide from you, nor public that I would preach it.
entries.matn_en: When 'Uthman was attacked and killed, I said to Ibn Abi Talib: 'Avoid this matter, and you will be spared it.' He disobeyed me, and I do not think he will prevail. By God, Ibn Abi Sufyan will overcome you, because God said: 'Whoever is killed unjustly, We have given his heir authority' [17:33]. And by God, Quraysh will rule among you by the way of Persia and Rome." He said: We said: "What do you command us, Ibn 'Abbas, if we live to see that?" He said: "Whoever of you holds to what he knows will be saved, and whoever abandons it, and you will be abandoners, will be like some of these generations that perished."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ بْنِ خَالِدٍ، أَنَّ مَالِكًا الْأَشْتَرَ دَخَلَ عَلَى عَلِيٍّ فَقَالَ: إِنَّ النَّاسَ قَدْ أَنْكَرُوا بَعْضَ الْأَمْرِ، وَقَالُوا: مَا أَشْبَهَ اللَّيْلَةَ بِالْبَارِحَةِ، عَتَبْنَا أَمْرًا فَنَحْنُ فِي مِثْلِهِ، قَالَ وَعِنْدَهُ الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبَّاسٍ، فَقَالَ عَلِيٌّ: «يَا غُلَامُ ائْتِنِي بِالْجَامِعَةِ وَالسَّيْفِ» ، قَالَ: فَقَامَ الْحَسَنُ وَابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ فَقَالَا: يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، نَنْشُدُكَ اللَّهَ، فَلَمْ يَزَالَا يُكَلِّمَانِهِ حَتَّى تَرَكَ، وَقَالَ لَهُ: «انْطَلِقْ» ، فَخَرَجَ سَرِيعًا، فَهَبَطَ عَلَى دَرَجَةِ الْبَيْتِ خَائِفًا، فَقَالَ عَلِيٌّ حِينَ ذَهَبَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: إِنَّهُ فَرَّقَنَا فَفَرَّقْنَاهُ، فَأَيُّنَا كَانَ أَشَدَّ فَرَقًا لِصَاحِبِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Ibn Tawus, from 'Ikrima b. Khalid, that Malik al-Ashtar went in to 'Ali and said: "The people disapprove of some matters. They say: 'How much tonight resembles last night! We blamed one thing and now we are in the like of it.'" Al-Hasan b. 'Ali and 'Abdullah b. 'Abbas were with him. 'Ali said: "Boy, bring me the manacle and the sword." Al-Hasan and Ibn 'Abbas stood and said: "Commander of the Faithful, we ask you by God," and they kept speaking to him until he gave up. And he said to [al-Ashtar]: "Go." He went out quickly and went down the steps of the house frightened. 'Ali said when he had gone: "
entries.matn_en: He frightened us and we frightened him. Which of us was more afraid of the other?"

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ عَبَّادٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كُنَّا مَعَ عَلِيٍّ فَكَانَ إِذَا شَهِدَ مَشْهَدًا أَوْ أَشْرَفَ عَلَى أَكَمَةٍ أَوْ هَبَطَ وَادِيًا قَالَ: «صَدَقَ اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ» ، فَقُلْتُ لِرَجُلٍ مِنْ بَنِي يَشْكُرَ: انْطَلِقْ بِنَا إِلَى أَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ حَتَّى نَسْأَلَهُ عَنْ قَوْلِهِ: صَدَقَ اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ، قَالَ: فَانْطَلَقْنَا إِلَيْهِ فَقُلْنَا: يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، رَأَيْنَاكَ إِذَا شَهِدْتَ مَشْهَدًا، أَوْ هَبَطْتَ وَادِيًا، أَوْ أَشْرَفْتَ عَلَى أَكَمَةٍ، قُلْتَ: صَدَقَ اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ، فَهَلْ عَهِدَ إِلَيْكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ شَيْئًا فِي ذَلِكَ؟ قَالَ فَأَعْرَضَ عَنَّا وَأَلْحَفْنَا عَلَيْهِ، فَلَمَّا رَأَى ذَلِكَ قَالَ: «وَاللَّهِ §مَا عَهِدَ إِلَيَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ عَهْدًا إِلَّا شَيْئًا عَهِدَهُ إِلَى النَّاسِ، وَلَكِنَّ النَّاسَ وَقَعُوا عَلَى عُثْمَانَ فَقَتَلُوهُ، فَكَانَ غَيْرِي فِيهِ أَسْوَأَ حَالًا وَفِعَالًا مِنِّي، ثُمَّ رَأَيْتُ أَنِّي أَحَقُّهُمْ لِهَذَا الْأَمْرِ فَوَثَبْتُ عَلَيْهِ، فَاللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ أَصَبْنَا أَمْ أَخْطَأْنَا»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq told us: Ma'mar told us, from 'Ali b. Zayd, from al-Hasan, from Qays b. 'Abbad, who said:
entries.matn_en: We were with 'Ali, and whenever he witnessed a scene, or climbed a hillock, or descended into a valley, he would say: "God and His Messenger spoke the truth." I said to a man of Banu Yashkur: "Come with us to the Commander of the Faithful so that we may ask him about his saying: 'God and His Messenger spoke the truth.'" We went to him and said: "Commander of the Faithful, we have seen that when you witness a scene, or descend into a valley, or climb a hillock, you say: 'God and His Messenger spoke the truth.' Did the Messenger of God entrust anything to you concerning that?" He turned away from us, and we pressed him. When he saw that, he said: "By God, the Messenger of God did not entrust me with any covenant except something he entrusted to the people. But the people fell upon 'Uthman and killed him, and others than I were worse in state and deeds in it than I. Then I saw that I was the most entitled of them to this matter, so I seized it. And God knows best whether we were right or wrong."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ يَقُولُ: سَمِعْتُ عَلِيًّا يَقُولُ: «§
entries.matn_ar: وَاللَّهِ مَا قَتَلْتُ عُثْمَانَ وَلَا أَمَرْتُ بِقَتْلِهِ وَلَكِنْ غُلِبْتُ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Ibn Tawus, from his father, who said: I heard Ibn 'Abbas say: I heard 'Ali say: "
entries.matn_en: By God, I did not kill 'Uthman, nor did I order his killing, but I was overpowered."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: لَمَّا وَقَعَتْ فِتْنَةُ عُثْمَانَ قَالَ رَجُلٌ لِأَهْلِهِ: أَوْثِقُونِي بِالْحَدِيدِ، فَإِنِّي مَجْنُونٌ، فَلَمَّا قُتِلَ عُثْمَانُ قَالَ: خَلُّوا عَنِّي فَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي شَفَانِي مِنَ الْجُنُونِ وَعَافَانِي مِنْ قَتْلِ عُثْمَانَ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Ibn Tawus, from his father, who said: "
entries.matn_en: When the trial of 'Uthman occurred, a man said to his family: 'Bind me in iron, for I am mad.' When 'Uthman was killed he said: 'Release me. Praise be to God who cured me of madness and spared me from the killing of 'Uthman.'"

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ عُثْمَانُ لِحُذَيْفَةَ وَلَقِيَهُ: «وَاللَّهِ مَا يَدَعُنِي مَا يَبْلُغُنِي عَنْكَ بِظَهْرِ الْغَيْبِ» ، ثُمَّ وَلَّى حُذَيْفَةُ، فَلَمَّا أَجَازَ قَالَ: رُدُّوهُ، قَالَ لَهُ عُثْمَانُ أَيْضًا مِثْلَ قَوْلِهِ الْأَوَّلِ، فَقَالَ لَهُ حُذَيْفَةُ: «§وَاللَّهِ لَتَخْرُجَنَّ كَمَا يَخْرُجُ الثَّوْرُ، وَلَتَسْخَطَنَّ كَمَا يَسْخَطُ الْجَمَلُ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from al-A'mash, who said:
entries.matn_en: 'Uthman said to Hudhayfa when he met him: "By God, what reaches me about you behind my back does not leave me [in peace]." Then Hudhayfa turned away, and when he had passed on, ['Uthman] said: "Bring him back." 'Uthman said to him again the like of his first words. Hudhayfa said to him: "By God, you will come out as the bull comes out, and you will rage as the camel rages."

sections.title_en: The Shade of the Sarḥ Tree

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كَانَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْأَنْصَارِ مُسْتَظِلًّا تَحْتَ سَرْحَةٍ، فَمَرَّ عُمَرُ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ فَسَلَّمَ عَلَيْهِ، وَقَالَ: «أَتَدْرِي لِمَا يُسْتَحَبُّ ظِلُّ السَّرْحِ؟» ، قَالَ: نَعَمْ، قَالَ: «لِمَ؟» ، قَالَ: لِأَنَّهُ بَارِدٌ ظِلُّهَا، وَلَا شَوْكَ فِيهَا، قَالَ: «وَلِغَيْرِ ذَلِكَ، أَرَأَيْتَ إِذَا كُنْتَ بَيْنَ الْمَأْزِمَيْنِ دُونَ مِنًى، فَإِنَّ مِنْ هُنَالِكَ إِلَى مَطْلِعِ الشَّمْسِ مَكَانَ السُّرَرِ - أَوْ قَالَ: مَسْجِدِ السُّرَرِ - سُرَّ فِيهِ سَبْعُونَ نَبِيًّا، §فَاسْتَظَلَّ نَبِيُّ مِنْهُمْ تَحْتَ سَرْحَةٍ، دَعَا فَاسْتَجَابَ لَهُ، وَدَعَا لَهَا فَكُفِيَ كَمَا رَأَيْتَ، لَا يَعْتَلُّ كَمَا يَعْتَلُّ السَّحْرُ» ، قَالَ مَعْمَرٌ: «سُرُّوا: قُطِعَتْ سُرَرُهُمْ، لَا تَعْتَلُّ: يَعْنِي حَفْرًا أَبَدًا»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Zayd b. Aslam, who said:
entries.matn_en: A man of the Ansar was sitting in the shade under a sarha tree. 'Umar, ؓ, passed by and greeted him, and said: "Do you know why the shade of the sarh is favored?" He said: "Yes." He said: "Why?" He said: "Because its shade is cool and it has no thorns." He said: "And for another reason as well. Consider when you are between the two narrow passes before Mina: from there to the sunrise is the place of the sarar, or he said: the mosque of the sarar. Seventy prophets had their umbilical cords cut there, and one prophet among them sheltered under a sarha, and he prayed and his prayer was answered, and he prayed for it, so it was sufficed as you see: it does not become diseased as other trees do." Ma'mar said: "Surru means their umbilical cords were cut. La ta'tall means it never decays."

sections.title_en: The Laughter of the Companions of the Prophet ﷺ, and Other Matters
sections.title_ar: بَابُ ضَحِكِ أَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَغَيْرِ ذَلِكَ

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: سُئِلَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، §هَلْ كَانَ أَصْحَابُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَضْحَكُونَ؟ قَالَ: «نَعَمْ، وَالْإِيمَانُ فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ أَعْظَمُ مِنَ الْجِبَالِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Qatada, who said: Ibn 'Umar, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: was asked whether the Companions of the Messenger of God ﷺ used to laugh. He said: "Yes, and faith in their hearts was greater than mountains."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنِ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ، قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: كُنْتُ أَسْمَعُ الْحَدِيثَ مِنْ عَشَرَةٍ كُلُّهُمْ يَخْتَلِفُ فِي اللَّفْظِ وَالْمَعْنَى وَاحِدٌ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Ayyub, from Ibn Sirin, who said: "
entries.matn_en: I used to hear a hadith from ten people, each differing in wording while the meaning was one."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، قَالَ: كَتَبَتْ عَائِشَةُ إِلَى مُعَاوِيَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا «
entries.matn_ar: أَمَّا بَعْدُ، فَإِنَّهُ §مَنْ يَطْلُبْ أَنْ يَحْمَدَهُ النَّاسُ بِسَخَطِ اللَّهِ، يَكُنْ مَنْ يَحْمَدُهِ مِنَ النَّاسِ ذَامًّا»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, who said: 'A'isha wrote to Mu'awiya, ؓ: "
entries.matn_en: To proceed: whoever seeks to be praised by people at the cost of God's displeasure, those among the people who praise him will become his blamers."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، يَرْفَعُ الْحَدِيثَ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «§
entries.matn_ar: مِنْ خَيْرِ أَعْمَالِكُمْ مَا تُحِبُّونَ أَنْ يُعْلَمَ» ، قَالَ زَيْدٌ: وَإِنْ سَتَرَهُ أَسْلَمُ لَهُ وَهُوَ يُحِبُّ أَنْ يُعْلَمَ بِهِ "
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Zayd b. Aslam, raising the hadith, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "
entries.matn_en: Among the best of your deeds are those you like to be known." Zayd said: "Even if he conceals it, it is safer for him, while he likes it to be known."

sections.title_en: Mention of al-Ḥasan, May God Be Pleased With Him
sections.title_ar: بَابُ ذِكْرِ الْحَسَنِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَنْبَأَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنِ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ: أَنَّ الْحَسَنَ بْنَ عَلِيٍّ، قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: لَوْ نَظَرْتُمْ مَا بَيْنَ حَالوسَ إِلَى حَابلقَ مَا وَجَدْتُمْ رَجُلًا جَدُّهُ نَبِيٌّ غَيْرِي وَأَخِي، فَإِنِّي أَرَى أَنْ تَجْمَعُوا عَلَى مُعَاوِيَةَ» {وَإِنْ أَدْرِي لَعَلَّهُ فِتْنَةٌ لَكُمْ وَمَتَاعٌ إِلَى حِينٍ} [الأنبياء: ١١١] ، قَالَ مَعْمَرٌ: «حَالوسُ وَحَابلقُ: الْمَغْرِبُ، وَالْمَشْرِقُ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq told us: Ma'mar informed us, from Ayyub, from Ibn Sirin, that al-Hasan b. 'Ali said: "
entries.matn_en: If you looked from Halus to Habilq, you would not find a man whose grandfather was a prophet other than me and my brother. And I think you should unite behind Mu'awiya: 'And I do not know, perhaps it is a trial for you and enjoyment for a time' [21:111]." Ma'mar said: "Halus and Habilq: the west and the east."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ،: أَخْبَرَنِي مَنْ، سَمِعَ الْحَسَنَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرَةَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يُحَدِّثُنَا يَوْمًا وَالْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ فِي حِجْرِهِ، فَيُقْبِلُ عَلَى أَصْحَابِهِ، فَيُحَدِّثُهُمْ ثُمَّ يُقْبِلُ عَلَى الْحَسَنِ فَيُقَبِّلُهُ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: «§ابْنِي هَذَا سَيِّدٌ، إِنْ يَعِشْ يُصْلِحْ بَيْنَ طَائِفَتَيْنِ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, who said: One who heard al-Hasan told me, narrating from Abu Bakra, who said:
entries.matn_en: The Prophet ﷺ was speaking to us one day with al-Hasan b. 'Ali in his lap. He would turn to his Companions and speak to them, then turn to al-Hasan and kiss him. Then he said: "This son of mine is a leader. If he lives he will reconcile two groups of Muslims."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي مَنْ، سَمِعَ ابْنَ سِيرِينَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ مَوْلًى لِلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كَانَ الْحَسَنُ فِي مَرَضِهِ الَّذِي مَاتَ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُ إِلَى مِرْبَدٍ لَهُ، فَأَبْطَأَ عَلَيْنَا مَرَّةً ثُمَّ رَجَعَ فَقَالَ: «§لَقَدْ رَأَيْتُ كَبِدِي آنِفًا، وَلَقَدْ سُقِيتُ السُّمَّ مِرَارًا، وَمَا سُقِيتُهُ قَطُّ أَشَدَّ مِنْ مَرَّتِي هَذِهِ» ، فَقَالَ حُسَيْنٌ: وَمَنْ سَقَى لَهُ؟ قَالَ: «لِمَ؟ أَتَقْتُلُهُ؟» ، بَلْ نَكِلُهُ إِلَى اللَّهِ
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, who said: One who heard Ibn Sirin told me, narrating from a freedman of al-Hasan b. 'Ali, who said:
entries.matn_en: In his last illness, al-Hasan used to go back and forth to a stable of his. Once he was slow in returning to us, then came back and said: "I just saw my liver. I have been given poison several times, and never was it more severe than this time." Husayn said: "Who gave it to you?" He said: "Why? Would you kill him? No, we leave him to God."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: دَخَلَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ عَلَى مُعَاوِيَةَ فَقَالَ لَهُ: إِنِّي لَأَرَاكَ عَلَى مِلَّةِ ابْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ، فَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ: «§لَا، وَلَا عَلَى مِلَّةِ ابْنِ عَفَّانَ» ، قَالَ طَاوُسٌ: «يَعْنِي مِلَّةَ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ لَيْسَتْ لِأَحَدٍ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Ibn Tawus, from his father, who said: Ibn 'Abbas
entries.matn_en: went in to Mu'awiya, who said to him: "I see you on the creed of Ibn Abi Talib." Ibn 'Abbas said: "No, and not on the creed of Ibn 'Affan either." Tawus said: "He meant that the religion of Muhammad ﷺ belongs to no one [in particular]."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: لَمْ يَكُنْ فِيهِمْ أَحَدٌ أَشْبَهُ بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مِنَ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq told us: Ma'mar told us, from al-Zuhri, who said: Anas b. Malik told me: "
entries.matn_en: None of them resembled the Messenger of God ﷺ more than al-Hasan b. 'Ali."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، يَقُولُ: «§
entries.matn_ar: مَا رَأَيْتُ رَجُلًا كَانَ أَخْلَقَ لِلْمُلْكِ مِنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ، كَانَ النَّاسُ يَرِدُونَ بَيْتَهُ عَلَى أَرْجَاءِ وَادٍ لَيْسَ بِالضَّيِّقِ الْحَصِرِ الْعَصْعَصِ الْمُتَعَصِّبِ» يَعْنِي ابْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Hammam b. Munabbih, who said: I heard Ibn 'Abbas say: "
entries.matn_en: I have not seen a man more fit for kingship than Mu'awiya. People would come to his house over the reaches of a valley that was not narrow, tight, rough or stubborn," meaning Ibn al-Zubayr.

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ رَأَى رَجُلًا قَدْ حَلَقَ قَفَاهُ، وَلَبِسَ حَرِيرًا، فَقَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: مَنْ تَشَبَّهَ بِقَوْمٍ فَهُوَ مِنْهُمْ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Qatada, that 'Umar b. al-Khattab saw a man who had shaved his nape and was wearing silk, and he said: "
entries.matn_en: Whoever imitates a people is one of them."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، قَالَ: دَخَلَ رَجُلٌ عَلَى أَبِي ذَرٍّ فَرَأَى امْرَأَتَهُ مُشَعَّثَةً لَيْسَ عَلَيْهَا أَثَرُ مَجَاسِدِ وَلَا خَلُوقٍ، فَقَالَ: إِنَّ هَذِهِ تَأْمُرُنِي أَنْ آتِيَ الْعِرَاقَ، وَلَوْ أَتَيْتُ الْعِرَاقَ قَالُوا: هَذَا أَبُو ذَرٍّ صَاحِبُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَأَمَالُوا عَلَيْنَا مِنَ الدُّنْيَا، فَإِنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَدْ أَخْبَرَنَا: «أَنَّ §
entries.matn_ar: بَيْنَ أَيْدِينَا جِسْرًا دُونَهُ دَحْضٌ وَمَزَلَّةٌ، وَأَمَّا أَنْ نَأْخُذَهُ وَنَحْنُ مُصْطَرَّةٌ أَحْمَالُنَا خَيْرٌ مِنْ أَنْ نَأْخُذَهُ وَنَحْنُ مُثْقَلُونَ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Qatada, who said: A man came in to Abu Dharr and saw his wife disheveled, with no trace of dye or perfume on her. He [Abu Dharr] said: "She is urging me to go to Iraq. If I went to Iraq they would say: 'This is Abu Dharr, a Companion of the Messenger of God ﷺ,' and they would heap the world upon us. The Prophet ﷺ told us: '
entries.matn_en: Ahead of us is a bridge, before which there is slipperiness and a slide. For us to cross it with our loads compact is better than to cross it heavily burdened.'"

sections.title_en: Setting Animals Against One Another, and the Grave of Abū Righāl
sections.title_ar: بَابُ التَّحْرِيشِ بَيْنَ الْبَهَائِمِ، وَقَبْرِ أَبِي رِغَالٍ

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، - قَالَ مَعْمَرٌ: لَا أَدْرِي أَرَفَعَهُ أَمْ لَا - قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: لَا يَحِلُّ لِأَحَدٍ أَنْ يُحَرِّشَ بَيْنَ فَحْلَيْنِ دِيكَيْنِ فَمَا فَوْقَهُمَا»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Ibn Tawus, from his father (Ma'mar said: I do not know whether he raised it to the Prophet or not), who said: "
entries.matn_en: It is not lawful for anyone to incite fighting between two cocks, or more than two."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أُمَيَّةَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: مَرَّ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِقَبْرٍ، فَقَالَ: «أَتَدْرُونَ مَا هَذَا؟» ، قَالُوا: اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَعْلَمُ، قَالَ: «§هَذَا قَبْرُ أَبِي رِغَالٍ» ، قَالُوا: وَمَنْ أَبُو رِغَالٍ؟ قَالَ: «رَجُلٌ كَانَ مِنْ ثَمُودَ، كَانَ فِي حَرَمِ اللَّهِ، فَمَنَعَهُ حَرَمُ اللَّهِ عَذَابَ اللَّهِ، فَلَمَّا خَرَجَ أَصَابَهُ مَا أَصَابَ قَوْمَهُ، فَدُفِنَ هَاهُنَا، وَدُفِنَ مَعَهُ غُصْنٌ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ فَابْتَدَرَهُ الْقَوْمُ، فَبَحَثُوا عَنْهُ حَتَّى اسْتَخْرَجُوا الْغُصْنَ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq told us: Ma'mar told us, from Isma'il b. Umayya, who said:
entries.matn_en: The Prophet ﷺ passed by a grave and said: "Do you know what this is?" They said: "God and His Messenger know best." He said: "This is the grave of Abu Righal." They said: "Who was Abu Righal?" He said: "A man from Thamud who was in God's sanctuary, and God's sanctuary protected him from God's punishment. When he left it, what befell his people befell him, and he was buried here, and a branch of gold was buried with him. The people rushed to it and dug for it until they extracted the branch."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ: «كَانَ §
entries.matn_ar: رَجُلٌ فِيمَا خَلَا مِنَ الزَّمَانِ، وَكَانَ رَجُلًا عَاقِلًا لَبِيبًا فَكَبِرَ فَقَعَدَ فِي الْبَيْتِ، فَقَالَ لِابْنِهِ يَوْمًا: إِنِّي قَدِ اغْتَمَمْتُ، فَلَوْ أَدْخَلْتَ عَلَيَّ رِجَالًا يُكَلِّمُونَنِي، فَذَهَبَ ابْنُهُ فَجَمَعَ نَفَرًا فَقَالَ: ادْخُلُوا فَحَدِّثُوهُ، فَإِنْ سَمِعْتُمْ مِنْهُ مُنْكَرًا فَاعْذِرُوهُ، فَإِنَّهُ قَدْ كَبِرَ، وَإِنْ سَمِعْتُمْ مِنْهُ خَيْرًا فَاقْبَلُوا، فَدَخَلُوا عَلَيْهِ، فَكَانَ أَوَّلَ مَا تَكَلَّمَ بِهِ أَنْ قَالَ: أَلَا أَكْيَسُ الْكَيْسِ التُّقَى، وَإِنَّ أَعْجَزَ الْعَجْزِ الْفُجُورُ، وَإِذَا تَزَوَّجَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلْيَتَزَوَّجْ فِي مَعْدِنٍ صَالِحٍ، وَإِذَا اطَّلَعْتُمْ مِنْ رَجُلٍ عَلَى فُجْرَةٍ فَاحْذَرُوهُ، فَإِنَّ لَهَا أَخَوَاتٍ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq told us: Ma'mar told us, from Ibn Tawus, from his father, who said: "
entries.matn_en: There was a man in times past, a wise and sensible man. He grew old and stayed at home. One day he said to his son: 'I have become depressed. Why not bring some men in to talk with me?' His son went and gathered a group and said: 'Go in and talk with him. If you hear anything objectionable from him, excuse him, for he is old, and if you hear anything good, accept it.' They went in to him, and the first thing he said was: 'Lo, the cleverest of cleverness is piety, and the greatest incapacity is wickedness. When one of you marries, let him marry from a good stock. And when you find out that a man has committed a sin, beware of him, for it has sisters.'"

sections.title_en: Bad Treatment of Slaves and of the Self, and Other Matters
sections.title_ar: بَابُ سُوءِ الْمَلَكَةِ وَالنَّفْسِ، وَغَيْرِ ذَلِكَ

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ بْنِ سَهْلِ بْنِ حُنَيْفٍ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «§
entries.matn_ar: لَا يَقُلْ أَحَدُكُمْ إِنِّي خَبِيثُ النَّفْسِ، وَلَكِنْ لِيَقُلْ: إِنِّي لَقِسُ النَّفْسِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq told us: Ma'mar told us, from al-Zuhri, from Abu Umama b. Sahl b. Hunayf, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "
entries.matn_en: Let none of you say: 'I am foul of soul,' but let him say: 'My soul is queasy.'"

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «§
entries.matn_ar: لَا يَقُلْ أَحَدُكُمْ خَبُثَتْ نَفْسِي، وَلَكِنْ لِيَقُلْ: لَقِسَتْ نَفْسِي»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Hisham b. 'Urwa, from his father, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "
entries.matn_en: Let none of you say: 'My soul has become foul,' but let him say: 'My soul has become queasy.'"

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ فَرْقَدٍ السَّبَخِيِّ، عَنْ مُرَّةَ الطَّيِّبِ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «§
entries.matn_ar: لَا يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ سَيِّئُ الْمَلَكَةِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq told us: Ma'mar told us, from Farqad al-Sabakhi, from Murra al-Tayyib, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "The one who is bad to those under his control
entries.matn_en: will not enter Paradise."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي مَنْ، سَمِعَ عِكْرِمَةَ يَقُولُ: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «§
entries.matn_ar: لَيْسَ مِنَّا مَنْ خَبَّبَ امْرَأَةً عَلَى زَوْجِهَا، وَلَيْسَ مِنَّا مَنْ خَبَّبَ عَبْدًا عَلَى سَيِّدِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, who said: One who heard 'Ikrima told me that he said: The Prophet ﷺ said: "
entries.matn_en: He is not of us who turns a woman against her husband, and he is not of us who turns a slave against his master."

sections.title_en: What to Say When You Enter a Village, the Trial of Wealth, and the Place of Death
sections.title_ar: بَابُ الْقَوْلِ إِذَا دَخَلْتَ قَرْيَةً، وَفِتْنَةِ الْمَالِ، وَالْمَيْتَةِ

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، قَالَ: كَانَ ابْنُ مَسْعُودٍ إِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَدْخُلَ قَرْيَةً قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا أَظَلَّتْ، وَرَبَّ الْأَرْضِ وَمَا أَقَلَّتْ، وَرَبَّ الشَّيَاطِينِ وَمَا أَضَلَّتْ، وَرَبَّ الرِّيَاحِ وَمَا ذَرَّتْ، أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا وَخَيْرَ مَا فِيهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا وَشَرِّ مَا فِيهَا»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Qatada, who said: When Ibn Mas'ud wanted to enter a village he would say: "
entries.matn_en: O God, Lord of the heavens and what they shade, Lord of the earth and what it bears, Lord of the devils and those they lead astray, Lord of the winds and what they scatter: I ask You for its good and the good of what is in it, and I seek refuge in You from its evil and the evil of what is in it."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ أَبِي بَلْجٍ، عَنْ أُسَامَةَ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «§
entries.matn_ar: مَا جَعَلَ اللَّهُ مَيْتَةَ عَبْدٍ بِأَرْضٍ إِلَّا جَعَلَ لَهُ بِهَا حَاجَةً»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Ayyub, from Abu Balj, from Usama, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "
entries.matn_en: God does not appoint the death of a servant in a land except that He has given him a need there."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَدِمَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ الشَّامِ الْمَدِينَةَ، فَلَقِيَ أَصْحَابَ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَسَلَّمَ عَلَيْهِمْ، وَكَانَ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ عَوْفٍ غَائِبًا فِي أَرْضٍ لَهُ بِالْجُرُفِ، فَأَتَاهُ، فَإِذَا هُوَ وَاضِعٌ رِدَاءَهُ، وَالْمِسْحَاةُ فِي يَدِهِ وَهُوَ يُحَوِّلُ الْمَاءَ فِي أَرْضِهِ، فَلَمَّا رَآهُ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ وَضَعَ الْمِسْحَاةَ مِنْ يَدِهِ، وَلَبِسَ رِدَاءَهُ، قَالَ: فَوَقَفَ عَلَيْهِ الرجل فسلم عليه وَقَالَ: جِئْتُ لِأَمْرٍ، فَرَأَيْتُ أَعْجَبَ مِنْهُ، مَا أَدْرِي أَعَلِمْتُمْ مَا لَمْ نَعْلَمْ، أَوْ جَاءَكُمْ مَا لَمْ يَأْتِنَا، مَا لَنَا نَخِفُّ فِي الْجِهَادِ وَتَتَثَاقَلُونَ عَنْهُ، وَنَزْهَدُ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَتَرْغَبُونَ فِيهَا، وَأَنْتُمْ سَلَفُنَا وَأَصْحَابُ نَبِيِّنَا؟ فَقَالَ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ عَوْفٍ: «§مَا عَلِمْنَا إِلَّا مَا عَلِمْتُمْ، وَلَا جَاءَنَا إِلَّا مَا جَاءَكُمْ، وَلَكِنَّا ابْتُلِينَا بِالضَّرَّاءِ فَصَبَرْنَا، وَابْتُلِينَا بِالسَّرَّاءِ فَلَمْ نَصْبِرْ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, who said: Ibrahim b. 'Abd al-Rahman b. 'Awf told me:
entries.matn_en: A man from Syria came to Medina and met the Companions of the Prophet ﷺ and greeted them. 'Abd al-Rahman b. 'Awf was away on a piece of land of his at al-Juruf, so he went to him and found him with his cloak laid aside and a spade in his hand, diverting water in his land. When 'Abd al-Rahman saw him, he put the spade down and put on his cloak. The man stood before him and greeted him and said: "I came for one matter and saw something more astonishing. I do not know whether you know something we do not know, or something has come to you that has not come to us. Why do we hasten to jihad while you are sluggish about it, and why are we abstinent in the world while you desire it, when you are our predecessors and the Companions of our Prophet?" 'Abd al-Rahman b. 'Awf said: "We know nothing but what you know, and nothing has come to us but what has come to you. But we were tested with hardship and we were patient, and we were tested with ease and we were not patient."

sections.title_en: Merchants, and Those Who Eat and Dress at Their Brother's Expense
sections.title_ar: بَابُ التُّجَّارِ، وَمَنْ أَكَلَ وَلَبِسَ بِأَخِيهِ

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ شَيْخًا، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ، وَأَظُنُّهُ شَهْرَ بْنَ حَوْشَبٍ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «§
entries.matn_ar: الزَّرْعُ أَمَانَةٌ، وَالتَّاجِرُ فَاجِرٌ، وَاللَّهِ مَا أُحِبُّ أَنَّ لِي أَمَةً بَغِيًّا بِدِرْهَمَيْنِ، وَلَا عَبْدًا حَنَّاطًا خَائِنًا بِدِرْهَمٍ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from al-A'mash, who said: I heard an old man narrate from Abu al-Darda' (I think it was Shahr b. Hawshab) that the Messenger of God ﷺ said: "
entries.matn_en: Farming is a trust, and the merchant is a wrongdoer. By God, I would not like to own a slave woman who is a prostitute for two dirhams, nor a slave who is a dishonest grain-seller for one dirham."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ خُثَيْمٍ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ رِفَاعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: خَرَجْتُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِلَى السُّوقِ فَقَالَ: «يَا مَعْشَرَ التُّجَّارِ» فَرَفَعَ النَّاسُ إِلَيْهِ أَبْصَارَهُمْ وَاسْتَجَابُوا لَهُ، فَقَالَ: «إِنَّ §التُّجَّارَ يُبْعَثُونَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فُجَّارًا، إِلَّا مَنِ اتَّقَى اللَّهَ وَبَرَّ وَصَدَقَ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq told us: Ma'mar told us, from Ibn Khuthaym, from Isma'il b. 'Ubayd b. Rifa'a, from his father, from his grandfather, who said:
entries.matn_en: I went out with the Messenger of God ﷺ to the market, and he said: "Assembly of merchants!" The people raised their eyes to him and responded to him. He said: "Merchants will be raised on the Day of Resurrection as wrongdoers, except those who fear God, act righteously and speak truthfully."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَمَّنْ سَمِعَ الْحَسَنَ يَقُولُ: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «§
entries.matn_ar: مَنْ أَكَلَ بِأَخِيهِ الْمُسْلِمِ أُكْلَةً أَطْعَمَهُ اللَّهُ مِثْلَهَا مِنْ نَارٍ، وَمَنْ لَبِسَ بِأَخِيهِ الْمُسْلِمِ ثَوْبًا أَلْبَسَهُ اللَّهُ ثَوْبًا مِثْلَهُ مِنَ النَّارِ، وَمَنْ قَامَ بِأَخِيهِ الْمُسْلِمِ مَقَامَ رِيَاءٍ وَسُمْعَةٍ، أَقَامَهُ اللَّهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مَقَامَ رِيَاءٍ وَسُمْعَةٍ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from one who heard al-Hasan say: The Prophet ﷺ said: "
entries.matn_en: Whoever eats a meal at the expense of his Muslim brother, God will feed him the like of it from Fire. Whoever wears a garment at the expense of his Muslim brother, God will clothe him with a like garment from the Fire. Whoever stands in a position of show and reputation on account of his Muslim brother, God will make him stand on the Day of Resurrection in a position of show and reputation."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: لَقِيَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ رَجُلًا مِنَ الْأَنْصَارِ مَهْمُومًا، فَقَالَ لَهُ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «مَا شَأْنُكَ؟» ، فَقَالَ: رَأَيْتُ فِي النَّوْمِ أَنِّي أَمُوتُ غَدًا، فَلَهَزَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي صَدْرِهِ وَقَالَ: «§أَلَيْسَ غَدًا الدَّهْرَ كُلَّهُ؟»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Zayd b. Aslam, who said:
entries.matn_en: The Prophet ﷺ met a man of the Ansar who was anxious, and the Prophet ﷺ said to him: "What is the matter with you?" He said: "I saw in a dream that I will die tomorrow." The Prophet ﷺ thumped him on his chest and said: "Is not tomorrow all of time?"

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ، قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: يُوشِكُ قَوْمٌ أَنْ يَأْكُلُوا بِأَلْسِنَتِهِمْ كَمَا تَأْكُلُ الْبَقَرُ بِأَلْسِنَتِهَا»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Zayd b. Aslam, from a man, from Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas, who said: "
entries.matn_en: A people are about to eat by their tongues, as cattle eat with their tongues."
