sections.title_en: Seeking Rain by the Stars, and Leniency

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ كَيْسَانَ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ الْجُهَنِيِّ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: صَلَّى بِنَا النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ الصُّبْحَ بِالْحُدَيْبِيَةِ فِي أَثَرِ سَمَاءٍ، فَقَالَ لَمَّا انْصَرَفَ: «لَمْ تَسْمَعُوا مَا قَالَ رَبُّكُمُ اللَّيْلَةَ؟ §مَا أَنْعَمْتُ عَلَى عِبَادِي نِعْمَةً إِلَّا أَصْبَحَ فَرِيقٌ مِنْهُمْ بِهَا كَافِرِينَ، فَأَمَّا مَنْ آمَنَ بِي وَحَمِدَنِي عَلَى سِقَائِي، وَأَثْنَى عَلَيَّ، فَذَلِكَ الَّذِي آمَنَ بِي وَكَفَرَ بِالْكَوْكَبِ، وَأَمَّا مَنْ قَالَ: مُطِرْنَا بِنَوْءِ كَذَا وَكَذَا، فَذَلِكَ الَّذِي آمَنَ بِالْكَوْكَبِ وَكَفَرَ بِي - أَوْ قَالَ: كَفَرَ نِعْمَتِي»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq told us: Ma'mar told us, from Salih b. Kaysan, from 'Ubaydullah b. 'Abdillah b. 'Utba, from Zayd b. Khalid al-Juhani, who said:
entries.matn_en: The Prophet ﷺ led us in the dawn prayer at al-Hudaybiya after rain had fallen in the night. When he turned from the prayer he said: "Did you not hear what your Lord said tonight? 'I have not bestowed a favor on My servants but a group of them became disbelievers in it. As for the one who believed in Me and praised Me for giving him rain and extolled Me, he is the one who believed in Me and disbelieved in the star. And as for the one who said: "We were given rain by the rising of such-and-such star," he is the one who believed in the star and disbelieved in Me,'" or he said: "disbelieved in My favor."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، قَالَ: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «§
entries.matn_ar: أَحَبَّ اللَّهُ عَبْدًا سَمْحًا إِذَا بَاعَ، سَمْحًا إِذَا اشْتَرَى، سَمْحًا إِذَا قَضَى، سَمْحًا إِذَا اقْتَضَى»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Zayd b. Aslam, who said: The Prophet ﷺ said: "
entries.matn_en: God loves a servant who is lenient when he sells, lenient when he buys, lenient when he pays, and lenient when he demands payment."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ خَلَّادِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَجُلًا مِنْ قُرَيْشٍ، يَقُولُ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «§
entries.matn_ar: لَوْ أَنَّ أَصْحَابَ الْبَقَرِ الَّذِينَ يَتَّبِعُونَ أَذْنَابَ ثِيرَانِهِمْ لَا يُشْرِكُونَ بِاللَّهِ شَيْئًا، سَبَقُوا النَّاسَ سَبْقًا بَعِيدًا، وَحَلَّتْ لَهُمْ كُلُّ حُلْوَةٍ، بَيْدَ أَنَّهُمْ يُعِينُونَ النَّاسَ بِأَعْمَالِ أَبْدَانِهِمْ وَيُغِيثُونَ أَنْفُسَهُمْ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Khallad b. 'Abd al-Rahman, who said: I heard a man of Quraysh say: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "
entries.matn_en: If it were that the owners of cattle, who follow the tails of their oxen and associate nothing with God, would outstrip people by a great distance, and every sweet thing would be lawful to them, except that they help people with the labor of their bodies and give help to themselves…" [the sentence is elliptical]

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «§
entries.matn_ar: تَصَدَّقُوا وَلَا تَحْقِرُوا» ، قَالُوا: عَلَى مَنْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ؟ قَالَ: «عَلَى النَّاسِ: الْأَسِيرِ، وَالْمِسْكِينِ، وَالْفَقِيرِ» ، قَالُوا: فَأَيُّ أَمْوَالِنَا أَفْضَلُ؟ قَالَ: «الْحَرْثُ وَالْغَنَمُ» ، قَالُوا: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فَالْإِبِلُ؟ قَالَ: «تِلْكَ عَنَاتِينُ الشَّيَاطِينِ، لَا تَغْدُو إِلَّا مُوَلِّيَةً، وَلَا تَرُوحُ إِلَّا مُوَلِّيَةً، وَلَا يَأْتِيهَا خَيْرُهَا إِلَّا مِنْ جَانِبِهَا الْأَيْسَرِ» ، قَالُوا: إِذًا يُسَيِّبُهَا النَّاسُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، قَالَ: «لَنْ يَقْدَمَ الْأَشْقِيَاءُ الْفَجَرَةُ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Qatada, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "
entries.matn_en: Give charity, and do not despise [any]." They said: "To whom, Messenger of God?" He said: "To people: the captive, the poor, the needy." They said: "Which of our properties is best?" He said: "Farmland and sheep." They said: "Messenger of God, and camels?" He said: "Those are the 'anatin of the devils. They go out only turning away and come back only turning away, and their good comes only from their left side." They said: "Then people will let them loose, Messenger of God." He said: "The wretched and wicked will not come forward." ['anatin is an obscure term.]

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، قَالَ: قِيلَ لِعُمَرَ: §
entries.matn_ar: سُيِّبَتِ الْإِبِلُ، قَالَ: «فَأَيْنَ الْأَشْقِيَاءُ؟» يَعْنِي الْحَمَّالِينَ
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Qatada, who said: It was said to 'Umar: "
entries.matn_en: The camels have been let loose." He said: "Then where are the wretched?" meaning the porters.

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْجَحْشِيِّ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: يَا أُمَّ هَانِئٍ §اتَّخِذِي غَنَمًا فَإِنَّهَا تَرُوحُ بِخَيْرٍ وَتَغْدُو بِخَيْرٍ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq told us: Ma'mar told us, from Sa'id ibn 'Abd al-Rahman al-Jahshi, that the Prophet ﷺ said: "
entries.matn_en: Umm Hani', acquire sheep, for they go out in good and return in good."

sections.title_en: The Shares of Inheritance and Archery Contests

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ، قَالَ: «إِنَّ §
entries.matn_ar: مَثَلَ مَنْ قَرَأَ الْقُرْآنَ وَلَمْ يَتَعَلَّمِ الْفَرِيضَةَ، كَمَثَلِ رَجُلٍ لَبِسَ بُرْنُسًا لَا وَجْهَ لَهُ» ، قَالَ: وَقَالَ عُمَرُ: «تَعَلَّمُوا بِالنِّضَالِ، وَتَحَدَّثُوا بِالْفَرِيضَةِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq told us: Ma'mar told us, from Qatada, that 'Umar b. al-Khattab said: "
entries.matn_en: The likeness of one who reads the Qur'an but does not learn the shares of inheritance is that of a man wearing a hooded cloak with no opening for the face." He said: And 'Umar said: "Learn archery contests, and talk about the shares of inheritance."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ سَلَّامٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ الْأَزْرَقِ، قَالَ: كَانَ عُقْبَةُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ الْجُهَنِيُّ يَخْرُجُ فَيَرْمِي كُلَّ يَوْمٍ وَيَسْتَتْبِعُهُ، فَكَأَنَّهُ كَادَ أَنْ يَمَلَّ، فَقَالَ لَهُ: أَلَا أُخْبِرُكَ؟ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ: «إِنَّ §
entries.matn_ar: اللَّهَ يُدْخِلُ بِالسَّهْمِ الْوَاحِدِ ثَلَاثَةَ نَفَرٍ الْجَنَّةَ، صَانِعَهُ الَّذِي يَحْتَسِبُ فِي صَنْعَتِهِ الْخَيْرَ، وَالَّذِي يُجَهِّزُ بِهِ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ» ، وَقَالَ: «ارْمُوا وَارْكَبُوا، وَإِنْ تَرْمُوا خَيْرٌ مِنْ أَنْ تَرْكَبُوا» ، وَقَالَ: «كُلُّ شَيْءٍ يَلْهُوَ بِهِ ابْنُ آدَمَ فَهُوَ بَاطِلٌ إِلَّا ثَلَاثًا: رَمْيُهُ عَنْ قَوْسِهِ، وَتَأْدِيبُهُ فَرَسَهُ، وَمُلَاعَبَتُهُ أَهْلَهُ، فَإِنَّهُنَّ مِنَ الْحَقِّ» قَالَ: «فَتُوُفِّيَ عُقْبَةُ وَلَهُ بِضْعَةٌ وَسَبْعُونَ قَوْسًا، مَعَ كُلِّ قَوْسٍ قَرْنٌ وَنَبْلٌ، فَأَوْصَى بِهِنَّ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq told us: Ma'mar told us, from Yahya b. Abi Kathir, from Zayd b. Sallam, from 'Abdullah b. Zayd al-Azraq, who said: 'Uqba b. 'Amir al-Juhani used to go out and shoot every day and take him along, and it seemed that he was about to grow weary. ['Uqba] said to him: "Shall I not tell you? I heard the Messenger of God ﷺ say: '
entries.matn_en: God admits three people to Paradise because of a single arrow: its maker, who seeks reward in his craft, and the one who equips [a fighter] with it in the way of God.'" [Only two are listed; the usual third is the one who shoots.] And he said: "Shoot and ride, but that you shoot is better than that you ride." And he said: "Everything with which the son of Adam amuses himself is vain except three: his shooting from his bow, his training of his horse, and his playing with his wife, for those are of the truth." He said: "'Uqba died leaving seventy-odd bows, each with a quiver and arrows, and he bequeathed them for the way of God."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، قَالَ: كَتَبَ عُمَرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ إِلَى عَدِيِّ بْنِ أَرْطَاةَ، وَكَانَ اسْتَعْمَلَهُ عَلَى الْبَصْرَةِ: «
entries.matn_ar: أَمَّا بَعْدُ، §فَإِنَّكَ غَرَرْتَنِي بِعِمَامَتِكَ السَّوْدَاءِ، وَمُجَالَسَتِكَ الْقُرَّاءَ، وَإِرْسَالِكَ الْعِمَامَةَ مِنْ وَرَائِكَ، فَإِنَّكَ أَظْهَرْتَ لِيَ الْخَيْرَ فَأَحْسَنْتَ، فَقَدْ أَظْهَرَنَا اللَّهُ عَلَى مَا كُنْتُمْ تَكْتُمُونَ، وَالسَّلَامُ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, who said: 'Umar b. 'Abd al-'Aziz wrote to 'Adi b. Artat, whom he had appointed over Basra: "
entries.matn_en: To proceed: you deceived me with your black turban, your sitting with the Qur'an reciters, and your letting the turban hang down behind you. You showed me goodness and I thought well of you. But God has now shown us what you used to conceal. Peace."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَمَّنْ سَمِعَ حَرَامَ بْنَ مُعَاوِيَةَ يَقُولُ: كَتَبَ إِلَيْنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ: «§
entries.matn_ar: لَا يُجَاوِرَنَّكُمْ خِنْزِيرٌ وَلَا يرفع فيكم صَلِيبٌ، وَلَا تَأْكُلُوا عَلَى مَائِدَةٍ يُشْرَبُ عَلَيْهَا الْخَمْرُ، وَأَدِّبُوا الْخَيْلَ، وَامْشُوا بَيْنَ الْغَرَضَيْنِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq told us: Ma'mar told us, from one who heard Haram b. Mu'awiya say: 'Umar b. al-Khattab wrote to us: "
entries.matn_en: Let no swine live as your neighbor, and let no cross be raised among you. Do not eat at a table at which wine is drunk. Train the horses, and walk between the two targets."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: الْفَرِيضَةُ ثُلُثُ الْعِلْمِ، وَالطَّلَاقُ ثُلُثُ الْعِلْمِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq told us: Ma'mar told us, from Qatada, who said: "
entries.matn_en: The shares of inheritance are a third of knowledge, and divorce is a third of knowledge."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: يَضْرِبُ وَلَدَهُ عَلَى الْحَقِّ» ،
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from 'Abdullah b. 'Umar, from Nafi', from Ibn 'Umar, that he said: "
entries.matn_en: He should strike his child for the sake of what is right."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ عَنِ الثَّوْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ،
entries.matn_ar: مِثْلَهُ
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from al-Thawri, from 'Ubaydullah b. 'Umar, from Nafi', from Ibn 'Umar,
entries.matn_en: the like of it.

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ: قَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ فَقَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: هَا هُنَا أَرْضُ الْفِتَنِ» وَأَشَارَ إِلَى الْمَشْرِقِ «وَحَيْثُ يَطْلُعُ قَرْنُ الشَّيْطَانِ - أَوْ قَالَ: قَرْنُ الشَّمْسِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, from Salim, from Ibn 'Umar, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ stood on the pulpit and said: "
entries.matn_en: Here is the land of trials," and he pointed toward the east, "and where the horn of Satan rises," or he said: "the horn of the sun."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، لَا أَعْلَمُهُ إِلَّا رَفَعَهُ قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: لَمْ يَخْلُقِ اللَّهُ خَلْقًا إِلَّا خَلَقَ مَا يَغْلِبُهُ، خَلَقَ رَحْمَتَهُ تَغْلِبُ غَضَبَهُ، وَخَلَقَ الصَّدَقَةَ تُطْفِئُ الْخَطِيئَةَ كَمَا يُطْفِئُ الْمَاءُ النَّارَ، وَخَلَقَ الْأَرْضَ فَأَزْخَرَتْ وَتَزَخْرَفَتْ، فَقَالَتْ: مَا يَغْلِبُنِي؟ فَخَلَقَ الْجِبَالَ فَوَتَدَهَا بِهَا، فَقَالَتِ الْجِبَالُ: غَلَبْتُ الْأَرْضَ فَمَا يَغْلِبُنِي؟ فَخَلَقَ الْحَدِيدَ، فَقَالَ الْحَدِيدُ: غَلَبْتُ الْجِبَالَ فَمَا يَغْلِبُنِي؟ فَخَلَقَ الْمَاءَ، فَقَالَ الْمَاءُ: غَلَبْتُ النَّارَ فَمَا يَغْلِبُنِي؟ فَخَلَقَ الرِّيحَ، قَالَ: فَرَدَّهُ فِي السَّحَابِ، فَقَالَتِ الرِّيحُ: غَلَبْتُ الْمَاءَ فَمَا يَغْلِبُنِي؟ فَخَلَقَ الْإِنْسَانَ يَبْنِي الْبِنَاءَ الَّذِي لَا تَنْفُذُهُ الرِّيحُ، فَقَالَ ابْنُ آدَمَ: غَلَبْتُ الرِّيحَ فَمَا يَغْلِبُنِي؟ فَخَلَقَ الْمَوْتَ، فَقَالَ الْمَوْتُ: غَلَبْتُ ابْنَ آدَمَ فَمَا يَغْلِبُنِي؟ فَقَالَ اللَّهُ: §أَنَا أَغْلِبُكَ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq told us: Ma'mar told us, from Zayd b. Aslam, who said (I know only that he raised it to the Prophet): "
entries.matn_en: God did not create any creature but He created something that overcomes it. He created His mercy to overcome His wrath, and He created charity to extinguish sin as water extinguishes fire. He created the earth, and it swelled and adorned itself, and it said: 'What can overcome me?' So He created the mountains and pegged it down with them. The mountains said: 'I have overcome the earth; what can overcome me?' So He created iron. Iron said: 'I have overcome the mountains; what can overcome me?' So He created water. Water said: 'I have overcome fire; what can overcome me?' [The creation of fire is missing from the text.] So He created the wind, and it drove [the water] into the clouds. The wind said: 'I have overcome water; what can overcome me?' So He created man, who builds a building that the wind cannot penetrate. The son of Adam said: 'I have overcome the wind; what can overcome me?' So He created death. Death said: 'I have overcome the son of Adam; what can overcome me?' And God said: 'I overcome you.'"

sections.title_en: Provision, and the Pledge of Allegiance to the Prophet ﷺ
sections.title_ar: بَابُ الرِّزْقِ وَمُبَايَعَةِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، أَوْ غَيْرِهِ قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: مَا جَاءَنِي أَجَلِي فِي مَكَانٍ مَا عَدَا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ أَحَبَّ إِلَيَّ مِنْ أَنْ يَأْتِيَنِي وَأَنَا بَيْنَ شُعْبَتَيْ رَحْلِي أَطْلُبُ مِنْ فَضْلِ اللَّهِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, from 'Ubaydullah b. 'Abdillah b. 'Umar or another, who said: "
entries.matn_en: My death does not come to me in any place, apart from in the way of God, more beloved to me than that it should come while I am between the two ends of my saddle, seeking God's bounty."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي إِدْرِيسَ الْخَوْلَانِيِّ، عَنْ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: بَايَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَفَرًا أَنَا فِيهِمْ، فَتَلَا عَلَيْنَا آيَةَ النِّسَاءِ: {لَا تُشْرِكُوا بِهِ} [النساء: ٣٦] الْآيَةَ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: «§مَنْ وَفَّى فَأَجْرُهُ عَلَى اللَّهِ، وَمَنْ أَصَابَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ شَيْئًا فَعُوقِبَ بِهِ فِي الدُّنْيَا، فَهُوَ لَهُ طُهْرَةٌ - أَوْ قَالَ: كَفَّارَةٌ -، وَمَنْ أَصَابَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ شَيْئًا فَسَتَرَهُ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ، فَأَمْرُهُ إِلَى اللَّهِ، إِنْ شَاءَ غَفَرَ لَهُ، وَإِنْ شَاءَ عَذَّبَهُ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq told us: Ma'mar told us, from al-Zuhri, from Abu Idris al-Khawlani, from 'Ubada b. al-Samit, who said:
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ took the pledge of a group of people of whom I was one, and recited to us the verse of the women: "[that] they not associate anything with Him" [cited in the text as 4:36] to the end of the verse. Then he said: "Whoever fulfills it, his reward is with God. Whoever commits any of that and is punished for it in this world, it is a purification for him (or he said: an expiation). And whoever commits any of that and God conceals it, his matter is with God: if He wishes He forgives him, and if He wishes He punishes him."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ: «
entries.matn_ar: جَاءَتْ فَاطِمَةُ بِنْتُ عُتْبَةَ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ لِتُبَايِعَ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، §فَأَخَذَ عَلَيْهَا أَلَّا تُشْرِكِي بِاللَّهِ شَيْئًا» الْآيَةَ، فَوَضَعَتْ يَدَهَا عَلَى رَأْسِهَا حَيَاءً، فَأَعْجَبَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مَا رَأَى مِنْهَا، فَقَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ: أَقِرِّي أَيَّتُهَا الْمَرْأَةُ، فَوَاللَّهِ مَا بَايَعْنَا إِلَّا عَلَى هَذَا، قَالَتْ: فَنَعَمْ إِذًا، فَبَايَعَهَا الْآيَةَ
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq told us: Ma'mar told us, from al-Zuhri, from 'Urwa, from 'A'isha, who said:
entries.matn_en: Fatima bint 'Utba b. Rabi'a came to pledge allegiance to the Prophet ﷺ, and he took from her [the pledge] that she would not associate anything with God, to the end of the verse. She put her hand on her head out of modesty, and the Messenger of God ﷺ was pleased by what he saw of her. 'A'isha said: "Accept, woman! By God, we pledged only to this." She said: "Then yes, indeed." And he accepted her pledge on the verse.

sections.title_en: Those Who Revile One Another, and Charity

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، قَالَ: بَعَثَ إِلَيَّ أَبُو قِلَابَةَ بِكِتَابٍ فِيهِ: «§
entries.matn_ar: الْزَمْ سُوقَكَ، وَاعْلَمْ أَنَّ الْغِنَى مُعَافَاةٌ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq told us: Ma'mar told us, from Ayyub, who said: Abu Qilaba sent me a letter in which was: "
entries.matn_en: Stay in your market, and know that wealth is well-being."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، قَالَ: كَانَ بَيْنَ أَبِي ذَرٍّ وَرَجُلٍ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ شَيْءٌ، فَعَيَّرَهُ أَبُو ذَرٍّ بِأُمٍّ كَانَتْ لَهُ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ، فَبَلَغَ ذَلِكَ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَ: «إِنَّ §
entries.matn_ar: فِيكَ يَا أَبَا ذَرٍّ لَحَمِيَّةً، مَا يَعْنِي أَسْوَدُ وَلَا أَخْضَرُ أَنْتَ خَيْرٌ مِنْهُ حَتَّى يَرْضَى عَنْكَ صَاحِبُكَ» قَالَ: فَانْطَلَقْتُ أَلْتَمِسُهُ فَأَبْصَرَنِي قَبْلَ أَنْ أُبْصِرَهُ، فَقَالَ: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا أَبَا ذَرٍّ فَجِئْتُ فَسَلَّمْتُ عَلَيْهِ، وَقُلْتُ: اسْتَغْفِرْ لِي، قَالَ: يَغْفِرُ اللَّهُ لَكَ، قَالَ: فَجِئْتُ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لَهُ، وَأَخْبَرْتُهُ أَنْ قَدْ رَضِيَ عَنِّي وَاسْتَغْفَرَ لِي، فَقُلْتُ: اسْتَغْفِرْ لِي يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، فَقَالَ: «يَغْفِرُ اللَّهُ لِصَاحِبِكَ» ثُمَّ قُلْتُ: اسْتَغْفِرْ لِي يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، فَقَالَ: «يَغْفِرُ اللَّهُ لِصَاحِبِكَ» ، قُلْتُ اسْتَغْفِرْ لِي يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، لَا أَعْلَمُهُ إِلَّا قَالَ فِي الثَّالِثَةِ: «غَفَرَ اللَّهُ لَكَ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Zayd b. Aslam, who said: There was something between Abu Dharr and a man among the Muslims, and Abu Dharr taunted him about a mother he had had in the pre-Islamic period. This reached the Prophet ﷺ, who said: "
entries.matn_en: In you, Abu Dharr, there is a zeal [of the pre-Islamic period]. You are no better than any black or green [person] until your companion is pleased with you." He said: I went to look for him, and he saw me before I saw him and said: "Peace be upon you, Abu Dharr." I came and greeted him and said: "Ask forgiveness for me." He said: "May God forgive you." He said: I came to the Prophet ﷺ and told him of that, and informed him that he was pleased with me and had asked forgiveness for me. I said: "Ask forgiveness for me, Messenger of God." He said: "May God forgive your companion." Then I said: "Ask forgiveness for me, Messenger of God." He said: "May God forgive your companion." I said: "Ask forgiveness for me, Messenger of God." I know only that he said on the third time: "God has forgiven you."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، قَالَ: أَقْرَأَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَامِرٍ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ صَدَقَتَهُ، فَقَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: حَسَنٌ إِنْ كَانَ طَيِّبًا، وَإِنْ كَانَ خَبِيثًا فَإِنَّ الْخَبِيثَ لَا يَكُونُ إِلَّا خَبِيثًا» قَالَ عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ: «يَعْنِي نَخْلَ عَرَفَاتٍ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Qatada, who said: 'Abdullah b. 'Amir had 'Abdullah b. 'Umar read his charitable endowment, and Ibn 'Umar said: "
entries.matn_en: Good, if it is pure. And if it is foul, then the foul is nothing but foul." 'Abd al-Razzaq said: "He meant the palm grove of 'Arafat."

sections.title_en: Whoever Initiates a Practice, and Harming the Predecessors
sections.title_ar: بَابُ مَنْ سَنَّ سُنَّةً وَآذَى السَّلَفَ

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: مَا مِنْ أَحَدٍ سَنَّ سُنَّةً صَالِحَةً يُعْمَلُ بِهَا بَعْدَهُ إِلَّا جَرَى عَلَيْهِ أَجْرُهَا، وَمِثْلُ أَجْرِ مَنْ عَمِلَ بِهَا بَعْدَهُ، وَمَنْ سَنَّ سُنَّةً سَيِّئَةً جَرَى عَلَيْهِ وَزْرُهَا وَوِزْرُ مَنْ عَمِلَ بِهَا بَعْدَهُ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Ibn Tawus, from his father, who said: "
entries.matn_en: No one initiates a good practice that is followed after him but its reward continues to flow to him, along with the like of the reward of whoever acts upon it after him. And whoever initiates a bad practice, its burden continues to fall on him, along with the burden of whoever acts upon it after him."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ هِلَالٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ هِلَالٍ، عَنْ جَرِيرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْبَجَلِيِّ:
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَجُلًا مِنَ الْأَنْصَارِ جَاءَ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِصُرَّةٍ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ تَمْلَأُ مَا بَيْنَ أَصَابِعِهِ، فَقَالَ: هَذِهِ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ، ثُمَّ قَامَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ فَأَعْطَى، ثُمَّ قَامَ عُمَرُ فَأَعْطَى، ثُمَّ قَامَ الْمُهَاجِرُونَ وَالْأَنْصَارُ فَأَعْطَوْا، قَالَ: فَأَشْرَقَ وَجْهُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ حَتَّى رَأَيْنَا الْإِشْرَاقَ فِي وَجْنَتَيْهِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «§مَنْ سَنَّ سُنَّةً صَالِحَةً فِي الْإِسْلَامِ فَعُمِلَ بِهَا بَعْدَهُ، كَانَ لَهُ مِثْلُ أُجُورِهِمْ مِنْ غَيْرِ أَنْ يَنْقُصَ مِنْ أُجُورِهِمْ شَيْئًا، وَمَنْ سَنَّ فِي الْإِسْلَامِ سُنَّةً سَيِّئَةً يُعْمَلُ بِهَا بَعْدَهُ، كَانَ عَلَيْهِ مِثْلُ أَوْزَارِهِمْ مِنْ غَيْرِ أَنْ يَنْقُصَ مِنْ أَوْزَارِهِمْ شَيْئًا»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq told us: Ma'mar told us, from Qatada, from Humayd b. Hilal, from 'Abd al-Rahman b. Hilal, from Jarir b. 'Abdillah al-Bajali:
entries.matn_en: A man of the Ansar came to the Prophet ﷺ with a purse of gold that filled the space between his fingers and said: "This is for the way of God." Then Abu Bakr stood and gave, then 'Umar stood and gave, then the Emigrants and the Ansar stood and gave. He said: The face of the Messenger of God ﷺ lit up until we saw the glow in his cheeks. Then the Prophet ﷺ said: "Whoever initiates a good practice in Islam and it is acted upon after him will have the like of their rewards, without anything being diminished from their rewards. And whoever initiates a bad practice in Islam and it is acted upon after him will bear the like of their burdens, without anything being diminished from their burdens."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: تَسَلَّفَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ رَجُلٍ مِائَةَ دِينَارٍ، أَوْ أَقَلَّ أَوْ أَكْثَرَ، فَقَالَ: لَا نُسَلِّفُكَ حَتَّى تَأْتِيَنِي بِحَمِيلٍ، قَالَ: مَا أَجِدُ أَحَدًا يَكْفُلُ عَلَيَّ، وَلَكِنْ لَكَ اللَّهُ حَمِيلٌ وَكَفِيلٌ أَنْ أُؤَدِّيَ إِلَيْكَ، قَالَ: فَأَسْلَفَهُ، قَالَ: فَرَكِبَ الْمُسَلِّفُ فِي الْبَحْرِ، فَحَلَّ الْأَجَلُ وَلَمْ يَسْتَطِعْ أَنْ يَرْكَبَ إِلَيْهِ، وَحَالَ بَيْنَهُمَا الْبَحْرُ، فَأَخَذَ عُودًا فَنَقَرَهُ، ثُمَّ وَضَعَ الدَّنَانِيرَ، وَكَتَبَ إِلَيْهِ كِتَابًا وَضَعَهُ مَعَ الدَّنَانِيرِ، ثُمَّ شَدَّ رَأْسَهُ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ تَحَمَّلْتَ عَلَيَّ وَمَنْ أَدَّى إِلَى الْكَفِيلِ فَقَدْ بَرِئَ، فَإِنِّي أُؤَدِّيَهَا إِلَيْكَ فَرَمَى بِالْعُودِ فِي الْبَحْرِ، فَضَرَبَهُ الرِّيحُ - أَوْ قَالَ: الْمَوْجُ - هَكَذَا وَهَكَذَا، فَقَالَ: لَوْ أَخَذْتُ هَذَا الْعُودَ حَطَبًا لِأَهْلِي، فَأَخَذَ الْعُودَ، فَلَمَّا دَخَلَ بَيْتَهُ كَسَرَهُ، فَإِذَا هُوَ بِالدَّنَانِيرِ وَالْكِتَابِ، وَإِذَا هُوَ مِنْ صَاحِبِهِ، فَضَرَبَ الدَّهْرُ حَتَّى جَاءَ صَاحِبُهُ، فَلَزِمَهُ، فَقَالَ: نَعَمْ وَاللَّهِ، إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَيَعْلَمُ أَنِّي قَدْ أَدَّيْتُهَا، قَالَ: فَسَكَتَ عَنْهُ وَذَهَبَ مَعَهُ لِيُنْقِدَهُ، فَلَمَّا أَخْرَجَهَا قَالَ: وَاللَّهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَيَعْلَمُ أَنِّي قَدْ أَدَّيْتُ، قَالَ: وَكَيْفَ أَدَّيْتَ؟ فَأَخْبَرَهُ كَيْفَ صَنَعَ، قَالَ: فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ أَدَّاهَا عَنْكَ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq told us: Ma'mar told us, from Ibn Tawus, from his father, who said: "
entries.matn_en:
A man borrowed a hundred dinars from another man (or fewer, or more). He said: 'I will not lend to you until you bring me a guarantor.' He said: 'I cannot find anyone to stand surety for me, but God is your guarantor and surety that I will pay you.' So he lent it to him. The borrower then sailed across the sea. The term fell due and he could not sail to him, and the sea came between them. So he took a piece of wood and hollowed it out, then put the dinars in it and a letter he wrote to him, and he put it with the dinars. Then he sealed its head and said: 'O God, You stood surety for me, and whoever pays the surety is discharged, so I pay it to You.' He threw the wood into the sea, and the wind (or he said: the wave) struck it this way and that.

"The lender said: 'If I were to take this piece of wood as firewood for my family.' So he took the wood, and when he entered his house he broke it, and there were the dinars and the letter, and it was from his debtor. Time passed until his debtor came, and he [the lender] seized hold of him. The debtor said: 'Yes, by God, God knows that I paid it.' The lender fell silent about it, and the debtor went with him to pay him. When he brought it out he said: 'By God, God knows that I paid.' The lender said: 'And how did you pay?' So he told him what he had done. He said: 'Then God has paid it on your behalf.'"

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ: «§
entries.matn_ar: كَانَ رَجُلٌ لَهُ أَرْبَعُ بَنِينَ، فَمَرِضَ، فَقَالَ أَحَدُهُمْ: إِمَّا أَنْ تُمَرِّضُوهُ وَلَيْسَ لَكُمْ مِنْ مِيرَاثِهِ شَيْءٌ، وَإِمَّا أَنْ أُمَرِّضَهُ وَلَيْسَ لِي مِنْ مِيرَاثِهِ شَيْءٌ، قَالُوا: بَلْ مَرِّضْهُ وَلَيْسَ لَكَ مِنْ مِيرَاثِهِ شَيْءٌ، قَالَ: فَمَرَّضَهُ حَتَّى مَاتَ، وَلَمْ يَأْخُذْ مِنْ مَالِهِ شَيْئًا، قَالَ: فَأُتِيَ فِي النَّوْمِ فَقِيلَ لَهُ: ايتِ مَكَانَ كَذَا وَكَذَا فَخُذْ مِنْهُ مِائَةَ دِينَارٍ، فَقَالَ فِي نَوْمِهِ: أَفِيهَا بَرَكَةٌ؟ قَالُوا: لَا، قَالَ: فَأَصْبَحَ، فَذَكَرَ ذَلِكَ لِامْرَأَتِهِ فَقَالَتْ: خُذْهَا، فَإِنَّ مِنْ بَرَكَتِهَا أَنْ نَكْتَسِيَ وَنَعِيشَ فِيهَا، قَالَ: فَأَبَى، فَلَمَّا أَمْسَى أُتِيَ فِي النَّوْمِ فَقِيلَ لَهُ: ايتِ مَكَانَ كَذَا وَكَذَا فَخُذْ مِنْهُ عَشْرَةَ دَنَانِيرَ، فَقَالَ: أَفِيهَا بَرَكَةٌ؟ قَالُوا: لَا، فَلَمَّا أَصْبَحَ ذَكَرَ ذَلِكَ لِامْرَأَتِهِ فَقَالَتْ: مِثْلَ مَقَالَتِهَا الْأُولَى، فَأَبَى أَنْ يَأْخُذَهَا، فَأُتِيَ فِي النَّوْمِ فِي اللَّيْلَةِ الثَّالِثَةِ: أَنِ ايتِ مَكَانَ كَذَا وَكَذَا فَخُذْ مِنْهُ دِينَارًا، قَالَ: أَفِيهِ بَرَكَةٌ؟ قَالُوا: نَعَمْ، قَالَ: فَذَهَبَ فَأَخَذَ الدِّينَارَ، ثُمَّ خَرَجَ بِهِ إِلَى السُّوقِ، فَإِذَا هُوَ بِرَجُلٍ يَحْمِلُ حُوتَيْنِ، فَقَالَ: بِكَمْ هُمَا؟ فَقَالَ: بِدِينَارٍ، فَأَخَذَهُمَا مِنْهُ بِالدِّينَارِ، ثُمَّ انْطَلَقَ بِهِمَا، فَلَمَّا دَخَلَ بَيْتَهُ شَقَّ الْحُوتَيْنِ فَوَجَدَ فِي بَطْنِ كُلِّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا دُرَّةً لَمْ يَرَ النَّاسُ مِثْلَهَا، قَالَ: فَبَعَثَ الْمَلِكُ لِدُرَّةٍ يَشْتَرِيهَا، فَلَمْ تُوجَدْ إِلَّا عِنْدَهُ، فَبَاعَهَا بِوَقْرٍ ثَلَاثِينَ بَغْلًا ذَهَبًا، فَلَمَّا رَآهَا الْمَلِكُ قَالَ: مَا تَصْلُحُ هَذِهِ إِلَّا بِأُخْتٍ اطْلُبُوا مِثْلَهَا، وَإِنْ أَضْعَفْتُمْ، فَجَاءُوهُ وَقَالُوا: عِنْدَكَ أُخْتُهَا وَنُعْطِيكَ ضِعْفَ مَا أَعْطَيْنَاكَ؟ قَالَ: وَتَفْعَلُونَ؟ قَالُوا: نَعَمْ، قَالَ: فَأَعْطَاهُمْ إِيَّاهَا بِضِعْفِ مَا أَخَذُوا الْأُولَى»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq told us: Ma'mar told us, from Ibn Tawus, from his father, who said: "
entries.matn_en: There was a man who had four sons, and he fell ill. One of them said: 'Either you nurse him and have no share of his inheritance, or I nurse him and have no share of his inheritance.' They said: 'No, you nurse him, and you have no share of his inheritance.' So he nursed him until he died and took nothing from his wealth. Then he was visited in his sleep and told: 'Go to such-and-such a place and take a hundred dinars from it.' He said in his sleep: 'Is there blessing in it?' They said: 'No.' So he woke and told his wife, and she said: 'Take it, for part of its blessing is that we shall be clothed and live on it.' He refused. When evening came he was visited in his sleep and told: 'Go to such-and-such a place and take ten dinars.' He said: 'Is there blessing in it?' They said: 'No.' When he woke he told his wife, and she said the same as she had said the first time, and he refused to take it. Then on the third night he was visited and told: 'Go to such-and-such a place and take one dinar.' He said: 'Is there blessing in it?' They said: 'Yes.' So he went and took the dinar and went out with it to the market. There was a man carrying two fish, and he said: 'How much for them?' He said: 'A dinar.' So he took them from him for the dinar and went off with them. When he entered his house he split open the two fish and found in the belly of each of them a pearl the like of which people had never seen. The king sent for a pearl to buy, and none could be found except with him, so he sold it for a load of thirty mules' worth of gold. When the king saw it he said: 'This is suited only by a sister to it. Seek its like, even if you must pay double.' They came to him and said: 'You have its sister, and we will give you double what we gave you.' He said: 'Will you really?' They said: 'Yes.' So he gave it to them for double what they had paid for the first."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ مِنَ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ، §لَقَدْ أَدْرَكْتُ أَقْوَامًا مِنَ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ لَوْ رَأَوْنِي أَجْلِسُ مَعَكُمْ لَسَخِرُوا مِنِّي»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq told us: Ma'mar told us, from al-Zuhri, from a man of the Emigrants, who said: "
entries.matn_en: By the One in whose hand is my soul, I met people among the Emigrants who, had they seen me sitting with you, would have mocked me."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِإِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّ لِي جَارًا عَامِلًا، وَإِنَّهُ دَعَانِي إِلَى طَعَامٍ، فَأَبَيْتُ أَنْ أُجِيبَهُ، فَقَالَ: «إِنَّ §
entries.matn_ar: الشَّيْطَانَ عَرَضَ بَيْنَكُمْ لِيُوقِعَ بَيْنَكُمُ الْعَدَاوَةَ، وَقَدْ كَانَتِ الْأُمَرَاءُ يَهْمِطُونَ ثُمَّ يَدْعُونَ فَيُجَابُونَ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq told us: Ma'mar told us, from Mansur, who said: I said to Ibrahim: "I have a neighbor who is a governor, and he invited me to a meal and I refused to accept." He said: "
entries.matn_en: Satan has put himself between you to cast enmity between you. And the rulers used to wrong people and then invite them, and they were answered."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ: «إِنَّ §
entries.matn_ar: مُعَلِّمَ الْخَيْرِ لِتُصَلِّي عَلَيْهِ دَوَابُّ الْأَرْضِ حَتَّى الْحِيتَانُ فِي الْبَحْرِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq told us: Ma'mar told us, from al-A'mash, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr, from Ibn 'Abbas, who said: "The creatures of the earth pray for the
entries.matn_en: teacher of good, even the fish in the sea."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ بْنِ أَبَانَ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، قَالَ: قَالَ عَلِيٌّ: «§
entries.matn_ar: خَمْسٌ احْفَظُوهُنَّ، لَوْ رَكِبْتُمُ الْإِبِلَ لَأَنْضَيْتُمُوهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ تُدْرِكُوهُنَّ: لَا يَخَافُ الْعَبْدُ إِلَّا ذَنْبَهُ، وَلَا يَرْجُو إِلَّا.. .، وَلَا يَسْتَحْيِي جَاهِلٌ أَنْ يَسْأَلَ، وَلَا يَسْتَحْيِي عَالِمٌ إِنْ لَمْ يَعْلَمْ أَنْ يَقُولَ: اللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ، وَالصَّبْرُ مِنَ الْإِنْسَانِ بِمَوْضِعِ الرَّأْسِ مِنَ الْجَسَدِ، إِذَا قُطِعَ الرَّأْسُ يَيْبَسُ مَا فِي الْجَسَدِ، وَلَا إِيمَانَ لِمَنْ لَا صَبْرَ لَهُ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq told us: Ma'mar told us, from al-Hakam b. Aban, from 'Ikrima, who said: 'Ali said: "
entries.matn_en: Five things, remember them: if you were to ride camels, you would wear them out before you attained them. A servant should fear only his sin; he should hope only [for his Lord…] [the text is incomplete here]. An ignorant person should not be ashamed to ask; and a knowledgeable one, if he does not know, should not be ashamed to say 'God knows best.' And patience, in a person, is in the place of the head in the body: when the head is cut off, what is in the body dries up. And there is no faith for one who has no patience."

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ النُّعْمَانَ بْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ الصَّنْعَانِيَّ، يُحَدِّثُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ يُوسُفَ، أَوْ أَيُّوبَ بْنَ يَحْيَى
entries.matn_ar: بَعَثَ إِلَى طَاوُسٍ بِسَبْعِ مِائَةِ دِينَارٍ - أَوْ خَمْسِ مِائَةٍ -، وَقِيلَ لِلرَّسُولِ: إِنْ أَخَذَهَا مِنْكَ فَإِنَّ الْأَمِيرَ سَيَكْسُوكَ وَيُحْسِنُ إِلَيْكَ، قَالَ: فَخَرَجَ بِهَا حَتَّى قَدِمَ عَلَى طَاوُسٍ الْجُنْدُ، فَقَالَ: يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ نَفَقَةٌ بَعَثَ بِهَا الْأَمِيرُ إِلَيْكَ، قَالَ: «§مَا لِي بِهَا حَاجَةٌ» ، فَأَرَادَهُ عَلَى أَخْذِهَا، فَفَعَلَ طَاوُسٌ، فَرَمَى بِهَا فِي كُوَّةِ الْبَيْتِ، ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ، فَقَالَ: قَدْ أَخَذَهَا، فَلَبِثُوا حِينًا، ثُمَّ بَلَغَهُمْ عَنْ طَاوُسٍ شَيْءٌ يَكْرَهُونَهُ، فَقَالُوا: ابْعَثُوا إِلَيْهِ، فَلْيَبْعَثْ إِلَيْنَا بِمَالِنَا، فَجَاءَهُ الرَّسُولُ فَقَالَ: الْمَالُ الَّذِي بَعَثَ بِهِ إِلَيْكَ الْأَمِيرُ؟ قَالَ: «مَا قَبَضْتُ مِنْهُ شَيْئًا» ، فَرَجَعَ الرَّسُولُ فَأَخْبَرَهُمْ، فَعَرَفُوا أَنَّهُ صَادِقٌ، فَقَالَ: انْظُرُوا الرَّجُلَ الَّذِي ذَهَبَ بِهَا، فَابْعَثُوا إِلَيْهِ، فَبَعَثُوهُ، فَجَاءَهُ، فَقَالَ: الْمَالُ الَّذِي جِئْتُكَ بِهِ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ؟ فَقَالَ: «هَلْ قَبَضْتُ مِنْكَ شَيْئًا؟» ، قَالَ: لَا، فَقِيلَ لَهُ: «تَدْرِي حَيْثُ وَضَعْتَهُ؟» ، قَالَ: نَعَمْ، فِي تِلْكَ الْكُوَّةِ، قَالَ: فَانْظُرْهُ حَيْثُ وَضَعْتَهُ، قَالَ: فَمَدَّ يَدَهُ، فَإِذَا هُوَ بِالصُّرَّةِ قَدْ بَنَتْ عَلَيْهِ الْعَنْكَبُوتُ، قَالَ: فَأَخَذَهَا فَذَهَبَ بِهَا إِلَيْهِمْ "
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq said: I heard al-Nu'man b. al-Zubayr al-San'ani narrating that Muhammad b. Yusuf, or Ayyub b. Yahya,
entries.matn_en: sent Tawus seven hundred dinars (or five hundred), and the messenger was told: "If he takes it from you, the amir will clothe you and be generous to you." So he set out with it until he came to Tawus at al-Janad, and said: "Abu 'Abd al-Rahman, this is provision that the amir has sent to you." He said: "I have no need of it." The messenger pressed him to take it, [but Tawus refused,] so he threw it into a niche in the wall of the house and left, saying: "He took it." [The text reads "so Tawus did so," which does not fit the sense.] They waited for a while, then something about Tawus reached them that they disliked, and they said: "Send to him, and let him send us our money." The messenger came to him and said: "The money that the amir sent to you?" He said: "I took nothing from him." The messenger returned and told them, and they knew that he was telling the truth. Then they said: "Look for the man who took it, and send him." So they sent for him, and he came to him and said: "The money I brought you, Abu 'Abd al-Rahman?" He said: "Did I take anything from you?" He said: "No." So he was told: "Do you know where you put it?" He said: "Yes, in that niche." He said: "Then look at where you put it." He reached out his hand and there was the purse, with a spider having built its web over it. So he took it and went with it to them.

entries.label: Entry
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنِ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ: «كَانَ §
entries.matn_ar: شَعْرُ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِلَى أَنْصَافِ أُذُنَيْهِ»
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd al-Razzaq told us: Ma'mar told us, from Thabit, from Anas, who said: "The
entries.matn_en: hair of the Prophet ﷺ reached to the middle of his ears."
